41643561.summary: Sixteen trials found that all six types of exercise improved physical function and mood in women with MS compared with control groups, with yoga ranking highest for psychological wellbeing.

40576014.conclusion_quote: TES shows promise as an effective and safe intervention for cognitive dysfunction in MS patients.
40576014.summary: Pooled results from nine studies suggest that brain stimulation with electrical currents may improve thinking abilities in people with MS, with mild side effects.

41930757.conclusion_quote: This study provides a comparative framework for evaluating herpetic reactivation rates during MS treatment with DMTs.
41930757.summary: Analysis of 78 studies found that MS drugs such as alemtuzumab carried higher rates of herpes virus reactivation than fingolimod or natalizumab.

41213786.conclusion_quote: Our systematic review and meta-analysis are the first to demonstrate an effect of AHSCT on female fertility in MS patients; however, small sample size and limited number of studies are the main limiting factors.
41213786.summary: Pooled data from four small studies found about 10 percent of women with MS became pregnant after stem cell transplant, but evidence is too limited to be certain.

41556318.conclusion_quote: Occupational therapy may improve daily functioning and mental-health-related quality of life post-intervention, regardless of the comparator intervention.
41556318.summary: Occupational therapy may improve daily functioning and mental health quality of life soon after treatment, but most of the evidence is low certainty.

42859432.conclusion_quote: The findings of this systematic review indicate that BD is relatively common among MS patients, who have an approximately threefold higher risk of developing BD than the general population.
42859432.summary: Bipolar disorder is fairly common in people with multiple sclerosis, affecting about 3 in 100, and they face roughly three times the risk compared with the general population.

40088718.conclusion_quote: In the current multilevel meta-analysis, we provided comprehensive treatment effects for T25FW in MS, confirming the better effects of ocrelizumab and fampridine.
40088718.summary: Pooling 41 studies, this review found that ocrelizumab and fampridine were associated with better walking speed on a timed 25-foot walk test in people with MS.

39551269.conclusion_quote: We determined that the prevalence of uveitis among pwMS is 1.1 %.
39551269.summary: Pooling 12 studies, researchers found about 1.1 percent of people with multiple sclerosis have uveitis, an eye inflammation, with intermediate uveitis the most common type.

42018029.conclusion_quote: Monoclonal antibodies are an effective option in RRMS, with clinical and radiological benefits superior to those of conventional treatments.
42018029.summary: Monoclonal antibody drugs reduced relapses and MRI brain activity in relapsing MS more than standard treatments, but effects on disability were inconsistent and side effects such as infections need monitoring.

40339263.conclusion_quote: Exercise exhibits the most significant benefits in enhancing information processing speed among MS patients, while the combination of virtual reality and exercise shows the best improvement for memory.
40339263.summary: Researchers combined 67 trials and found that exercise, mindfulness and virtual reality combined with exercise may help thinking skills in people with multiple sclerosis.

42956553.conclusion_quote: BFR therapy may improve lower-limb strength (more consistently for hamstrings than quadriceps) and may reduce fatigue in people with MS compared with exercise alone, but the certainty of the evidence is low.
42956553.summary: Adding blood flow restriction to exercise may modestly strengthen thigh and hamstring muscles and reduce fatigue in people with MS, though evidence is limited.

40467854.conclusion_quote: Our study indicates that physical exercise is an appropriate stimulus to increase BDNF release in MS patients.
40467854.summary: Exercise raised levels of a protein that supports brain health in people with MS, both right after a session and after up to three weeks of training.

39627054.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis revealed a significant dynamic nexus between MS and VD.
39627054.summary: Review of 23 studies found people with MS have more heart and blood vessel problems, and about one in six deaths in MS were linked to these.

39342812.conclusion_quote: The cumulative evidence supports that persons with MS have worse VF, notably greater arterial stiffness, than healthy controls.
39342812.summary: People with multiple sclerosis have worse blood vessel function than healthy people, mainly stiffer arteries, according to a review of 14 studies.

39740576.conclusion_quote: Studies with poorer VA outcome did not significantly differ in the proportion of patients with various ON regional enhancement patterns.
39740576.summary: Scans showing where optic nerve inflammation occurs did not predict how well people with MOG antibody optic neuritis regained sight across studies.

42455621.conclusion_quote: The aim is to support clinical decision-making by promoting a safe, individualized, and patient-centered intervention.
42455621.summary: This guideline gives doctors a structured way to check for and manage low antibody levels in MS patients on anti CD20 drugs, including when to give antibody replacement therapy.

39603062.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis suggests that a history of head trauma may be associated with an increased risk of developing MS.
39603062.summary: People with a history of head injury appear to have higher odds of developing multiple sclerosis, though the evidence is of low certainty.

42027697.conclusion_quote: Natalizumab may represent a viable therapeutic option for POMS patients exhibiting highly active disease or serves as an effective alternative in those with inadequate response to initial treatment.
42027697.summary: Natalizumab reduced relapses and improved disability in children with MS across 18 studies, with manageable side effects, though none of the studies were randomized trials.

39823691.conclusion_quote: Balance training may effectively improve overall and specific domains of cognitive function in persons with MS.
39823691.summary: Pooled studies suggest balance training can improve thinking skills such as memory and processing speed in people with MS, with longer weekly sessions giving bigger gains.

39406601.conclusion_quote: Adding the SWI method to routine sequences for MS investigation can provide useful diagnostic information.
39406601.summary: Combining 19 studies, researchers found that a special brain scan called SWI can help spot MS lesions and tell MS apart from similar diseases.

39246018.conclusion_quote: This study provides summary-level evidence for the high prevalence of MS misdiagnosis and underdiagnosis.
39246018.summary: Many people with MS are wrongly diagnosed or missed, with about 15 percent misdiagnosed and 36 percent underdiagnosed, and women were more often misdiagnosed.

40183837.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis suggest that ocrelizumab EID is not associated with greater odds of clinical and radiological disease activity in patients with MS.
40183837.summary: Pooled data from 16 studies found that stretching ocrelizumab doses further apart did not significantly increase relapses or MRI disease activity compared with standard dosing.

42678179.conclusion_quote: Dual-task training may represent a promising intervention to improve balance and gait speed in PwMS.
42678179.summary: Combining physical and thinking exercises improved balance and walking speed in people with MS, though the studies had quality concerns and more large trials are needed.

42682857.conclusion_quote: It is fundamental to screen patients with MS for OSA and offer management options such as continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) when appropriate.
42682857.summary: Around 44 percent of people with multiple sclerosis had obstructive sleep apnea, and they slept less and had more breathing pauses than healthy people.

41850122.summary: Ocrelizumab sometimes caused low white blood cell counts, usually early in treatment. Most cases were severe but caused mild illness, and treatment could often be restarted safely.

42287858.conclusion_quote: Exercise appears to improve physiological fitness, physical function, and disease impact, but not disability status.
42287858.summary: This review of 29 studies found exercise improved fitness, physical function and disease impact in people with severe MS, but not disability scores, with fewer gains in the most affected.

41960941.conclusion_quote: RS-tDCS appears feasible and may benefit select motor domains in MS; however, current evidence remains preliminary.
41960941.summary: Five studies found that remotely supervised brain stimulation may improve walking, balance, and hand skill in multiple sclerosis, though fatigue results were mixed and evidence is still preliminary.

41174823.conclusion_quote: Many parents with MS encounter substantial daily challenges due to fatigue, limited mobility, and cognitive difficulties.
41174823.summary: Review of 22 studies finds MS usually makes parenting harder, through fatigue, limited mobility and thinking difficulties, and support such as mental health care and family networks can help.

39642350.conclusion_quote: The results of this review and meta-analysis provide evidence that high-intensity interval training interventions improved and reduced fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis.
39642350.summary: Combined results from trials show that short bursts of hard exercise improved fitness and reduced tiredness in people with multiple sclerosis.

41989606.conclusion_quote: Iron-sensitive quantitative MRI captures clinically relevant deep gray matter (DGM) pathology associated with cognitive impairment in MS, with basal ganglia measures showing the strongest linkage with cognitive and clinical outcomes.
41989606.summary: A review of 12 studies found that brain scans sensitive to iron in deep brain regions, especially the basal ganglia, relate to thinking problems in MS.

42048775.conclusion_quote: OCT is a valuable diagnostic modality in cADS, particularly for detecting optic nerve lesions.
42048775.summary: Researchers reviewed studies of eye scans in children with inflammatory nerve disorders and found retinal thinning, especially after optic nerve inflammation, making the scan useful for diagnosis.

39692818.conclusion_quote: Recommendations for the treatment of relapses and chronic immunosuppressive treatment, including the most recent methods of immunotherapy, are also presented.
39692818.summary: A Polish expert guideline on diagnosing and treating neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, covering blood tests, brain scans, relapse treatment, long-term immune therapies, vaccination and pregnancy.

41762178.conclusion_quote: MRI is the cornerstone imaging modality, providing superior sensitivity over CT for detecting demyelinating lesions in the brain and spinal cord.
41762178.summary: This guideline says MRI is the best scan for finding demyelinating lesions in MS, NMOSD and MOGAD, and newer MRI features help doctors make more accurate diagnoses.

40939471.conclusion_quote: AZA and MMF reduce ARR and EDSS similarly to RTX but do not reduce relapse time.
40939471.summary: A review of 37 studies found rituximab, azathioprine and mycophenolate all reduce NMOSD attacks similarly, while rituximab causes fewer side effects but more infections.

41366504.conclusion_quote: Overall, tele-exercise is feasible and may support patient-centered care, but current evidence does not confirm significant improvements in balance and QoL for people with MS.
41366504.summary: Exercise done through technology did not clearly improve balance or quality of life in people with MS, though some trends were positive, and more high quality studies are needed.

40891169.conclusion_quote: A wide range of MDs in NMOSD were found, each with distinct features and frequency in literature.
40891169.summary: A review of 96 studies found that movement disorders are common in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, with tonic spasms or paroxysmal dystonia and ataxia being the most frequent.

41746227.conclusion_quote: None of the self-management measures identified are suitable for use during MS transition.
41746227.summary: Reviewers found no self-management questionnaire suitable for young people with MS moving to adult care, as existing tools miss key MS-specific topics.

39673046.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our systematic review and meta-analysis showed that NTZ can lead to reduction of intrathecal OCBs in MS patients, indicating a possible effect of NTZ on memory plasma cells, which are the main source of OCBs in MS.
39673046.summary: A review of eight studies found that natalizumab, an MS drug, can reduce oligoclonal bands, antibody markers in spinal fluid, in relapsing MS patients.

40187066.conclusion_quote: In patients with MS, HCBST significantly improves leg strength, walking, mobility and physical fatigue; while HCBST combined with balance training significantly improved walking, balance, fall, physical activity and quality of life.
40187066.summary: Strength training at home or in the community helped people with MS improve leg strength, walking, and balance, especially when combined with balance exercises.

40273120.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that probiotics can control the development of MS by reducing inflammatory conditions, and may have beneficial effects in the prevention and treatment of MS.
40273120.summary: A review of animal and human studies found that probiotics reduced inflammation and disease severity in MS, suggesting they may help slow its progression.

39709696.conclusion_quote: Tele-exercise can improve fatigue, depression, mental and physical health, and overall QoL in MS patients.
39709696.summary: Online-delivered exercise programs helped people with multiple sclerosis feel less tired and depressed, and improved their physical health and quality of life.

39674074.conclusion_quote: The limited available evidence suggests that subjective sleep quality is affected by MS and it should be considered by the clinicians for prevention of sleep-related symptoms such as depression and anxiety.
39674074.summary: Thirteen studies found people with MS reported worse sleep quality than healthy people, though the chance of poor sleep was not clearly higher.

42249339.conclusion_quote: CADASIL may occasionally present with MS like inflammatory features, .
42249339.summary: Some people with a genetic blood vessel disease called CADASIL were wrongly diagnosed with MS, so doctors should consider CADASIL when MS-like signs are atypical and test genes.

39637162.conclusion_quote: This study offers evidence suggesting that cortical lesion volume, brain volume, GMV, and MRI measurements of the spinal cord may constitute reliable indicators for assessing disability in pwMS.
39637162.summary: Brain scans measuring spinal cord size, lesion volume, and brain and grey matter shrinkage were linked to how severely disabled people with MS were.

39843649.conclusion_quote: The clinical presentation of recurrent MOGCE is atypical, and most patients had different symptoms upon recurrence compared to the first episode.
39843649.summary: Adults with recurrent MOG antibody-linked brain inflammation often have different symptoms on relapse, and most respond well to long-term immunotherapy.

40288459.conclusion_quote: This study confirms that non-pharmacological interventions can improve depression in MS patients.
40288459.summary: Researchers combined 33 trials and found that cognitive behavioral therapy, exercise, and education can help reduce depression in people with multiple sclerosis.

42242131.conclusion_quote: Vitamin D supplementation as an adjuvant therapy may reduce relapse and disability progression, with a favorable safety profile.
42242131.summary: A review of 32 trials found that vitamin D taken alongside usual treatment may reduce MS relapses and slow disability worsening, with few serious side effects.

41530978.conclusion_quote: The impact of walking impairment on community participation is perceived by persons with MS as negative and the cause of disconnect from those around them.
41530978.summary: Qualitative studies show that walking problems make people with MS feel disconnected from others and limit community life, with barriers seen as mainly outside themselves.

42416760.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that the pooled OR of developing MS in children with obesity is significantly high.
42416760.summary: Children with obesity appear to have higher odds of developing multiple sclerosis, based on pooling four studies, though the studies varied widely in their results.

41135262.conclusion_quote: Ibudilast demonstrates robust neuroprotection in progressive MS, particularly PPMS, with benefits on brain and retinal atrophy and chronic lesion activity.
41135262.summary: A drug called ibudilast appeared to slow brain shrinkage in progressive MS, especially primary progressive MS, but did not clearly slow disability worsening.

39799767.conclusion_quote: Early initiation of anti-IL6 therapies might help improve outcomes in such patients.
39799767.summary: A young girl developed seizures that did not respond to usual treatment because of MOG antibody disease, and a review of past cases suggests early anti IL6 treatment may help.

39053438.conclusion_quote: Waterpipe as one of the common ways of tobacco smoking becoming popular has an association with MS, and even the use of waterpipe for a certain period in the lifetime has a significant correlation with MS.
39053438.summary: Pooling five studies, people who ever smoked tobacco through a waterpipe were more likely to have multiple sclerosis than those who did not.

39798200.conclusion_quote: DTI measurements, including corpus callosum FA and MD, white matter FA, and fornix FA and MD, represent the indicators of cognitive performance in PwMS.
39798200.summary: Researchers pooled 38 studies and found that brain scan measures of white matter health in key areas are linked to thinking and memory in people with MS.

39378738.conclusion_quote: The study provides secondary evidence that CBT has moderate short-term and small long-term effects in reducing fatigue in patients with MS.
39378738.summary: Combining eight studies, this review found that cognitive behavioural therapy reduced fatigue in people with MS, with a moderate short term effect and a smaller long term effect.

39871045.conclusion_quote: Our study reveals significant correlations between MRI techniques and histological assessments of myelin, axonal damage, and gliosis in MS.
39871045.summary: Researchers pooled 38 studies of donated brain tissue and found MRI scans track myelin loss in MS well, especially within lesions.

40722137.conclusion_quote: The levels of GFAP and NfL in MS and NMOSD patients were significantly higher than those in healthy controls.
40722137.summary: Pooled studies found higher blood levels of two nerve damage markers, GFAP and NfL, in people with MS and NMOSD than in healthy people, suggesting diagnostic potential.

42704608.conclusion_quote: Anti-CD20 therapies provide effective control of relapse and MRI disease activity compared with teriflunomide in RMS.
42704608.summary: Anti CD20 drugs cut relapses and MRI lesions more than teriflunomide in relapsing MS, but raise serious side effects slightly. Brain shrinkage was similar between the two.

41983559.conclusion_quote: Implementation of this protocol is essential for establishing reliable diagnoses, ensuring adequate disease monitoring, and supporting critical clinical decisions regarding treatment initiation and modification.
41983559.summary: Polish neurology and radiology societies updated their recommended MRI scanning protocol for people with multiple sclerosis, adding optic nerve scans and newer markers to support accurate diagnosis.

41074564.conclusion_quote: This review underscores the lack of dyadic-focused intervention studies for couples living with MS, highlighting the need for more RCTs with comparable outcomes to assess the effectiveness of such interventions.
41074564.summary: This review of eight studies suggests couple programs may improve relationship quality, sexual satisfaction and quality of life, but the evidence is weak and more trials are needed.

39874745.conclusion_quote: pRNFL and mGCIPL thickness are correlated with MRI measurements, suggesting that OCT can serve as a non-invasive, cost-effective, and complementary tool to MRI for enhancing the exploring of brain structural changes in PwMS.
39874745.summary: Pooling 68 studies of 6168 people with MS, researchers found that eye scan thickness measures track brain MRI findings, suggesting OCT could be a low cost, non invasive complement to MRI.

39826442.conclusion_quote: Although the prevalence of multiple sclerosis in Brazil varies substantially between regions, it is in accordance with what is known in the world.
39826442.summary: Eleven studies pooled in this review estimate about 14.5 multiple sclerosis cases per 100,000 people in Brazil, with most patients being women and having the relapsing form of disease.

39225447.conclusion_quote: Educational interventions for people with MS-related fatigue may be effective in reducing fatigue in the short term.
39225447.summary: Education programmes helped reduce fatigue in people with MS in the short term, though long term benefits remain unclear and need more research.

42480206.conclusion_quote: These Malaysian consensus statements provide a practical and locally relevant framework to support more consistent and evidence-based NMOSD care.
42480206.summary: Malaysian experts agreed on 36 recommendations for diagnosing and treating NMOSD, a rare condition that attacks the spinal cord and optic nerves, plus three extra points on related conditions.

39453915.conclusion_quote: MSAU primarily affects young adult females, typically presenting as bilateral intermediate uveitis with vision-related complications.
39453915.summary: Pooling 36 studies, this review found that uveitis linked to MS mostly strikes young women, usually in both eyes, and most people have relapsing MS.

42215611.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that emotion-recognition deficits in MS seem partially connected to neurocognitive dysfunctions.
42215611.summary: A meta-analysis of 23 studies found that people with MS who struggle to recognize emotions tend to have weaker thinking and memory skills, especially processing speed and executive function.

41874037.conclusion_quote: SELs are revealed to affect around half of PwMS and are associated with disability and disease progression in MS.
41874037.summary: Slowly expanding lesions, a brain scan marker of smouldering inflammation, were found in about 57 percent of people with MS and linked to worse disability.

41344139.conclusion_quote: The diverse range of interventions offer flexibility and accessibility and appear to be promising solutions in addressing the diverse needs of ICs.
41344139.summary: Digital tools such as online programs and video consultations may help reduce stress and improve wellbeing for people caring for someone with MS, but more research is needed.

42005664.conclusion_quote: Given the higher prevalence of SI in people with MS than in the general population, it should be considered during routine clinical visits and psychological evaluations.
42005664.summary: About one in five people with multiple sclerosis have thoughts of suicide, higher than in the general population, and depression, anxiety, and disability raise the risk.

39068819.conclusion_quote: PwMS were at a substantially increased risk of developing osteopenia (2-fold), osteoporosis (1.7-fold), and overall fractures (1.9-fold).
39068819.summary: People with multiple sclerosis have higher risks of weak bones, osteoporosis and broken bones than healthy people, according to a review of 51 studies.

40754128.conclusion_quote: Our umbrella review demonstrates that participants living with MS exhibit significantly elevated serum Hcy levels, along with reduced concentrations of VB12 and folate, compared to healthy controls.
40754128.summary: People with multiple sclerosis tend to have lower blood levels of vitamin B12 and folate and higher levels of homocysteine than healthy people, according to combined past studies.

39276596.conclusion_quote: CBT-based interventions appear efficacious for the management of depression and anxiety symptoms in adults with MS.
39276596.summary: A review of 15 trials found that cognitive behavioural therapy moderately reduced depression and slightly reduced anxiety in adults with multiple sclerosis.

39270413.conclusion_quote: This review found evidence in favour of telerehabilitation using exergaming and Pilate-based interventions.
39270413.summary: Five trials suggest that remote rehabilitation, such as video games and Pilates exercises, improves walking and balance in people with multiple sclerosis, and is practical to deliver.

39661205.conclusion_quote: DTI proves promising for identifying microstructural abnormalities in cerebellar peduncles of RRMS patients, with decreased FA and increased RD, and MD values observed.
39661205.summary: Brain scans using a method called diffusion tensor imaging found tissue damage in the cerebellar peduncles, the brain's connecting pathways, of people with relapsing MS.

39613552.conclusion_quote: Overweight and obese individuals are at increased risk for MS, emphasizing the significance of weight status in MS susceptibility.
39613552.summary: People who are overweight or obese have a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, while being underweight did not change the risk.

42954086.conclusion_quote: ST appears well tolerated and may improve flexibility while also being potentially associated with clinically meaningful improvements in mobility, spasticity, pain, and fatigue in PwMS.
42954086.summary: Seven small studies suggest stretching is well tolerated by people with MS and may improve flexibility, walking, stiffness, pain and tiredness, but the evidence is weak.

42921615.conclusion_quote: The current PAG-MS appear to be effective in improving QOL in people with MS.
42921615.summary: Pooling 19 trials with 891 people, exercise meeting new MS guidelines improved quality of life, with physical and mental scores passing clinical significance thresholds.

42696515.conclusion_quote: Overall, rTMS appears generally well tolerated in small trials, with short-term symptomatic improvements reported in some domains.
42696515.summary: Small trials suggest repeated magnetic brain stimulation may reduce spasticity and modestly ease fatigue and low mood in MS, with few side effects, though larger studies are needed.

40049384.conclusion_quote: Among technology-based physical rehabilitation approaches, exergaming interventions have shown promising effectiveness in improving balance in people with multiple sclerosis.
40049384.summary: Pooled studies found that exercise programs using technology modestly improved balance in people with MS, with active video game training appearing most helpful.

41892831.conclusion_quote: The findings support robust relapse suppression across monoclonal antibody therapies within comparable trial frameworks, while highlighting heterogeneity in disability outcomes.
41892831.summary: Monoclonal antibody drugs strongly reduced relapses in MS trials compared with their control treatments, but evidence on slowing disability was mixed and no overall ranking was possible.

40818446.conclusion_quote: The most robust drivers of long-term disability in MS were related to the degree of initial brain damage and its limited repair capacity.
40818446.summary: A review of 241 studies found the strongest predictors of future disability in multiple sclerosis are early brain damage and poor repair, plus age and disease duration.

39421950.conclusion_quote: This review suggests, with a very-low-to-low certainty of evidence, that while some specific serious games may improve balance, fatigue and visuo-spatial memory, their overall effect on upper limb activity, gait, and other cognitive functions appears neutral.
39421950.summary: Virtual reality serious games gave mixed results for people with MS: some helped balance, fatigue and visual memory, while most other outcomes showed no clear effect.

39416662.conclusion_quote: The prevalence of MS-related fatigue is quite high.
39416662.summary: A review of 69 studies found that about 59 percent of people with multiple sclerosis experience fatigue, with higher rates in women, older people, and those with more disability.

41161577.conclusion_quote: Acupuncture therapies are potential treatment options for MS, and are relatively safe.
41161577.summary: Acupuncture added to standard medicine appeared to improve disability and quality of life in people with MS, with few mild side effects, though evidence quality is low.

41009767.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the value of metabolomics for biomarker discovery and support its integration into personalized therapeutic strategies in MS.
41009767.summary: A review of 29 studies found that metabolomics, which measures small molecules in body fluids, shows promise for finding new multiple sclerosis biomarkers and subtypes.

39457238.conclusion_quote: The main finding of this research confirms that psychiatric disorders often co-occur with MS, impacting the clinical symptoms and life quality of patients living with this illness.
39457238.summary: This review found that roughly one in five people with MS have depression, and mental health conditions such as anxiety and high neuroticism often occur alongside the disease.

39659961.conclusion_quote: Exercise is an effective method for improving fatigue and muscular fitness in patients with MS.
39659961.summary: Exercise, especially mind body practices and resistance training, reduced tiredness in people with MS, and high intensity interval training best improved muscle fitness.

39064479.conclusion_quote: Regarding that GFAP is increased in MS and NMOSD and has correlations with disease features, it can be a potential biomarker in MS and NMOSD and indicate the disease progression and disability in these disorders.
39064479.summary: GFAP, a brain protein, was higher in people with MS and NMOSD than in healthy people, and levels were linked to disability.

39180838.conclusion_quote: Vitamin D deficiency is associated with an increased likelihood of multiple sclerosis.
39180838.summary: Pooling 14 studies, people with low vitamin D had higher odds of MS, though whether studies excluded vitamin D supplement users changed the results.

39741703.conclusion_quote: The current literature shows that the incidence of OSAHS is higher in MS patients.
39741703.summary: Sleep apnea was found in about a quarter to a third of people with MS, depending on the screening test used, suggesting it is more common in MS.

41574448.conclusion_quote: In MS, treatment effects on s/pNfL are moderately associated with therapeutic effects on ARR, MRI new/enlarging T2 lesions, and CDW, whereas no consistent association was observed with PBVC.
41574448.summary: Across 15 MS drug trials, blood nerve-damage marker NfL changes moderately tracked relapse, new lesion and disability outcomes, but not brain volume loss.

39151239.conclusion_quote: Our study provides preliminary evidence for the potential role of training in reducing blood NfL levels in pwMS.
39151239.summary: Exercise programs were linked to lower blood levels of a nerve damage marker in people with MS, though the evidence is preliminary and needs stronger studies.

41975171.conclusion_quote: Additionally, MS does not alter the risk of developing T2DM.
41975171.summary: About 5% of people with MS have type 2 diabetes, and MS does not appear to change the risk of developing it, according to a review of 45 studies.

41106279.conclusion_quote: B-cell repopulation appears to be temporally associated with relapses in NMO, highlighting the potential value of CD19+ and CD27+ monitoring by flow cytometry to guide retreatment strategies.
41106279.summary: A review of 22 studies found that B cell recovery after rituximab often came before relapses in NMO, though some relapses happened without it.

39577299.conclusion_quote: Physical activity appears beneficial in improving cardiovascular fitness and managing some traditional CVD risk factors in adults with MS.
39577299.summary: Exercise programs improved fitness and lowered some heart disease risk factors, such as blood fats and body fat, in adults with MS across 30 studies.

42879060.conclusion_quote: Although these mechanistic observations provide biological plausibility for further investigation of these agents as potential repurposed therapies for MS, particularly in the context of remyelination and neuroinflammation, they remain based on preclinical evidence and should therefore be considered hypothesis-generating.
42879060.summary: Five animal studies suggest that drugs blocking leukotriene inflammatory signals may reduce disease severity and aid myelin repair, but human evidence is still needed.

39073308.conclusion_quote: As conclusion, the study highlights substantial thinning in the pRNFL and macular GCIPL between MS versus controls.
39073308.summary: A pooled analysis of 100 studies found that the retinal nerve layers at the back of the eye are thinner in people with multiple sclerosis than in healthy people.

42611952.conclusion_quote: Anti-inflammatory diets may improve MS clinical manifestations, especially fatigue and disability; therefore, more research is needed to confirm the present findings.
42611952.summary: Diets designed to reduce inflammation may lessen fatigue and improve physical health in people with MS, but the evidence from 10 small trials is limited.

41015666.conclusion_quote: With good safety and efficacy profiles in treating relapsing multiple sclerosis, both of the BTKis (Evobrutinib and Tolebrutinib) show promise.
41015666.summary: Tolebrutinib and evobrutinib, two oral drugs, reduced brain inflammation and relapses in relapsing MS with generally mild side effects, though more trials are needed.

39917858.conclusion_quote: These findings support the efficacy of laquinimod in managing RRMS but necessitate careful monitoring during treatment.
39917858.summary: Pooling four trials of 3,665 people, laquinimod reduced relapses and delayed disability worsening at three months, with safety similar to placebo.

42080501.conclusion_quote: AFOs improve specific biomechanical deficits (e.g. ankle motion) in PwMS, and dynamic designs may enhance endurance.
42080501.summary: Sixteen studies found leg braces called ankle foot orthoses did not change walking speed but improved ankle movement, and dynamic designs may help walking endurance.

39311403.conclusion_quote: Resistance training was found to significantly improve walking speed in people with MS.
39311403.summary: Strength training of the legs modestly improved walking speed in people with MS, though results varied between studies, so more research is needed on how to prescribe it.

39260078.conclusion_quote: The meta-analysis suggests a notable improvement in MS-related fatigue following acupuncture, both compared to controls and pre-treatment levels, positioning it as a potential adjunct therapy.
39260078.summary: A review of six studies found acupuncture reduced fatigue and improved quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis, though the studies had quality concerns.

41205558.conclusion_quote: PRLs are associated with an increased risk of MS progression through PIRA.
41205558.summary: Brain lesions with a visible rim on special MRI scans were linked to a higher chance of MS getting worse, including disability growth not caused by relapses.

39960275.conclusion_quote: The reviewed studies showed that foot reflexology positively impacts the management of multiple sclerosis-related fatigue.
39960275.summary: Seven studies found that foot reflexology, a therapy applying pressure to the feet, generally reduced fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis.

39182455.conclusion_quote: The Japanese guidelines for clinical practice on MS, NMOSD, and MOGAD were updated.
39182455.summary: Japan updated its clinical guidelines for multiple sclerosis, neuromyelitis optica and MOG antibody disease, giving treatment recommendations for doctors in 2023.

38901931.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this systematic review and meta-analysis provides evidence of a positive association between higher DII scores with the likelihood of developing MS, highlighting that diet-induced inflammation could play a role in MS or other demyelinating autoimmune diseases risk.
38901931.summary: Five studies found that a more inflammatory diet was linked to higher odds of developing MS, though one measure showed no clear link.

42155970.conclusion_quote: Resistance training is effective and safe for ambulatory individuals with multiple sclerosis.
42155970.summary: Pooled trials found resistance training improved leg strength, walking, fatigue and quality of life in people with MS, with programs over 20 sessions showing the clearest functional benefits.

41940302.conclusion_quote: This review highlights gaps in studies targeting the experience of WwMS in managing reproductive health in low- and middle-income countries.
41940302.summary: A review of 29 studies found that women with MS often lack reliable reproductive health information, and little research comes from poorer countries.

42130400.conclusion_quote: Amantadine, dalfampridine, and methylphenidate were found to be superior to placebo in improving the impact of fatigue on patients' lives.
42130400.summary: Amantadine, dalfampridine and methylphenidate reduced how much fatigue affected daily life in people with MS, while other tested drugs showed no clear benefit over placebo.

41032996.conclusion_quote: Suboptimal dosing of DMTs in MS is a growing treatment strategy to enhance patient adherence and reduce adverse events.
41032996.summary: Lower or less frequent doses of MS drugs reduced side effects in many studies, while effects on relapses and disability were mostly similar to standard doses, though evidence was limited.

38608788.conclusion_quote: Persistent, low-grade inflammation in MS could be upregulated by non-pharmacological complementary therapies, in particular by regular aerobic PA that could reduce and positively modulate inflammation.
38608788.summary: A review of studies found that regular physical activity, especially aerobic exercise, is linked to lower inflammation in people with multiple sclerosis.

41604238.conclusion_quote: Genetic predisposition to MS is a causal factor for TN.
41604238.summary: A genetic analysis suggests that people genetically predisposed to multiple sclerosis have an 11 percent higher risk of developing trigeminal neuralgia, a facial nerve pain condition.

41428098.conclusion_quote: The most promising direction is the shift toward blood-based biomarkers, due to their minimally invasive nature and potential for clinical applicability, which may enable clinicians to anticipate, monitor, and potentially modify the cognitive trajectory of people living with MS.
41428098.summary: This review of longitudinal studies found mixed evidence that blood and spinal fluid markers can predict thinking decline in MS, with some markers like BDNF and microRNAs showing promise.

38489946.conclusion_quote: PwMS are twice as likely to experience migraine as controls, but the results need to be translated with caution since most of the studies included in the meta-analysis were of low or moderate quality.
38489946.summary: People with multiple sclerosis appear to have migraine more often than people without it, but the studies were of modest quality, so more solid research is needed.

38885600.conclusion_quote: We conclude that thalamic volume exhibits highest relationships with information processing speed (IPS), visuospatial learning-memory, verbal learning-memory, and executive function in pwMS.
38885600.summary: Researchers pooled 136 studies and found that thalamus volume on MRI was most strongly linked to thinking speed, memory, and executive function in people with MS.

40849402.conclusion_quote: Functional exercise training for pwMS is a comprehensive approach to achieving functional improvements, strength gains, and improved endurance simultaneously, thereby promoting beneficial health effects.
40849402.summary: A review of 19 studies found functional exercise, which mixes strength, balance and coordination training, may help people with MS, though results varied widely and adherence was poorly reported.

39515028.conclusion_quote: Our findings emphasize the complexity in carrying drugs from animals to clinical practice.
39515028.summary: Researchers reviewed 497 animal studies of multiple sclerosis drugs and found that animal results did not reliably predict which drugs would be approved for people.

42585300.conclusion_quote: Non-pharmacological interventions may provide modest short-term physical health-related quality-of-life benefits.
42585300.summary: Exercise, rehabilitation and behavioural programmes gave people with early MS a small short term boost in physical quality of life, while effects on mental wellbeing were uncertain.

41579245.conclusion_quote: This review indicated that the overall frequency 10.7% of OCD increased risk (3.2-fold) of OCD among PwMS.
41579245.summary: About one in ten people with multiple sclerosis had obsessive compulsive disorder, and they had higher odds of it than healthy people.

39053021.conclusion_quote: Regular exercise can help to stabilise mood for people living with multiple sclerosis, regardless of session frequency or duration.
39053021.summary: Exercise lowered depression symptoms in people with MS across 22 studies, but the benefit faded after training stopped.

38054069.conclusion_quote: Our study has the potential to influence more assertive public policies.
38054069.summary: Some jobs, such as offshore work, pesticide exposure, and farming, were linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis in this review of studies.

40505709.conclusion_quote: The evidence suggests that hypnotherapy can be an effective additional strategy for MS symptom management, with hypnotic cognitive treatment exhibiting notable efficacy for tiredness and psychosocial problems.
40505709.summary: Hypnotherapy helped people with multiple sclerosis reduce pain, tiredness, poor sleep and low mood, with better results when combined with other treatments.

41692184.conclusion_quote: These best practice recommendations aim to promote consistency, accuracy, and clinical utility of CSF OCB testing for MS diagnosis in Canada.
41692184.summary: Canadian laboratory experts agreed on 24 best practice recommendations for testing spinal fluid for bands that help diagnose multiple sclerosis.

38522226.conclusion_quote: Available evidence suggested a link between TC and LDL with cognitive outcomes of MS patients which was not evident in our quantitative synthesis.
38522226.summary: Pooled studies found that higher total cholesterol was linked to lower thinking test scores in people with MS, while other blood fats showed no clear link.

42659570.conclusion_quote: The identification of IgG antibodies against aquaporin-4 (AQP4-IgG) has transformed the understanding and classification of the disease, distinguishing it from other inflammatory CNS disorders.
42659570.summary: This guideline gives recommendations for diagnosing and treating a rare autoimmune disease affecting the optic nerve and spinal cord in children and teenagers.

40459586.conclusion_quote: Limited evidence suggests that SEC and IXE may be safe and effective treatment options in patients with comorbid MS, either as monotherapies or in combination with MS-specific DMTs.
40459586.summary: Across 19 studies of 42 people, secukinumab and ixekizumab appeared fairly safe and somewhat helpful for people with both MS and skin or joint disease, though evidence is limited.

38010852.conclusion_quote: SARS-CoV-2, with a 3.74 odds ratio, has a significantly more potent negative effect on MS among viral infections.
38010852.summary: Researchers combined earlier studies on 12 viruses and found that the COVID virus and Epstein Barr virus showed the strongest links to multiple sclerosis.

41563513.conclusion_quote: In summary, this current meta-analysis suggested that the IL-10 gene polymorphisms may be the substantial factors for the development of MS.
41563513.summary: Pooled studies suggest that certain variants in the immune gene IL10 may raise the chance of developing multiple sclerosis, though results varied across studies.

38810817.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis revealed comparable results between home- and center-based balance training in terms of balance and mobility improvement.
38810817.summary: Home-based balance exercises worked about as well as clinic-based training for balance and mobility in people with MS, with little extra benefit over no training except for standing balance.

38890188.conclusion_quote: In this rigorously conducted systematic review, we found a significant association of cognitive changes, specifically SDMT/PASAT and verbal fluency, to changes in T2LV and atrophy in individuals with MS.
38890188.summary: Researchers found that changes in thinking speed and word fluency were linked to changes in brain lesions and shrinkage over time, though evidence is limited.

38988104.conclusion_quote: The data indicates that modafinil confers a therapeutic benefit when treating fatigue in patients with MS and improves overall quality of life; however, there is a risk of precipitating adverse events.
38988104.summary: Pooled trials found modafinil reduced fatigue and sleepiness more than placebo and improved quality of life, but it caused more side effects such as insomnia.

38906489.conclusion_quote: Taken together studies indicate a minor to modest impact of psychological stressors on disease onset, inflammatory activity and progression of MS.
38906489.summary: Psychological stress appears to have a small to moderate effect on whether MS starts, on relapses and on how fast disability gets worse, though many studies were weak.

38703425.conclusion_quote: Pregnant women with MS have a greater chance of adverse pregnancy results than pregnant women without MS.
38703425.summary: Pregnant women with multiple sclerosis appear more likely to have cesarean deliveries, preterm births, congenital malformations, and small babies than women without MS.

41657373.conclusion_quote: Tailored exercise and psychoeducation significantly benefit sexual function in MS, while other therapies like yoga require refinement; future research should investigate long-term outcomes and patient-specific factors.
41657373.summary: Exercise, mindfulness and psychoeducation improved sexual function in people with MS in this review, while yoga did not clearly help. Most studies were short-term.

39105769.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates an increase in CP volume among MS patients compared to HCs, implying the potential involvement of CP in MS pathogenesis and/or progression.
39105769.summary: Researchers pooled 17 studies and found that people with multiple sclerosis have larger choroid plexus structures in the brain than healthy people, suggesting this tissue may help indicate the disease.

38172026.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this systematic review and meta-analysis revealed that disability in patients with MS is linked to extensive changes in different brain regions, encompassing gray and white matter, as well as T1 and T2 weighted MRI lesions.
38172026.summary: This review of 105 studies found that several brain MRI measures, such as lesion volume and grey and white matter volume, are linked to disability in MS.

40066932.summary: Rituximab, an antibody therapy, may reduce relapses in people with MS, but evidence on disability is unclear and it may increase some serious infections.

38660348.conclusion_quote: Exercise had beneficial effects in improving balance, walking ability, walking endurance, fatigue, and quality of life in people with MS.
38660348.summary: Exercise improved balance, walking, endurance, fatigue and quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis across 40 studies.

41108054.conclusion_quote: Nevertheless, the field remains at an early discovery stage, with no near-term clinical applicability demonstrated.
41108054.summary: This review found that the gene-editing tool CRISPR shows promise for repairing nerve coverings in rare peripheral nerve disorders, but it is still at an early research stage.

38142541.conclusion_quote: The majority of MS patients vaccinated for COVID-19 or seasonal influenza mount an adequate immune response without safety concerns.
38142541.summary: Most people with MS given COVID-19 or flu vaccines built a good immune response, and the vaccines caused no major safety problems. Response was weaker with some MS drugs.

40738870.conclusion_quote: Resistance training appears to be beneficial in improving muscle fitness and reducing fatigue in patients with MS, even though only some of the studies achieved statistical significance.
40738870.summary: Five small trials suggest resistance training may build muscle strength and reduce fatigue in people with MS, though the evidence is weak.

39563246.conclusion_quote: The MACFIMS effectively discriminates between pwMS patients and HCs, demonstrating its validity as a comprehensive cognitive assessment tool for MS.
39563246.summary: Pooling eight studies, this review found people with MS performed worse than healthy people on all cognitive tests, especially processing speed, supporting the MACFIMS as a useful assessment tool.

38528009.conclusion_quote: Summarized, this study confirmed substantial socio-cognitive impairment in MS and highlights the potential exacerbating role of comorbid clinical symptoms.
38528009.summary: People with multiple sclerosis often have trouble understanding other people's thoughts, feelings and viewpoints, and fatigue seems to make this worse.

39415615.conclusion_quote: QSM may serve as a biomarker for understanding χ value alterations such as iron dysregulation and its contribution to neurodegeneration in RRMS, especially in the basal ganglia nuclei including PUT, GP, and CN.
39415615.summary: Researchers combined nine studies and found that brain scans measuring iron levels were higher in deep brain regions of people with relapsing MS than in healthy people.

42085349.conclusion_quote: We conclude from our review of the literature that tobacco smoking is a consistent risk factor for the onset of MS, indicating the need for targeted cessation interventions.
42085349.summary: Smoking was linked to higher MS risk in a review of 18 studies, while alcohol showed no clear effect on developing the disease.

41764015.conclusion_quote: Acoustic markers of speech timing and articulatory precision correlate moderately with physical disability, whereas aerodynamic capacity and voice quality appear relatively preserved.
41764015.summary: Speech timing and clarity measures from reading tasks moderately track physical disability in MS, while breath capacity and voice quality changed little.

41216863.conclusion_quote: Future proof-of-concept clinical trials investigating remyelinating agents in MS should consider combining outcome measures into composite endpoints.
41216863.summary: This review found that several approved MS drugs show signs of repairing myelin in lab studies, but proof in patients is limited because current markers cannot confirm true repair.

34246019.conclusion_quote: our study provides further evidence that MOG-AD and AQP4-NMOSD have distinct MRI features that may help clinicians for an early differential diagnosis.
34246019.summary: Researchers pooled 14 studies and found that MOG antibody disease and AQP4 neuromyelitis optica show different MRI brain and spinal cord lesion patterns, which may help diagnosis.

37717305.conclusion_quote: There is a high prevalence of depression, anxiety, and sleep disturbances among NMOSD.
37717305.summary: A review of 31 studies found that about 40 percent of people with NMOSD have depression, 45 percent anxiety, and 55 percent sleep problems.

38850684.conclusion_quote: Six to ten weeks of CSEs is an effective therapeutic strategy for balance improvement in PwMS that can help improve balance, especially in patients with moderate disability levels (EDSS3.5-6).
38850684.summary: Seven trials found that core stability exercises for six to ten weeks improved balance in people with multiple sclerosis, especially those with moderate disability.

40334524.conclusion_quote: This review underscores the transformative potential of ML-enhanced EEG analysis in improving MS management, providing insights into future research directions to overcome existing limitations and further improve clinical practice.
40334524.summary: This review finds machine learning applied to brain EEG recordings shows promise for diagnosing and monitoring multiple sclerosis, though challenges and biases remain to be addressed.

40088721.conclusion_quote: Hippotherapy appears to have positive effects (balance, fatigue, gait, spasticity, pain, muscle strength and quality of life) as an intervention method on the clinical picture of people with MS.
40088721.summary: Five randomised trials suggest that hippotherapy, which uses horse riding movement, may improve balance, fatigue, walking, spasticity, pain, muscle strength and quality of life in people with MS.

40613334.conclusion_quote: Fingolimod (1.25 mg) and ozanimod (1 mg) had the best efficacy, and siponimod (1.25 mg and 0.25 mg) had the best safety profile among the S1PRM.
40613334.summary: Comparing 17 trials of S1P receptor drugs for relapsing MS, fingolimod and ozanimod best reduced relapses and new brain lesions, while siponimod caused the fewest side effects.

39329016.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest the potential of PBM as a promising non-pharmacological intervention for the management of MS, although further research is needed to standardize PBM protocols and assess its long-term effects.
39329016.summary: This review of eight studies found that light therapy called photobiomodulation may improve movement, sensation, and thinking in people with MS, and no side effects were reported.

38573365.conclusion_quote: The findings of the present meta-analysis indicate that MS is associated with an increased risk for ischaemic and haemorrhagic stroke.
38573365.summary: Combining 13 studies of over 146,000 people, this review found that people with multiple sclerosis have about two and a half times the stroke risk of the general population.

42858119.conclusion_quote: Lower baseline relapse activity accompanied declining event yield.
42858119.summary: Relapse rates in control groups of MS drug trials have fallen over time, along with patients' baseline relapse activity, though recruitment timing explains much of the pattern.

42640321.conclusion_quote: This case underscores the importance of a multidisciplinary approach and suggests that possible shared immunopathogenic mechanisms warrant further investigation.
42640321.summary: Researchers reviewed the literature and described a patient with Sjögren's disease who also had lung amyloidosis, stomach lymphoma, and multiple sclerosis, a combination not previously reported.

39186371.conclusion_quote: RTX demonstrates efficacy in reducing relapse frequency and exhibits potential in stabilizing disability progression over a 2-year follow-up, particularly among individuals with shorter disease duration.
39186371.summary: Rituximab reduced relapses in people with secondary progressive MS, but it did not significantly slow disability worsening over about two years.

40215830.conclusion_quote: DMF could be considered for patients with POMS both as first-line and switching therapy.
40215830.summary: Dimethyl fumarate appeared to reduce relapses and MRI disease activity in children with MS, with mostly mild side effects like stomach upset and flushing.

40505539.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, a collaboration of immune structures and mediators may result in subpial cortical demyelination in MS patients, resulting in a progressive disease course and a reduced remyelination activity in the nervous system.
40505539.summary: Studies reviewed suggest that damage to the brain's outer grey matter is more common in secondary progressive MS, possibly driven by immune activity in surrounding membranes.

38212940.conclusion_quote: Cognitive impairment is observed in all MS phenotypes, with varying degrees.
38212940.summary: Review of 48 studies found cognitive problems in all types of multiple sclerosis, getting worse from early stages to later progressive forms, though test methods vary widely.

37956522.conclusion_quote: The cumulative evidence supports that persons with MS engage in more SB than non-MS controls.
37956522.summary: People with multiple sclerosis spend more time sitting or inactive than people without MS, though the difference is small and varies between studies.

42346748.conclusion_quote: Aquatic therapy may represent a generally well-tolerated and potentially beneficial rehabilitation strategy for improving fatigue, mobility, and QoL in people with MS.
42346748.summary: Pooling seven randomized trials, exercise in water reduced fatigue and improved walking, physical function and quality of life in people with MS, though evidence is limited.

42022641.conclusion_quote: This review underscores QSM's utility as a biomarker for MS pathophysiology while advocating for standardized protocols and longitudinal studies to validate its clinical translation.
42022641.summary: Review of seven studies finds a brain imaging method called QSM can detect iron buildup and damage in MS, but more standardized research is needed before routine clinical use.

40446561.conclusion_quote: Conclusion This systematic review suggests that neuraxial anesthesia can be administered safely to patients with multiple sclerosis, as the incidence of severe complications appears relatively low.
40446561.summary: A review of 34 studies found that spinal or epidural numbing anesthesia rarely caused serious problems in people with MS, though some relapses and symptom flare ups were reported.

39711787.conclusion_quote: Results of this SLR-informed NMA showed that there is no statistically significant difference between ublituximab and the other mAbs in terms of clinical efficacy.
39711787.summary: Ublituximab performed about as well as other antibody treatments for relapsing MS in relapses and disability, and stopping rates were similar except for alemtuzumab.

39642137.conclusion_quote: This study identified elevated As and Cd levels in MS patients, indicating the need for targeted interventions and public health guidelines for toxic metal exposure.
39642137.summary: Researchers combined many studies and found that people with multiple sclerosis had higher levels of arsenic and cadmium in their body samples than healthy people, but not of other metals.

39906910.conclusion_quote: The absence of consensus on the optimal model for MS lesion segmentation highlights the need for standardized methodologies and clinical validation.
39906910.summary: A review found AI tools for spotting MS lesions on MRI vary widely in performance, and most have not been tested in real clinical settings.

38507873.conclusion_quote: MS can increased the risk of developing COPD, while asthma does not exhibit a significant relationship with MS.
38507873.summary: Researchers pooled 40 studies and found people with MS have a higher risk of COPD, while asthma was not clearly linked to MS.

36745300.conclusion_quote: Although rare, NMOSD/NMO impact affected individuals in devastating ways.
36745300.summary: Researchers pooled studies worldwide and found neuromyelitis optica is very rare, affecting about 1.5 to 2 people per 100,000, and more often women.

40582076.conclusion_quote: Methodological heterogeneity may have led to inconclusive evidence regarding MDTs impact on HRQoL in MS.
40582076.summary: A review of sixteen studies found multidisciplinary care gave some benefits for emotional wellbeing, but no clear overall improvement in quality of life for people with MS.

41212037.conclusion_quote: Coffee consumption was associated with a lower risk of MS in pooled analysis, but the substantial heterogeneity limits the strength and generalizability of this conclusion.
41212037.summary: Pooling eight studies, this review found people who drink coffee had lower odds of developing multiple sclerosis, though results varied widely between studies.

41208691.conclusion_quote: Out of the comorbidity and frailty scales currently available, no single scale has displayed sufficient evidence to warrant routine use.
41208691.summary: This review found that no single comorbidity or frailty scale has enough evidence yet for routine use in people with multiple sclerosis.

38781885.conclusion_quote: AI models based on MRI features showed a high potential to discriminate between NMOSD and MS.
38781885.summary: Fifteen studies found that computer models using MRI scans can fairly accurately tell apart NMOSD and MS, though inconsistent study methods limit reliability.

41206297.conclusion_quote: MS is associated with measurable alterations in multiple acoustic domains, particularly reflecting vocal instability and reduced phonatory capacity.
41206297.summary: People with multiple sclerosis had lower, less stable voices and shorter breath holding than healthy people, suggesting voice tests could help detect the disease.

38370410.conclusion_quote: The past three decades have witnessed a significant expansion of research on MOGAD.
38370410.summary: This analysis mapped research on MOG antibody disease from 1947 to 2022, showing steady growth led by the United States and the Mayo Clinic.

37979408.conclusion_quote: The results of this review does not suggest that COVID-19 influences the relapse rate in pwMS.
37979408.summary: A review of 14 studies found that coronavirus infection does not appear to trigger MS relapses, so people with MS need not worry that infection will set off attacks.

37224631.conclusion_quote: The potential impact of pregnancy and the postpartum period on disease activity suggest a proactive management strategy early on may improve maternal and infant outcomes, but more clinical data are needed, particularly for MOGAD.
37224631.summary: This review of published studies found that pregnancy and the weeks after birth can raise relapse risk in women with NMOSD and MOGAD, and more research is needed, especially for MOGAD.

38089033.conclusion_quote: Our seminal review may serve as an example of how patients with neurological diseases or disabilities in general may have their jobs impacted in a pandemic and foster the context of global socio-economic crisis.
38089033.summary: A review of 49 studies found nearly half of people with MS were unemployed or retired during the pandemic, and progressive MS was linked to job loss.

41691991.conclusion_quote: Most reports suggest that breastfeeding is inversely related to the occurrence of MS; this might reveal an association with MS risk.
41691991.summary: This review of past studies suggests that longer breastfeeding in early childhood may be linked to a lower chance of developing multiple sclerosis, though this is not proven.

41362332.conclusion_quote: AQP4-IgG+ NMOSD patients have specific global and local central nervous system volume reductions, potentially induced by astrocytic damage and demyelination.
41362332.summary: Patients with a specific NMOSD antibody type had smaller brains, gray matter, and upper spinal cord measurements than healthy people, suggesting MRI could help track the disease.

40253902.conclusion_quote: Exergame interventions have been shown to improve participation-related factors including quality of life, mood, and treatment adherence in PwMS.
40253902.summary: Seventeen randomised trials found that video game exercise can improve quality of life, mood and sticking to treatment in people with MS, though measures did not specifically assess participation.

41753066.conclusion_quote: NP affects one in two NMOSD patients, and is associated with thoracic spinal cord lesions.
41753066.summary: About half of people with NMOSD, a rare condition affecting the brain and spinal cord, have nerve pain, often linked to spinal cord damage and hard to treat.

40317119.conclusion_quote: Processing speed appears to be collectively associated with PA volume, mobility, and gait quality.
40317119.summary: A review of 26 studies found that slower thinking speed is linked to less daily activity, walking ability, and gait quality in people with MS.

42472231.conclusion_quote: Dietary interventions may hold promise as adjunctive strategies for cognitive health in MS; however, inconsistencies in study designs, cognitive measures, and intervention duration, combined with limited high-quality evidence, undermine strong recommendations, which warrant further evaluations.
42472231.summary: Diet may help thinking skills in MS, with some diets like Wahls and Mediterranean showing mixed results, but evidence remains limited and needs more high quality research.

38690271.conclusion_quote: The occurrence of secondary autoimmune diseases in patients with MS treated with ALZ is noteworthy, particularly in the form of thyroid events and hematological events.
38690271.summary: Pooling 37 studies, this analysis found that people with MS treated with alemtuzumab often developed other autoimmune conditions, especially thyroid and blood disorders.

37682389.conclusion_quote: The result of this systematic review and meta-analysis shows that the prevalence of MS has increased dramatically during the timespan in Oceania.
37682389.summary: This review of seventeen studies estimated MS prevalence in Oceania, finding that rates rose sharply over the study periods.

38699050.conclusion_quote: This study provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of anti-CD20 drugs on serum IgG levels in MS patients, exploring the prevalence of hypogammaglobulinemia, based on different drug types, treatment durations, and infection patterns.
38699050.summary: Anti-CD20 MS drugs lowered antibody levels, about 11 percent of patients developed low antibody levels, and lung infections were the most common infection.

38767742.conclusion_quote: The meta-analysis revealed a significant association between IR, insulin and MS, with stronger associations in studies that recruited mixed patients.
38767742.summary: Researchers combined earlier studies and found people with MS tend to have higher insulin resistance and insulin levels than healthy people, though results varied widely.

39775922.conclusion_quote: We found evidence that the use of virtual reality may be more effective than no intervention in improving upper limb function and participation and quality of life.
39775922.summary: Virtual reality training may help balance and some arm and quality of life outcomes in people with MS, but did not clearly improve walking, and evidence is limited.

38176285.conclusion_quote: Polymorphism of rs12044852 and rs2300747 of the CD58 gene provided a protective effect for multiple sclerosis.
38176285.summary: Pooling 13 studies, two common CD58 gene variants were linked to a lower chance of developing multiple sclerosis, with a stronger effect seen in people of European descent.

39651635.conclusion_quote: The limited evidence available suggests that azathioprine may result in a modest benefit in terms of relapse frequency, with a possible increase in SAEs, when compared to interferon beta-1b, for people with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.
39651635.summary: Limited low-quality evidence suggests azathioprine may reduce relapses compared with interferon beta, but may increase serious side effects, and evidence on disability and other harms is very uncertain.

38838423.conclusion_quote: The study highlights the safety potential of MSC therapy for pwMS.
38838423.summary: Stem cell therapy given intrathecally modestly improved disability scores, but relapses were not reduced and effectiveness remains uncertain, though it appeared generally safe.

38735202.conclusion_quote: This systematic review provides valuable evidence for improving cognitive function and mood in PwMS through VR-based rehabilitation.
38735202.summary: Virtual reality rehabilitation improved memory, thinking and anxiety in people with MS, but did not clearly help depression, processing speed or attention.

42400084.conclusion_quote: Pilates-based interventions may improve mobility, balance, walking endurance, fatigue, and quality of life in people with MS.
42400084.summary: Pilates exercise appears to improve walking, balance, fatigue, and quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis, though the evidence is limited and uncertain.

38616570.conclusion_quote: Overall, REAGT seems to have a positive effect to Quality of Life, especially in MS patients' perspective of General and Mental Health and a slight positive effect in depression as measured by PHQ-9.
38616570.summary: Robot and exoskeleton assisted walking training appeared to improve quality of life and mental health in people with MS, with a slight benefit for depression.

39071226.conclusion_quote: Preliminary findings in meta-analysis are inconsistent but suggest potential benefits from MBI training on cognitive functioning in PwMS.
39071226.summary: Mindfulness training showed some promise for improving thinking skills in people with MS, but only one attention test clearly improved and results were inconsistent.

39162296.conclusion_quote: Improvements of balance were found across interventions when measured by balance composite scores and mobility tests, but not when measured by stepping or gait speed outcomes.
39162296.summary: Balance training improved balance scores and mobility tests in people with MS, but did not improve stepping or walking speed.

38822024.conclusion_quote: SCT can improve the disability of MS patients and reduce their brain lesion volume.
38822024.summary: Stem cell transplant appeared to reduce disability and brain lesion volume in MS patients, and was generally safe, though infusion site reactions and blood disorders occurred.

39626449.conclusion_quote: DIR acquisition allows higher detection in intracortical and infratentorial lesions compared to T2-FLAIR.
39626449.summary: This review of studies found that a special MRI scan called DIR spots more MS lesions in the outer brain and back brain areas than the standard FLAIR scan.

37952373.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our systematic review and meta-analysis study provides strong evidence of the correlation between T1 and T2 lesions and cognitive function in MS patients.
37952373.summary: Researchers pooled 21 studies and found that more brain lesions seen on MRI scans were linked to poorer thinking and memory scores in people with MS.

41749662.conclusion_quote: A systematic quantification of comorbidity prevalence, incidence (where available), and risk, together with POMS-specific characteristics and any reported impact on clinical outcomes, is anticipated to provide a crucial evidence base for guiding screening, refining management strategies, and informing future research directions.
41749662.summary: This protocol plans a review of how often and how likely other health conditions are in children with MS, and how they affect their illness.

41403803.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that, except for penicillin, the use of other antibiotics may increase the risk of MS.
41403803.summary: Combining six studies, this review found that most antibiotics except penicillin may be linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, though the evidence is not conclusive.

38058136.conclusion_quote: The available evidence is insufficient to support a relationship between greater fracture risk for people with MS taking glucocorticoid, antidepressant, or anxiolytic medication, compared with nonusers, and it is unclear whether these medications are associated with bone loss in people with MS, beyond that in the general population.
38058136.summary: Medications such as steroids may be linked to weaker bones in people with MS, but the evidence on fracture risk is too limited to draw firm conclusions.

40358800.conclusion_quote: Sex (male), smoking, a higher number of relapses, EDSS score, and DMTs are predictors of MS deterioration.
40358800.summary: Male sex, smoking, more relapses, and higher disability scores raise the risk of worsening multiple sclerosis, while disease-modifying drug use lowers it.

42798841.summary: This notice corrects an earlier review of stem cell transplants for progressive multiple sclerosis. It does not report new findings.

39667129.conclusion_quote: This study concludes that CoQ10 might exert dose-dependent beneficial effects on ameliorating oxidative stress and inflammation in MS, and also sheds light on its possible utility in relieving clinical symptoms of MS; however, limitations of the evidence such as the small number of included studies, suggested future studies for clinical recommendations.
39667129.summary: A review of six small studies suggests coenzyme Q10 supplements may reduce oxidative stress, inflammation, depression and fatigue in MS, but evidence remains limited.

40468842.conclusion_quote: Music-based interventions show promise in improving motor and nonmotor outcomes in PwMS.
40468842.summary: Music interventions may help walking, memory, mood and fatigue in people with MS, but the evidence is inconsistent and more research is needed.

40015346.conclusion_quote: Standardizing imaging protocols and integrating novel techniques could improve reliability and enable clinical applications to optimize patient monitoring and interventions.
40015346.summary: Brain scans show that MS affects communication between brain networks, linked to thinking problems, fatigue and depression, though inconsistent methods limit reliability.

39222581.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis suggests the efficacy of TCE in improving balance, activities of daily living, MSIS scores, depression, and ABC scores in MS patients.
39222581.summary: Tai Chi style exercises improved balance, daily activities, impact scores, depression and balance confidence in people with multiple sclerosis, but more research is needed.

42012210.conclusion_quote: A very small proportion of clinical trials have used SC MRI metrics as outcome measures.
42012210.summary: A review of 291 MS clinical trials found very few, about 1%, measured the spinal cord with MRI as an outcome, despite spinal cord damage strongly affecting disability.

38660089.conclusion_quote: This study found that there was a certain incidence of Immune thrombocytopenia in multiple sclerosis patients after treatment with alemtuzumab.
38660089.summary: Pooled data from 15 studies found about 2 in 100 MS patients treated with alemtuzumab developed low platelet counts, though missing control groups limit conclusions.

41901557.conclusion_quote: An integrated assessment of clinical, neuroimaging, and laboratory factors enables more effective risk stratification in patients with newly diagnosed MS.
41901557.summary: This review finds that early clinical, brain scan, and blood or fluid markers can help predict how aggressive MS will become, guiding treatment decisions.

38419451.conclusion_quote: Our research found that the coexistence of these two disorders was more frequent in female rheumatologic patients with a SjS diagnosis with neurological manifestations and in neurologic patients for whom a SjS diagnosis was suspected.
38419451.summary: Researchers pooled 29 studies and found that neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder appears more often in people with Sjogren syndrome, especially those with nervous system symptoms.

42674905.conclusion_quote: Overall, the findings highlighted that the integration of these multimodal biomarkers into clinical practice offers a scalable, non-invasive solution for personalized management.
42674905.summary: Review of fourteen studies finding that phone and wearable sensors can track walking, typing, fatigue, and mood in multiple sclerosis, potentially catching symptoms between clinic visits.

37428437.conclusion_quote: Our findings illustrated an acceptable safety for this treatment.
37428437.summary: Rituximab modestly improved disability scores in people with MS, but relapse reduction was not significant, and side effects were common.

41032995.conclusion_quote: Computer-based cognitive training has a positive effect on information processing speed and memory in MS patients, but does not improve attention or executive function.
41032995.summary: Computer training helped people with MS think faster and remember better, but did not improve attention or planning skills.

38320418.conclusion_quote: Exercise interventions can improve well-being and HRQoL in PwMS.
38320418.summary: Pooling 49 trials, exercise improved overall wellbeing, mood, social wellbeing, and quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis.

37478676.conclusion_quote: A high prevalence of CP was found among MS patients compared with healthy controls.
37478676.summary: Combined data from three observational studies found that people with multiple sclerosis were about twice as likely to have gum disease as healthy controls.

37944194.conclusion_quote: EST is effective and safe for alleviating pain in MS, but it should be noted that limited sample sizes and methodological issues were present in the included studies.
37944194.summary: Electrical stimulation therapy reduced pain in people with multiple sclerosis across ten small trials, with no adverse events reported, though study quality varied.

37453952.conclusion_quote: The diagnosis of breast cancer most often occurs after the onset of the paraneoplastic NMOSD symptoms.
37453952.summary: Review of 19 cases found breast cancer usually appeared after neuromyelitis optica symptoms, sometimes years later, so older women with new diagnosis should be screened.

37394561.conclusion_quote: Although MS is not typically considered a major risk factor for VTE, the meta-analysis of cohort studies shows that MS has a relative association with an increased incidence of VTE.
37394561.summary: Pooling nine studies, this review found about 1.8 percent of people with MS had a venous blood clot, and MS was linked to roughly double the risk.

38252220.conclusion_quote: This study encountered that melatonin may be associated with improved behavioral and cognitive outcomes of preclinical models of MS with acceptable safety profiles.
38252220.summary: Animal studies suggest melatonin reduced disease severity and improved behavior and thinking in mouse and other rodent models of multiple sclerosis, with few safety concerns.

40452261.conclusion_quote: Although NCS remain the primary instrumental test for the diagnosis of CIDP, US and MRI can be valuable adjuncts in cases with diagnostic uncertainty.
