40452261.summary: This review finds that nerve ultrasound and MRI can help diagnose and track chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy, a nerve disorder, though nerve conduction tests remain the main test.

37558179.conclusion_quote: Based on the neuroimaging findings, we found that, given the heterogeneity of MS, LOMS patients have a high rate of spinal cord lesions and supratentorial involvement.
37558179.summary: Review of 15 studies on MS starting after age 50 found that most patients had spinal cord lesions, and many had brain lesions in the upper brain.

38113581.conclusion_quote: NMOSD patients have lower serum 25(OH)D levels than healthy controls.
38113581.summary: Combined studies found people with NMOSD have lower vitamin D levels than healthy people, but the research does not prove low vitamin D causes the disease.

37209499.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis did not show a significant association between antibiotic or penicillin use with the risk of MS.
37209499.summary: Antibiotic use did not appear to be linked to a higher risk of multiple sclerosis in pooled studies, though results varied widely between studies and more research is needed.

40017411.conclusion_quote: Neuraxial analgesia/anaesthesia does not increase the risk of postpartum relapse in MS parturients in the year following delivery.
40017411.summary: Eight studies of 1315 pregnant women with MS found that epidural or spinal pain relief during childbirth did not raise the chance of relapse in the following year.

42645076.conclusion_quote: Current evidence supports a biologically possible association between periodontal disease and multiple sclerosis through shared inflammatory and microbial pathways.
42645076.summary: A review of 17 studies suggests gum disease and multiple sclerosis may share inflammation pathways, but it does not prove that one causes the other.

38582068.conclusion_quote: We could provide meta-analytic evidence for DGM susceptibility changes in MS compared to HC; basal ganglia susceptibility is increased and, in the putamen, associated with disability, while thalamic susceptibility is decreased.
38582068.summary: Brain scans measuring iron and myelin suggest basal ganglia deep grey matter are higher in people with MS, while the thalamus is lower, and putamen levels track disability.

40359743.conclusion_quote: So far there has been limited interest in the vulnerability of MS patients to climate change.
40359743.summary: Review of 24 studies finds that heat and hot weather often worsen symptoms and hospital visits in people with multiple sclerosis, and that little research has addressed climate change.

40381455.conclusion_quote: Our study found that HETs were significantly more effective in lowering relapse rates than METs, demonstrating a distinct benefit in treating POMS.
40381455.summary: Pooled studies in children with MS found that stronger treatments like natalizumab and ocrelizumab reduced relapses more than moderate treatments.

38937399.conclusion_quote: Findings suggest that SCIG for CIDP maintenance not only provides a more feasible alternative, with economic evaluations showing considerable cost reductions over time, and patient preference for SCIG being pronounced, but may also deliver comparable or superior health outcomes.
38937399.summary: Subcutaneous immunoglobulin shots appear to be a practical maintenance option for CIDP nerve disease, with patients preferring them and often reporting fewer side effects.

39357272.conclusion_quote: Circuit training can have positive effects on PwMS in terms of increasing balance, gait, and reducing fatigue.
39357272.summary: A review of 14 trials found that circuit training improved balance and reduced fatigue in people with MS, though walking speed and distance gains were not significant.

41853290.conclusion_quote: Living with MS is expensive as a significant chronic disease.
41853290.summary: A review of 31 studies finds that living with multiple sclerosis is costly, mainly due to expensive drugs and lost work productivity, and the true burden is likely underestimated.

37924591.conclusion_quote: OCT measurements are correlated with disability in pwMS, and they can complement the comprehensive neurological visit as an additional paraclinical test.
37924591.summary: Researchers pooled 100 studies and found that eye scan measurements of the retina are linked to how disabled people with MS are.

42458195.conclusion_quote: This NMA showed hazard ratio point estimates favoring eculizumab and ravulizumab over rituximab.
42458195.summary: This review compared rituximab with newer NMOSD drugs to prevent relapses. Results were inconclusive, since estimates favored other drugs but uncertainty was very high.

38630771.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis revealed no significant difference in serum levels of IGF-1, GH, IGFBP-2, and IGFBP-3 between the MS group and healthy controls, except for IGFBP1.
38630771.summary: This review of 11 studies found IGF-1 and growth hormone levels were similar in people with MS and healthy people, while one binding protein, IGFBP-1, was higher in MS.

36283808.conclusion_quote: RTX showed effective in MOGAD, although to a lesser extent than in AQP4-IgG+NMOSD, while the safety profile warrants some caution in its prescription.
36283808.summary: Rituximab reduced relapses and disability in people with MOG antibody disease, though less than in NMO patients, and caused side effects in about one in five patients.

41673923.conclusion_quote: The evidence gathered and analyzed through this review will be crucial for our next step of updating the exercise guidelines for MS.
41673923.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of randomized trials to determine which exercise types and doses best help adults with multiple sclerosis, to update exercise guidelines.

40174440.conclusion_quote: This review highlights the multifaceted nature of DM deficits in individuals with MS.
40174440.summary: This review of 18 studies found that people with multiple sclerosis often have trouble making decisions, linked to memory problems, brain changes, and emotional issues like depression.

38020591.conclusion_quote: Inflammatory disease activity is common in PPMS and has remained stable over the last decades.
38020591.summary: Many people with primary progressive MS show signs of active inflammation, mostly on MRI scans, and younger age and longer monitoring predicted more activity.

39586156.conclusion_quote: Gut diversity was not associated with MS-related outcomes in most studies whereas several gut taxa were, including higher abundances of short chain-fatty acid producers (e.g. Bacteroidota) showing associations with lower EDSS scores.
39586156.summary: This review of 23 studies found gut bacteria diversity usually did not track MS activity or disability, but certain gut bacteria levels were linked to better or worse outcomes.

42428733.conclusion_quote: Although pooled results suggest a slight protective effect of overall dairy consumption on MS risk, findings remain inconsistent and inconclusive, especially when considering specific dairy products and study design.
42428733.summary: Researchers combined twenty studies and found dairy intake had a very small link to lower MS risk, but results were inconsistent.

38211504.conclusion_quote: The findings of this meta-analysis strengthen current evidence that vitamin D 3 supplementation has no significant impact on clinical outcomes in patients with MS.
38211504.summary: Vitamin D3 supplements taken alongside usual MS treatment did not significantly improve disability, relapse rates, or new brain lesions in nine trials with 867 people.

38479045.conclusion_quote: NMOSD Patients with AQP4+IgG receiving C5 inhibitors have lower rate of relapses and improved levels of disability and quality of life.
38479045.summary: Drugs that block the C5 immune protein cut relapses in people with neuromyelitis optica, and improved walking and quality of life in two trials.

38529035.conclusion_quote: DMTs can effectively control disease progression and reduce disease deterioration during the treatment of PMS.
38529035.summary: Disease-modifying drugs slowed disease progression and reduced worsening in progressive MS, with mitoxantrone, siponimod and ocrelizumab performing best at delaying progression.

39954116.conclusion_quote: Fampridine may improve gait and functional mobility in MS, but its effect on balance requires further investigation in RCTs.
39954116.summary: This review of 23 trials found that fampridine may help walking and daily movement in MS, while cannabinoids and baclofen mainly eased stiffness with little effect on mobility.

37740822.conclusion_quote: Based on our quantitative synthesis of real-world data, in the absence of definitive answers from clinical trials, DMT discontinuation appears feasible with a high degree of certainty in selected patients.
37740822.summary: Stopping MS disease-modifying drugs seemed relatively safe for selected patients, with relapses becoming rare in older people and those with long stable disease.

39954489.conclusion_quote: The revised consensus and guidelines aim to enhance long-term outcomes in these regions by assisting patients, regulatory bodies, healthcare providers, and policymakers.
39954489.summary: Regional experts from Central America and the Caribbean issued updated recommendations on treating MS, NMOSD and MOGAD, covering medicines, pregnancy, vaccines and monitoring, to improve patient care.

40372550.conclusion_quote: This SLR demonstrates the significance of sNfL as a sensitive biomarker for monitoring MS progression.
40372550.summary: A review of 75 studies found that higher blood levels of a nerve damage marker called neurofilament light predict relapses, disease progression and worse disability in MS.

42397849.conclusion_quote: Data sources remain limited, and further dedicated real-world studies that capture the full range of outcomes required to inform risk-benefit discussions are needed.
42397849.summary: UK experts updated their guidance on managing multiple sclerosis during pregnancy and breastfeeding, covering treatment choices, breast milk transfer, and vaccines. More real-world research is still needed.

38457005.conclusion_quote: In summary, our meta-analysis indicates that natalizumab maintains its effectiveness under extended interval dosing [up to 8 weeks], presenting comparable risks for clinical relapses, MRI lesions, EDSS, and PML.
38457005.summary: Combining fourteen studies, this review found that spacing natalizumab infusions every five to eight weeks worked about as well as standard timing, with similar safety risks.

40775082.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that ravulizumab had the highest probability of being the most superior treatment in decreasing relapse risk in NMO-SD.
40775082.summary: Comparing immunotherapies for neuromyelitis optica, this analysis of eight trials suggests ravulizumab was most likely the best at preventing relapses.

38432828.conclusion_quote: tDCS applied by multiple session and combined with motor rehabilitation (i.e., aerobic and/or resistance training) can improve stride length in PwMS.
38432828.summary: Brain stimulation alone did not improve walking speed in people with MS, but repeated sessions combined with exercise training improved stride length.

37597350.conclusion_quote: Our study indicates that a significant proportion of people with MS in Iran are affected by depression and anxiety.
37597350.summary: Roughly half of Iranian people with MS had depression and about half had anxiety, according to a pooled analysis of 23 studies.

39721211.conclusion_quote: The findings offer preliminary evidence to suggest that a more negative body image is associated with higher levels of psychological distress in MS, indicating that body image may be a target for intervention.
39721211.summary: Thirteen studies found that people with MS who view their bodies more negatively tend to have more emotional distress, so body image may be a useful target for support.

37844435.conclusion_quote: Through telephone communication or other electronic monitoring systems, can be achieved an effective treatment of people with depression and MS, based on exercise and physiotherapy.
37844435.summary: Pooled results from six trials suggest remote exercise and physiotherapy programs can reduce depressive symptoms in people with MS more than control activities.

40566801.conclusion_quote: Stem cell therapy is safe; however, it is no better than control (mostly placebo, mitoxantrone and conventional disease-modifying therapy) in the treatment of MS.
40566801.summary: Stem cell therapy was found to be safe in multiple sclerosis, but it did not work better than placebo, mitoxantrone or standard treatments across 11 trials.

39541831.conclusion_quote: Informal care cost contributes considerably to MS-related costs.
39541831.summary: Unpaid care from family and friends makes up about 15% of the total cost of multiple sclerosis, rising with disability severity and caregiving time.

38740399.conclusion_quote: This metanalysis revealed that 2D-3D CNN based MRI is an automated system that has high diagnostic performance and can promptly and effectively predict the disease.
38740399.summary: Pooled studies found that a type of artificial intelligence applied to brain scans detected multiple sclerosis lesions and classified cases with high accuracy.

37017322.conclusion_quote: A significant difference in AFC, estradiol and LH levels was observed, but not for AMH levels.
37017322.summary: Women with multiple sclerosis had lower antral follicle counts and estradiol and higher LH levels than healthy women, but their AMH levels were similar.

38199581.conclusion_quote: HIIT and MCT yield similar results in terms of fatigue, body composition, cognitive functions, and blood biomarkers.
38199581.summary: Intense interval training improved VO2max and memory more than moderate training in people with MS, while other outcomes showed similar results.

39155841.conclusion_quote: Clinicians should consider the centrality of identity redefinition for the promotion of MS patients' adjustment to the illness.
39155841.summary: This review of 43 studies found MS can erode people's sense of self, and those who keep a positive self image or accept MS into their identity adjust better.

38587704.conclusion_quote: Approximately one third of adults with RRMS experience clinical levels of CIm.
38587704.summary: Across 50 studies, about one in three adults with relapsing MS had clinically significant cognitive problems, more often those with longer disease or older age.

42913143.conclusion_quote: Theory-based nursing interventions not only yield significant positive effects on physical, psychological, and behavioral outcomes among individuals with multiple sclerosis but also serve as an essential framework for guiding the planning and delivery of holistic nursing care.
42913143.summary: Nine trials found that nursing care plans based on established health theories improved quality of life, self-efficacy, daily living, fatigue, and sleep in people with MS.

39525231.conclusion_quote: In recent years, there have been increasing reports of MOGAD occurring after infections.
39525231.summary: A teenage boy developed an inflammatory disease of the nervous system after a bacterial infection, and he recovered with immunoglobulin treatment.

37394516.conclusion_quote: Pediatric patients with multiple sclerosis show higher levels of serum neurofilament light chains at their first clinical demyelinating attack compared to pediatric hospital-based controls.
37394516.summary: Children with multiple sclerosis had higher blood levels of a nerve damage marker at their first attack than children without the disease, suggesting it could help diagnosis.

37499339.conclusion_quote: Cooling garments can improve physical function for people with MS.
37499339.summary: Cooling garments helped people with MS walk farther and move more easily, and none caused harm, so people can try different types to find one they prefer.

40189590.conclusion_quote: This systematic review highlights the variability in assessed balance response outcomes in PwMS.
40189590.summary: This review of 23 studies found virtual reality can help researchers study balance problems in people with MS, though methods and outcomes vary widely and need standardizing.

41586489.conclusion_quote: Spin is common in MS randomized controlled trials with nonsignificant primary outcomes and may mislead clinical decisions.
41586489.summary: Researchers found that many multiple sclerosis drug trials with missed main results presented them in misleadingly positive ways, which could distort treatment decisions.

39487492.conclusion_quote: While the mechanism underlying SAID following alemtuzumab is not fully understood, potential biomarkers and risk factors that may assist in elucidating mechanisms underlying this phenomenon have been documented in several independent studies.
39487492.summary: This review of 19 studies found that nearly half of people treated with alemtuzumab developed a second autoimmune disease, with possible warning signs such as thyroid antibodies and immune activity markers.

38520792.conclusion_quote: Patients with NMOSD showed significantly reduced vitamin D levels compared with healthy controls.
38520792.summary: People with NMOSD, a rare condition affecting the optic nerves and spinal cord, had lower vitamin D levels in their blood than healthy people, based on six studies.

38331311.conclusion_quote: NOx levels are increased in relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS) patients in the relapse phase.
38331311.summary: Nitrite and nitrate levels were higher in MS patients during relapses and in those with greater disability, according to a review of 20 studies.

36434909.conclusion_quote: MS is an independent risk factor for both incident and prevalent epilepsy, suggesting variation in grey matter involvement over the disease course.
36434909.summary: People with multiple sclerosis appear to have a higher chance of developing epilepsy than people without it, based on pooled data from 17 studies.

38155333.conclusion_quote: There is a lack of evidence regarding the safety and efficacy of selenium supplements in MS patients.
38155333.summary: Nine studies found that about 14% of people with MS currently take selenium supplements, but there is too little evidence to show they are safe or helpful.

36749275.conclusion_quote: Reflexology therapy can be used as an effective intervention for the pain and fatigue of MS patients while improving the quality of life.
36749275.summary: Eleven trials found reflexology reduced pain and fatigue in people with MS compared with sham reflexology, but did not clearly improve other quality of life measures.

42651171.conclusion_quote: We found that in MS, network alterations are state-dependent, shifting from reduced connectivity at rest to increased coherence during cognitive effort.
42651171.summary: MEG brain scans in people with MS showed weaker brain connections at rest but stronger connections during a thinking task, and a review of 44 studies agreed.

39082295.conclusion_quote: The gut microbiome's role in MS presents a complex panorama, where alterations in microbial composition might hold greater significance to disease mechanisms than diversity changes.
39082295.summary: Combining 26 studies, this review found gut bacteria diversity was similar in people with MS overall, but lower during active disease and in the relapsing form.

39291039.conclusion_quote: Thoughtful, structured design of educational programs requires a match between the educational aspects specific to each individual and the appropriate choice of content, delivery modalities of the interventions and evaluation protocol, as well as a reasonable follow-up time.
39291039.summary: A review of 21 studies found that education programs often improved quality of life for people with MS, especially when tailored to individual needs.

38243036.conclusion_quote: Our findings of statistically indifferent prevalence of H. pylori infection as compared between pwMS and healthy controls suggested the absence of protective effect for risk of MS following H. pylori infection.
38243036.summary: Researchers combined 17 studies and found people with MS were no less likely to have H. pylori infection than healthy people, so no protective link was seen.

42064064.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings illustrate the rapid expansion of NMOSD clinical research, alongside persistent gaps in transparency and trial design.
42064064.summary: This review of 141 registered trials shows NMOSD research is growing fast, led by China and the US, but many trials lack public results and rarely measure outcomes that matter to patients.

37055710.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis show that fampridine improves gait imbalance in patients with MS.
37055710.summary: Pooled results from 18 studies suggest that fampridine, a drug, improves walking ability in people with multiple sclerosis, though most studies lacked placebo control.

38958756.conclusion_quote: The female:male sex ratio and the mean age of onset of AQP4 antibody-associated NMOSD are significantly higher than MS.
38958756.summary: Women make up most people with AQP4 antibody positive NMOSD, and onset tends to be later in populations with longer life expectancy, based on 89 studies.

39811975.conclusion_quote: In addition, it provides recommendations on the management for qualifying for DMT and monitoring the safety of the therapy from anoncological perspective.
39811975.summary: Polish expert guidance on how some newer MS immune-modifying drugs may raise cancer risk, and how doctors should assess and monitor patients for it.

36928889.conclusion_quote: Future research is warranted on how to prevent long-term impairment in CIDP.
36928889.summary: A pooled analysis of 21 studies found that about 3 percent of people with CIDP died, 8 percent could not walk, and 47 percent had good outcomes without disability.

36630841.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review shows that the prevalence of dysphagia in MS patients is 45% which is greatly higher compared to the general population.
36630841.summary: A pooled analysis of 54 studies found that about 45 percent of people with multiple sclerosis have difficulty swallowing, much higher than in the general population.

41241603.conclusion_quote: This systematic review identifies that PwMS present with diverse vocal symptoms.
41241603.summary: People with multiple sclerosis show many different voice problems, such as breathiness and weaker voice strength, but studies vary too much to be certain of the pattern.

39447821.conclusion_quote: Our comprehensive analysis of guidelines for PA promotion in MS reveals the need for more actionable recommendations and better reporting of guideline development, which has the potential to improve the translation of evidence into practice.
39447821.summary: This review of 19 physical activity guidance documents for MS found that many recommendations are unclear about who should act, what to do, and when, and that guideline quality varies.

34512521.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, anti-NMDAR-IgG + /MOG-IgG + was rarely observed, but the incidence rate of relapse was very high.
34512521.summary: This review of 25 studies found that people with antibodies against both NMDA receptors and MOG are rare, often have seizures and behaviour changes, and relapse frequently.

37851580.conclusion_quote: Consumption of fruits and vegetables may be associated with a potential protective effect against MS.
37851580.summary: Eating more fruits and vegetables was linked to lower odds of multiple sclerosis in pooled observational studies, though stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.

39390289.conclusion_quote: The evidence is uncertain on the effectiveness of RAGT on balance and gait in people with MS, but a multimodal rehabilitation approach, including RAGT, should be encouraged.
39390289.summary: Eight trials found unclear evidence that robot assisted walking training improves walking and balance in people with MS, though it appears safe.

37660457.conclusion_quote: Although TJA may benefit MS patients, current evidence suggests that their postoperative outcomes may be inferior to those of non-MS patients.
37660457.summary: Seven studies found people with multiple sclerosis had more complications, longer hospital stays, and more revision surgeries after hip or knee replacement than people without MS.

39232367.conclusion_quote: This review supports PRLs as a predictor of EDSS progression.
39232367.summary: Seven studies found that multiple sclerosis patients with paramagnetic rim lesions tend to have higher disability scores at baseline and may progress more over time.

40620741.conclusion_quote: HDL-C levels were significantly decreased in RRMS patients compared with HC.
40620741.summary: Pooled studies found people with relapsing MS have lower good cholesterol (HDL) and higher triglycerides and total cholesterol than healthy people, suggesting lipids may help assess disease.

39485626.conclusion_quote: This review suggests that CR may have a positive impact on motor and balance performance in pwMS, underscoring the relationship between cognition and motor function.
39485626.summary: Reviewing eight studies with 668 people, this paper found cognitive rehabilitation may improve movement and balance in people with MS, though more research is needed.

36775211.conclusion_quote: The results of the present study showed that EBV, VZV, and HHV-6 infection are associated with multiple sclerosis and can be considered as potential risk factors for MS.
36775211.summary: Researchers pooled 134 studies and found that infection with EBV, VZV and herpesvirus 6 is linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

39243503.conclusion_quote: Although anti-CD20 therapy is associated with some AEs, it can be provided in several circumstances, especially to patients with highly active disease, or ones resistant to platform therapies.
39243503.summary: Anti-CD20 drugs such as rituximab and ocrelizumab reduced relapses and brain lesions in children with MS, especially those with very active disease, but can cause side effects.

37595371.conclusion_quote: Thus, these findings support the idea that NIBS could have some promising effects on specific MS symptoms.
37595371.summary: Brain stimulation, mainly tDCS, reduced fatigue in people with MS compared with fake treatment, with little benefit for movement or thinking.

39229847.conclusion_quote: In general, vaccinations do not seem to aggravate multiple sclerosis (MS) or increase the probability of relapse, particularly for inactivated vaccines and, in general, for the rest of the vaccines.
39229847.summary: A review of 133 studies found vaccines generally do not worsen multiple sclerosis or trigger relapses, though they work less well for people on certain drugs.

37062787.conclusion_quote: Our results showed acceptable safety and efficacy for cladribine for the treatment of MS except in terms of reducing EDSS.
37062787.summary: Pooled analysis of 23 studies found cladribine generally safe and effective for MS, with infections the most common side effect, though it did not clearly reduce disability scores.

39693809.conclusion_quote: The review findings suggest a complex association between oxidative stress and inflammation with cognitive outcomes in MS.
39693809.summary: Blood markers of inflammation and oxidative stress were reviewed against thinking ability in MS. Evidence linking them to cognition is mixed and inconclusive.

41036984.conclusion_quote: Finally, the 2024 revised criteria refined the diagnostic work-up of pediatric onset multiple sclerosis by introducing the antibody testing for myelin oligodendrocytes glycoprotein in patients younger than 12 years.
41036984.summary: This review explains the 2024 updated criteria for diagnosing multiple sclerosis, including new brain scan markers and changes for children and people with early warning signs.

41886880.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results reveal attenuated autonomic responses to psychological stress in MS, possibly linked to central lesions affecting stress-regulation networks, and support autonomic reactivity as a potential physiological marker of emotional and functional impairment in MS.
41886880.summary: People with MS showed weaker heart and blood pressure responses to stress than healthy controls, suggesting autonomic nervous system reactions may serve as a marker of emotional and functional problems.

39271990.conclusion_quote: The review consistently identified stigma to be significantly associated with adverse psychological and physical health outcomes in all 18 identified studies.
39271990.summary: This review of 18 studies found that stigma is consistently linked to worse mental and physical health in people with multiple sclerosis.

40967038.conclusion_quote: The study demonstrates excellent performance of the 2023 MOGAD diagnostic criteria among children with acquired demyelination; however, the criteria did not enhance the diagnostic accuracy of antibody testing alone.
40967038.summary: In 388 children, the 2023 MOGAD diagnostic criteria correctly identified almost all cases, but did not improve on the antibody test alone.

40388453.conclusion_quote: Antigen-specific tolerance-inducing therapeutic approaches appeared to be safe.
40388453.summary: Researchers reviewed 26 studies of treatments that retrain the immune system in MS. The treatments seemed safe with no clear difference in side effects, but whether they work remains unclear.

42559795.conclusion_quote: This consensus proposes the first interdisciplinary framework for reproductive care in MS within the Italian context.
42559795.summary: Italian MS experts agreed that early pregnancy counseling, teamwork across specialists, and personalised treatment planning are key, while disagreeing on some pregnancy medicines.

37447189.conclusion_quote: Thus, our findings show that the therapeutic use of vitamin D on fatigue in people with MS could be considered.
37447189.summary: Combining five trials, this review found that vitamin D supplements modestly reduced fatigue in people with MS compared with control groups, though the dose remains unclear.

42941573.conclusion_quote: The available evidence does not consistently establish that OT interventions improve occupational performance or reduce physical and cognitive fatigue in adults with MS.
42941573.summary: Seven randomized trials found occupational therapy results inconsistent for daily activity performance and fatigue in people with MS, with very low certainty of evidence.

38289559.conclusion_quote: Considering the heterogeneity of studies, the current evidence suggests that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation may be effective in treating pain and improving motor function, while transcranial direct current stimulation may be useful in alleviating fatigue and enhancing certain aspects of cognitive performance.
38289559.summary: Brain stimulation may help some MS symptoms such as pain, movement, fatigue, thinking and tremor, but the evidence is mixed and needs more research.

41300779.conclusion_quote: This review identifies reproducible and context-specific lncRNA dysregulation in MS, emphasizing the need for transcriptome-wide approaches, standardized methods, and multi-center validation.
41300779.summary: This review of 51 studies found a few RNA molecules, such as MALAT1 and GAS5, consistently change in MS, though results vary with treatment and relapses.

39539070.conclusion_quote: In most of the assessed aspects, telerehabilitation is comparable to regular centre-based rehabilitation.
39539070.summary: This review of 10 studies found remote exercise programs for people with MS were feasible and safe, with mixed effects on outcomes.

39121597.conclusion_quote: There is a clear benefit for SDM for patients with MS, and without it, patients report dissatisfaction, decisional regret, and lack of confidence in the medical system.
39121597.summary: A review of 89 studies found that involving patients in treatment choices helps people with MS, but patients from underserved groups often miss out.

41869917.conclusion_quote: This study guides the use of cladribine tablets in clinical practice, supporting treatment decision-making in patients with RRMS, and summarizes the current knowledge from clinical trials and real-world studies of the efficacy and safety of cladribine tablets.
41869917.summary: Portuguese neurologists agreed on recommendations for using cladribine tablets in relapsing MS, covering treatment timing, patient selection, extra cycles, monitoring, safety and pregnancy planning.

39805178.conclusion_quote: The available evidence from published studies of varying reliability supports the efficacy of DMTs in POMS.
39805178.summary: A review of 13 published studies found that disease-modifying drugs, some used off-label, reduce relapses and disease activity in children with MS, though more long-term trials are needed.

37608400.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis identified that non-pharmacological interventions can be an effective method of improving QoL in patients with MS, especially modalities with a physical activity component and balance interventions.
37608400.summary: Researchers reviewed trials and found that treatments without medicine, especially exercise and balance training, modestly improved quality of life for people with multiple sclerosis.

40213512.conclusion_quote: Tremor is a prevalent complaint in PwMS.
40213512.summary: Pooling 14 studies, about one in three people with MS had tremor, and it was less common in larger studies, suggesting tremor needs targeted support.

40649948.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the value of re-analysing publicly available proteomics data to develop robust biomarker panels for MS diagnosis.
40649948.summary: Combining six studies of spinal fluid protein data found 11 proteins that differ in MS, and one protein, IGKC, may help diagnose the disease.

42547073.conclusion_quote: This guideline, developed by a group of expert neurologists, members of the Mexican Committee for the Treat-ment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis (MEXCTRIMS), aims to standardize the criteria for diagnosis and treatment of multiple sclerosis in Mexico, adapting them to particular characteristics of the Mexican health system, to offer the neurologist an agile and useful reference tool, applicable to each setting.
42547073.summary: This guideline gives Mexican neurologists standard steps for diagnosing and treating multiple sclerosis, adapted to the Mexican health system and its needs.

39588648.conclusion_quote: Our study suggested a critical link between POMS and psychosis emphasizing the need for thorough evaluation, early diagnosis, and prompt management.
39588648.summary: Researchers reviewed a patient and nine published case reports, finding that psychosis often appeared before pediatric multiple sclerosis was diagnosed, so doctors should screen young patients with psychosis for MS.

39579647.conclusion_quote: PRO instruments are the best way to know the patients' perception of their symptomatology in this case of fatigue, which will undoubtedly contribute to a better approach and better intervention strategies in a personalized way, another component in the improvement of the quality of care and in line with the new paradigm of patient-centered care, which requires an assessment of fatigue by means of a PRO instrument.
39579647.summary: Researchers reviewed questionnaires that ask people with MS about their fatigue and checked how well they measure it, finding that quality varies across tools.

37714098.conclusion_quote: Our study highlights that approximately 24% of pwMS experience migraine.
37714098.summary: About a quarter of people with multiple sclerosis have migraines, and they are roughly twice as likely to have them as healthy people.

42906194.conclusion_quote: Physical disability, cognitive symptoms, adverse health behaviours may drive which type and amount of activity a PwMS participates in.
42906194.summary: This chart review of 455 people with MS found that walking ability, driving, disability level, and smoking were linked to whether they met recommended exercise levels.

37880997.conclusion_quote: In studies that reported safety outcomes, there was no higher risk of relapse, AE, adverse effects or SAE for exercise training than the comparator.
37880997.summary: Exercise in people with MS did not increase the risk of relapses, side effects, or serious adverse events compared with no exercise in the trials reviewed.

38015240.conclusion_quote: All guidelines were found to contain inadequate recommendations for osteoporosis screening, management and treatment in people with MS given the evidence of higher prevalence of osteoporosis at an earlier age and compounding risk factors in this population.
38015240.summary: Researchers reviewed existing guidelines and found that none adequately address bone thinning, fractures and falls in people with MS, despite their higher risk.

37139531.conclusion_quote: An estimated 36% of people with MS suffer from anxiety.
37139531.summary: About 36% of people with multiple sclerosis have anxiety, which is linked to age, being female, living with others, past mental health problems, depression, and not taking MS medication.

37667181.conclusion_quote: The result of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that menopause can be associated with relapse rate reduction, unlike increase in disease-related disability in women with MS.
37667181.summary: Menopause was linked to fewer MS relapses but a rise in disability in women with MS, based on four combined studies.

40880040.conclusion_quote: This review demonstrates the importance of integrating the subjective experiences of people with MS into research to ensure that the multidimensional aspects of MS-related fatigue, together with these people's values, needs, and preferences, are captured and used to develop useful, comprehensive, and meaningful tools designed to measure MS-related fatigue.
40880040.summary: Researchers reviewed 85 studies and found that existing fatigue questionnaires for MS miss some causes and effects of tiredness, so better tools are needed.

41619131.conclusion_quote: MBMIs are commonly included in MS exercise reviews and may improve balance, pain, and depression.
41619131.summary: Mindful movement exercises like tai chi, yoga and dance may help people with MS with balance, pain and low mood, but the evidence is weak and needs better trials.

36905816.conclusion_quote: AZA, MMF, RTX, maintenance IVIG, and TCZ all reduce the risk of relapse in both pediatric and adult patients with MOGAD.
36905816.summary: Pooling 41 studies, this review found that five common medicines reduced relapses in children and adults with MOGAD, though most evidence came from retrospective studies.

37001408.conclusion_quote: This review concluded that TOT alone can be effective for improving UL functions in patients with MS but meta-analyses showed non-significant differences when it was compared with conventional physical therapy.
37001408.summary: Five small trials found task focused training alone may help arm and hand function in people with MS, but it was not clearly better than standard physical therapy.

42662141.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the 2024 revisions of the McDonald criteria aim to facilitate an accurate and early diagnosis of MS potentially enabling earlier MS therapy initiation.
42662141.summary: Experts in Germany discuss how to apply the 2024 McDonald criteria for diagnosing MS, noting that new scans and blood markers need more resources and training.

37078621.conclusion_quote: Robot-assisted gait training with grounded exoskeletons exerts a positive short-term effect and is an adequate treatment option for patients with MS.
37078621.summary: Walking training with robotic exoskeletons improved walking speed, endurance, balance and fatigue in people with MS, but no clear differences remained at later checkups.

36658048.conclusion_quote: Cases of MS and NMOSD have been reported following COVID-19 vaccination.
36658048.summary: Researchers reviewed 12 case studies and found that some people developed multiple sclerosis or NMOSD after COVID-19 vaccination, though larger studies are needed to confirm any link.

41300861.conclusion_quote: The different versions of the MSISQ-15 are valid for use in the Polish, German, Italian, French, Turkish, Greek, and Spanish populations, and it will be necessary to adapt the questionnaire to other languages for use with patients with multiple sclerosis in other countries.
41300861.summary: This review found that the MSISQ-15 questionnaire, which measures sexual problems in people with MS, is valid in seven languages and needs adapting for others.

40786588.conclusion_quote: Fampridine has a significant role in decreasing cognitive impairments is MS patients.
40786588.summary: Pooling 15 studies, this review found that fampridine, a drug usually used for walking, was linked to modest improvements in thinking and memory test scores in people with MS.

42631555.conclusion_quote: The integration of consensus-based guidelines with a standardised, extensible implementation provides a practical basis for consistent and reproducible specification of disability outcomes in MS.
42631555.summary: Experts agreed on practical rules for calculating disability outcomes in MS studies and built free software, msprog, so researchers can calculate and report results consistently.

40471928.conclusion_quote: Despite a detailed breakdown of measures of association, no clear pattern emerged regarding the link between proprioceptive ability and physical function.
40471928.summary: Across 56 studies of stroke, Parkinson's and MS, proprioception and physical function were usually linked, but no clear pattern emerged about how strongly they connect.

40551221.conclusion_quote: OCT-A metrics demonstrate potential as biomarkers that may help distinguish MS and NMOSD, with PwNMOSD showing more severe retinal vascular alterations.
40551221.summary: Review of nine studies found that eye scans measuring tiny blood vessels in the retina may help tell apart MS and NMOSD, with NMOSD showing more damage.

36315017.conclusion_quote: These findings show an association between TMD and MS.
36315017.summary: A meta-analysis of eight studies found people with multiple sclerosis have about twice the risk of jaw joint and chewing muscle disorders compared with controls.

39684620.conclusion_quote: Key genetic loci and immune system-related genes, such as HLA class II genes, are associated with MS susceptibility.
39684620.summary: This review found that certain genes, especially HLA class II genes, are linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, and gene changes may also affect disease progression.

41038424.conclusion_quote: Multicomponent exercise programs appear to improve fatigue, functional capacity, and physical fitness in patients with GBS and CIDP.
41038424.summary: Exercise programs mixing strength, aerobic, balance and breathing training appear to reduce tiredness and improve daily function in people with Guillain Barré syndrome and CIDP.

36303065.conclusion_quote: Overall, AI models can further improve our diagnostic practice in MS patients.
36303065.summary: A review of 41 studies found AI tools diagnosed multiple sclerosis accurately, with about 94% overall accuracy, especially when analysing MRI scans.

37403051.conclusion_quote: The result of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that the pooled prevalence of SD in women with MS is 61% and the odds of developing SD in comparison with controls is 3.05.
37403051.summary: About 61% of women with multiple sclerosis experience sexual dysfunction, and they have roughly three times the odds of it compared with women without MS.

38721672.conclusion_quote: Our findings show that CP imaging has the potential to become a novel and valuable tool in multiple sclerosis management.
38721672.summary: A review of 16 studies found that the choroid plexus, a brain structure, is often enlarged in people with multiple sclerosis, suggesting imaging it could help manage the disease.

42190886.conclusion_quote: Much work remains to be done to optimize rehabilitation potential by applying the most methodologically rigorous research designs to provide class I evidence in support of specific treatment strategies.
42190886.summary: This review of 84 studies found growing research on cognitive rehabilitation for multiple sclerosis, but stronger high quality trials are still needed to prove which treatments work best.

41799794.conclusion_quote: Despite methodological heterogeneity, the available limited evidence indicates the association between periodontitis and MS.
41799794.summary: This review found that people with multiple sclerosis tend to have worse gum health and more gum-disease bacteria, though the evidence is limited and inconsistent.

40905746.conclusion_quote: VR can be a useful adjunct to traditional rehabilitation, but it may not be superior in all aspects of MS rehabilitation, unambiguous evidence regarding the effect of virtual reality training in multiple sclerosis is still missing.
40905746.summary: Virtual reality rehabilitation helped some outcomes in people with MS, like upper limb function and balance, but not gait, cognition, or fatigue, and stronger evidence is needed.

38859675.conclusion_quote: The findings from this synthesis provide support for the conceptualisation of MS as a shared experience to support couples' rehabilitation efforts.
38859675.summary: Eleven studies found couples coping with MS rely on good communication, a shared understanding of the illness, and focusing on the present moment.

39032400.conclusion_quote: Sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnicity are poorly reported in studies on SD in MS.
39032400.summary: Researchers reviewed sexual dysfunction studies in multiple sclerosis and found that most fail to report participants' gender, sexual orientation, or ethnicity.

39920457.conclusion_quote: Observational study data on the risk of infection in people with MS on DMT are sparse.
39920457.summary: Researchers reviewed 22 studies on infection risk in people with MS taking disease modifying drugs and found such real world evidence is limited and sparse.

37875941.conclusion_quote: These results reveal that tDCS is an effective treatment for improving gait ability with a low quality of evidence.
37875941.summary: Mild electrical brain stimulation improved walking in people with MS but did not clearly improve standing balance, according to a review of trials.

36473240.conclusion_quote: Our analyses provide level 1 evidence on the effect of balance intervention to improve mobility.
36473240.summary: Pooled trials show that balance and mobility training improves balance in people with MS, and longer, task specific sessions gave better results.

42063521.summary: This is a correction notice for a review on using 7 Tesla MRI scans in multiple sclerosis, and it does not report new findings.

41081871.conclusion_quote: Monitoring and educating patients on anti-CD20 mAb is fundamental to quickly identifying adverse events and minimizing clinical risks.
41081871.summary: Drugs targeting CD20 cells, such as rituximab and ocrelizumab, often caused low antibody levels and infections, and these risks grew with longer treatment.

39000478.conclusion_quote: This review provides support for the consideration of monocytes when researching effective diagnostics, therapeutic interventions, and procedures for managing MS pathophysiology.
39000478.summary: A review of 14 studies found that nonclassical monocytes may serve as biomarkers for MS and help guide diagnosis, treatment development, and disease monitoring.

36973708.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis of the studies reporting OCT-A measurements of people with MS confirmed the tendency of MS eyes to exhibit reduced vessel density in the macular and optic disc areas, mainly in SCP, DCP, and RPC vessel densities.
36973708.summary: Pooling 18 studies, this review found that eyes of people with MS have less blood vessel density in the retina than healthy eyes, which may serve as an imaging marker.

37408136.conclusion_quote: Physical activity levels remain significantly lower in persons with multiple sclerosis compared with controls, but the magnitude of difference has become smaller over the past decade.
37408136.summary: Adults with MS are less physically active than healthy controls, though the gap has narrowed over the past decade, and they are about as active as other clinical groups.

36171477.conclusion_quote: Our systematic review and meta-analysis confirm the temporal fluctuations in the relapse of MS through a comprehensive review of the existing literature, with a lower relapse rate during late summer and fall and a higher relapse rate during early spring.
36171477.summary: A review of 24 studies with about 29,000 people with MS found relapses are less common in late summer and fall and more common in early spring.

36722184.conclusion_quote: COVID-19 vaccination does not appear to increase the risk of relapse and serious adverse events in MS.
36722184.summary: Nineteen studies of over 14,000 people with MS found COVID vaccines rarely caused relapses or serious side effects, supporting vaccination for people with MS.

40880702.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis concluded that robotic rehabilitation was effective for gait rehabilitation in patients with MS.
40880702.summary: Pooled results from 12 studies suggest robotic training may improve walking in people with MS, though the walking test improvement was not clearly statistically significant.

38303903.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, IF might be a potential beneficial dietary intervention for MS.
38303903.summary: A review of five small studies suggests intermittent fasting may help manage symptoms and quality of life in MS, but more large trials are needed.

40132489.conclusion_quote: CCM can be a non-invasive imaging biomarker for axonal degeneration in pwMS.
40132489.summary: Eight studies found that an eye scan detects nerve damage in people with MS, and that nerve loss relates to the MSSS severity score.

36864256.conclusion_quote: MS patients are recommended to participate in at least three multicomponent training sessions per week, with each session lasting up to 60 min, and the exercise goal of 180 min per week can be achieved by increasing the frequency of exercise.
36864256.summary: Exercise produced a small improvement in thinking and memory in people with multiple sclerosis, with multicomponent programs of about 60 minutes, three times weekly, working best.

37172366.conclusion_quote: Exercise training is clinically effective for improving overall HRQOL in MS and produces greater improvements in the physical domain of HRQOL than the mental domain.
37172366.summary: Exercise programs, especially supervised group aerobic training lasting at least three months, improved overall quality of life in people with MS, with bigger benefits for physical health than mental health.

38457882.conclusion_quote: Treatment of steroid-resistant ON with CTC+PLP or CTC+IVIG is more effective than treatment with CTC alone.
38457882.summary: Pooling six studies, adding plasma exchange or immunoglobulin infusions to steroids helped steroid-resistant optic neuritis recover vision more often than steroids alone.

40902228.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that MSC therapy holds potential for slowing disease progression and promoting neurological recovery in MS patients.
40902228.summary: This review of 34 studies found stem cell therapy may calm the immune system, protect nerves and aid recovery in MS, but long-term benefits remain unclear.

42741224.summary: This is a correction notice for a review of brain imaging studies in people with MS, which looked at how brain activity relates to movement and thinking.

39249502.conclusion_quote: MAbs used in MS immunotherapy have shown to induce secondary autoimmune disorders including endocrine complications, which have been reported in many case reports.
39249502.summary: Researchers reviewed published case reports of autoimmune hormone gland disorders caused by MS antibody drugs, finding thyroid problems most often, especially with alemtuzumab.

39217808.conclusion_quote: Our systematic review provides valuable insights into RIDA in NMOSD.
39217808.summary: Review of 38 studies of 1881 neuromyelitis optica patients found signs of ongoing nerve damage and inflammation between relapses, mostly in the eye and vision system.

38849992.conclusion_quote: More efforts should be done to improve transparency, accuracy, and representativeness, in publications and at a design phase, by addressing social determinants of health that historically limit the enrollment of underrepresented population.
38849992.summary: Many clinical trials of MS treatments did not report race or ethnicity, and most participants were White, with few Black or Asian people enrolled.

38823049.conclusion_quote: The evidence supports ITB as a clinically effective treatment for MSRS, particularly in patients in whom oral antispasmodics and physiotherapy have failed.
38823049.summary: Intrathecal baclofen, a pump delivering medicine into the spinal fluid, appears to reduce muscle stiffness in people with MS whose tablets fail, and most side effects were surgical.

37170791.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis and systematic review suggested that HSCT can be effective in the treatment of refractory CIDP.
37170791.summary: Pooled data from 11 studies of 89 patients suggest stem cell transplant can help people with treatment-resistant nerve inflammation (CIDP), though it carries risks.

42911241.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that the panel of French neurologists favoured monoclonal HET initiation amongst treatment-naïve RRMS patients with high radiological disease activity, whereas clinical characteristics played a complementary role.
42911241.summary: French neurologists agreed that people newly diagnosed with MS and showing many lesions on scans should start strong monoclonal drugs early, with symptoms playing a smaller role.

41226806.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our review highlights the necessity of expanding B cell-oriented MS research beyond antibody production to include a broader spectrum of B cell functions.
41226806.summary: This review of proposed B cell targets in MS found most lack specificity, suggesting antibodies may not start lesions and other B cell roles deserve more study.

42956555.conclusion_quote: These LATAM-adapted consensus recommendations provide a practical, evidence-informed framework for MRI use in NMOSD, aiming to improve diagnostic accuracy, harmonize imaging practices, and optimize patient management across diverse healthcare settings.
42956555.summary: Latin American experts agreed on practical rules for using MRI scans to diagnose, monitor, and manage neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder across different healthcare settings.

41080911.conclusion_quote: Several DMTs-including newer therapies-significantly reduce BVL, and this effect correlates with reduced disability accumulation.
41080911.summary: A review of 33 trials found that several MS drugs, including newer ones, reduce brain shrinkage, and this effect is linked to slower disability worsening.

37182477.conclusion_quote: The frequency of NMOSD attacks occurring after vaccination is low and non-specific to different vaccine technologies.
37182477.summary: A pooled review found that attacks of neuromyelitis optica occurring within a month of vaccination are rare, occurring in about 2 percent of patients.

37255097.conclusion_quote: This evidence supports the recommendations to treat MS-related spasticity with rTMS, but underlines the need for further large randomized trials.
37255097.summary: Repetitive magnetic brain stimulation reduced muscle stiffness in people with MS right after treatment, but the benefit was not clear two weeks later.

40497375.conclusion_quote: The results of the reviewed studies are undoubtedly encouraging, reinforcing CVS's role as a valuable tool in multiple sclerosis management.
40497375.summary: A review of 48 studies found the central vein sign, a brain scan feature, helps tell multiple sclerosis apart from similar conditions and may aid diagnosis.

36114398.conclusion_quote: The total prevalence of SD in women with MS was found considerably high (62.5%) in the world, which needs more serious attention by health policymakers.
36114398.summary: About 6 in 10 women with multiple sclerosis have sexual dysfunction, according to a review of 14 studies covering 2,115 women worldwide.

42355702.conclusion_quote: VR-based rehabilitation appears to be a safe, feasible, and effective approach for enhancing cognitive abilities in individuals with MS, particularly in processing speed and visuospatial memory.
42355702.summary: Virtual reality training appears to safely improve thinking skills in people with MS, especially processing speed and visual memory, though studies vary widely.

36848839.conclusion_quote: EIT presents higher efficacy in preventing disability progression, a similar safety profile, and can be cost-effective within a 5-year timeline.
36848839.summary: Starting with powerful drugs from the outset cut disability worsening by about 30 percent over five years compared with the step up approach, with similar safety and possible cost savings.

39455533.conclusion_quote: The scarcity of studies on exercise barriers in MS is partly due to the absence of reliable assessment methods for evaluating exercise adherence, along with the prevalent emphasis on physical activity.
39455533.summary: A review of thirteen studies found that fatigue, false beliefs, cost and lack of time are the most common reasons people with MS skip exercise.

39230834.conclusion_quote: Our study suggested that different primary vasculitis can be an important comorbidity of MS and can mimic its symptoms and MRI.
39230834.summary: This review found 18 patients with both MS and a blood vessel inflammation disease called vasculitis, which can mimic MS symptoms.

42502707.conclusion_quote: Overall, real-world practice in Sweden broadly aligns with national recommendations, with widespread use of rituximab before pregnancy reflecting its perceived safety and durable effect, alongside some individualized deviations from discontinuation guidance.
42502707.summary: Most women with MS in Sweden followed national advice on stopping disease modifying drugs around pregnancy, though many still received rituximab before conception.

40506118.conclusion_quote: There is a critical need for improved detection and monitoring of invisible symptoms in AQP4+NMOSD.
40506118.summary: Many people with NMO spectrum disorder have hidden symptoms like fatigue, pain, mood problems and bladder issues that are often missed, so better detection and monitoring are needed.

42501585.conclusion_quote: This Delphi consensus provides practical, region-specific guidance to optimize the use of cladribine tablets in RRMS across NWA, aiming to harmonize treatment practices and improve long-term outcomes.
42501585.summary: Senior neurologists across northwest Africa agreed on expert recommendations for using cladribine tablets, an oral drug, to treat relapsing multiple sclerosis in the region.

40047834.conclusion_quote: Systematic literature review and network meta-analysis revealed statistically significant superiority of divozilimab over cladribine and fingolimod and absence of statistically significant differences with alemtuzumab, ocrelizumab, ofatumumab and natalizumab in the annual relapse rate during 2 years of treatment.
40047834.summary: A pooled comparison of two-year trials found divozilimab reduced relapses more than fingolimod and cladribine, and worked about as well as several other MS drugs.

41383791.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrated that injection of intra-detrusor Onabotulinumtoxin had a positive effect on improving urodynamic findings in patients with MS.
41383791.summary: Botox injected into the bladder muscle improved bladder test results in people with multiple sclerosis, according to pooled data from five studies.

36807056.conclusion_quote: Increased postpartum annualised relapse rate and possible modifiers should be considered in counselling women with MS who are considering pregnancy.
36807056.summary: Women with MS had almost twice as many relapses in the first three months after giving birth compared with before pregnancy, though rates fell later.

36396812.conclusion_quote: RNFL thickness is associated with cognitive processing speed, verbal learning and memory, visual learning and memory, as well as verbal fluency in PwMS.
36396812.summary: Retinal nerve layer thickness measured by eye scans is linked to thinking speed, memory, and word fluency in people with MS, though the evidence is limited.

41843295.conclusion_quote: Results corroborate limited previous findings of a significant, but small, relationship between subjective and objective measurements of fatigue, but also suggest further investigation is needed in considering fatigue construct definitions and assessment within the context of these significant moderators.
41843295.summary: Researchers pooled 66 studies and found that questionnaire fatigue scores and performance tests in MS only weakly match, with stronger matches in studies with more women.

38412757.conclusion_quote: Voluntary walking interventions appear to be safe and effective at improving walking performance in pwMS.
38412757.summary: Walking programmes in people with MS were safe, well attended, and improved walking speed and distance, though larger studies are needed to confirm this.

37520572.conclusion_quote: It is important to consider MOGAD as an underlying etiology for adult CCE, as early detection and immunotherapy may improve outcomes.
37520572.summary: Two new cases and a review of 39 published patients show that MOG antibody disease can cause brain cortex inflammation with seizures and headaches, often improving with steroid treatment.

35526474.conclusion_quote: The findings of this study imply that the cytokines genes interleukin IL2RA and IL7R may play a role in the development of MS.
35526474.summary: This summary of earlier pooled studies found no genetic markers with convincing evidence for MS risk, though a few gene variants, including in IL2RA and IL7R, showed suggestive links.

39342299.conclusion_quote: Evidence proposes sleep is an independent factor associated with cognitive outcomes in MS.
39342299.summary: This review of 35 studies found that objectively measured poor sleep is linked to thinking problems in MS, but more rigorous research is needed.

40485316.conclusion_quote: Compared with placebo, two-, and three-year treatment with rituximab or interferon beta-1b, respectively, probably slightly reduce relapses in PMS people.
40485316.summary: A review of 23 trials found rituximab and one type of interferon may slightly reduce relapses in progressive MS, while several treatments led more people to stop due to side effects.

39260224.conclusion_quote: Publications were heterogeneous in measuring efficacy, with different use of endpoints and relapse definitions.
39260224.summary: This review of 127 NMOSD studies found researchers measure treatment success in many different ways, and relapse definitions often are not stated, making comparisons difficult.

41175453.conclusion_quote: These results support a novel biological hypothesis linking impaired MTHFR function to protection from MS.
41175453.summary: A genetic variant that reduces activity of an enzyme involved in folate processing was linked to lower risk of developing MS, but not to disease severity.

38534961.conclusion_quote: The role of inflammation and subsequent SVZ microenvironment disruption is evident in MS pathology.
38534961.summary: A review of 20 studies finds that inflammation disrupts the brain's subventricular zone in MS, which may reduce the brain's ability to repair myelin.

37393524.conclusion_quote: Quantitative MRN has considerable diagnostic value in CIDP patients with accuracy and reliability.
37393524.summary: Quantitative MR nerve imaging was accurate for diagnosing CIDP, a nerve disorder, with fractional anisotropy and nerve size as the most promising measures.

36608917.conclusion_quote: Neurofilament light chain and vitamin D are promising biomarkers to track impairments in IPS in MS.
36608917.summary: Blood and spinal fluid levels of neurofilament light chain, plus blood vitamin D, were linked to slower thinking speed in people with MS, suggesting they could help track cognitive decline.

38330723.conclusion_quote: This co-occurrence, though rare, suggests potential underlying shared mechanisms or vulnerabilities, possibly at a genetic or environmental level.
38330723.summary: Researchers reviewed published case reports and found 145 people with both multiple sclerosis and a brain tumour called glioma, most with relapsing MS.

37294322.conclusion_quote: Results of the study indicate that the correlation between 9-HPT and PROMs is strong, although the constructs measured by these instrument does not fully overlap.
37294322.summary: Researchers pooled 27 studies and found that a timed peg test of hand function and patient questionnaires about hand use are strongly linked, though they measure somewhat different things.

41919071.conclusion_quote: These findings support the use of anti-CD20 antibodies as an economically reasonable option in many healthcare settings, particularly when compared with platform therapies, while underscoring that cost-effectiveness relative to other high-efficacy treatments is context-dependent.
41919071.summary: Anti CD20 MS drugs were usually good value or money saving compared with older treatments, but results against other strong drugs varied by setting.

39867847.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis reports significant associations between higher concentrations of TNF-α, IFN-γ, IL-6 and IL-10 and level of depresson in individuals with MS.
39867847.summary: Researchers pooled 15 studies of people with MS and found higher levels of several inflammatory proteins were linked to more depression, though most studies were low quality.

38759513.conclusion_quote: Most MS patient groups revealed ERP abnormalities, suggesting that these neurophysiological tests may be a relevant and appropriate diagnostic aid method for cognitive impairment in MS.
38759513.summary: Researchers reviewed 26 studies and found that brain wave tests called event related potentials often showed abnormal results in people with MS and cognitive problems.

36311694.conclusion_quote: Unlike AQP4-IgG + NMOSD, MOGAD lacks clustering of autoimmune diseases and autoantibodies associated with systemic and organ-specific autoimmunity.
36311694.summary: Unlike NMOSD, MOGAD rarely clusters with other autoimmune diseases or cancers, so routine screening for them is not clearly needed, except for NMDA receptor encephalitis.

37866020.conclusion_quote: The comprehensive data indicate that TCZ treatment can reduce the frequency of NMOSD relapses, improve patients' neurological function, and have good safety.
37866020.summary: Tocilizumab, a drug that blocks interleukin 6 signalling, reduced relapses and improved disability scores in people with neuromyelitis optica, with mostly mild side effects.

42073506.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that identifying and treating sleep disorders may be essential for optimizing cognitive rehabilitation outcomes in MS.
42073506.summary: A review of sleep studies in MS found that fragmented sleep, poor sleep quality, and low oxygen levels at night are linked to worse attention, thinking speed, and memory.

39593675.conclusion_quote: The evidence for the impact of TO training on upper extremity function in PwMS was limited.
39593675.summary: Five randomized trials found task-oriented training was safe for people with MS but did not work better than usual treatments for arm and hand function.

41100485.summary: This is a correction notice for a published plan for a review of whether diet changes affect inflammation markers in people with MS.

40366569.conclusion_quote: PROMs of good quality assessing all relevant aspects of HRQoL are required for better insight in HRQoL in patients with GBS and CIDP.
40366569.summary: This review found that no current patient questionnaire is fully reliable for measuring quality of life in people with GBS or CIDP, though one fatigue scale performed well.

41984387.conclusion_quote: The MSQOL-54 demonstrates robust potential for global application, though its psychometric performance remains contingent on sample size and regional reporting norms.
41984387.summary: A review of ten studies found the MSQOL 54 quality of life questionnaire works well across many countries, though mental wellbeing often differs from physical disability levels.

42369642.conclusion_quote: Current guideline statements on MRI prediction in RRMS often rely on associations rather than validated individualized predictions.
42369642.summary: Guideline statements that MRI can predict future MS outcomes mostly rely on correlations and associations, not on validated tools that estimate individual risk accurately.

35963537.conclusion_quote: Sexual dysfunction is a prevalent complication of MS in male patients which should be considered by clinicians.
35963537.summary: About two thirds of men with multiple sclerosis have sexual problems, and about half have erectile dysfunction, according to a pooled analysis of 29 studies.

39104136.conclusion_quote: Based on the available data, aHSCT does not halt progression in people with PMS.
39104136.summary: Stem cell transplants did not stop progression in people with progressive MS, though some selected patients seemed to do better, and the evidence is inconsistent.

39274226.conclusion_quote: This study reports a 21-27% prevalence of OA in people with MS.
39274226.summary: Around one in five to one in four people with MS also have osteoarthritis, a joint condition, at rates similar to people without MS.

41440089.conclusion_quote: MR and AR may serve as effective complements to conventional and VR-based rehabilitation, particularly in personalized, task-oriented training for MS populations.
41440089.summary: A review of seven studies found that augmented and mixed reality training may briefly improve walking, hand grip and coordination in people with MS, though evidence is limited.

38876706.conclusion_quote: The evidence for the impact of TO training on people with MS was limited.
38876706.summary: Nine studies gave mixed, limited evidence that training on everyday movement tasks improves walking in people with MS, and the best method is unclear.

36055575.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that the pooled prevalence of cancer in MS patients who received rituximab is 1 in 100,000 cases.
36055575.summary: Researchers pooled 22 studies and found that about 1 in 100,000 multiple sclerosis patients treated with rituximab had cancer, though the studies varied widely.

39002455.conclusion_quote: Dual-task performance could be useful for assessing gait impairments in patients with multiple sclerosis provided that assessments and protocols are standardized.
39002455.summary: Walking while doing a second task slowed walking speed in both people with MS and healthy people, but these measures could not reliably separate early MS from healthy controls.

32222694.conclusion_quote: Our study suggested that epileptic seizures were common in MOG-Ab-associated disease and offered insight into associated factors that contribute to the occurrence of seizures.
32222694.summary: Seizures occurred in about one in five people with MOG antibody disease, more often in men and in those with acute brain inflammation.

38473835.conclusion_quote: Treatment strategies of multiple sclerosis that either target or utilize these cytokines seem rather promising, but more comprehensive research is necessary to gain a clearer understanding of how these cytokines precisely affect MS development and progression.
38473835.summary: This review finds that several interleukins are raised during active MS and may drive disease, while some may also protect nerves, but more research is needed.

36117421.conclusion_quote: Our study showed that polysomnographic abnormalities are present in MS.
36117421.summary: People with multiple sclerosis have poorer overnight sleep tests than healthy people, with more disrupted sleep and leg movements, especially in older or sleepier patients.

37380203.conclusion_quote: Chronic cerebrospinal venous insufficiency is significantly associated with multiple sclerosis and it is more prevalent in patients with multiple sclerosis than in healthy individuals, but considerable heterogeneity of results is still observed.
37380203.summary: Pooling 20 studies, this review found a blood drainage problem called venous insufficiency was more common in people with MS than healthy people, though results varied.

35839616.conclusion_quote: According to our meta-analysis, orthotic interventions do not seem to improve the balance of people with multiple sclerosis.
35839616.summary: Orthotic devices such as insoles and ankle foot braces did not reliably improve balance in people with multiple sclerosis, according to a review of nine studies.

39502271.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis showed that nabiximols was the most common cannabinoid which was used to control MS-related spasticity, and it was effective in controlling MS-related spasticity (significantly decreased SMD of NRS, and Ashworth after treatment).
39502271.summary: Review of 31 studies found that cannabinoid medicines, mainly nabiximols, reduced spasticity symptoms such as muscle stiffness in people with MS.

39492055.conclusion_quote: This systematic review pointed out possible beneficial effects of Mediterranean-like diets for MS patients.
39492055.summary: A review of 11 studies found hints that a Mediterranean style diet may ease inflammation, fatigue, and attacks in MS, but better trials are needed.

37265062.conclusion_quote: The most efficacious DMTs for RMS were mAb therapies.
37265062.summary: This review compared MS drugs for relapsing disease and found antibody treatments were most effective at reducing relapses and disability worsening.

36058956.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that the pooled prevalence of RLS is 28% in MS cases and 8%.
36058956.summary: About 28% of people with multiple sclerosis have restless legs syndrome, compared with 8% of people without MS, and it is more common in women.

38678968.conclusion_quote: Observational studies show some evidence for an association between diet and MS symptoms, particularly quality of life and disability.
38678968.summary: A review of 32 observational studies found diet quality may be linked to better quality of life and disability in people with MS, but more evidence is needed.

37777076.conclusion_quote: Thus, we demonstrated the association between neuropathic pain, depression and anxiety symptoms and the influence of diagnosis, age, disease score, and disease duration in the increased prevalence of neuropathic pain in MS patients.
37777076.summary: Analysis of 24 studies found about 27 percent of people with MS have nerve pain, more often in women and in secondary progressive MS, and linked to depression and anxiety.

36521386.conclusion_quote: PwMS are more sedentary and engage in less LPA, MVPA, steps per day and accelerometer counts per day than healthy controls when measured using accelerometers during free-living conditions.
36521386.summary: People with MS are more sedentary and move less than healthy adults, based on wearable activity trackers worn during daily life.

36453167.conclusion_quote: The findings indicate that κ-FLC index has similar diagnostic accuracy in MS as OCB.
36453167.summary: A review of 32 studies found that a spinal fluid protein test, the kappa free light chain index, diagnoses MS about as accurately as the standard oligoclonal band test.

36779055.conclusion_quote: These results of this present study provide evidence that non-invasive brain stimulation could improve alertness in pwMS.
36779055.summary: Brain stimulation without surgery did not improve overall thinking in people with MS but helped motor function, spasticity, and alertness, especially in younger patients with milder disability.

36044828.conclusion_quote: In this study, we found rituximab to be relatively safe and efficacious in the treatment of NMOSD, particularly at a dose of 100mg intravenous infusion per week for 3 consecutive weeks.
36044828.summary: Rituximab reduced relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica patients and appeared fairly safe, with the best results at 100 mg weekly for three weeks.

38430123.conclusion_quote: Overall, the current evidence supports multi-task WM training rather than single-task-limited program.
38430123.summary: A review of 31 studies found working memory training helped people with brain injury or MS overall, though evidence is modest and long term everyday benefits are unclear.

41778011.conclusion_quote: Digital rehabilitation tools demonstrate promising usability and feasibility for motor rehabilitation in pwMS.
41778011.summary: Digital tools like games, apps and wearable sensors appear easy to use and may help people with MS improve walking and balance, though larger trials are needed.

34986455.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that TN is a common problem among patients with MS, predominantly male patients.
34986455.summary: Pooling 19 studies of about 30,000 people, this review estimates that about 3.4 percent of people with MS have trigeminal neuralgia, a severe facial pain condition, and it may be more common in men.

37638199.conclusion_quote: The reported cases of MOGAE following COVID-19 infection suggest an increasing new clinical problem, and show an association between COVID-19 and MOGADs.
37638199.summary: A 60-year-old man developed worsening memory and thinking problems after COVID-19 and tested positive for MOG antibodies. A review of 9 similar cases suggests a link between the two.

35988329.conclusion_quote: Aquatic therapy has positive effects on fatigue and balance.
35988329.summary: Pooled studies found that exercise in water reduced tiredness and improved balance in people with MS, though more long term research is needed.

40642279.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that the pooled incidence of MS-related relapse after COVID-19 is 7%.
40642279.summary: A pooled review of twelve studies found that about 7% of people with multiple sclerosis had a relapse after catching COVID-19.

35803087.conclusion_quote: ApoE may have a domain-specific association with cognitive impairment in MS patients.
