38551913.summary: Review of 60 MRI studies found brain wiring changes linked to depression and fatigue in relapsing MS, but results were mixed and inconclusive.

36203986.conclusion_quote: Based upon available literature, the rate of CNS demyelinating events occurring in the setting of preceding or concurrent SARS-CoV-2 infection is relatively low considering the prevalence of SARS-CoV-2 infection.
36203986.summary: A review of 67 articles found that brain and spinal demyelinating events linked to coronavirus infection are rare, and most affected patients had favourable outcomes.

38403972.conclusion_quote: These studies illuminate the multifaceted role of AMPK in MS animal models, involving energy metabolism, inflammatory processes, oxidative stress, and gene regulation leading to mitochondrial dysfunction.
38403972.summary: This review of eight animal studies found that the energy sensor AMPK is linked to mitochondrial damage, oxidative stress and altered gene activity in MS models.

33070914.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review shows that the prevalence of migraine in MS patients is 31% while the prevalence differs significantly among residents of different continents.
33070914.summary: Pooling 23 studies, this review found about 31 percent of people with multiple sclerosis also have migraine, with rates differing across continents.

37295321.conclusion_quote: Clinicodemographic data might aid in recognizing different subtypes of TmMS and warrant consideration of unconventional therapies because outcomes may be poor in the vInf of TmMS.
37295321.summary: A review of published cases found that tumefactive demyelinating disorders can mimic strokes, and inflammatory forms often had much worse outcomes than MS variants.

37782515.conclusion_quote: PIRA is the most frequent manifestation of disability accumulation across the full spectrum of traditional MS phenotypes, including clinically isolated syndrome and early RRMS.
37782515.summary: Researchers reviewed studies on disability that builds up in MS without relapses, finding it is the most common cause and proposing one shared definition.

39323842.conclusion_quote: Adherence to MeD may improve BMI and fatigue severity in MS patients.
39323842.summary: Pooled results from five randomised trials suggest a Mediterranean diet may modestly lower body mass index in people with MS, while the trend toward less fatigue was not statistically significant.

37057959.conclusion_quote: Adding the THC:CBD sprays have been shown to be more effective in treating MS spasticity than optimizing the dose of first-line antispastic drugs in selected responders patients.
37057959.summary: Sprays containing THC and CBD helped reduce muscle stiffness and improved daily activities for people with MS whose usual medicines were not working well enough.

37015139.conclusion_quote: Familial clustering of NMOSD is more common than would be expected in the general population.
37015139.summary: Neuromyelitis optica sometimes runs in families, and this study of Thai patients plus published cases found shared genetic features linked to the disease.

41648862.conclusion_quote: These findings explored identifying the DEGs among shade of the autoimmune disease RA, SLE, MS, and this hub gene are associated with transcription factors are most crucial role play in the disease potentially clinical therapeutic targets of the autoimmune disease.
41648862.summary: Researchers combined gene activity data from rheumatoid arthritis, lupus and multiple sclerosis to find shared key genes that might become future drug targets.

33420337.conclusion_quote: Differences in the Multiple Sclerosis and Neuromyelitis Optica genetic susceptibility was confirmed in Afro descendants.
33420337.summary: Pooling 13 studies, this review found that neuromyelitis optica is linked to specific immune genes, with the DRB1*03 gene group more common in patients, varying by ethnicity.

33878488.conclusion_quote: The present study demonstrated the hierarchy of DMTs treating RRMS.
33878488.summary: A review of 21 studies found most multiple sclerosis drugs reduce relapses compared with placebo, with ofatumumab, alemtuzumab and natalizumab ranking best overall.

33629669.conclusion_quote: These results indicated that probiotics may have beneficial effects on the prevention and treatment of multiple sclerosis.
33629669.summary: Combined trials in people with MS suggest probiotics may improve mood and mental health, while animal studies show they may reduce disease severity, though evidence quality is low.

33082449.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis found no significant association of MS with prevalent vitiligo (pooled OR 1.33; 95% CI 0.80‒2.22).
33082449.summary: Combining six studies, researchers found no clear link between multiple sclerosis and vitiligo, a skin condition causing pale patches, though ethnic and genetic differences may matter.

39445673.conclusion_quote: This work provides the basis for an evidence-based definition of outcome targets for relevant stakeholders and regulatory authorities.
39445673.summary: Researchers reviewed over a thousand studies to judge which MS measures can show whether treatment has stopped disease activity, and proposed practical outcome targets for clinics.

32896820.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis highlighted that the currently proposed therapeutic agents had no beneficial effects on the alleviation of MS-induced cognitive impairment.
32896820.summary: Pooled results from 31 studies found that cognitive drugs did not improve thinking in people with MS overall. Only fampridine showed a small gain in one test of processing speed.

38643612.conclusion_quote: We highlight some key EEG patterns in pwMS at rest and during movement, both suggesting an alteration or disruption of brain connectivity, more specifically involving sensorimotor networks.
38643612.summary: A review of 26 studies found that brain electrical recordings (EEG) show altered communication in movement control networks in people with MS, which may help detect motor problems.

36086713.conclusion_quote: NMOSDs patients treated with RTX can significantly reduce the relapse frequency and EDSS scores, and also improve neurological dysfunction, besides the efficacy is better than azathioprine.
36086713.summary: Pooled studies found rituximab reduced relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica patients, worked better than azathioprine, and caused mostly mild side effects.

35216773.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that PTNS in effective in treating LUTS in patients with MS.
35216773.summary: A review of eight studies found that a minimally invasive nerve stimulation near the ankle reduced bladder problems such as nighttime urination and leakage in people with MS.

34100130.conclusion_quote: Hospitalization rate is higher among MS patients based on COVID-19 infection while the pooled infection rate is estimated as 4%.
34100130.summary: About 4 percent of people with multiple sclerosis had COVID-19 infection, and those infected were hospitalized more often, at about 10 percent.

35175439.conclusion_quote: Conclusion Home-based VR and TR can be used as prolongation to conventional therapy.
35175439.summary: Home-based virtual reality and telerehabilitation improved balance over time in Parkinson, MS and stroke patients, but did not outperform control groups.

37483528.conclusion_quote: Our findings highlight that the presence of UC increases the risk of developing MS by more than 50%, whereas the presence of MS does not increase the risk of UC occurrence.
37483528.summary: Patients with ulcerative colitis had a higher risk of later developing multiple sclerosis, while multiple sclerosis did not significantly raise the risk of developing ulcerative colitis.

39290831.conclusion_quote: The results of this meta-analysis showed that cognitive rehabilitation has an effect on improving the performance of patients with MS.
39290831.summary: Cognitive training programs helped some memory, thinking and mood measures in people with MS compared with routine rehabilitation, but not all outcomes improved.

33012266.conclusion_quote: Amantadine is the most studied drug that has shown improvement of MS-related fatigue, with mild side effects and good tolerability.
33012266.summary: Researchers reviewed 11 clinical trials and found that amantadine can reduce fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, with mild side effects.

36549103.conclusion_quote: It is important to understand patients' experiences with the disease and identifying problems to help and support families, patients, and health care personnel's.
36549103.summary: This review of 13 studies found that people with MS often feel strong emotions after diagnosis, struggle with communication with clinicians, and fear being seen as different.

36130458.conclusion_quote: Eighteen out of 20 papers reported the existence of a moderate effect size when analysing the relationship between illness perceptions and outcome, whereby "positive" perceptions (e.g. stronger beliefs of control) related to better outcomes, while "negative" ones (e.g. attribution of negative consequences to the disease) related to worse outcome.
36130458.summary: Researchers reviewed 20 studies and found that people with MS who held positive views of their illness tended to have better outcomes than those with negative views.

34512632.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our meta-analysis indicated that MSC administration improved functional recovery and promoted remyelination prominently in rodent models of MS.
34512632.summary: Stem cell treatment from mesenchymal cells improved movement and nerve coating repair in MS animal studies, according to a review of 88 studies.

38085006.conclusion_quote: Here, we show the potential role of anti-CD20 therapy more of a boon than a bane as the therapy yields more promising results for MS treatment.
38085006.summary: This review finds that drugs that deplete B cells such as rituximab show promise for multiple sclerosis, and their side effects can be reduced with careful treatment planning.

36279391.conclusion_quote: It aims to improve the quality of life for people with multiple sclerosis by promoting prompt and effective symptom management and relapse treatment, and comprehensive reviews.
36279391.summary: This NICE guideline explains how doctors should diagnose and manage multiple sclerosis in adults, focusing on symptom control, relapse treatment and reviews to improve quality of life.

33254090.conclusion_quote: The study demonstrated that prior HSV-1 infection might relate to the onset of pediatric MS/CIS and might not play a role in the development of adult MS.
33254090.summary: Pooled data from eight studies found higher herpes simplex type 2 antibody levels in people with MS or early symptoms, while HSV-1 links appeared only in children.

33611721.conclusion_quote: GKRS still represents a valuable option for MS-TN; however, its long-term efficacy should be always considered.
33611721.summary: Gamma Knife radiosurgery relieved facial pain in most MS patients with trigeminal neuralgia at first, but only about half kept the relief over time.

39474367.conclusion_quote: E-based PE interventions in pwMS may improve MS-related symptoms, but the study quality is generally low, and findings are often inconsistent.
39474367.summary: Home-based video, telerehabilitation and web exercise programs may help people with MS feel better, but the studies are small and their results are inconsistent.

34770694.conclusion_quote: Conclusion VRBT is effective at reducing fatigue and MS impact and improving QoL in PwMS.
34770694.summary: Virtual reality therapy reduced tiredness, the effect of MS on daily life, and improved quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis, based on twelve randomised trials.

33609924.conclusion_quote: Our systematic review and update meta-analysis provide new evidences that RTX can effectively improve disability and reduce ARR ratio.
33609924.summary: A review of 29 studies with 732 NMOSD patients found rituximab reduced disability scores and relapse rates after treatment.

37442074.conclusion_quote: Our findings verify the significant positive relationship between Cpn infection and MS.
37442074.summary: Researchers pooled 37 studies and found that infection with Chlamydia pneumoniae bacteria was linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, especially when detected by PCR testing.

33565886.conclusion_quote: Pregnancy is associated with lower disease activity, and puerperium with higher disease activity.
33565886.summary: Women with MS had fewer relapses during pregnancy but more after giving birth, while disability and birth outcomes were generally similar to other women.

40599174.summary: This erratum corrects a published systematic review of prediction models for whether clinically isolated syndrome progresses to multiple sclerosis.

37290187.conclusion_quote: Current scientific data do not allow for strong recommendations on the choice of treatment for CIDP.
37290187.summary: Seven studies found IVIG helped about 61 percent of CIDP patients with diabetes, versus 71 percent without, but evidence is too limited for firm advice.

36963169.conclusion_quote: According to this review, MT intervention has positive therapeutic effects on gait disorders in PwMS.
36963169.summary: Music therapy appeared to improve walking problems in people with multiple sclerosis, with ten of twelve included studies confirming benefit.

36674968.conclusion_quote: It is evident that the use of RNA-seq in the study of complex pathologies, such as MS, is a valid strategy to shed light on new involved mechanisms.
36674968.summary: This review examines gene activity in MS, finding distinct molecular patterns at different disease stages and new deregulated pathways that help explain how the disease works.

37670845.conclusion_quote: Comparative effectiveness of SMI is currently unknown.
37670845.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of whether structured self-management education helps people with MS manage symptoms, mood, fatigue, pain and quality of life.

35674609.conclusion_quote: This study found that beer intake could cause an excess risk of multiple sclerosis.
35674609.summary: Pooled studies found no overall link between drinking alcohol and multiple sclerosis risk, but beer drinking was linked to higher risk. Larger studies are needed to confirm this.

36621161.conclusion_quote: We provide strong evidence for increased depression prevalence in plwMS who are either current-smokers or former-smokers.
36621161.summary: Smoking, both current and former, was linked to higher depression in people with MS, while only current smoking was linked to more anxiety.

38684013.conclusion_quote: The findings of this review suggest that TBS may hold promise in addressing specific MS symptoms, notably fatigue and spasticity.
38684013.summary: A review of five small trials found that brain stimulation called theta burst may help reduce spasticity and fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis.

34134109.conclusion_quote: Collectively, we found that PM exposure (PM10 and PM2.5) in MS patients associates with the occurrence and relapse of disease.
34134109.summary: Researchers combined ten studies and found that breathing fine and coarse air particles is linked to more multiple sclerosis cases and relapses.

39359438.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that robotic rehabilitation has positive effects on fatigue, and disability in patients with MS.
39359438.summary: Robotic rehabilitation appeared to reduce fatigue and disability in people with MS and improved mental health scores, based on 11 studies.

34495999.conclusion_quote: In this study, we show that paramagnetic rim lesions may be present in an important proportion of MS patients, notwithstanding significant variation in their assessment across studies.
34495999.summary: Pooling 29 studies, rim lesions appeared in about 41 percent of people with MS, but results varied widely between studies.

41191274.conclusion_quote: For PwMS to be unburdened by symptoms, professionals and stakeholders within the MS community should work together to meet the updated MS21 vision, including access to appropriate care, greater PwMS involvement in decisions, and further research and development to address unmet needs in MS.
41191274.summary: An international expert panel updated MS care standards, prioritising fast access to treatment after diagnosis, greater patient involvement in decisions, and research into progressive MS and repair.

36649574.conclusion_quote: There is a need for sharing standard definitions and components of feedback and serious game in technologically assisted upper limb rehabilitation.
36649574.summary: This review found that robotic arm training for people with MS often uses video game style feedback, but there are no shared standard definitions for it.

36544309.conclusion_quote: The effect of therapeutic exercise has a positive impact on the depressive symptoms of people with MS.
36544309.summary: Nine trials found that various exercise programs, such as aerobic training, Pilates and video games, can help reduce depression in people with MS.

35239684.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis shows that physical activity increases peripheral levels of BDNF in PwMS.
35239684.summary: Pooling 13 trials of 271 people with MS, this review found that exercise raises blood levels of a protein that supports nerve health.

35158467.conclusion_quote: Patients treated with rituximab seem to be at higher risk of severe COVID-19 outcomes compared to patients under other treatments.
35158467.summary: This review of 29 studies found that MS patients taking rituximab had higher rates of severe COVID-19 outcomes than those on other treatments.

32683307.conclusion_quote: There is evidence of the regional differences in the association between CMV IgG seropositivity and MS.
32683307.summary: Pooled studies found no overall link between cytomegalovirus antibodies and MS, but the link differed by region, being lower in Europe and higher in the Middle East.

35843587.conclusion_quote: Results found to date have shown that ML algorithms may offer great support for health professionals both in clinical settings and in research into MS.
35843587.summary: This review of studies found machine learning is used in MS to classify disease subtypes, tell patients from healthy people, and predict progression and treatment response.

37128143.conclusion_quote: Results support a significant association between ACEs and the development of MS; individuals with a positive history of ACEs develop MS symptoms earlier.
37128143.summary: This review of 11 studies found that childhood adversity is linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, earlier symptom onset, and more relapses.

32143784.conclusion_quote: Although the CVS is a clinically relevant and viable sign, further work is needed to integrate this into the existing diagnostic criteria.
32143784.summary: Central vein sign appears in about 46 percent of MS lesions, a useful diagnostic clue, but more work is needed before routine use.

38807619.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that there is no relationship between male factor infertility and risk of MS.
38807619.summary: A review of three studies found no clear link between male infertility and developing multiple sclerosis, though the evidence was inconsistent and uncertain.

37716210.conclusion_quote: PRLs can be reliably detected both at per-lesion and per-subject level.
37716210.summary: Researchers and doctors can reliably spot chronic active MS lesions on a special brain scan, both lesion by lesion and across each person's whole scan.

36121184.conclusion_quote: Psychological online interventions may improve physical, socio-affective and cognitive symptoms as well as QoL in pwMS, overcoming the face-to-face barriers (i.e. disability).
36121184.summary: Online psychological programmes, mainly cognitive behavioural therapy and mindfulness, appeared to help people with MS with mood, fatigue, stress and quality of life.

32787642.conclusion_quote: The results of this study indicated that the consumption of fish decreases the risk of MS [OR (95% CIs): 0.77 (0.64, 0.92); p-value = 0.004; I 2 = 54.7%] compared with controls.
32787642.summary: Pooling six observational studies, this review found people who ate more fish had lower odds of developing multiple sclerosis, though more research is needed to confirm this.

33162302.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, we propose a clinical classification of paediatric MOGAD with clinical definitions and key features.
33162302.summary: Experts reviewed how myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody disorders appear in children and proposed a clinical classification to guide future research.

39199465.conclusion_quote: NIBS might be an effective intervention for cognition improvement among pwMS.
39199465.summary: Brain stimulation and aerobic exercise may improve thinking skills like attention and processing speed in people with MS, though more research is needed.

34605190.conclusion_quote: The correlation between T1 hypointense lesions' mean volume and EDSS was interpreted as low to slightly moderate.
34605190.summary: A review of 27 studies with 1919 people found that bigger dark spots on brain MRI scans are only weakly to moderately linked to disability in multiple sclerosis.

38452336.conclusion_quote: The "digital revolution" led to increasingly customized tools for PwMS, especially as m-health or social-networking apps.
38452336.summary: Researchers searched app stores and found 54 multiple sclerosis apps, mostly free and in English, with most aimed at people with MS and fewer for doctors or caregivers.

37272878.conclusion_quote: The small association between the MSNQ and objective measures of cognition shows that the measures do not converge well.
37272878.summary: A review of 15 studies found that the MS screening questionnaire matches objective thinking tests only weakly, but it correlates moderately with mood.

36585597.conclusion_quote: The management of sexual dysfunction in PwMS needs to be further investigated.
36585597.summary: Review of nine studies found limited evidence for treatments of sexual problems in people with MS, including drugs, exercise, yoga and devices, calling for more research.

32507036.conclusion_quote: Reactive balance assessments can highlight functional impairments related to falls in people with MS, and perturbation training can acutely improve reactive balance control and such improvements can be retained for 24 hours in this population.
32507036.summary: People with MS have worse balance recovery after being pushed than healthy people, and short practice sessions improved their reactions, with gains lasting a day.

37499338.conclusion_quote: The currently available research supports the presence of PIRA in relapsing MS.
37499338.summary: Reviewers found 13 studies that differ in how they define progression without relapses in MS, with reported rates of 4% to 24%, and proposed a clearer definition.

32963057.conclusion_quote: According to the results of this study, the total score for HRQOL indicates moderate quality of life.
32963057.summary: A global review of 54 studies found that people with multiple sclerosis have moderate quality of life, with mental wellbeing better in Europe and physical wellbeing better in Asia.

35977771.conclusion_quote: Although abnormal results on auditory and vestibular tests were noted in PwMS, specific effects of MS on the audio-vestibular system could not be determined due to the heterogeneity between studies that restricted the ability to conduct any quantitative analyses.
35977771.summary: Review of 35 studies found hearing and balance tests often abnormal in people with MS, but heterogeneity prevented firm conclusions about MS effects on these systems.

34379879.conclusion_quote: Our findings revealed that probiotics supplementation can improve disease progression, suppress depression, and general health in MS patients; although, further investigations may be needed.
34379879.summary: Probiotic supplements improved disability scores, depression symptoms, and general wellbeing in people with relapsing MS, but did not change body weight or BMI.

40661885.conclusion_quote: This Delphi study highlights the need for tailored diagnostic tools and integrated treatment approaches for managing depression in MS.
40661885.summary: Italian MS neurologists agreed on how to recognise, diagnose and treat depression in MS, including a need for tailored diagnostic tools and talking therapies alongside medicines.

37500817.conclusion_quote: In this overlap syndrome of AQP4 + NMOSD and pSS, patients have a neurologically disabling disorder that can mimic neurological manifestations of pSS, frequently occurs prior to the onset of pSS, has a relapsing course, responds well to immunosuppressants, and necessitates indefinite treatment.
37500817.summary: A review of 44 patients with both neuromyelitis optica and Sjögren's syndrome found the nerve disorder often starts first, tends to relapse, and responds well to long term immune suppressing drugs.

35306242.conclusion_quote: Review regarding case reports showed that NMOSD is conceivable following COVID-19.
35306242.summary: A review of 11 published case reports found that neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, a rare inflammatory condition, can follow coronavirus infection.

37641617.conclusion_quote: Results highlight that insomnia and perceptions of poor sleep have a stronger link than objective sleep duration to fatigue in multiple sclerosis and may represent a more effective target for intervention.
37641617.summary: Across 46 studies, poor sleep quality and insomnia were strongly linked to fatigue in MS, while objectively measured sleep duration and awakenings were not.

39011445.conclusion_quote: The pooled prevalence of cognitive impairment in patients with MS is estimated as 41%, so CI it should be considered by clinicians.
39011445.summary: Pooled analysis of 90 studies found that about 41% of people with multiple sclerosis have cognitive impairment, a problem clinicians should watch for.

34720084.conclusion_quote: Thus, the adverse effects of headache and flu-like pain symptoms appear to be linked to IFN-β treatment in MS.
34720084.summary: Pooled trials found that people with MS who received interferon beta injections were more likely to get headaches and flu-like pain, which can make them less likely to keep taking the treatment.

33769574.conclusion_quote: Most measures assessed HRQoL and not QoL.
33769574.summary: This review found that most quality of life tools for children with MS measured health-related quality of life, and their scores were similar to those of healthy children.

34108854.conclusion_quote: For diagnosing of a specific subset of CIDP characterized by poor response to intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg), we found a moderate sensitivity and a high specificity.
34108854.summary: Antibody tests for a subtype of CIDP, a nerve disorder, were moderately sensitive and highly specific, so they work best as confirmation rather than screening.

34118585.conclusion_quote: This study shows that MOG-Abs represent a substantial proportion of AQP4-Ab seronegative NMOSD patients despite different underlying mechanisms, clinical manifestations, and treatment response, suggesting MOG-Ab screening in AQP4-Ab seronegative NMOSD patients can facilitate accurate diagnoses and treatments.
34118585.summary: Around a third of NMOSD patients who test negative for AQP4 antibodies have MOG antibodies instead, so testing for them can help doctors reach accurate diagnoses.

35026625.conclusion_quote: Our study provides high-grade evidence for the substantial presence of LME in MS and a comprehensive panel of other neurological diseases.
35026625.summary: This review found that a contrast-enhancing lining around the brain is common in MS, more so in progressive MS and on 7 T scans, and linked to greater disability and lesion load.

32629678.conclusion_quote: It is reliable to adopt results about infection, pregnancy period, and postpartum period.
32629678.summary: This review of 43 studies found infections, the postpartum period, stress, vitamin D and certain genes linked to more relapses in relapsing MS, while pregnancy was linked to fewer.

39338150.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this systematic review suggests that the NWF has shown favorable effects compared to control regimes on functional mobility and fatigue outcomes in patients with MS.
39338150.summary: Seven studies found that the Nintendo Wii Fit video game system improved walking and daily movement ability and reduced tiredness in people with multiple sclerosis compared with control treatments.

35661909.conclusion_quote: We found that the NMSRI has used previous experiences well and has achieved promising properties equal to European countries.
35661909.summary: This review compared 14 multiple sclerosis registries from 12 countries, finding Iran's registry performs well against European ones but needs more funding.

36728340.conclusion_quote: Initial real-world effectiveness data for ocrelizumab appear favorable and consistent with results reported in clinical trials, providing clinicians with an efficacious option to treat patients with multiple sclerosis.
36728340.summary: A review of 52 studies from everyday clinical practice found that ocrelizumab reduced relapses and disease progression in MS, similar to results seen in clinical trials.

41232276.conclusion_quote: This expert consensus provides evidence-based guidance for the diagnosis and management of NMOSD in Saudi Arabia, striking a balance between clinical evidence and expert opinion where data gaps exist.
41232276.summary: Saudi experts updated their guidance on treating NMOSD, a rare disorder that attacks the optic nerves and spinal cord, covering diagnosis, acute attacks, and long term drugs.

40485150.conclusion_quote: Many patients following GBS or with active CIDP experience symptoms that may fulfill the criteria for mental health diagnoses, but the paucity of literature suggests that mental health disorders are underdiagnosed and undertreated in this population.
40485150.summary: Many people with Guillain-Barré syndrome or active CIDP have mental health symptoms, and these are likely underdiagnosed and undertreated, so they need timely mental health care.

37111166.conclusion_quote: Interestingly, recent RCTs reported a significant reduction in new MRI lesions in the central nervous system of MS patients during supplementation with vitamin D3.
37111166.summary: Vitamin D supplements mostly did not reduce relapses or disability in MS patients, though recent trials showed fewer new brain and spinal lesions on MRI scans.

33819724.conclusion_quote: The level of CSF-GFAP is correlated with MS and its different subtypes, reflecting the different degrees of damage to astrocytes in different subtypes of MS.
33819724.summary: Pooling 11 studies, the review found that people with MS had higher levels of the GFAP protein in spinal fluid and blood than healthy or other controls.

36384390.conclusion_quote: The Mediterranean diet, on the other hand, is more recommendable than other diet models due to the positive health results reported in long-term studies and the absence of any side effects.
36384390.summary: This review of 17 studies from 2018 to 2022 found several diets showed promise for MS, but the Mediterranean diet appears safest and most recommended for long term use.

36155965.conclusion_quote: This systematic review is the first to report the strong association between stress and MS relapse, and, contradictory to past reports, an inconsistent relationship between stress and MS onset.
36155965.summary: Thirteen studies found stress is consistently linked to MS relapses, while its link to MS onset remains inconsistent, and timing of stress seemed to matter little.

35978300.conclusion_quote: High variability was observed in the estimated SPMS prevalence, and the quality of the studies conducted.
35978300.summary: Researchers pooled 86 good quality studies and found secondary progressive MS affects about 22 per 100,000 people, varying widely between countries and regions.

34744983.conclusion_quote: The results demonstrated that the serum AQP4-IgG titer was not associated with disease activity but indicated the disease severity in the attack phase in patients with NMOSD.
34744983.summary: Antibody levels in the blood did not differ between NMOSD attacks and remission, but higher levels matched more spinal cord involvement and greater disability during attacks.

32997295.conclusion_quote: Several preventive immunotherapies have been demonstrated to be effective and safe for adult patients with MOG-AD; however, large controlled studies for subgroups with specific manifestations are still needed in the future.
32997295.summary: A review of 33 studies found that several ongoing immunotherapies, such as steroids, rituximab and IVIG, can help prevent relapses in adults with MOG antibody disease.

39425889.conclusion_quote: A total of 30 studies were included, with the majority reporting real-world persistence data that appear to be similar to or better than in the pivotal clinical trials, with only 1 study reporting higher discontinuation rates due to adverse events compared with the clinical trials.
39425889.summary: This review of 30 real world studies found that people on ocrelizumab usually stayed on treatment as long as or longer than in clinical trials, with few stopping due to side effects.

35339007.conclusion_quote: Further well-designed comparative clinical trials with a large sample size can improve clinical management of tremor in patients with MS.
35339007.summary: Review of drug treatments for tremor in MS found mixed results: botulinum toxin helped but has side effects, while cannabis, levetiracetam and isoniazid showed weak or inconsistent benefit.

34325022.conclusion_quote: Exercise training has a positive effect on outcomes that capture participation, providing further evidence for the role of exercise training in promoting and maintaining engagement in everyday life.
34325022.summary: Exercise training improved participation in daily life for people with MS, with a moderate overall benefit across 23 randomized trials pooled together.

33594840.conclusion_quote: Added to the role of these biomarkers in determining prognosis and treatment response, to conclude, they may serve in diagnosis of MS and distinguishing different subtypes.
33594840.summary: This review of 64 studies found higher spinal fluid levels of nerve damage and support cell markers in MS, suggesting they could help diagnose MS.

41290343.conclusion_quote: This narrative review highlights the need for comprehensive and multidisciplinary clinical guidelines to optimize physical therapy interventions and improve the long-term well-being of MS patients.
41290343.summary: This review of three international guidelines finds that structured aerobic, resistance, balance and flexibility exercise helps MS patients keep their independence, though access and adherence remain challenges.

37042392.conclusion_quote: Despite some limitations, we pointed out the potential of NODDI in MS to unravel microstructural alterations.
37042392.summary: A review of 24 studies found that an advanced brain scan method called NODDI detects consistent changes in white and grey matter in people with MS.

32956562.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis showed the benefit of TPE during the NMOSD attack with a significantly improved disability status immediately after treatment and during follow-up.
32956562.summary: Plasma exchange given during an acute neuromyelitis optica attack improved disability scores, both right after treatment and during follow-up.

32470858.conclusion_quote: Little consensus existed on definition of adherence or determination of drop-out in MS exercise studies, with reporting generally of poor quality, if done at all.
32470858.summary: This review of 81 exercise trials in people with MS found that participants stuck with exercise well on average, but many studies reported adherence and dropouts poorly.

36184292.conclusion_quote: Cognitive impairment, cognitive fatigue and disability negatively influence MI ability in pwMS.
36184292.summary: Thinking through movements in your mind, called motor imagery, works less well for some people with MS. Thinking problems, tiredness and disability reduce it, while cues help.

38541964.conclusion_quote: Additionally, our findings highlight the significant association between abdominal fat, as indicated by WC, and disease progression.
38541964.summary: This review of 16 studies found that waist size, unlike body mass index, was linked to worsening disability in people with multiple sclerosis.

37528262.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that DMF is associated with a lower risk of relapses than TRF, with more nuanced differences in younger naïve patients.
37528262.summary: Dimethyl fumarate cut relapses slightly more than teriflunomide, but more people stopped dimethyl fumarate because of side effects.

35168496.conclusion_quote: Quantitative studies were synthesized using a narrative approach, with results suggesting that MS is associated with some degree of self-concept change.
35168496.summary: This review of 30 studies found that multiple sclerosis often changes how people see themselves, with change shaped by MS events and varying acceptance of those changes.

39425150.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised and non-randomised studies will provide an updated synthesis of the risk of cancer associated with DMTs for adult patients with multiple sclerosis.
39425150.summary: This protocol describes a planned review that will combine past studies to find out whether multiple sclerosis drugs change the chance of developing cancer.

40783885.conclusion_quote: This Italian Delphi underscores the importance of early, personalized HE-DMT use to optimize long-term outcomes in MS.
40783885.summary: Italian MS experts agreed that powerful treatments should start early and be tailored using scans, biomarkers and symptoms to prevent future disability.

35579532.conclusion_quote: RTP improves strength, functional capacity, balance, and fatigue in people with MS.
35579532.summary: Resistance training improved strength, walking, and balance in people with multiple sclerosis, according to this review of 44 studies.

31669297.conclusion_quote: While this review indicated that PwMS are capable of motor learning, several knowledge gaps still exist.
31669297.summary: Review of 17 studies found people with multiple sclerosis can learn motor skills such as moving around and using their hands, but evidence quality is low.

37406155.conclusion_quote: We recommend the MFIS for comprehensive measurement and the FSS for screening of subjective fatigue in people with MS.
37406155.summary: Researchers reviewed fatigue questionnaires used in multiple sclerosis and found the Modified Fatigue Impact Scale and Fatigue Severity Scale performed best.

37487596.conclusion_quote: AQP4+NMOSD in SLE patients is a relapsing and neurologically disabling disorder that can mimic neuropsychiatric manifestations, frequently occurs after the onset of lupus or may predate, responds to immunosuppressants, and necessitates indefinite treatment.
37487596.summary: Lupus patients can develop a relapsing, disabling neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder that may mimic lupus brain symptoms and usually needs lasting immunosuppressive treatment.

32541543.conclusion_quote: MBIs represent a valid and effective mind-body intervention to improve the well-being of patients with MS.
32541543.summary: Mindfulness-based programmes improved well-being in people with MS, reducing stress, depression and anxiety, and the benefits lasted after the programmes ended.

35180619.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, diagnosis of MS based on new markers and AI is a growing field of research with MRI images, followed by images obtained from OCT, serum and CSF biomarkers, and motor associated markers.
35180619.summary: This review of 38 studies found that artificial intelligence can accurately detect multiple sclerosis, mainly using MRI scans, with reported accuracy of 81 to 100 percent.

38736922.conclusion_quote: The results of the present systematic review and meta-analysis show that aquatic therapy is effective for depression, fatigue, and balance improvement in subjects with MS.
38736922.summary: Aquatic exercise in water appeared to improve depression, fatigue, and balance in people with multiple sclerosis, according to pooled results from ten studies.

32114368.conclusion_quote: Aquatic physical therapy is a valid means of rehabilitation for people with Multiple Sclerosis.
32114368.summary: A review of 11 randomized trials found aquatic physical therapy is a useful rehabilitation option for people with multiple sclerosis, though more studies are needed.

37839365.conclusion_quote: Fatigue has a major impact on PwMS yet there is limited trial-based evidence on the impact of DMTs on fatigue.
37839365.summary: Only 7 of 130 drug trials for MS measured fatigue, and the reporting of fatigue results was often poor, so evidence on drugs and fatigue is limited.

42118031.conclusion_quote: Following an investigation by the publisher, all parties have concluded that this article was accepted solely on the basis of a compromised peer review process.
42118031.summary: This notice retracts a 2024 meta-analysis on spinal cord stimulation and wound healing in people with MS because its peer review was compromised. The authors disagree with the retraction.

36964744.conclusion_quote: Results suggest that patients with MS and higher levels of depressive symptomatology may also show more difficulties in several aspects of cognition, especially those needed to retain, respond, and process information in one's environment, and to those needed be adequately stimulated in processing relevant information.
36964744.summary: People with multiple sclerosis who feel more depressed tend to have more trouble with thinking skills, such as memory, attention and processing speed.

32535500.conclusion_quote: The current study showed that MSCs transplantation could ameliorate clinical performance in EAE animal model of MS.
32535500.summary: Across 36 animal studies, stem cell transplants reduced disease symptoms in models of MS, and the benefit did not clearly depend on cell type or dose.

31991397.conclusion_quote: The prevalence and incidence of MS in the Persian Gulf region has gone through significant changes during the past decades.
31991397.summary: Pooled studies from Persian Gulf countries found MS prevalence rising over 1985 to 2018, with about 39 cases per 100,000 people and an average onset age of 23.

34959021.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis showed that the treatment of NMOSD patients with RTX, MMF and AZA is associated with decreased number of relapses and disability improvement as well, and there was no significant difference in the effect of the three drugs on reducing EDSS scores, but RTX significantly reduced ARR compared with the other two drugs.
34959021.summary: Rituximab, mycophenolate and azathioprine each reduced relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica patients, with rituximab cutting relapses more than the other two.

34912290.conclusion_quote: Synaptic loss seems to take place throughout the entire central nervous system.
34912290.summary: A review of autopsy studies found that connections between nerve cells are lost across much of the central nervous system in multiple sclerosis, though study results vary.

36331588.conclusion_quote: We conclude that there is limited evidence in the literature regarding clinical validation and in-use evaluation of commercial MS QReports with a particular lack of clinician end-user testing.
36331588.summary: This review found 10 companies offering MRI tools that measure MS brain changes, but evidence proving they work in clinics is limited, especially testing by clinicians.

40476168.conclusion_quote: Treatment with teriflunomide improves satisfaction in patients with MS.
40476168.summary: Nine observational studies found that people with MS taking teriflunomide were more satisfied with their treatment, especially with how convenient it was to take.

37541785.conclusion_quote: RCTs for DMTs in MS have relevant and frequent limitations.
37541785.summary: Researchers checked 31 large MS drug trials published since 2010 and found frequent weaknesses, especially in reporting participant details, outcome measures, and transparency about conflicts of interest.

33763014.conclusion_quote: These results provide preliminary evidence that tDCS has a favorable effect on cognitive processing speed, mood disturbance, pain, and fatigue in MS.
33763014.summary: Pooled studies suggest that a mild brain stimulation technique called tDCS may help people with MS with thinking speed, mood, pain, and tiredness, though results varied by test.

35410503.conclusion_quote: There is emerging evidence that relaxation therapies can improve outcomes for persons with multiple sclerosis.
35410503.summary: Review of 28 studies found relaxation techniques likely help mood, anxiety, stress and fatigue in people with MS, though study quality was often low.

35667315.conclusion_quote: Although by number of studies, the predominant pattern was increasing MS incidence, in studies where a consistent case definition was used across the duration of the study and with high population coverage, no predominant pattern of MS incidence was evident.
35667315.summary: Reviewing 64 studies, MS incidence mostly rose over time, but with consistent methods and wide population coverage no clear overall trend appeared.

33328183.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis suggests a high lifetime prevalence of BD in patients with MS.
33328183.summary: Pooled analysis of 23 studies found about 3% of people with multiple sclerosis have bipolar disorder, with 8% lifetime prevalence, suggesting routine screening.

36257149.conclusion_quote: Exercise studies in pwMS included primarily middle-aged (35-54 years) pwMS having an EDSS of 2.0-6.5 and a disease duration of 5-14.5 years.
36257149.summary: Most exercise studies in multiple sclerosis enrolled middle aged people with moderate disability, leaving young, older, and severely disabled people largely understudied.

32097613.conclusion_quote: ApaI and TaqI TT genotype were found contributing to MS susceptibility and BsmI and FokI showed no relation with MS susceptibility in the Iranian population.
32097613.summary: Pooling nine Iranian studies, this review found that the ApaI and TaqI gene variants were linked to multiple sclerosis risk, but BsmI and FokI were not.

34109523.conclusion_quote: PM 10 is correlated with the disease MS, while other pollution is not connected with MS.
34109523.summary: Only coarse particulate matter called PM10 was linked to multiple sclerosis in this review of six studies, while other air pollutants were not.

36077520.conclusion_quote: Information systematized in this review provides interesting data and new insight to help improve clinical outcomes for patients with neurodegenerative disorders.
36077520.summary: This review examines tear-based markers for Alzheimer's, Parkinson's and multiple sclerosis, finding possible biomarkers that could help diagnose and manage these diseases.

32554283.conclusion_quote: This review provides evidence to support the effectiveness of emotional wellness programs for improving mental health outcomes in adults with MS.
32554283.summary: Emotional wellness programs appeared to reduce depression, anxiety, and stress and improve quality of life in adults with multiple sclerosis, though the findings need cautious interpretation due to high variability.

35929897.conclusion_quote: This review suggests positive impacts of both VR-exergaming and conventional exercise in MS rehabilitation.
35929897.summary: A review of 10 trials found that both virtual reality gaming exercise and conventional exercise helped people with MS, with virtual reality often giving somewhat greater gains.

32900473.conclusion_quote: Physicians and patients should be aware of the updated recommendations for UTis and MS.
32900473.summary: French MS experts recommend treating urinary infections in MS as in the general population. UTIs do not raise relapse risk, but fever can worsen temporary symptoms.

37775062.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, NODDI is suggested to have higher sensitivity and specificity, as seen by inspecting imaging results, compared to DTI, while still being clinically feasible.
37775062.summary: This review of 11 studies found that brain tissue damage in multiple sclerosis extends beyond visible lesions, and that NODDI may detect it more sensitively than the standard DTI method.

32390502.conclusion_quote: These results do not support the efficacy of exercise training on global or domain-specific cognitive performance in pwMS.
32390502.summary: Exercise training did not meaningfully improve thinking abilities in people with multiple sclerosis, based on 13 included studies.

40775233.conclusion_quote: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) plays an essential role in the clinical management of MS, aiding in the diagnosis, monitoring disease activity, and assessing treatment effects.
40775233.summary: This paper reviews Portuguese MRI guidelines for multiple sclerosis and argues that neurologists and neuroradiologists need to collaborate better to use them.

36399965.conclusion_quote: Existing balance training interventions in PwMS primarily consist of practicing sensory and motor strategies.
36399965.summary: Review of 40 studies found balance training for MS mostly practiced sensory and motor skills, but rarely tracked intensity or gradual progression over time.

39325074.conclusion_quote: The results indicate that more neuropsychiatric symptoms, especially depressive symptoms and apathy, are associated with cognitive dysfunction in MS patients.
39325074.summary: Review of 37 studies found that depression and apathy in people with MS are most clearly linked to thinking and memory problems, while anxiety showed no consistent link.

33407874.conclusion_quote: Sexual dysfunction is highly prevalent in men with MS.
33407874.summary: About six in ten men with multiple sclerosis have sexual dysfunction, according to a pooled analysis of 20 studies.

39986280.conclusion_quote: Our integrated study identified novel germline and somatic mutations associated with NMOSD pathogenesis.
39986280.summary: Researchers combined genetic data from Japanese people to find inherited and acquired gene changes linked to NMOSD, a rare disease that inflames the optic nerves and spinal cord.

35069404.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this systematic review summarizes the pronounced differences in various socioeconomic outcomes between patients with MS with regards to their physical disability and cognitive function.
35069404.summary: Review of 19 studies found that people with MS who have more physical disability or cognitive problems more often face unemployment, lower earnings, and work disability.

32842948.conclusion_quote: All studies reported the beneficial effects of COX and LOX inhibitors in MS.
32842948.summary: This review of 146 studies found that inflammatory chemicals made from arachidonic acid are raised in MS, and drugs blocking them appeared helpful in the studies.

31452116.conclusion_quote: Among different categories of ATEs, Graves' hyperthyroidism was the most common thyroid dysfunction, occurring in more than half of cases.
31452116.summary: Alemtuzumab, an MS drug, often causes thyroid problems, mostly overactive thyroid from Graves' disease, affecting about a third of treated patients.

40713053.conclusion_quote: We have developed the first COS for future trials of complementary therapies for pwMS.
40713053.summary: Researchers and people with MS agreed on a set of 30 outcomes to measure in future trials of complementary therapies, so studies better reflect what matters to patients.

34537682.conclusion_quote: We find evidence for the utility of MEG in Multiple Sclerosis.
34537682.summary: A review of 30 studies found that magnetic brain recordings can detect abnormal brain activity and connections in people with MS, suggesting the method could be useful.

31132909.conclusion_quote: PwMS can benefit from ITA in the treatment of motor symptoms according to the current model of continuity of care.
31132909.summary: Telerehabilitation delivered at home improved motor function in people with MS, with a large effect, but showed little benefit for thinking skills or daily life.

31234793.conclusion_quote: Compared with the general population, people with MS have an increased risk of developing any type of stroke and ischemic stroke in particular.
31234793.summary: People with multiple sclerosis appear to have a higher chance of having a stroke than people without it, especially a stroke caused by a blocked blood vessel.

37124459.conclusion_quote: The findings of this review highlight the need to develop high-quality, comprehensive clinical practice guidelines with clear recommendations that can be globally implemented by healthcare clinicians working with people with MS.
37124459.summary: Only six guidelines on detecting and treating depression in MS were found, and most were low quality and inconsistent, so clearer guidance is needed.

39497494.conclusion_quote: Despite a wide range of non-pharmacological interventions used for the management of spasticity in pwMS, there is a lack of conclusive evidence for many.
39497494.summary: Reviewing 32 trials, the authors found moderate to low certainty evidence that exercise and brain magnetic stimulation can reduce spasticity in MS, while other therapies lack strong proof.

33897490.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest differential impairment of the core aspects of social cognitive processing in patients with MS, which may importantly inform the development of structured social cognitive MS interventions.
33897490.summary: People with multiple sclerosis struggled to work out what others think and feel, while sharing others' emotions was largely unaffected.

32535680.conclusion_quote: Available literature suggests a higher EPVS burden in MS patients compared to controls.
32535680.summary: Brain scans show that people with multiple sclerosis tend to have more enlarged perivascular spaces than healthy people, but these spaces do not yet reliably predict disease.

39923189.conclusion_quote: Through these guidelines, we aim to support safe, timely and effective management of patients with MS in Australia and New Zealand.
39923189.summary: Australian and New Zealand experts issued 80 consensus recommendations for managing adults with multiple sclerosis, covering drug choice, testing, monitoring, switching and stopping treatments.

39923190.conclusion_quote: A safe, effective and comprehensive approach to managing MS is crucial for improving long term outcomes and quality of life in individuals affected by MS.
39923190.summary: This Australian and New Zealand consensus gives doctors practical advice on safety during MS treatment, pregnancy, lifestyle, relapses and symptom management.

36701192.conclusion_quote: A meta-analysis would be informative, but study variability across the literature makes directly comparing AFO and FES device effects unreliable.
36701192.summary: Review of 17 studies on ankle braces and electrical stimulation for foot drop in MS found direct comparisons unreliable because study designs varied too much.

38253528.conclusion_quote: Only few and mostly small pragmatic trials exist in MS which rarely assess drugs.
38253528.summary: Researchers found only 48 pragmatic trials in MS, mostly small and testing supportive care rather than drugs, and very few used routine health data.

31055633.conclusion_quote: The month and the season of birth are significantly associated with MS births.
31055633.summary: Researchers combined 22 studies and found that people with multiple sclerosis were slightly more likely to be born in spring than in autumn.

37226414.conclusion_quote: Combined and resistance training seem to be the most effective exercises to improve muscular fitness and aerobic exercise for CRF in people with MS.
37226414.summary: Combined and resistance training improved muscle strength most, while aerobic exercise best improved heart and lung fitness, across 72 trials of people with MS.

39768480.conclusion_quote: Radiation-induced demyelination is a critical clinical and radiological entity that requires attention from both oncologists and neurologists.
39768480.summary: Radiotherapy can cause MS-like white matter lesions on brain scans, mimicking multiple sclerosis. A review of 7 published cases found similar patterns, and some patients improved with steroids.

35040719.conclusion_quote: Anxiety in PwMS is linked to a number of modifiable factors.
35040719.summary: A review of 39 studies found that anxiety in people with MS is linked to changeable factors such as exercise, coping ability and support from friends.

36760514.conclusion_quote: The current evidence shows that compared with the population control, patients with MS have no relationship with PCa risk and further large samples and long-term trials are needed to verify these results.
36760514.summary: Eight studies with over 210,000 people found no clear link between multiple sclerosis and prostate cancer risk, though results were mixed after adjusting for other factors.

38929476.conclusion_quote: The findings indicate a strong association between MS and PDs, likely mediated by systemic inflammatory responses detectable in saliva.
38929476.summary: This review found a strong link between multiple sclerosis and gum disease, possibly driven by inflammation that can be detected in saliva, though cause and effect remain unclear.

38592200.conclusion_quote: Resistance training is useful for improving muscle strength; however, walking needs to be combined with motor control training.
38592200.summary: Resistance training improved muscle strength in middle aged people with MS, but its effect on walking was small and not significant unless combined with motor control exercises.

36399281.conclusion_quote: PwMS are exposed to a wide variety of work barriers and job adjustments.
36399281.summary: Review of 49 studies found people with MS face many work barriers, mainly job demands, and most often need workload adjustments at work.

30623859.conclusion_quote: Pilates is a feasible therapy for people with MS that can lead to improvements on their physical function, and it might be helpful for reducing self-perceived fatigue.
30623859.summary: Pilates appears feasible for people with MS and may improve physical function and fatigue, but it was not clearly better than other physical therapies.

32020320.conclusion_quote: LAQ can considerably improve clinical and imaging outcomes in RRMS patients.
32020320.summary: Laquinimod, a pill for relapsing MS, reduced relapses, new brain lesions and disability decline in six trials, though back pain and headache rose.

34587933.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that exercise-based interventions are effective at reducing falls in PD, however, the evidence for MS and stroke is less conclusive.
34587933.summary: This review of 18 reviews found exercise likely reduces falls in Parkinson's disease and stroke, but evidence for people with MS is not conclusive.

34990911.conclusion_quote: It remains unclear if there are significant differences in many flow variables between MS patients and controls considered in this review.
34990911.summary: Review of 22 studies found blood flow in the jugular vein did not clearly differ between people with MS and controls, but more research is needed.

33028926.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis showed that using MMF as a preventive therapy in NMOSD patients can significantly reduce relapse rates and improve disease severity with acceptable tolerability.
33028926.summary: Mycophenolate mofetil reduced relapses and improved disability in neuromyelitis optica patients in this review of fifteen studies, with side effects considered acceptable.

36122472.conclusion_quote: The oral therapies have some significant post-marketing adverse effects that have been diagnosed in numerous case reports.
36122472.summary: A review of published case reports found that some oral multiple sclerosis drugs, especially fingolimod and teriflunomide, caused notable side effects after approval, while dimethyl fumarate caused milder ones.

38202306.conclusion_quote: Overall, motor TR has a positive impact on the QoL of patients with neurological diseases, especially in stroke patients; although caution is needed in the interpretation of the results due to the high heterogeneity found.
38202306.summary: Telerehabilitation, or remote physiotherapy, appears to improve quality of life for people with stroke, Parkinson's and MS, especially stroke patients, though results vary widely.

34310251.conclusion_quote: Clinicians should be aware that the prevalence of serious infections during alemtuzumab can be higher than expected from RCTs.
34310251.summary: Researchers pooled studies of alemtuzumab in multiple sclerosis and found about one in four patients developed infections, most of them mild, with some rare infections reported for the first time.

35158449.conclusion_quote: Existing literature on co-occurrence of cannabis use and MS lacks high quality evidence to recommend for or against cannabis and cannabinoid therapies for pwMS based on cognitive effects.
35158449.summary: Review of 18 studies finds chronic whole plant cannabis may harm attention and memory in MS, while short term medicinal cannabinoids seem not to impair thinking, though evidence quality is low.

35661568.conclusion_quote: To date, the optimal retreatment schedule for RTX in NMOSD has not yet been determined.
35661568.summary: This review of nine studies found no agreed best timing for repeat rituximab doses in NMOSD, though CD27+ B cell counts may help guide retreatment in the first six months.

32471473.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis revealed significant association of MMP-9 (- 1562 C/T) Single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) with MS susceptibility that increased the disease risk.
32471473.summary: Researchers combined 15 studies and found that a variation in the MMP-9 gene is linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

35582858.conclusion_quote: We believe that currently MSS is insufficiently treated and this would be improved if a clear and detailed set of guidelines were available and implemented in daily practice.
35582858.summary: European guidelines for treating muscle stiffness in MS were reviewed, sixteen were found and they vary, so the authors call for one detailed, standard guideline.

36332464.conclusion_quote: Clinicians should be aware of possible post-vaccination NMOSD to help with earlier diagnosis and treatment.
36332464.summary: A review of 16 people who developed a neuromyelitis optica disorder after COVID-19 vaccination found it often caused spinal inflammation and many improved with steroids.

31727014.conclusion_quote: The result of this systematic review showed that the risk of MS decreases by increasing age at menarche.
31727014.summary: Pooling three studies, this review found that girls who start their periods later may have a lower risk of developing multiple sclerosis.

35779372.conclusion_quote: Less disease activity was reported in the Ublituximab group (OR=3.33, P < 0.00001).
35779372.summary: Pooling two large trials, this analysis found ublituximab modestly reduced relapses and brain lesions, and led to less disease activity, than teriflunomide in relapsing MS.

31835209.conclusion_quote: MBIs appear to be an effective treatment for fatigue in PwMS.
31835209.summary: Mindfulness programmes appeared to reduce fatigue in people with MS, while evidence for pain relief was unclear. The best type of programme is still unknown.

33516133.conclusion_quote: Cladribine in the form of tablets was significantly more effective in achieving NEDA-3 than DMF and TERI, but there was no significant difference vs FTY.
33516133.summary: Cladribine tablets were more likely than dimethyl fumarate and teriflunomide to keep MS fully controlled with no evidence of disease activity, but not better than fingolimod.

34690670.conclusion_quote: Overall, motor rehabilitation promotes clinical improvement, paralleled by positive adaptive brain changes, whose features and extent depend upon different variables, including the type of rehabilitation approach.
34690670.summary: A review of 17 studies found that motor rehabilitation improves clinical outcomes in MS and brain scans show positive changes, though small and varied studies limit certainty.

33763062.conclusion_quote: Compared with a placebo and other active treatments, fingolimod was associated with a 16% increase in the risk of infection, especially lower respiratory infection and herpes virus infection.
33763062.summary: Combining 12 trials of 8,448 people, fingolimod raised infection risk by about 16 percent compared with placebo or other treatments, especially chest and herpes infections.

39585063.conclusion_quote: BFRT in people with MS appears to be effective and safe for people with MS.
39585063.summary: Seven small studies suggest that combining exercise with blood flow restriction, which uses a cuff to limit blood flow, may improve strength and balance in people with MS.

39336991.conclusion_quote: The findings underscore the importance of tailored psychoeducational and therapeutic interventions focusing on emotional health, social support, and adaptive coping strategies.
39336991.summary: People with MS who used problem solving and task focused coping had better quality of life, while emotion focused and avoidance coping went with poorer outcomes.

31491597.conclusion_quote: tDCS is a safe and effective treatment for fatigue in MS patients.
31491597.summary: Brain stimulation with tDCS, a mild electrical current applied to the scalp, appears to reduce fatigue in people with MS and causes only minor side effects.

32169035.conclusion_quote: The results of this study extracted from a detailed meta-analysis reveal and confirm that physical exercise significantly reduces fatigue in patients with MS.
32169035.summary: Pooling 31 studies, this review found that physical exercise reduces fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, supporting regular exercise as part of rehabilitation.

35226064.conclusion_quote: This systematic review supports occupational therapy practitioners addressing PA and medication health management and maintenance IADLs through the use of coaching interventions when treating people with MS.
35226064.summary: Coaching helped people with MS keep up daily tasks like physical activity and taking medications, while evidence for other everyday activities is still limited.

36126537.conclusion_quote: the findings of this review suggest that understanding the relationship between coping strategies and quality of life as well as the symptoms related to the disease is important to understand development of psychological interventions adopted by specialists to support these patients.
36126537.summary: Review of 39 studies found that women use more religious and social coping, while depression and disability link to avoidance and unhelpful coping styles.

38625399.conclusion_quote: Certain DMTs have the potential to positively impact QoL of PwMS, and the assessment and reporting of QoL is suboptimal with a multitude of diverse instruments being used.
38625399.summary: A review of 38 drug trials found that some disease modifying MS treatments may improve quality of life, but studies measured quality of life in many inconsistent ways.

35994977.conclusion_quote: Our data provides practical evidence regarding the occurrence and the management of neutropenia during treatment with anti-CD20 in PwMS.
35994977.summary: Low white blood cell counts occasionally occurred in people with MS treated with ocrelizumab or rituximab, usually managed with growth factor injections or antibiotics, and no relapses followed those injections.

39445084.conclusion_quote: The NAIMS expects that this article will provide a roadmap for future use of 7T MRI in MS.
39445084.summary: Experts reviewed 7T MRI scanning in multiple sclerosis and agreed on consensus statements about its current uses, future research needs, and a standard scanning protocol.

30361954.conclusion_quote: Patients with MS display both increased prevalence and incidence of psoriasis.
30361954.summary: People with multiple sclerosis are more likely to have psoriasis than people without it, according to a combined analysis of 11 studies.

33961198.conclusion_quote: Results suggest that MS fatigue is characterised by greater cortico-subcortical grey matter atrophy and neural lesions, accompanied by neurophysiological decrements, which include reduced strength and voluntary activation.
33961198.summary: People with MS who have high fatigue show more brain shrinkage, more lesions and weaker muscles than those with low fatigue, according to this review of 66 studies.

33901439.conclusion_quote: AT and RT appear equally highly effective in terms of improving lower extremity physical function and perceived fatigue in PwMS.
33901439.summary: Exercise trials in people with MS found aerobic and resistance training work about equally well for improving leg function and reducing fatigue.

32379628.conclusion_quote: Yoga is a simple exercise for patients with MS that is capable of decreasing fatigue in these patients.
32379628.summary: A pooled analysis of ten trials found yoga reduced fatigue in people with MS more than usual care, but did not clearly improve quality of life.

37023829.conclusion_quote: We found transcriptomic and functional differences between MS males and MS females (especially in the immune system), which may support the development of new sex-based research of this disease.
37023829.summary: A review of gene activity studies found that brain and blood samples differ between men and women with MS, mainly in immune system genes and pathways.

39003098.conclusion_quote: The present paper aims to propose a consensus, approved by expert French consensus from the Cognition group of the SF-SEP (http://sfsep.org [Société Francophone de la Sclérose en Plaques]), for cognitive assessment of pwMS suggesting the tools that should be used in order to apprehend the other cognitive impairments that could appear in MS.
39003098.summary: French experts propose a set of cognitive tests, beyond the brief BICAMS screen, to better detect thinking problems in people with multiple sclerosis.

35180100.conclusion_quote: Hypnosis is an appropriate psychological therapy for the management of MS patients' symptoms.
35180100.summary: A review of 14 studies found that hypnosis helped people with multiple sclerosis with pain, low mood, fatigue and physical functioning, while other nondrug methods did not.

32731048.conclusion_quote: Rituximab can improve relapse and disability conditions in patients with RRMS and has the potential for RRMS treatment.
32731048.summary: Pooled results from 20 studies suggest rituximab reduces relapses and modestly lowers disability in relapsing MS, though infusion reactions and infections were common.

36363469.conclusion_quote: It was also evident that the use of free light chains in the diagnosis of clinically isolated syndrome (CIS) and multiple sclerosis is relatively fast and inexpensive in comparison to other conventional state-of-the-art diagnostic methods, e.g., using oligoclonal bands (OCBs).
36363469.summary: This review of 116 reports finds that kappa free light chain tests can diagnose multiple sclerosis quickly and cheaply compared with standard oligoclonal band testing.

39985419.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, most studies have shown that tDCS does not improve various cognitive domains in PwMS.
39985419.summary: A review of nine trials found mixed evidence on whether mild electrical brain stimulation called tDCS improves thinking skills in people with MS, with most studies showing no benefit.

34512500.conclusion_quote: Hence, there is an urgent need for reliable and objective biomarkers to prospectively predict and define SPMS conversion.
34512500.summary: Reviews current clinical, imaging, and blood and spinal fluid markers to predict when relapsing multiple sclerosis turns into secondary progressive disease earlier than current diagnosis allows.

38226694.conclusion_quote: To fast-forward clinical translation of CAL, the North American Imaging in Multiple Sclerosis Cooperative developed a consensus statement, which provides guidance for the radiological definition and measurement of CAL.
38226694.summary: Experts agreed on standard MRI and PET rules for finding and measuring chronic active lesions in MS, and listed the knowledge gaps still remaining.

39974450.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review show that exposure to Ocrelizumab during conception is not associated with a higher frequency of preterm deliveries or major malformations.
39974450.summary: Researchers reviewed five studies of women who took ocrelizumab around conception and found no higher rates of premature birth or major birth defects.

30964886.conclusion_quote: The current meta-analysis showed that the prevalence and incidence of MS in Iran is high and is rising over time.
30964886.summary: Researchers pooled 39 studies and found that multiple sclerosis is fairly common in Iran, affecting about 29 in every 100,000 people, with rates appearing to rise over time.

35595875.conclusion_quote: Although it remains unclear if this association is casual or causal, clinicians should be aware that an HSP diagnosis does not always exclude a concomitant MS.
35595875.summary: A woman with a genetic spastic paraplegia form also had multiple sclerosis, and a review found 20 similar possible cases, so MS can coexist with this disorder.

37568348.conclusion_quote: Even though the prevalence of DMII in the MS population is lower than 10% (the reported prevalence of DMII in the general population) the interactions between the two conditions create significant challenges for MS patients, their caregivers, and physicians.
37568348.summary: A review of 19 studies found about 5% of people with multiple sclerosis also have type II diabetes, lower than in the general population, but the combination still creates challenges.

36029752.conclusion_quote: Overall, the COVID-19 vaccination may trigger relapses in some MS patients, but as the infection itself can stimulate relapse, the benefit of vaccination outweighs its risk in this population, and mass vaccination against COVID-19, especially in MS patients, should be continued and encouraged.
36029752.summary: A review of 7 case reports found 29 people with MS whose symptoms flared after COVID vaccination, usually within about ten days. Researchers still judged vaccination worthwhile.

39823690.conclusion_quote: Consensus recommendations were developed on the most important areas of NMOSD treatment by a panel of experts in LATAM.
39823690.summary: Experts in Latin America agreed on 31 treatment recommendations for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, covering general care and specific clinical situations, to guide doctors in the region.

34303537.conclusion_quote: Before starting immunosuppressive treatment, it is recommended to inform patients of the risks of infections and to look for a constitutive or acquired immune deficiency.
34303537.summary: French experts recommend screening MS patients for infections and updating their vaccines at diagnosis and before starting stronger immune-suppressing treatments.

31781296.conclusion_quote: Our summary of results from a high number of patients and controls suggests that allelic variants from both DQB1 and DRB1 genes are equally involved in MS susceptibility/protection transethnically.
31781296.summary: Variants in immune genes called HLA, especially DRB1 and DQB1, raise or lower multiple sclerosis risk across different ethnic groups.

32004798.conclusion_quote: Serum 25(OH)D levels are associated with a modest decrease in relapse rate and radiological inflammatory activities in patients with MS.
32004798.summary: Higher blood vitamin D levels were linked to slightly fewer relapses and fewer new inflammatory MRI lesions in people with MS.

31684026.conclusion_quote: There is preliminary evidence from individual studies which indicates that people with MS can improve their lower limb flexibility following participation in physical exercise programs, but the meta-analysis did not confirm these findings.
31684026.summary: Seven studies found some early evidence that exercise can improve leg flexibility in people with MS, but pooled results did not show a significant benefit.

40171147.conclusion_quote: CH technologies show promise in improving psychological wellbeing and QoL among PwMS and their caregivers.
40171147.summary: A review of 47 studies found that connected health tools, such as apps and online programs, may help people with MS and caregivers feel better, though results varied.

38324543.conclusion_quote: Thus, it is expected that the planned systematic review and meta-analysis will yield robust evidence on the effects of diet on inflammatory profile in the setting of MS.
38324543.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of trials testing whether diet changes lower inflammation markers in people with multiple sclerosis.

39246867.conclusion_quote: The development of neuropsychiatric manifestations in persons with MS is influenced by various factors.
39246867.summary: Eight studies reviewed found that brain changes, immune processes, social circumstances and personal traits can all contribute to depression, anxiety and other mental health problems in people with MS.

34479111.conclusion_quote: Patients with multiple sclerosis (MS) should be vaccinated against COVID-19.
34479111.summary: Guideline advising people with multiple sclerosis to get COVID-19 vaccines, which appear safe and effective even for those taking treatments that alter the immune system.

36182621.conclusion_quote: This led us to elaborate French recommendations for the management of adult & pediatric CIDP patients.
36182621.summary: French experts issued recommendations for diagnosing and treating chronic inflammatory nerve disease in adults and children, not multiple sclerosis.

39408391.conclusion_quote: The Journal retracts and amends the authorship of the article "Association of Polyunsaturated Fatty Acid Intake on Inflammatory Gene Expression and Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis" [...].
39408391.summary: This notice announces that a journal has withdrawn a 2022 review of fatty acids and multiple sclerosis and changed its author list.

37976077.conclusion_quote: Direct costs, particularly DMTs, appear to be the major cost drivers for people with MS in the United States.
