37976077.summary: A review of 65 US studies found that MS medicines, especially disease modifying treatments, cause the biggest direct costs. Cheaper treatments could ease the financial burden.

35309325.conclusion_quote: Systems biology has not solved the mystery of MS, but it has discovered multiple molecules and networks potentially contributing to the pathogenesis.
35309325.summary: A review of brain tissue and single cell gene and protein studies in multiple sclerosis found the disease affects all brain cell types, but results are inconsistent and mostly descriptive.

35639218.conclusion_quote: Control treatments identified as "usual care" are underdescribed when compared to experimental treatments, affecting the validity, generalizability, and interpretability of results.
35639218.summary: This review of 24 trials found that physiotherapy studies describe their experimental treatments in much more detail than the usual care given to control groups, which makes results harder to trust and apply.

30844555.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis shows that rituximab is associated with reduced annualized relapse rates and disability levels in patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.
30844555.summary: Rituximab reduced relapses and modestly reduced disability in relapsing MS across 15 studies of 946 patients, and mostly mild side effects were reported.

36046943.conclusion_quote: Our findings do not support the hypothesis that H. pylori infection represents a protective factor against the development of MS; however, the results varied depending on the diagnostic method(s).
36046943.summary: Pooled analysis of 22 studies found no clear link between H. pylori stomach infection and MS risk, though results depended on how infection was tested.

40435656.conclusion_quote: These recommendations outlined in this consensus seek to enhance the management and specific treatment protocols tailored for MOGAD patients in LATAM, with the aim of optimizing patient outcomes over long term.
40435656.summary: Latin American neurologists agreed on 59 recommendations for diagnosing, monitoring, and treating MOGAD, a rare inflammatory disease of the nervous system.

38585674.conclusion_quote: The final QIs provide a structured approach to document, monitor, and enhance the quality of care for people with MS across their treatment journey.
38585674.summary: Experts developed and agreed on 24 quality indicators and checklists to help doctors monitor and improve care for people with multiple sclerosis.

35421068.conclusion_quote: This study will perform a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis on the efficacy of acupuncture for MS, making up for the lack of relevant evidence of the clinical use of acupuncture.
35421068.summary: This protocol describes a planned review that will pool randomized trials to assess whether acupuncture is safe and helps people with multiple sclerosis.

37854988.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review and meta-analysis show that the pooled prevalence of IBD in MS patients was 1% and the pooled odds ratio of developing IBD in MS cases was 1.36.
37854988.summary: This review of 17 studies found that about 1% of people with multiple sclerosis also have inflammatory bowel disease, with MS patients having somewhat higher odds of developing it.

39836321.conclusion_quote: As systematic reviews play a remarkable role in disseminating health economic research, a careful description of the methods and the findings reported in the included studies is of paramount importance.
39836321.summary: A letter correcting a review's account of a cost study, which found teriflunomide was cheaper and gave more healthy life years for newly diagnosed relapsing MS patients.

31421274.conclusion_quote: IMU measurement has the potential to increase the sensitivity of clinical and performance tests to identify evolution in gait alteration in MS.
31421274.summary: Wearable motion sensors measured walking in people with multiple sclerosis, and speed and step length tracked disability levels, suggesting they could help monitor disease in mild to moderate cases.

34121613.conclusion_quote: We believe this systematic review is a starting point for an evidence-based approach to recommend cognitive tests for use with people with MS.
34121613.summary: This review found that researchers use thousands of different cognitive tests in MS, and some popular tests may be unsuitable because they measure the wrong thinking skills.

31816024.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that breastfeeding is protective against postpartum relapses in MS, although high-quality prospective studies to date are limited and well-designed observational studies that aim to emulate a randomized trial would be of benefit.
31816024.summary: Pooling 24 studies, this review found women who breastfed had lower odds of MS relapses after giving birth than those who did not.

37298310.conclusion_quote: Validation studies of selected top up- or down-regulated genes highlighted MS subtype-specific differences in the expression of some of the identified genes, underlining a more complex scenario of white matter pathology amongst people afflicted by this devastating disease.
37298310.summary: Researchers combined three public brain tissue datasets from people with MS and found over 1,400 genes with altered activity, many linked to myelin and protein handling.

39266642.conclusion_quote: Overall, this framework ensures accurate and reliable results, exploiting complementary features and overcoming some of the limitations of individual algorithms.
39266642.summary: Researchers combined several existing computer programs to outline MS lesions on brain scans more accurately, matching doctors' manual outlines better than single programs did.

39364460.conclusion_quote: This systematic review shows that the effect of vitamin D supplements on improving symptoms and relapses during treatment in MS patients remains inconclusive.
39364460.summary: A review of 16 trials found vitamin D raised blood levels in MS patients, but its effect on relapses and disability remains unclear.

32540746.conclusion_quote: In general, incidence estimates were similar across regions; however, prevalence was found to be more variable.
32540746.summary: Pooled data from 18 studies estimate that about 0.87 per 100,000 people a year develop pediatric MS worldwide, with prevalence varying more between regions.

31612418.conclusion_quote: There is strong evidence that PR fampridine exerts strong effects on the ability to walk short distances and on perceived walking capacity.
31612418.summary: Fampridine, a drug for walking problems in MS, clearly improved how far people could walk over short distances and how able they felt to walk, across 20 trials.

31136907.conclusion_quote: AZA improves relapses and disability in patients with NMOSD but this regimen is associated with relatively frequent adverse events based on limited published evidences.
31136907.summary: Azathioprine appears to reduce relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica patients, but it often causes side effects, and the evidence is limited.

33504225.conclusion_quote: The most popular tools are the Fatigue Severity Scale and the Modified Fatigue Impact Scale.
33504225.summary: Researchers reviewed 119 studies and found 45 tools for measuring tiredness in people with MS, with the Fatigue Severity Scale and Modified Fatigue Impact Scale used most often.

41477116.conclusion_quote: The employed injectable MS immunotherapies demonstrate various autoimmune adverse reactions that have been documented across numerous case reports.
41477116.summary: This review of published case reports found that several multiple sclerosis immunotherapy drugs can trigger autoimmune skin conditions, with alemtuzumab linked to the most cases.

39464533.conclusion_quote: This study shows that the consumption of SSRIs in MS patients compared to the control group does not bring about a significant change in the indices related to neurological and depressive symptoms.
39464533.summary: Pooled trials found that antidepressants called SSRIs did not meaningfully improve thinking speed, disability, fatigue or depression in people with multiple sclerosis.

38033519.conclusion_quote: This study aims to address the current knowledge gap by investigating the comparative effectiveness of TIs.
38033519.summary: This protocol plans a review of studies testing telehealth, or remote care, for people with multiple sclerosis to see whether it improves their health and quality of life.

35066277.conclusion_quote: Current evidence suggests that pelvic floor muscle training seems to be an effective treatment modality for improving health-related quality of life and reducing the severity of urinary incontinence and overactive bladder symptoms in people with multiple sclerosis.
35066277.summary: Reviewing seven small trials, the authors found pelvic floor exercises likely help people with MS improve bladder leakage and quality of life, though most studies had weaknesses.

35173016.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that GM neurodegeneration is mostly secondary to damage in the WM during early disease stages while becoming more detached and dominated by other, possibly primary neurodegenerative disease mechanisms in progressive MS.
35173016.summary: This review of 90 studies found that brain white matter lesions are mainly linked to brain tissue loss early in MS, but less so in progressive disease.

31636528.conclusion_quote: Our findings clarified the circulating cytokine profile in MS, which provide targets for disease modifying treatments, and suggest that cytokines have the potential to be used as biomarkers for MS.
31636528.summary: This review pooled 226 studies to find which immune signalling proteins are raised in the blood or spinal fluid of people with MS, suggesting some could serve as biomarkers.

31450158.conclusion_quote: There is some evidence that long-term treatment with interferon beta reduces the risk of EDSS 6.0 and SPMS compared to no treatment or placebo.
31450158.summary: Over many years, disease modifying drugs appeared to lower the risk of severe disability and secondary progressive MS, with the most evidence for interferon beta.

33567335.conclusion_quote: Aerobic training improves gait speed, walking endurance, and balance.
33567335.summary: Aerobic exercise programs improved walking speed, walking endurance, and balance in people with MS, though fitness and fatigue gains were not clearly better than in control groups.

35779440.conclusion_quote: These results should be cautiously interpreted, yet highlight the need for continued work to disentangle and discern true associations.
35779440.summary: Twelve studies found that most reported links between childhood adversity and MS or its symptoms, though evidence is limited and needs more research.

33523319.conclusion_quote: This NMA indicated that Amiselimod (0.4 mg) is the most effective treatment strategy as a S1P receptor for MS patients.
33523319.summary: Drugs that block S1P receptors reduced MS relapses compared with placebo, and amiselimod 0.4 mg was ranked the most effective, though more research is needed.

32172997.conclusion_quote: The correlation between CSCA and EDSS scores was significant but moderate.
32172997.summary: Researchers combined 22 studies and found that spinal cord thinning on MRI is moderately linked to higher disability scores in multiple sclerosis, though the link is weaker in milder forms.

39229262.conclusion_quote: The low reporting of CONSORT items and the unclear risk of bias indicate the inadequate quality of RCTs in terms of reporting completeness and result validity.
39229262.summary: Researchers reviewed 25 trials of Chinese herbal medicine for multiple sclerosis and found they often left out key details, so their reliability is unclear.

36320121.conclusion_quote: The scarce evidence indicates that dual-task testing is not able to predict future falls among PwMS.
36320121.summary: Review of eight studies finding that tests combining walking or balance with a mental task do not reliably predict future falls in people with MS.

32880046.conclusion_quote: The final interpretation of the result is that organic solvents may be slightly associated with an increased risk to develop MS.
32880046.summary: Pooling fourteen case control studies, researchers found that work exposure to organic solvents is linked to a modestly higher risk of developing multiple sclerosis.

30953953.conclusion_quote: MS patients had higher HMGB1 protein levels in PBMC and CSF compared to controls.
30953953.summary: This review of seven studies found higher HMGB1 inflammation protein levels in immune cells and spinal fluid of people with MS than in controls.

34016734.conclusion_quote: Our study suggested that MS did not significantly increase the mortality rate from COVID-19.
34016734.summary: Pooling 87 studies of over 4,000 people, this review found MS did not clearly raise COVID-19 death rates, though results should be read cautiously.

34338108.conclusion_quote: Different massage approaches effectively improved MS symptoms such as fatigue, pain, anxiety, depression, and spasticity.
34338108.summary: Massage, especially reflexology and Swedish massage, may ease tiredness, pain, low mood, anxiety and muscle stiffness in people with MS.

29794531.conclusion_quote: Physiotherapy interventions can be a safe and beneficial option for spasticity in people with multiple sclerosis.
29794531.summary: Physical therapy such as exercise and electrical stimulation may help spasticity in people with MS and appears safe, though evidence on overall spasticity is not conclusive.

32664928.conclusion_quote: Approximately one in five patients with MS do not adhere to, and one in four discontinue, daily oral DMDs before 1 year.
32664928.summary: Roughly one in five people with MS do not take their daily oral disease modifying drugs as prescribed, and one in four stop them within a year.

37469335.conclusion_quote: A variety of dance interventions are likely feasible and potentially beneficial for people with mild to moderate relapsing-remitting MS, but studies were generally of low-moderate quality.
37469335.summary: Dance programs of about an hour twice weekly appear feasible and may help movement in people with mild to moderate MS, but studies were of low to moderate quality.

35954811.conclusion_quote: The psychosocial work environment needs to be taken into consideration as part of public and individual policies to promote the health of patients with MS.
35954811.summary: Across 26 studies, many people with MS faced workplace stigma, and fear of discrimination was the main reason they kept their diagnosis secret.

36044345.conclusion_quote: Cooling therapies have a beneficial effect on fatigue, physical activity, and the QoL of patients with MS.
36044345.summary: Nine studies found that cooling methods such as cooling garments and cold drinks reduced fatigue, increased physical activity, and improved quality of life in people with MS.

38264560.conclusion_quote: The main finding of this systematic review and metaanalysis is that the pooled prevalence of cancer in subjects who suffer from MS and received natalizumab was 2%.
38264560.summary: Pooling eight studies, this review found that about 2% of people with MS treated with natalizumab had cancer, and 12% of those cases were basal cell carcinoma.

32014337.conclusion_quote: Sufficient levels of vitamin D during pregnancy may be protective against offspring's development of multiple sclerosis later in life.
32014337.summary: Pooling four studies, higher vitamin D levels during pregnancy were linked to lower odds of the child later developing multiple sclerosis.

33197670.conclusion_quote: CAM recommendations were only present in one third of all eligible CPGs.
33197670.summary: A review of MS treatment guidelines found that few mention complementary and alternative medicine, and only four of them actually made recommendations about it.

34821118.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review show that outdoor air pollution, especially PM and nitrogen oxides might be related to the prevalence or relapse of MS.
34821118.summary: A review of 17 studies suggests outdoor air pollution, especially fine particles and nitrogen oxides, may be linked to more MS cases and relapses.

37987490.conclusion_quote: This study highlights the necessity of future studies on a population with similar characteristics, adopting similar protocols to evaluate their feasibility and validity to make physical intervention prescribed as a medicine.
37987490.summary: This review combined previous reviews of exercise trials in multiple sclerosis and found that most studies showed improved physical function, though study designs varied widely.

31328637.conclusion_quote: CCT is efficacious for overall and key cognitive domains in adults with MS, but efficacy on other outcomes and in progressive subtypes remains unclear.
31328637.summary: Brain training games on computers improved thinking skills in people with MS, especially attention, memory and problem solving, but the gains faded without ongoing practice.

31558363.conclusion_quote: Incidence of seroconversion in MS patients who had been treated with natalizumab is higher in European/American countries than Asian countries.
31558363.summary: This review pooled studies of people with MS taking natalizumab. About 19 percent developed antibodies to the JC virus, and about 5 percent later lost them, with more antibody development in Europe and America than in Asia.

29553780.conclusion_quote: Telephone psychotherapy provides small and moderate benefits in depression, fatigue, quality of life, MS symptoms, physical activity, and medication adherence in the short term.
29553780.summary: Phone-based talk therapy helped people with MS feel less depressed and reduced fatigue and other problems, but benefits mostly faded over the long term.

30935529.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that aerobic exercise and physiotherapy improves the satisfaction of MS patients with their physical, mental and social functioning and may be included as normal practice in the treatment of MS.
30935529.summary: Aerobic exercise and physiotherapy improved how people with MS felt about their physical, mental and social functioning, while yoga and combined exercise showed no clear benefit.

35596098.conclusion_quote: The inclusion of social costs affected the results/conclusions in multiple sclerosis-related interventions, helping to identify the most appropriate interventions for reducing its economic burden from a broader perspective.
35596098.summary: Including lost work and unpaid family care costs changed treatment recommendations in many multiple sclerosis economic evaluations, often favouring treatments from a societal view.

41265015.conclusion_quote: In total, the panel recommended 67 statements to be considered in daily practice for screening before starting ocrelizumab, prophylaxis where appropriate, monitoring, and early treatment of infections in PwMS treated with ocrelizumab.
41265015.summary: Iranian experts agreed on 67 recommendations for checking and managing infections like tuberculosis and hepatitis before people with MS start the drug ocrelizumab.

35908449.conclusion_quote: The management of NMOSD is under major revolution due to the many new therapeutic options.
35908449.summary: Saudi experts issued updated recommendations on diagnosing and treating NMOSD, a rare autoimmune condition affecting the optic nerves and spinal cord, noting new treatments and new diagnostic criteria.

33373835.conclusion_quote: These results indicated that DTI parameters were potential biomarkers with increased sensitivity for detecting pathological damage in the CC in patients with RRMS.
33373835.summary: A review of 15 studies found that imaging measures of the corpus callosum, the fibre bridge between brain hemispheres, are damaged in relapsing MS and may serve as biomarkers.

34624641.conclusion_quote: Identifying ways to foster positive FOCs, particularly self-efficacy, may have beneficial effects on QOL.
34624641.summary: This review found that feeling confident in one's ability to manage MS is linked to better quality of life for people with MS.

36675637.conclusion_quote: BICAMS is a valid and feasible international MS cognitive assessment.
36675637.summary: Researchers pooled 26 studies and found the BICAMS cognitive test can detect slower thinking and memory problems in people with MS compared with healthy adults.

33348212.conclusion_quote: IL7RA gene rs6897932 SNP decreases MS susceptibility in overall population and Europeans.
33348212.summary: Pooling 33 studies, this gene variant was linked to a lower chance of developing MS overall and in European populations, but not in Asian or American groups.

37754965.conclusion_quote: In general, no intervention showed consistent positive effects on BC.
37754965.summary: Exercise, rehabilitation, and diet did not consistently improve body composition or bone density in people with MS, though intense training and ketogenic diets looked most promising.

34649636.conclusion_quote: This paper demonstrates that multiple sclerosis lesions should not be an exclusion criterion in an otherwise suitable candidate for cochlear implantation.
34649636.summary: A patient with multiple sclerosis received a cochlear implant that kept speech understanding above 90 percent for eight years, and a review found no earlier similar cases.

36242805.conclusion_quote: A small proportion of AQP4-IgG-positive NMOSD is associated with malignancy.
36242805.summary: Researchers reported three new cases and reviewed prior reports, finding that a small share of AQP4 antibody positive NMOSD patients also had cancer, most often lung or breast.

37443793.conclusion_quote: The topic of the gut microbiome in the pathophysiology of MS is therefore relevant since it could be used as a biomarker of disease development and progression as well as a potential disease-modifying therapy.
37443793.summary: This review finds that gut bacteria are linked to multiple sclerosis and neuromyelitis optica, and may serve as disease markers or possible treatments.

35046135.conclusion_quote: Race and ethnicity are underreported in MS DMT trial publications and race and ethnic representation are omitted from manufacturer websites.
35046135.summary: A review of MS drug trials found that people who are not White were underrepresented, and race and ethnicity data were often missing or left out of drug websites.

34343867.conclusion_quote: Home-based ET, 2-7 times per week, is beneficial, feasible, and safe in people with MS.
34343867.summary: Review of 24 studies found that home exercise two to seven times weekly is helpful and safe for people with MS, though sticking to it is hard.

31036391.conclusion_quote: Physicians and patients should be aware of the updated recommendations for immunizations of patients with MS.
31036391.summary: French MS experts issued updated guidance on vaccines for people with MS, advising vaccination checks before treatment and noting live vaccines are unsafe after recent immunosuppressive drugs.

34959758.conclusion_quote: The systematic review allowed us to conclude that there may be a positive effect of vitamin D supplementation in MS patients, which was stated in all of the studies analyzing quality of life, as well as in one study analyzing depressive symptoms.
34959758.summary: This review of six studies suggests vitamin D supplements may improve quality of life and possibly mood in people with multiple sclerosis, though evidence is limited.

36628506.conclusion_quote: In all patients, despite treatment with corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulins (IVIG) or plasma exchange (PE), the LCIG therapy was terminated.
36628506.summary: A review of nine papers found that a rare nerve condition in Parkinson's patients receiving gut infused levodopa often forced treatment to stop, even with standard therapies.

32982663.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results revealed increased blood and CSF MDA and decreased blood albumin levels in patients with MS, strengthening the clinical evidence of increased oxidative stress in MS.
32982663.summary: Combining 31 studies, this review found higher levels of a fat damage marker in blood and spinal fluid of people with MS, and lower blood albumin.

30535563.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis provides evidences that AHSCT can induce long-term remissions for MS patients with a high degree of safety.
30535563.summary: Stem-cell transplants that rebuild the immune system kept most MS patients free of progression or relapses long term, with few deaths from the procedure itself.

37272540.conclusion_quote: Compared with interferon beta-1a, alemtuzumab may improve relapse-free survival and sustained disease progression-free survival, and make little to no difference on the proportion of participants with at least one adverse event for people with relapsing-remitting MS at 36 months.
37272540.summary: Three trials found that alemtuzumab may delay relapses and disability worsening better than interferon in relapsing MS over 36 months, with similar side effects.

36536783.conclusion_quote: The pooled prevalence of this systematic review showed that CD is not prevalent in MS cases.
36536783.summary: Researchers combined 15 studies and found that celiac disease, an autoimmune gut condition, is uncommon in people with multiple sclerosis.

38978508.conclusion_quote: hUCMSCs transplantation through the intravenous route to the animal MS model (EAE) seems a considerably effective procedure for the alleviation of motor defects in both phases of peak and recovery.
38978508.summary: A meta analysis of six animal studies found that umbilical cord stem cell transplants improved movement problems in animals with an MS like disease.

38188004.conclusion_quote: The result of this systematic review (including four studies) showed disruption of the microbiota-immune balance in pediatric-onset MS cases.
38188004.summary: Researchers reviewed four studies and found that children with MS starting in childhood had less diverse gut bacteria than healthy children, hinting gut microbes may affect immunity in this disease.

34676448.conclusion_quote: The findings should be used to inform the development of targeted patient support programs which improve treatment compliance.
34676448.summary: Reviewing 24 studies, researchers found that many people with MS miss doses of their treatments, with age, gender, depression and side effects linked to poorer adherence.

35803162.conclusion_quote: Compared to placebo, ponesimod 20 mg significantly reduced both the risk of 12-week CDA and mean ARR, suggesting it has robust efficacy in the treatment of RMS.
35803162.summary: A large analysis of past trials found ponesimod cut relapses by about half and slowed disability worsening compared with placebo, and most other treatments also reduced relapses.

30677733.conclusion_quote: Results suggest that ocrelizumab has an efficacy superior to or comparable with all other currently approved DMTs across all endpoints analyzed, and a similar safety profile, indicating it offers a valuable package for the treatment of patients with RMS.
30677733.summary: A network analysis of trials found ocrelizumab worked at least as well as other approved MS drugs for relapsing MS, with a similar safety profile.

35720098.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the presented meta-analysis represents a useful tool for researchers, reviewers, and funders to improve the design of future modeling studies in MS and to easily compare new studies with the published literature.
35720098.summary: This review of 302 studies found that most MS prediction models were poorly designed and rarely tested on independent groups, so their results may be overstated.

35158464.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review showed that lesions in different brain areas are correlated with SD in MS patients.
35158464.summary: Review of eight MRI studies found that brain lesions in various areas are linked to sexual problems in people with MS.

33591593.conclusion_quote: Our systematic review therefore indicates that NLR might serve as a potential biomarker of disease activity.
33591593.summary: A review of 19 studies found the blood neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio may help track multiple sclerosis activity, while CRP results were inconsistent.

32202208.conclusion_quote: EBV appears to interact with at least some established MS risk factors.
32202208.summary: This review of published studies found the Epstein Barr virus interacts with HLA genes, smoking and infectious mononucleosis to affect multiple sclerosis risk, though the mechanism is unclear.

34697961.conclusion_quote: However, the use of an NB model is recommended to optimize the number of included patients and to be congruent with the final analysis.
34697961.summary: This review of MS drug trials found sample sizes were rarely calculated using the best statistical model, which would often need fewer patients.

35149393.conclusion_quote: Although mental health issues such as anxiety and depression were common among PwMS during the pandemic, current evidence suggests that mental health among PwMS has not been significantly affected by pandemic-related restrictive measures.
35149393.summary: Nineteen studies found depression and anxiety were common in people with MS during the pandemic, but overall mental health did not clearly worsen compared with before.

31796822.conclusion_quote: Although various T2*-weighted images have been used across studies, the current evidence supports the use of the central vein sign on T2*-weighted images to differentiate MS from other white matter lesions.
31796822.summary: Researchers pooled 21 studies and found that a vein visible inside brain lesions on special scans is highly accurate at telling multiple sclerosis apart from other white matter lesions.

34498997.conclusion_quote: MBIs for PwMS need to take into consideration disability which can limit accessibility.
34498997.summary: Reviewing six studies, researchers found people with MS find mindfulness courses acceptable, online or in person, and value sharing experiences with peers and skilled instructors.

29291483.conclusion_quote: We detected significant heterogeneity from Hungary to Saskatchewan for FMS prevalence that was not latitude and ethnicity dependent.
29291483.summary: Researchers pooled 17 studies and found about 12.6 percent of people with MS have a family member with MS, with large differences between study locations.

36000489.conclusion_quote: Published data support the use of FO-DMTs in MS.
36000489.summary: Expert panellists agreed that cheaper copy versions of MS drugs approved under strict rules are as effective and safe as originals, but evidence on switching between them is lacking.

33328843.conclusion_quote: Excitatory NIBSS over M1, left DLPFC and spinal cord appear to be the most effective protocols for pain in MS.
33328843.summary: Review of nine studies found that brain and spinal stimulation with electrical or magnetic pulses reliably eased pain in people with MS, though other symptoms improved less consistently.

35696089.conclusion_quote: The current study does not support the significant protective role of To. gondii infection on MS development.
35696089.summary: Researchers pooled 11 studies and found no clear link between Toxoplasma infection and multiple sclerosis, so the earlier suggestion of protection was not supported.

33032798.conclusion_quote: Patients with MS commonly suffer from low back pain, but it is still an underdiagnosed cause of pain that reduces one's ability to perform activities in daily life.
33032798.summary: Back pain is common in people with MS, affecting about three quarters of a French survey group, and chronic low back pain limits daily activities.

38482512.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that foot reflexology could be a safe and effective modality to reduce the physical and psychological symptoms and also improve the quality of life for individuals with MS; however, well-designed, large-scale trials are required to confirm the effect.
38482512.summary: Review of nine small trials found foot reflexology may reduce fatigue, pain, spasms and stress in people with MS, but larger studies are needed to confirm.

37969907.conclusion_quote: Despite the small sample size in this study, this review showed that various intervention models that target caregivers of individuals with MS have been successful.
37969907.summary: This review of 20 studies found that various programs aimed at caregivers of people with MS, such as group education and behavioral therapy, have been successful.

33178102.conclusion_quote: Increased NMOSD-related disability and relapses during pregnancy the postpartum period may respond to aggressive management with corticosteroids and immunosuppressants such as azathioprine, which are safely administered during pregnancy and lactation.
33178102.summary: Pregnant women with NMOSD often had more disability and relapses, especially after birth, and common treatments appeared safe for pregnancy, though evidence is limited to case reports.

34384990.conclusion_quote: Nevertheless, most reports recommend screening for LTBI before starting MS treatment, mainly in high incidence countries.
34384990.summary: Researchers reviewed 14 studies on whether multiple sclerosis drugs reactivate latent tuberculosis. Evidence is limited, but most reports recommend screening for tuberculosis before starting treatment.

33956330.conclusion_quote: MS places a huge economic burden on healthcare systems and societies in LMICs.
33956330.summary: Review of 14 studies from middle income countries found multiple sclerosis imposes a huge cost on health systems and families, rising with severity and driven largely by disease modifying drugs.

36109726.conclusion_quote: ML is applicable to determining how candidate biomarkers perform in the assessment of disease severity.
36109726.summary: Reviewed studies from 2014 to 2020 found machine learning can help measure multiple sclerosis severity using blood, body, and other tests rather than brain scans.

33129851.conclusion_quote: The results of the included studies reveal that there was a significant relationship between exposure to air pollution and MS development and progression.
33129851.summary: Researchers reviewed 24 studies and found that breathing polluted air is linked to developing multiple sclerosis and worsening of the disease.

35583174.conclusion_quote: For people with RRMS, ocrelizumab probably results in a large reduction in relapse rate and little to no difference in adverse events when compared with interferon beta-1a at 96 weeks (moderate-certainty evidence).
35583174.summary: Ocrelizumab reduced relapses in relapsing MS compared with interferon, and may slow disability worsening in primary progressive MS, though infections and infusion reactions were common.

38599863.conclusion_quote: An awareness of these associations by physicians, along with multidisciplinary collaboration, may facilitate the early diagnosis and improve the prognosis of these patients.
38599863.summary: A patient's sudden heart weakening led to a multiple sclerosis diagnosis with brainstem lesions. Reviewing past cases, this heart condition most often occurred alongside brainstem involvement.

33563801.conclusion_quote: We suggest that pregnancy can trigger typical CIDP in some women, and women with CIDP have a higher risk of relapse during pregnancy.
33563801.summary: Researchers reviewed published cases of a rare nerve disease called CIDP during pregnancy and found pregnancy can trigger it or cause it to flare up.

31454391.conclusion_quote: An association between early life vitamin D and later risk of MS seems possible, however evidence is still insufficient to conclude that low vitamin D exposure in early life increases the risk of MS in adulthood.
31454391.summary: Reviewed studies suggest early life vitamin D may link to later MS risk, but evidence is not yet strong enough to prove a cause.

33873026.conclusion_quote: There is evidence supporting the use of smartphone applications to assess gait and balance among PwMS.
33873026.summary: Review of eight studies finding smartphone apps can reliably measure walking and balance problems in people with MS, though more testing of their accuracy is needed.

34661282.conclusion_quote: The evidence suggests that memory rehabilitation results in between-group differences favoring the memory rehabilitation group at the intermediate time point for subjective memory, verbal memory, information processing, and quality of life outcomes, suggesting that memory rehabilitation is beneficial and meaningful to people with MS.
34661282.summary: Memory rehabilitation modestly improved everyday memory, verbal memory and quality of life for people with MS at one to six months, though study quality varied.

31867992.conclusion_quote: Motivational interviewing is a flexible counselling technique that may improve rehabilitation care for multiple sclerosis.
31867992.summary: Ten trials found that motivational interviewing, a counselling approach, improved physical, psychological and behaviour outcomes in people with MS, though lasting benefits are unclear.

30324330.conclusion_quote: Based on our findings, the number of CD8 + Treg cells in the blood of MS subjects is significantly different as compared to healthy controls.
30324330.summary: Pooled studies found that people with multiple sclerosis have a significantly different number of CD8 positive regulatory immune cells in their blood compared with healthy people.

35902484.conclusion_quote: Current data encourages a broader application of AHSCT for treating patients with MS while still considering proper patient selection and transplant methods.
35902484.summary: Pooling 50 studies of 4831 people, this review found that stem cell transplants lowered disability scores and relapses, with few deaths from the procedure.

29581230.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study suggests that patients with MS have a significantly higher leptin level than in healthy controls.
29581230.summary: Researchers combined nine studies and found people with multiple sclerosis have higher leptin, a hormone made by fat cells, than healthy people.

35654266.conclusion_quote: Based on the available evidence, two instruments can be recommended for use, two are unrecommended, and five have the potential to be recommended for use but require further research.
35654266.summary: This systematic review of 24 studies found that tools measuring multiple sclerosis knowledge vary in quality. Only two are recommended for use, while five need more research.

30669140.conclusion_quote: These findings provide a starting point to estimate the social burden of CIDP and demonstrate the need to reach consensus on diagnostic criteria for CIDP.
30669140.summary: A review of studies found that about 3 in 100,000 people have CIDP, a rare nerve disorder, and that different diagnostic rules strongly change these numbers.

38600842.conclusion_quote: This article presents expert panel recommendations for managing MS in Iraq, taking into account international guidelines, medication updates, and local resources.
38600842.summary: Ten Iraqi MS experts agreed on recommendations for diagnosing and treating relapsing MS, including starting strong treatments early for high risk patients and tailoring care for women planning pregnancy.

31129710.conclusion_quote: All DMTs were superior to placebo in reducing the relapse rate during the 2 years of follow-up.
31129710.summary: Disease modifying drugs for relapsing MS reduced relapses compared with placebo, with alemtuzumab, ocrelizumab, natalizumab and fingolimod performing best overall.

34780613.conclusion_quote: This review highlights the lack of evidence related to various types of participation for adults with MS.
34780613.summary: Only four studies met criteria, an online work program, yoga group classes, and interdisciplinary rehabilitation showed some benefit for work or social participation, but evidence was limited.

33460576.conclusion_quote: This review provides the most accurate reference values to-date that can be used to assess the effectiveness of MS gait training programs and therapeutic techniques for individuals who differ on disability severity and fall classification.
33460576.summary: People with MS walk more slowly, take shorter steps and show more cautious walking patterns as disability worsens, and recent fallers walk about 18% slower than people who have not fallen.

28920886.conclusion_quote: The largest and most robust differences between the eyes of people with multiple sclerosis and control eyes were found in the peripapillary RNFL and macular GCIPL.
28920886.summary: Pooling 40 studies, this review found that the nerve fibre layer and a macular layer of the retina are thinner in people with multiple sclerosis, especially after optic neuritis.

39725754.conclusion_quote: These guidelines recommend intravenous or subcutaneous immunoglobulin as maintenance therapy, as well as unresolved questions on the evolving concept of CIDP and future treatments.
39725754.summary: This review explains updated 2021 European guidelines for diagnosing and treating CIDP, a nerve disorder that is not multiple sclerosis.

35860179.conclusion_quote: There is some evidence for the effectiveness of RAGT.
35860179.summary: Robot assisted gait training improved some walking, balance and fatigue measures in people with severe MS, while other physiotherapy approaches showed no clear benefit.

39544560.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis revealed that individuals with OA have approximately 25% higher odds of an accompanying ND diagnosis compared to those without OA.
39544560.summary: Combining nine studies, people with osteoarthritis had about 25% higher odds of a neurological diagnosis, though links to Parkinson's, MS and Alzheimer's were not statistically significant.

37293841.conclusion_quote: This first European consensus on vaccination in pwMS proposes the best vaccination strategy according to current evidence and expert knowledge, with the goal of homogenizing the immunization practices in pwMS.
37293841.summary: A European expert panel reviewed evidence and agreed 53 recommendations on vaccinating people with MS, especially those starting highly active medicines, to improve safety and consistency.

35084560.conclusion_quote: A (supportive) disease-modifying effect of exercise in pwMS cannot be concluded.
35084560.summary: Exercise may help walking ability scores in MS, but it has not been shown to slow disease activity or progression, as evidence is weak.

38255863.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the measurement of NOx in the serum might indeed be a valuable tool in supporting MS diagnosis.
38255863.summary: Blood tests showed higher levels of nitrite and nitrate stress molecules in people with MS than in people with somatic symptom disorder, suggesting a possible diagnostic aid.

31425902.conclusion_quote: RTX and MMF may be recommended as optimal treatments to prevent relapse in NMOSD.
31425902.summary: Rituximab appeared best at preventing relapses in neuromyelitis optica, and mycophenolate was the best tolerated of the drugs compared.

32799563.conclusion_quote: However, insufficient data were available to assess longer-term AEs, e.g., malignancy.
32799563.summary: Ocrelizumab caused more infections and infusion reactions than some comparators, though serious side effects were similar, and longer term risks like cancer remain unclear.

35863879.summary: UK neurology specialists give guidance on screening for, preventing and treating infections in people with multiple sclerosis, especially those taking disease modifying drugs.

29337021.conclusion_quote: Current evidence supports the efficacy of PA intervention on subjective but not objective outcomes.
29337021.summary: Behavior change programs helped people with MS report more physical activity in the short term, but did not improve measured activity or lasting change.

38449687.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review show that efficacy of interferon and fingolimod in controlling relapse rate and disability is similar.
38449687.summary: This review of four studies found that fingolimod and interferon beta work about equally well at controlling relapses and disability in relapsing multiple sclerosis.

32252967.conclusion_quote: The age at menopause is not associated with the presence of MS.
32252967.summary: Researchers reviewed 28 studies on menopause and MS. Age at menopause was not linked to MS, but the effect of hormone therapy on the disease remains unclear.

31096898.conclusion_quote: Overall, omega-3 supplementation may not have a clinically considerable impact on EDSS or proinflammatory markers.
31096898.summary: Omega-3 supplements did not clearly improve disability scores or most inflammation markers in people with MS, though they lowered one inflammatory marker, TNF alpha.

28099564.conclusion_quote: Therefore, a systematic review of the main published treatment guidelines was conducted and an escalating therapy proposed for guiding multiple sclerosis patient treatment in Brazil.
28099564.summary: The authors reviewed major published MS treatment guidelines and proposed a step-up treatment plan to help Brazilian neurologists choose therapies as patients' disease worsens.

32504530.conclusion_quote: Strong consistent evidence is lacking for dietary interventions in persons with MS.
32504530.summary: A review of 62 review articles found little strong evidence that diet changes MS progression or symptoms, vitamin D and fatty acids had mixed or no clear benefit.

35805808.conclusion_quote: We found no universal agreement on the effects of different exercise training protocols on the serum level of inflammatory markers in patients with MS.
35805808.summary: Reviewing randomised trials, exercise did not clearly change inflammatory markers in people with MS. Results were inconsistent across studies, so firm conclusions are not yet possible.

33540278.conclusion_quote: Despite multiple promising findings, DT interventions appear to have minimal impact on clinical balance and gait measures in PwMS.
33540278.summary: Five trials found dual task training may help walking speed, but evidence for improving balance is inconsistent and overall effects on balance and gait appear small.

31755637.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis provides level III evidence that DBS may improve MS-related tremor as measured by standardized tremor severity scales.
31755637.summary: Deep brain stimulation appears to reduce tremor in people with multiple sclerosis, based on pooled results from 13 studies, though the studies were varied and the evidence is limited.

36563595.conclusion_quote: This standard outcome set provides a guideline for measuring outcomes of MS in clinical practice and research.
36563595.summary: Patients and MS experts agreed on a set of fourteen outcomes to measure in MS care and research, covering disease activity, symptoms, daily function and quality of life.

37050456.conclusion_quote: Mobile app interventions are promising to improve outcomes concerning patient's physical activity, motor ability, cognition, quality of life and education for patients with PD, MS, and Stroke.
37050456.summary: This review of 21 studies on phone apps for Parkinson's, MS and stroke found most apps focused on exercise and rehabilitation, with mostly positive but weak evidence.

33690875.conclusion_quote: This review will suggest future research directions toward establishing efficacious treatments that can allow persons with MS to reclaim their physical abilities and maximize functionality for meaningful periods.
33690875.summary: This review examines whether physical training improves everyday activities for people with MS in the community, whether those gains last, and what research should come next.

31398354.conclusion_quote: The results of this meta-analysis suggest that higher levels of aerobic capacity are associated with lower fatigue.
31398354.summary: Ten studies found that fatigue in people with MS is moderately linked to lower aerobic fitness and only weakly linked to muscle strength.

38188227.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the existed investigations on the effect of sex hormones on inflammatory and neurodegenerative components of MS are promising particularly in relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS).
38188227.summary: Nine trials of sex hormone treatments in MS were reviewed. The hormones looked promising for inflammation and nerve damage, especially in relapsing MS, but the evidence is limited.

38213676.conclusion_quote: Further research is necessary to demonstrate the efficacy of most of the interventions.
38213676.summary: Behavioral treatments such as cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia showed sleep improvements in some studies, but the evidence is too varied to confirm which ones work best.

38268751.conclusion_quote: Ultimately, this study will provide support either for an association of these disorders (in which emotion-recognition deficits might result from more fundamental cognitive dysfunction), or for two distinct sets of symptoms which may occur independently, for targeted patient profiles.
38268751.summary: This protocol plans a meta-analysis of whether trouble recognising emotions in multiple sclerosis is linked to thinking and memory problems.

39202006.conclusion_quote: MiR-150 is a promising biomarker for MS, showing significant potential for improving diagnostic accuracy and monitoring disease progression.
39202006.summary: Ten studies reviewed found that a tiny molecule called microRNA 150 is consistently altered in people with MS, suggesting it could help diagnose the disease and track how it progresses.

31298582.conclusion_quote: Both group and individual-based stress management interventions appear to be effective in promoting self-management of stress.
31298582.summary: Eight randomised trials suggest that group and individual stress management programmes help people with MS manage stress better, though the best timing is still unclear.

36493561.conclusion_quote: Self-tracking options in MS apps are currently limited, though the apps that offer these functions are considered useful by individuals with MS.
36493561.summary: Researchers analysed user reviews of MS self-management apps and found most people rated them positively, though health tracking features were limited and users wanted more customization.

28870581.conclusion_quote: Current limited data suggest that amantadine may be the only drug that has relatively sufficient evidences in treatment of fatigue symptoms in MS.
28870581.summary: This review of 11 trials found amantadine helped reduce fatigue in MS, while modafinil did not, though evidence for other drugs remains limited.

36052576.conclusion_quote: Off-label high efficacy immunotherapy in PMS has biological plausibility and presented similar effectiveness to on-label DMDs in this network meta-analysis.
36052576.summary: Researchers compared high-efficacy MS drugs used off-label with approved ones for progressive MS, finding similar effects on disability worsening, though the evidence is limited.

30015803.conclusion_quote: Although incorporating the knowledge derived from the research arena into the daily clinical practice is always challenging, in this article, the authors provide useful recommendations to improve the information contained in the magnetic resonance report oriented to facilitate communication between radiologists and specialized medical teams involved in MS patients' multidisciplinary care.
30015803.summary: This update gives radiologists practical advice on MRI scans, reasons to order them, and report writing to help MS care teams communicate.

38720409.conclusion_quote: In this case study, estimates from observational studies predominantly agreed with estimates from randomized controlled trials given their posterior predictive distributions.
38720409.summary: Researchers compared relapsing MS drug results from randomized trials and real-world observational studies, and found the two mostly agreed, supporting use of real-world evidence.

28631829.conclusion_quote: This study has been showed that there were significant relationship between MS and HHV6 infection.
28631829.summary: A meta-analysis of 39 studies found that human herpesvirus 6 infection was significantly linked to multiple sclerosis, though it is unclear whether it causes the disease.

35006442.conclusion_quote: Available data, which suggest that MS patients treated with anti-CD20 monoclonal antibodies may be at increased risk for severe COVID-19, are subject to relevant limitations.
35006442.summary: Researchers reviewed 16 observational studies and found that anti-CD20 MS drugs may raise the risk of severe COVID-19, while other MS treatments did not clearly do so.

31443806.summary: Pooling 51 studies, researchers found that about 17% of people with early multiple sclerosis had depressive symptoms and 35% had anxiety symptoms.

38137679.conclusion_quote: All interventional means of gut microbiome modulation provided significant conclusions on several clinical aspects of MS and highlight the complexity in the relationship between MS and the gut microbiome.
38137679.summary: This review of 13 studies found that diet, probiotics, fecal transplants and intermittent fasting may help people with MS, with diet showing the clearest benefits.

35381533.conclusion_quote: In agreement with pre-pandemic literature, pwMS showed higher levels of psychological distress than HC also during the Covid-19 pandemic.
35381533.summary: A review of studies found people with MS had more depression, anxiety and stress than healthy people during the COVID-19 pandemic, and their sleep worsened.

32004856.conclusion_quote: Overall, there is a lack of validated predictive tools in MS, and further external validation of the existing ones are required.
32004856.summary: This review found that few tools for predicting multiple sclerosis progression have been properly tested, and the leading ones gave very different accuracy results.

30102003.conclusion_quote: The SC is atrophied in MS.
30102003.summary: This review of 94 studies found the spinal cord shrinks in MS, more so in progressive forms, and that shrinkage is linked to disability.

36143259.conclusion_quote: Even though a trend is shown, B-cell targeted therapies do not correlate with an increased incidence of headache as an adverse effect.
36143259.summary: Pooled trials found B-cell targeting MS drugs did not significantly raise headache risk overall, though cladribine was linked to a small increase.

32996098.conclusion_quote: Although the MoCA test demonstrated good sensitivity and specificity when used at the recommended threshold of 26, a lower threshold than the original cut-off was also reported to be useful for optimal screening, as it lowers false positive rates and improves diagnostic accuracy.
32996098.summary: A review of fourteen studies found the MoCA cognitive test works well for spotting thinking problems in MS, with a cutoff near 26 or 27 suggested.

35358308.conclusion_quote: Most quantitative gait parameters deteriorated during the 6MWT, especially in PwMS with moderate-to-severe disability.
35358308.summary: Walking for six minutes made gait worse in most people with MS, especially those with moderate to severe disability, which matters when designing walking therapies.

39651333.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore the role of epigenetic modifications in shaping MS pathology.
39651333.summary: Researchers combined existing DNA methylation data from blood and brain samples and found chemical changes on genes in MS, plus rare epigenetic changes seen only in people with MS.

29651873.conclusion_quote: Virtual reality training could be considered at least as effective as conventional training and more effective than no intervention to treat balance and gait impairments in multiple sclerosis rehabilitation.
29651873.summary: Virtual reality training improved balance compared with no treatment and worked about as well as standard therapy, though gait results were inconclusive.

38033465.conclusion_quote: While circRNA shows promise as an indicator or biomarker for MS disease pathology, further research is needed to fully explore its potential and impact on human biology.
38033465.summary: A review of published studies finds that circular RNA molecules differ between people with MS and healthy people, suggesting they could become useful disease markers, though more research is needed.

29957381.conclusion_quote: Similar but non-significant trends were seen among alleles, which in sum coincides with a Caucasian-like pattern.
29957381.summary: A meta-analysis of studies from Middle East and North African countries found the HLA DRB1*15 gene linked to higher MS risk, while DRB1*07 and DRB1*11 appeared protective.

31326830.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis of 6 MW performance defines mean difference in 6 MW performance in MS compared with HCs and provides an estimate of the disease-related effect of MS on endurance walking capacity for application within clinical research and practice.
31326830.summary: People with multiple sclerosis walked about 177 metres less than healthy people in a six minute walk test, and those with milder disability walked further than those with severe disability.

29972417.conclusion_quote: The therapeutic effect of IVIG for prevention of postnatal relapses in MS could not clearly be established in this meta-analysis.
29972417.summary: Researchers reviewed 11 studies of immunoglobulin infusions given after childbirth to women with MS. They could not clearly show that these infusions prevent relapses.

33554666.conclusion_quote: There is a class I evidence supporting the effectiveness of cell therapy as safe therapeutic option in multiple sclerosis with health benefits in the medium and long term.
33554666.summary: Researchers reviewed MS research on cell, gene and nanomedicine therapies, and found cell therapy trials appear safe with health benefits over the medium and long term.

34487465.conclusion_quote: Poor response or resistance to antipsychotics treatment should alert clinicians on the need to consider a differential diagnosis.
34487465.summary: People who develop psychosis before an MS diagnosis often respond poorly to antipsychotics, while steroids and immune treatments frequently help, so doctors should consider MS.

37583464.conclusion_quote: The results of this meta-analysis showed no significant differences in step count and moderate to vigorous physical activity level among individuals with MS, both within and between groups receiving physical activity interventions.
37583464.summary: Exercise and physical activity programs did not significantly increase daily step counts or moderate to vigorous activity in people with MS, based on eight trials.

34468108.conclusion_quote: This systematic review showed that different types of trunk training programs can improve trunk and upper limb function in PwMS.
34468108.summary: Sixteen studies found that trunk training exercises such as Pilates and core programs can improve trunk control and arm and hand function in people with MS.

38698450.conclusion_quote: There is a lacune for systematic reviews involving risk factors and long-term outcomes of dysphagia in pwMS to date.
38698450.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of studies on what raises the risk of swallowing problems in people with multiple sclerosis and what complications follow.

36884069.conclusion_quote: RTX and tocilizumab showed better efficacy than traditional immunosuppressants in reducing relapse.
36884069.summary: Rituximab and tocilizumab appeared to reduce NMOSD relapses more than older immune suppressing drugs, while mycophenolate and rituximab caused fewer side effects.

35216789.conclusion_quote: Postvaccination NMOSD is a rare condition that can occur with various types of vaccines.
35216789.summary: Two new cases and a review of ten reported cases suggest NMOSD, a rare nerve and spinal cord disorder, can occur after various vaccines, possibly in genetically prone people.

30268040.conclusion_quote: There were no significant difference when comparing IFN β and teriflunomide in terms of liver failure or elevation of transaminases.
30268040.summary: Comparing two MS drugs, interferon beta and teriflunomide, found no clear difference in their risk of liver damage, though direct evidence was very limited.

40034519.conclusion_quote: Future research should refine these diagnostic criteria and focus on enhancing screening and detection methods for AD in MS patients.
40034519.summary: This review gathered 125 published cases of people with both MS and Alzheimer's disease, compared shared disease mechanisms, and assessed tests used to detect Alzheimer's in MS patients.

28492970.conclusion_quote: In adult patients with acute MS relapse, there were no clear-cut differences in the efficacy and overall tolerability between oral and intravenous steroids.
28492970.summary: Comparing six trials, oral and intravenous steroids worked about equally well for MS relapses, though oral steroids caused more insomnia.

34505407.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that RTX is more efficient than MMF as a first-line therapy.
34505407.summary: Rituximab appeared to delay the first relapse of neuromyelitis optica better than mycophenolate, but not clearly better than azathioprine, across pooled patient studies.

36984620.conclusion_quote: Thus, the hypothesis that multiparity might have a protective role on MS outcomes needs to be tested in larger prospective cohort studies of neo-diagnosed women, evaluating both clinical and radiological features at presentation.
36984620.summary: Two women with late-onset MS had many pregnancies and breastfeeding, a review suggests multiple pregnancies may delay MS symptoms, but larger studies are needed to confirm this.

36405749.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis suggests that transplantation of MSC-EVs in MS rodent models improved functional recovery.
36405749.summary: Across twelve animal studies, treatment with vesicles released by stem cells improved disability scores in mice and rats with MS, but optimal doses remain unclear.

38851890.conclusion_quote: Our study identified suggestive risk genes and pathways for CIDP and IP.
38851890.summary: Genetic analysis of large datasets suggested several candidate genes and biological pathways linked to two rare nerve inflammation disorders, CIDP and inflammatory polyneuropathy.

32447549.conclusion_quote: Neurofilament light has shown consistent utility as a biomarker of neuroinflammation, future brain atrophy and immunosuppressive treatment response at a group level.
32447549.summary: This review found that a marker called neurofilament light reliably reflects inflammation and future brain shrinkage in progressive MS, but does not clearly track disability.

29260583.conclusion_quote: Clinical measures of balance differ significantly between fallers and non-fallers but have poor predictive ability for falls risk in people with multiple sclerosis.
29260583.summary: Balance tests can tell people with MS who have fallen apart from those who have not, but they are poor at predicting who will fall in future.

33611631.conclusion_quote: Our review suggests that MS is one of the most common causes of misdiagnosis of FND and vice versa.
33611631.summary: This review found that MS and functional neurological disorder are often mistaken for each other, and that some patients have both, which complicates diagnosis and treatment.

34375988.conclusion_quote: The results indicated that aquatic exercise ranked as the most effective among these interventions, and aerobic exercise had small-to-moderate effect sizes.
34375988.summary: Exercise programs reduced fatigue in people with MS, with aquatic exercise appearing most effective, while climbing performed worse than no exercise.

34663674.conclusion_quote: We advocate for systematic data collection to adequately capture and monitor the burden of NMOSD, for expansion of research efforts and facilities to perform fundamental and clinical research, and for improved access to health care including diagnostics, treatments, and rehabilitation services for people affected by NMOSD in the African continent.
34663674.summary: A review of 19 studies found about 410 people with neuromyelitis optica across ten African countries, with limited data and little reporting of outcomes.

34421807.conclusion_quote: The search led to a scientifically evident set of six quality indicators for the assessment of care for patients with MS.
34421807.summary: Researchers reviewed existing measures of good care for people with MS and selected six quality indicators that could help assess and improve their care.

33257483.conclusion_quote: This research aims to perform a direct and comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate MMF's effectiveness and safety in treating NMOSD.
33257483.summary: Researchers plan a systematic review and meta-analysis to find out whether mycophenolate mofetil works well and safely for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorders.

30876717.conclusion_quote: Treadmill training may be effective for improving mobility in people with Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis.
30876717.summary: Treadmill walking training improved walking speed in people with Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis, but overground walking did not improve mobility.

31513613.conclusion_quote: DAP can effectively improve Mobility Disability in patients with Multiple Sclerosis, which is safe and reliable in specific DAP usage doses.
31513613.summary: Pooled trials of dalfampridine, a drug for MS, found it improved walking ability compared with placebo, and it appeared safe at specific doses.

28890199.conclusion_quote: Results imply that, previously under-recognized, PPMS patients display severe degrees of CI and need more specialized disease management than RRMS patients.
28890199.summary: People with primary progressive MS have worse thinking and memory problems than those with relapsing MS, and need more specialised care.

36565573.conclusion_quote: RWE for the long-term use of CladT in the treatment of RMS is increasing, however, gaps in knowledge remain.
36565573.summary: A review of real-world studies found cladribine tablets usually keep MS under control long term, though some patients get new activity and more research is needed.

27282383.conclusion_quote: It is hypothesized that local alterations of Zn may be actively involved in the pathogenesis of MS.
27282383.summary: Pooling 13 studies, researchers found people with multiple sclerosis had lower blood zinc than healthy people, though zinc's role in the disease is unclear.

33391166.conclusion_quote: Monoclonal antibodies were effective and safe in NMOSD.
33391166.summary: Monoclonal antibody drugs reduced relapses and disability worsening in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, and appeared safe, across seven randomised controlled trials.

34783010.conclusion_quote: Based on the findings of the RCTs included in this review, we are uncertain whether siponimod interventions are beneficial for people with MS.
34783010.summary: A review of two trials found siponimod may reduce relapses and disability worsening at six months, but evidence is low certainty and long term effects remain unclear.

32736185.conclusion_quote: However, psychological and social factors such as emotional distress and stress-coping variables appear to be important.
32736185.summary: A review of 13 studies finds that prior distress and ways of coping with stress best predict emotional distress in people with multiple sclerosis.

42053047.conclusion_quote: These findings underscore the potential of SCS as an adjunct therapy in enhancing surgical recovery in MS patients, pointing towards its broader applications in post-operative care.
42053047.summary: A retracted analysis of seven studies claimed spinal cord stimulation helped surgical wounds heal faster and scar less in people with multiple sclerosis.

28431618.conclusion_quote: The present review showed that 1) isokinetic dynamometry has a high reliability in PwMS; 2) muscle strength, power and rate of force development is impaired in PwMS compared to HC, and muscle strength impairments are most pronounced during maximal moderate to fast dynamic muscle contractions of the lower extremities; and 3) progressive resistance training can improve muscle mechanical function in PwMS.
28431618.summary: People with multiple sclerosis have weaker muscles and slower force production than healthy people, and resistance exercise training can improve their muscle strength.

32172998.conclusion_quote: Gut microbiota diversity did not differ between MS cases and controls in the majority of studies.
32172998.summary: Ten studies found that gut bacteria variety was similar in people with and without MS, though some specific bacteria types differed consistently between groups.

35126965.conclusion_quote: tDCS in MS alleviates fatigue and improves cognitive function whereas rTMS reduces muscle spasticity.
35126965.summary: Pooling 25 trials, this review found brain stimulation with tDCS reduced fatigue and improved thinking, while rTMS eased muscle stiffness in multiple sclerosis.

38363408.conclusion_quote: Based on the results of all studies, it can be concluded that for the treatment of patients with MS, care-oriented strategies should be preferred to drug strategies.
38363408.summary: This review of 49 studies found oral MS drugs were preferred over injected or infused drugs in cost terms, and overall care approaches were favoured over drug approaches.

33212400.conclusion_quote: There is therefore some evidence that VR is effective in improving motor function in the UL, however, there is no clear consensus on which VR based approaches are the most effective, or the optimum intervention duration and intensity.
33212400.summary: Review of ten studies found some evidence that virtual reality games can improve arm and hand movement in people with MS, though the best approach remains unclear.

39755895.conclusion_quote: In the absence of alternative scientific data, recommendations from experts and their consensus provide useful insights into the administration and monitoring burden of HE DMTs used for MS in Saudi Arabia.
39755895.summary: A Saudi expert panel ranked high efficacy MS drugs by how hard they are to give and monitor, finding cladribine easiest to monitor and alemtuzumab hardest.

27655736.conclusion_quote: Social cognitive deficits are an overlooked but potentially important aspect of cognitive impairment in MS with potential prognostic significance for social functioning and quality of life.
27655736.summary: People with MS often struggle to read emotions in faces and to understand what others are thinking, compared with healthy people. Those problems are substantial and may affect social life.

28017241.conclusion_quote: Data of a large number of patients indicate increased prevalence of depression and anxiety in MS.
28017241.summary: Pooling 58 studies of nearly 88,000 people, this review found about 3 in 10 people with MS have depression and about 1 in 5 have anxiety.

29346446.conclusion_quote: The result of this study confirms that increased levels of OPN exist in CSF and peripheral blood of MS patients and strengthens the evidence regarding the clinical utility of OPN as a promising and validated biomarker for MS.
29346446.summary: A review of 22 studies found that multiple sclerosis patients have higher osteopontin levels in their spinal fluid and blood, suggesting it could help diagnose the disease.

29406017.conclusion_quote: Whilst there was only a limited pool of relatively small trials and a number of different compounds, we found that collectively, both AChEIs (donepezil and rivastigmine) and stimulants (methylphenidate, modafinil, l-amphetamine sulfate and lisdexamfetamine dimesylate) offered no significant benefits over placebo on measures of processing speed, working memory, verbal fluency, verbal memory, visuospatial memory or executive functioning.
29406017.summary: Drugs for memory and thinking problems in MS, including donepezil and modafinil, did not improve cognition better than placebo in these trials.

31815299.conclusion_quote: This systematic review provides evidence of an association between multiple sclerosis and at least some oral health problems.
31815299.summary: A review of 17 studies found people with multiple sclerosis may have more gum disease and jaw joint problems, though evidence for tooth decay is limited.

31940156.conclusion_quote: It aims to improve the quality of life for adults with multiple sclerosis by promoting symptom management, comprehensive reviews and effective relapse treatment.
31940156.summary: This NICE guideline explains how to diagnose and manage multiple sclerosis in adults, focusing on symptom relief, regular reviews and treating relapses. It does not cover drugs that slow the disease.

33962135.conclusion_quote: These quantitative results indicate that patients with MS and its subtypes have a differential impairment of the core aspects of social cognitive processing (including ToM and FER), which may help develop the structured social cognitive interventions in MS.
33962135.summary: People with multiple sclerosis, including all subtypes, had clear difficulties understanding others' thoughts and feelings and recognising emotions on faces, which may guide social skills training.

29306740.conclusion_quote: The present meta-analysis revealed a significant effect for computer-based cognitive training on the performance of the memory domain of patients with MS.
29306740.summary: Pooling nine studies, computer cognitive training modestly improved memory in people with MS compared with control activities, though evidence is limited.

27878439.conclusion_quote: Both IBD and MS patients seem to have a fifty-percent increased risk of MS or IBD comorbidity, respectively, with no apparent differences between patients with CD or UC.
27878439.summary: People with multiple sclerosis and people with inflammatory bowel disease are each about 50 percent more likely to have the other condition, based on ten studies.

34547886.conclusion_quote: The present comprehensive systematic review highlights the potential beneficial role on functional outcomes of the lower limb robotic devices in people with MS.
34547886.summary: Robotic gait training helped people with MS walk faster, last longer and balance better, about as well as usual therapy, and possibly more in severely affected patients.

33095366.conclusion_quote: PON1-55M alleles in Italians and PON1-192Q alleles in Poles were associated with a high risk of MS.
33095366.summary: This review found that certain genetic versions of the PON1 enzyme gene, and lower PON1 enzyme activity, may be linked to a higher risk of developing multiple sclerosis.

37877856.conclusion_quote: Although the current literature suggests that tibial nerve electrostimulation might be an effective method for treating neurogenic lower urinary tract dysfunction, the evidence base is poor and derived from small, mostly nonrandomized trials with a high risk of bias and confounding.
37877856.summary: Tibial nerve stimulation, a mild electrical treatment near the ankle, appeared to reduce bladder problems in people with MS, though the studies were small and weak.

30696832.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis also identifies 16 promising therapies which did not enter a clinical trial for MS so far, among them Pigment epithelium-derived factor, Plateled derived growth factor, and Tocopherol derivate TFA-12.
30696832.summary: Researchers reviewed animal studies of treatments that might repair myelin, the protective coating on nerves, and found 16 promising options not yet tested in MS trials.

38722571.conclusion_quote: In the absence of head-to-head randomized controlled trials, NMA results suggest ravulizumab, a C5 inhibitor, is likely to be more effective in preventing NMOSD relapse in patients with AQP4-Ab+ NMOSD when compared with other treatments having different methods of action.
38722571.summary: A network analysis of trials found ravulizumab likely prevents relapses better than inebilizumab and satralizumab in NMOSD, and performs similarly to eculizumab.

38157653.conclusion_quote: Patients with PPMS have altered levels of GDF-15, DKK-1 and cathepsin-D in serum, and GDF-15 and cathepsin-D may have predictive value in progression free of inflammatory activity in PPMS.
38157653.summary: Blood levels of GDF-15 and cathepsin-D were higher in people with progressive MS who got worse, and may help predict future disability.

33711580.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that monoclonal antibodies are highly effective and safe for the treatment of NMOSD; Rituximab showed better performance on multiple outcomes and has more evidence available.
33711580.summary: This review of 13 studies found that monoclonal antibodies, especially rituximab, work well and safely to reduce relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica.

35652121.conclusion_quote: Evidence suggests that magnetization transfer imaging metrics are sensitive to pathological brain changes in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, although effect sizes were small in comparison to inter-study variability.
35652121.summary: Reviewing 86 studies, researchers found that a scan measure of brain myelin, the protective coating on nerves, was lower in people with relapsing MS and tracked with disability.

29627036.conclusion_quote: Compared to other neurological diseases the nocebo effect in CIDP is significantly smaller.
29627036.summary: In CIDP drug trials, about 42 percent of placebo patients reported side effects and few quit, a smaller nocebo effect than in other neurological diseases.

29055459.conclusion_quote: This first review to supplement systematic review and meta-analytic methods with Hill's criteria to analyze the smoking-MS association provides evidence supporting the causal involvement of smoking in the development and progression of MS.
29055459.summary: A review of studies found smoking is strongly linked to developing MS and moderately linked to its progression, supporting smoking as a likely cause.

33180889.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis provides evidence that DBP rs7041 and rs4588 polymorphisms may not be associated with an increased risk in MS and T1DM.
33180889.summary: Pooling 13 studies, this review found no clear link between vitamin D gene variants and risk of multiple sclerosis or type 1 diabetes.

31965869.conclusion_quote: In MS patients, polypharmacy is common and closely associated with health issues.
31965869.summary: Seven studies found that many people with MS take five or more medicines at once, and this is linked to other health problems, disability, and lower quality of life.

39100118.conclusion_quote: This case highlights the importance of conducting a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) brain not only for initial onset psychosis but also for any sudden changes in patients who have had a relatively stable course.
