39100118.summary: This paper describes a patient with multiple sclerosis and psychosis and reviews published cases, finding psychosis can appear before or after MS diagnosis, so brain MRI scans are important.

35510826.conclusion_quote: Compared with placebo, nabiximols probably reduces the severity of spasticity in the short-term in people with MS.
35510826.summary: Cannabis medicines, mainly nabiximols, probably ease muscle stiffness in people with MS more than placebo, but may cause more side effects and dropouts.

27908533.conclusion_quote: Data from case-control studies do not support a link between IgG/IgM aPL and MS.
27908533.summary: Combined studies found antiphospholipid antibodies were not clearly linked to MS overall, though one antibody type was more common in people with active disease.

37178621.conclusion_quote: The results of this study provide the necessary quantitative information for both the rational clinical use of drugs and future clinical trials in primary progressive multiple sclerosis.
37178621.summary: Pooled data from 15 trials found most tested drugs beat placebo for primary progressive MS, with ocrelizumab performing best, while biotin and interferon beta did not.

36743361.conclusion_quote: Despite the importance of planning in response to disasters to address specific problems of MS patients, there is a lack of proper planning.
36743361.summary: This review found that few studies and plans address how disasters affect people with multiple sclerosis, and that better emergency planning for them is urgently needed.

29110148.conclusion_quote: Our preliminary results indicate the VDR gene ApaI, BsmI, FokI, and TaqI polymorphisms may not be associated with elevated MS risk among overall populations.
29110148.summary: Combining 24 studies, this review found no clear link between common vitamin D receptor gene variants and multiple sclerosis risk overall, though one variant may matter in Asian people.

27693958.conclusion_quote: MS has a significant effect on gait even for those with relatively low EDSS.
27693958.summary: Multiple sclerosis affects walking, with large differences in stride and speed compared with healthy people, and these differences are larger when walking fast.

31567981.conclusion_quote: FOXP3 gene polymorphism rs3761548 was associated with a higher MS risk, especially in Asians.
31567981.summary: Genetic variants in the FOXP3 gene, particularly rs3761548, may raise the chance of developing multiple sclerosis, especially in Asian people.

30646241.conclusion_quote: The results suggest a limited efficacy of cannabinoids for the treatment of spasticity, pain, and bladder dysfunction in patients with MS.
30646241.summary: Cannabinoid medicines gave small improvements in muscle stiffness, pain, and bladder problems in people with MS, but caused more side effects that led some to stop taking them.

36648561.conclusion_quote: Decreasing IgG levels have been correlated with increased infection risk over time.
36648561.summary: A review of ocrelizumab and ofatumumab studies found antibody (IgG) levels fell over time with ocrelizumab but stayed steady with ofatumumab, and falling levels may raise infection risk.

30393105.conclusion_quote: Results of this meta-analysis revealed a potential hazardous effect of MS for developing FSD.
30393105.summary: Women with multiple sclerosis appear to have a higher risk of sexual problems than healthy women, though the evidence quality is low.

33770729.conclusion_quote: The literature review clearly discloses that flavonoids alone or in combination with other anti-MS therapeutic agents can pave the way for improving MS therapeutic strategies.
33770729.summary: Review of 13 mostly animal studies found that flavonoids, plant compounds from fruits and vegetables, consistently reduced disease severity in MS models.

33541044.conclusion_quote: In available RCT, RAGT is mostly provided with exoskeleton devices and improves balance and gait outcomes in a clinically meaningful way.
33541044.summary: Robotic walking training improved balance and walking in people with MS in 12 randomized trials, often reaching clinically meaningful gains.

38222726.conclusion_quote: AHSCT has been proven to be one of the most effective treatment modalities for MS in recent studies.
38222726.summary: Review of 17 studies of stem cell transplants in MS found CD4 T cells dropped most, B cells usually recovered within six months, and NK cells often rose above baseline.

33557738.conclusion_quote: Although MSC therapy has showed to be effective in the improvement of some patients with MS, designing larger placebo-controlled clinical trials with MSCs expressing immune- regulators or MSCs-exosomes may provide a novel viewpoint in the treatment of MS.
33557738.summary: This review found that stem cell therapy reduced inflammation and aided nerve coating repair in animal studies, and stabilised disease in about 70% of patients in trials.

28567539.conclusion_quote: This suggests that the GCL is a promising biomarker, which may be used to examine in vivo neurodegeneration in ON and MS.
28567539.summary: Eye scans show a retinal layer thins in MS and optic neuritis, even without past eye inflammation, suggesting it could track nerve damage.

31421864.conclusion_quote: In MS, GM atrophy was regionally selective, and these regions were functionally connected.
31421864.summary: Researchers combined brain scans from 33 studies and found that grey matter shrinkage in multiple sclerosis affects specific brain regions that work together as connected networks.

30572285.conclusion_quote: Under random effect model of meta-analysis, the data showed that the results of Tregs in MS were different according to the definition method; and the proportion of Tregs defined by "CD4 + CD25 + FOXP3 + " was decreased in MS.
30572285.summary: Pooled studies found MS patients had fewer regulatory T cells only when these cells were identified using the strict FOXP3 marker, with no difference using looser definitions.

29778041.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that vitamin D appeared to have no therapeutic effect on EDSS score or ARR in the patients with MS.
29778041.summary: Pooled placebo-controlled trials found that vitamin D added to usual treatment did not reduce disability scores in people with MS, and it was linked to slightly more relapses.

37456635.conclusion_quote: Findings across these studies revealed that gray matter atrophy was more pronounced in older adults with MS, particularly in subcortical regions such as the thalamus; that the rates of atrophy were similar but varied by region for younger and older cohorts; and that males may experience more brain atrophy than females.
37456635.summary: Review of 21 MRI studies found brain shrinkage in people with MS is worse in older adults, especially deep areas, and men may lose more brain tissue than women.

34382408.conclusion_quote: These results indicate an urgent need for greater standardization in the field-in terms of the choice of MRI analysis and the definition of cognitive impairment.
34382408.summary: Studies of brain scans in people with MS show that cognitive problems are linked to both stronger and weaker connections between brain regions, so the methods need standardizing.

34748215.conclusion_quote: Rituximab likely results in a large reduction in relapses compared with interferon beta or glatiramer acetate (hazard ratio (HR) 0.14, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.05 to 0.39; 335 participants; moderate-certainty evidence).
34748215.summary: Rituximab, an off label antibody treatment, appears to reduce relapses in relapsing MS compared with several standard drugs, while its effect on disability is unclear.

32343973.conclusion_quote: Current evidence demonstrates that interventions are efficacious for increasing and potentially sustaining physical activity behavior in adults with MS.
32343973.summary: Interventions such as exercise and behaviour coaching helped people with multiple sclerosis become more active, and the benefits appeared to last for a while.

36266639.conclusion_quote: Our findings show that dietary intervention is associated with a trend of reduction in fatigue in MS.
36266639.summary: Diets gave a modest reduction in fatigue and better quality of life for people with MS, with no effect on disability and no serious side effects reported.

35609240.conclusion_quote: We recommend that the outcomes to continued use of foot drop electrical stimulators are carefully considered against the barriers.
35609240.summary: Seven qualitative studies found that people with MS or stroke valued better walking and confidence from foot drop stimulators, but disliked their looks, difficulty of use, reliability, and cost.

28687973.conclusion_quote: Based on the investigated Iranian studies, there is strong evidence confirming the effect of exercise therapy on QOL of patients with MS; there, however, exists a need for more studies to identify and establish effective exercise programs due to the heterogeneity of the studies conducted in this area.
28687973.summary: A review of Iranian trials found that exercise improved quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis, both physically and mentally, though more studies are needed.

32062028.conclusion_quote: All the treatments considered appeared to produce both qualitative and quantitative changes in the immune cell populations of patients with MS that resulted in a more anti-inflammatory immune profile.
32062028.summary: This review of 44 studies found that treatments such as stem cell transplant, alemtuzumab and cladribine shift immune cells toward a calmer, less inflammatory state in MS.

35856061.conclusion_quote: Then, our study brought together current data regarding psychiatric disorders in MS patients, which are comorbidities that affect the quality of life of these patients.
35856061.summary: Researchers pooled 12 studies and found depression and anxiety are common in people with MS, with anxiety especially frequent, and rates differ by MS type and disability.

34924905.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis showed that patients with MS had significantly higher levels of circulatory As and Cd compared to the controls.
34924905.summary: People with MS had higher blood levels of arsenic and cadmium than healthy controls, while mercury showed no clear difference.

33191096.conclusion_quote: Recently, antibodies against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG) have emerged as a new ADS biomarker, which clearly allow the identification of monophasic and relapsing ADS forms different from MS predominantly in children.
33191096.summary: Antibodies against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein help doctors tell apart children's demyelinating disorders from MS, though testing methods and disease cause are still debated.

33183945.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, main domains of importance in determining clinical outcome in paediatric MOGAD are visual, motor, autonomic and cognitive function.
33183945.summary: This consensus review finds that in children with MOG antibody disorders, the type of illness mostly predicts outcome, with transverse myelitis carrying the highest risk of lasting disability.

29582713.conclusion_quote: We recommended botulinum toxin as the optimal intervention for multiple sclerosis-related spasticity.
29582713.summary: Comparing many spasticity treatments in MS, botulinum toxin looked best overall, with cannabinoids and nerve stimulation also showing promise, though cannabinoid safety needs more checking.

39051525.conclusion_quote: We propose the concept of smouldering-associated-worsening (SAW), encompassing physical and cognitive symptoms, resulting from smouldering pathological processes, which remain unmet therapeutic targets.
39051525.summary: Researchers propose the term smouldering associated worsening for slow decline in MS that continues even when treatments stop relapses, and suggest ways to track it.

27457485.conclusion_quote: The present systematic review and meta-analysis suggest that mtDNA T4216C variation is a contributory factor in susceptibility to MS.
27457485.summary: Pooling previous studies, this review found that a mitochondrial DNA variant called T4216C is linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

33492630.conclusion_quote: Evidence in rodent models of EAE strongly supports CBD as effective, while clinical evidence is still limited and usually negative, due to paucity of studies and possibly to the use of suboptimal dosing regimens.
33492630.summary: Cannabidiol reduced inflammation and disease in mouse models of MS, but clinical studies in people with MS were few and mostly showed no benefit.

34979638.conclusion_quote: Contrast-enhanced MRI performed on a high strength scanner using MS protocol with structured protocol for evaluation along, with a better collaboration between radiologists and clinicians may help in minimizing errors in diagnosis of multiple sclerosis.
34979638.summary: A review of published studies found that MRI scans using a standard MS protocol, read alongside clinical findings, help doctors tell MS apart from similar conditions.

35958357.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review show that pregnancy history is a protective factor for MS development, whereas OCP use has no significant effect.
35958357.summary: Pooling four studies, this review found that having been pregnant lowers the chance of developing multiple sclerosis, while taking birth control pills did not clearly change the risk.

35785403.summary: This notice corrects an earlier review of side effects of rituximab in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, a rare condition affecting the optic nerves and spinal cord.

29246594.conclusion_quote: The RNFL loss was more severe in NMO than in MS, and the intereye RNFL difference between eyes with or without optic neuritis may be useful in differentiating NMO from MS.
29246594.summary: Researchers combined 24 studies and found that retinal nerve layer thinning is worse in NMO than MS, and may help tell the two diseases apart.

33176999.conclusion_quote: Four first-line therapies consisting of rituximab (RTX), azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil or monthly IVIG have been identified by the consensus group.
33176999.summary: Expert consensus for children with MOG antibody disease recommends steroids for attacks, and rituximab, azathioprine, mycophenolate or monthly IVIG to prevent further relapses.

36705346.conclusion_quote: The results of this study showed that the treatment of NMOSD patients with AZA and TCZ are associated with decreased number of relapses and disability improvement as well.
36705346.summary: Researchers pooled 27 studies and found that both azathioprine and tocilizumab reduced relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica, with tocilizumab reducing relapses more strongly.

28054170.conclusion_quote: Compared to MS patients without seizures, patients with epilepsy have an earlier MS onset and a higher EDSS score after similar disease duration.
28054170.summary: People with MS who have seizures tend to have their MS start earlier and more disability, while sex and MS type do not predict seizures.

29542102.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis showed smoking increased EDSS, insignificant findings were possibly due to the small number of studies, significant differences in methodologies, and variations in reporting of disability outcomes.
29542102.summary: A review of eleven studies found that smoking was linked to slightly higher disability scores in MS, but it did not clearly raise the risk of reaching key disability milestones.

31276913.conclusion_quote: Safety outcomes are poorly reported in primary studies of DMTs in RRMS, precluding the conduction of robust meta-analyses.
31276913.summary: Researchers reviewed 47 studies of multiple sclerosis drugs and found side effects are rarely reported well, so their safety remains hard to judge.

29486362.conclusion_quote: The large number of variables and lack of standardisation of reporting makes data synthesis challenging, however, people with MS display considerable deficits in postural control compared to healthy controls regardless of task condition or complexity.
29486362.summary: People with MS have considerable balance and postural control problems compared with healthy people, regardless of how difficult the standing task is.

35822180.conclusion_quote: Psychoeducational and medical interventions are the commonest effective interventions.
35822180.summary: Reviewers pooled 41 studies and found that psychoeducation and medical treatments most often improved sexual function or dysfunction in people with multiple sclerosis.

31678858.conclusion_quote: The reduced mobility may prevent pwMS participating in society.
31678858.summary: Review of 57 studies finds people with MS often struggle with driving, public transport and using wheelchairs or scooters, especially with cognitive problems or greater disability.

33876986.conclusion_quote: Treatment recommendations for balance and combined exercise are tentative as the certainty of the evidence was moderate.
33876986.summary: Exercise and cognitive behavioural therapy both reduced multiple sclerosis fatigue, with balance exercise showing the largest benefit, though recommendations for exercise remain tentative.

33624893.conclusion_quote: Findings suggested that daily recommended doses of Panax ginseng and Ginkgo biloba should not be exceeded, and herbal preparations differing from standardized products should be avoided, especially when combined with anticoagulants or substrates of certain cytochrome P450 isoforms.
33624893.summary: Review of 129 studies found that some herbs like ginseng and ginkgo can interact with MS drugs, so doses should be limited and risky combinations watched.

32452318.conclusion_quote: As a result, it is not possible to determine which disease- modifying therapy is really cost-effective in the context of relapsingremitting multiple sclerosis.
32452318.summary: Reviewers found nine economic studies of MS drugs with conflicting results, so it remains unclear which relapsing MS treatment gives the best value for money.

31669929.conclusion_quote: Overall, this meta-analysis indicated that taking vitamin D in people with MS had no significant effect on EDSS.
31669929.summary: Vitamin D supplements did not change disability scores in people with multiple sclerosis, according to a pooled analysis of six randomized trials.

37479377.conclusion_quote: Considering these data, an update to the recommended diagnostic approaches to common clinical presentations and key clinical and paraclinical red flags is warranted to inform the contemporary clinical evaluation of patients with suspected multiple sclerosis.
37479377.summary: Experts updated guidance on how doctors tell multiple sclerosis apart from similar conditions, using newer knowledge about warning signs, brain scans and lab tests.

32469447.conclusion_quote: The provision of home-based palliative care (either general or specialist) is recommended with weak strength for patients with severe, progressive MS.
32469447.summary: European experts issued guidance on palliative care for people with severe progressive MS, recommending care delivered at home, though evidence is limited in several areas.

34624548.conclusion_quote: Sensorimotor training seems the most effective exercise to improve HRQoL and aerobic and mind-body exercises to improve physical and mental HRQoL, respectively.
34624548.summary: Exercise improves quality of life in people with MS, sensorimotor training ranked best overall, aerobic exercise best for physical health, and mind and body exercises best for mental health.

29665426.conclusion_quote: This study strongly supports the absence of association between HPV vaccines and central demyelination.
29665426.summary: Pooled data from 11 observational studies found no link between HPV vaccination and central nervous system demyelination, including multiple sclerosis.

33733976.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that SPMS is associated with higher costs and more substantial HRQoL decrements than RRMS.
33733976.summary: Researchers reviewed 25 studies and found that people with secondary progressive MS have higher costs and lower quality of life than people with the relapsing form of MS, mainly due to fatigue and depression.

32048535.conclusion_quote: Sexual therapy, administration of OnabotulinumtoxinA, pelvic floor muscles exercises alone or combined with electrostimulation and the use of clitoral devices could be the most recommended interventions to improve the sexuality in women with multiple sclerosis.
32048535.summary: A review of 12 trials found that sexual therapy, botulinum toxin injections, pelvic floor exercises and clitoral devices may help sexual problems in women with MS.

31196913.conclusion_quote: MBIs are effective at improving mental well-being in PwMS.
31196913.summary: Mindfulness programmes improved mental wellbeing in people with MS, with a smaller but still positive benefit when compared with other active treatments.

30115676.conclusion_quote: Conventional MR imaging findings may help differentiate tumefactive demyelinating lesions from primary brain tumor, though further study is needed to determine the added value of advanced MR imaging.
30115676.summary: A review of 19 studies found that MRI scans can help doctors tell large myelin-damage lesions apart from brain tumors, correctly identifying most cases.

41477121.summary: This is a correction notice for a review of skin autoimmune disorders that can develop in people with MS taking biological immunotherapy drugs.

35060096.conclusion_quote: Evidence suggested that CAM therapies in patients with MS have the potential to target and enhancement numerous elements outlined in the ICF model.
35060096.summary: A review of 31 studies found complementary therapies like mindfulness, yoga and reflexology may help with MS symptoms such as fatigue, depression, balance and walking, though stronger trials are needed.

29954625.conclusion_quote: Although this meta-analysis study showed a lower seroprevalence of T. gondii in the MS patients as compared with that in the control group, no significant association was found between toxoplasmosis and MS disease.
29954625.summary: This review of five studies found no significant link between Toxoplasma gondii infection and multiple sclerosis, though infection was slightly less common in MS patients.

33310876.conclusion_quote: NMOSD is a rare disease worldwide.
33310876.summary: After reviewing 33 studies, researchers found NMOSD is rare worldwide, with rates varying by region and ethnicity and peaking in middle aged adults, mostly women.

32020080.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the study supported that AHSCT showed long-term effect on MS and NMOSD patients with a high safety.
32020080.summary: Stem cell transplantation kept most MS and NMOSD patients free from progression for a long time, with very few treatment-related deaths.

39105046.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of the panel underline the multidimensional role of CNPs in the management of MS at all stages.
39105046.summary: An expert panel of European nurse practitioners concluded they play many roles in MS care, from helping with early diagnosis to supporting treatment decisions and patient monitoring.

28789787.conclusion_quote: There is a significant relationship between perceived fatigue and fatigability in MS, such that people reporting elevated fatigue also are highly fatigable.
28789787.summary: People with MS who feel more fatigued also tend to show greater drops in physical performance over time, but the link is moderate, so both should be measured separately.

33845351.conclusion_quote: Overall, home-based active video games were found safe and effective improving static and dynamic balance in pwMS.
33845351.summary: Nine studies found that playing active video games at home was safe and improved balance in people with multiple sclerosis, though gait results were mixed.

33870797.conclusion_quote: While significant strides have been made to develop regenerative treatments for MS, the current evidence illustrates a skewed representation of the types of strategies that advance to clinical trials.
33870797.summary: A review of 221 studies found most experimental MS repair and nerve protection treatments were tested only in animals, with few reaching human trials.

27909800.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis indicates that NMO patients aged 24-60 years have significantly worse cognitive performance than demographically matched healthy subjects.
27909800.summary: Patients with neuromyelitis optica performed worse on thinking tests than healthy people of similar age and background, performing about as poorly as MS patients.

29627016.conclusion_quote: Across heterogeneous study designs and patient populations found in real-world studies, the consensus 1-year fingolimod persistence rate exceeded 80%, consistent with persistence rates identified in the recently-completed trial, PREFERMS.
29627016.summary: Pooled data from many studies show about 82 percent of people with relapsing MS stayed on fingolimod after one year, though results varied.

33158737.conclusion_quote: In contrast to the imaging characteristics of children with MS, children with MOGAD present with diverse imaging patterns which correlate with the main demyelinating phenotypes as well as age at presentation.
33158737.summary: Brain and spinal cord scans help tell apart MOG antibody disease from other inflammatory disorders in children, with imaging patterns varying by age and symptom type.

32452269.conclusion_quote: Such a paucity of evidence supporting exercise-induced neuroplasticity in MS is likely a product of a very small number of papers that do not sufficiently examine hypothesized mechanisms of action.
32452269.summary: Exercise is linked to better function in people with MS, but evidence that it reshapes the brain to explain these gains is mixed across just 10 studies.

32389548.conclusion_quote: Most studies revealed that tDCS can reduce the adverse effects of MS-related fatigue in particular cognitive type.
32389548.summary: Reviewing eight trials, most found that brain stimulation with tDCS reduced multiple sclerosis fatigue, but differing methods and brief monitoring make firm conclusions difficult.

34827498.conclusion_quote: The present study reveals that exercise can elicit improvements in chronic levels of BDNF in pwMS, whereas the effects of exercise on chronic levels of other neurotrophic factors and on acute levels of neurotrophic factors in general, along with a potential translational link (i.e., with exercise-induced improvements in neurotropic factors being associated with or even mediating neuroprotection), are sparse and inconclusive.
34827498.summary: Exercise raised levels of a brain-supporting protein called BDNF in people with MS, while evidence for other factors and for real brain protection remains weak.

37781253.conclusion_quote: Thirteen assessment and treatment recommendations were produced regarding pain in children with MS.
37781253.summary: Experts in MS care developed 13 recommendations for assessing and treating pain in children with multiple sclerosis, to be tested in clinics later.

33616198.conclusion_quote: MI and its combination with relaxation exercises have been shown to be effective in the treatment of fatigue, gait, balance, depression and QoL in patients with MS.
33616198.summary: A review of randomized trials found that motor imagery, especially combined with relaxation, may help fatigue, walking, balance, mood and quality of life in MS.

38011360.conclusion_quote: This systematic review highlights the ambiguity of evidence on safety and efficacy of alternate dosing of fingolimod, encouraging further research on the subject.
38011360.summary: Four observational studies found the evidence on taking fingolimod every other day instead of daily is unclear, with possible safety benefits but a risk of relapse.

30240176.conclusion_quote: NF155 is a specific protein marker for CIDP, but its diagnostic value has been questioned due to low sensitivity.
30240176.summary: Ten studies found the NF155 antibody test rarely gives false positives for CIDP, a nerve disease, but misses many cases, and may help identify patient subgroups.

37920108.conclusion_quote: This article provides a synopsis of this data, as well as practical information for optimizing patient care.
37920108.summary: This guide explains how to give natalizumab safely to people with relapsing MS, covering long-term effects, infection risk, pregnancy, vaccines, and infusion monitoring.

31703029.conclusion_quote: We conclude that while interventions such as exercise may impact QOL, they do not have a significant influence on inflammation associated with MS.
31703029.summary: Nine studies found that exercise did not meaningfully lower inflammation in people with MS, although it may improve function and quality of life.

37324408.conclusion_quote: Reported results consistently indicate that shared decision-making is important in effective MS symptomatic care.
37324408.summary: This review of 15 studies found that involving people with MS in choosing how to manage physical symptoms appears important, and no study showed it caused harm.

37315470.conclusion_quote: Using meta-analysis, we demonstrated that MS patients exhibited enhanced pancreatic and ovarian cancer risk, and diminished breast and brain cancer risk.
37315470.summary: Combining 18 studies, the authors found MS patients had different cancer risks depending on type, with genetic analysis suggesting higher lung cancer risk and lower breast cancer risk.

35465914.conclusion_quote: Further well-designed, randomised, controlled clinical trials involving a greater number of patients are warranted to attain a higher level of evidence in order to recommend the appropriate use of TMS in MS patients across the board.
35465914.summary: This review found TMS brain stimulation may improve spasticity, fatigue, bladder problems, hand skill, walking and working memory in MS, but stronger trials are needed.

34284811.conclusion_quote: The results from this systematic review and meta-analysis will inform and guide healthcare practitioners, researchers, and policymakers on the safety of exercise training in persons with multiple sclerosis.
34284811.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of exercise trials in people with multiple sclerosis, checking how often exercise causes relapses or serious side effects.

28254635.conclusion_quote: Future PA interventions should continue to focus on the psychosocial constructs of self-efficacy and goal-setting.
28254635.summary: A review of 26 studies found that confidence in one's abilities and setting goals are linked to being more physically active in people with MS.

29670565.conclusion_quote: This study found that the use of psychological interventions for MS-related fatigue management reduced fatigue in PwMS.
29670565.summary: Psychological treatments such as cognitive behavioral therapy, relaxation and mindfulness reduced tiredness in people with MS, though the long term effects still need more study.

36969978.conclusion_quote: The studies pointed towards an increased risk of preterm birth and small for gestational age among women with MS.
36969978.summary: A review of 22 studies found women with multiple sclerosis face higher risks of preterm birth and small babies, while treatment effects in pregnancy remain unclear.

35901036.conclusion_quote: This study will provide reliable evidence for the effect of TTNS in female patients with OAB and MS.
35901036.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of trials testing whether mild electrical stimulation near the ankle helps women with MS and overactive bladder.

39488012.conclusion_quote: An e-Delphi process has established lifestyle recommendations and identified behaviour change strategies to promote brain health-focussed care for MS.
39488012.summary: Experts from around the world agreed on lifestyle tips and ways to help people with MS change their habits to protect brain health.

28058780.conclusion_quote: Preliminary data imply that cannabinoids might be an effective and safe treatment option for NLUTD in patients with MS; however, the evidence base is poor and more high-quality, well-designed and adequately powered and sampled studies are urgently needed to reach definitive conclusions.
28058780.summary: Cannabinoid medicines reduced bladder leakage episodes in people with multiple sclerosis across three studies, with mostly mild side effects, though the evidence is still limited.

28434474.conclusion_quote: The available evidence from present study supported but limited to recommend the routine use of CHM adjuvant therapy for MS because of the poor methodological quality and clinical heterogeneity.
28434474.summary: Adding Chinese herbal medicine to standard treatment for MS flare ups appeared to improve disability scores and relapse measures, but the studies were low quality, so firm recommendations are not possible.

34950240.conclusion_quote: RTX is mostly safer than other immunosuppressants in NMOSD: the incidence of RTX-associated AEs was not high, and when present, the AEs were usually mild or moderate and could be well controlled.
34950240.summary: A review of 36 studies with 1,542 patients found rituximab causes few side effects in neuromyelitis optica, though evidence comparing it with other drugs is weak.

29942278.conclusion_quote: This present review bridges the gaps in literature by suggesting application of rhythmic auditory cueing in conventional rehabilitation approaches to enhance gait performance in the multiple sclerosis community.
29942278.summary: Rhythmic sound cues helped people with multiple sclerosis walk faster and take longer steps, according to a combined analysis of five studies.

38873801.conclusion_quote: Strategies are needed to optimize criteria adoption during routine clinical care such that GBS and CIDP diagnosis can be achieved with greater speed and accuracy.
38873801.summary: This review explains new guidelines for diagnosing two nerve conditions, Guillain Barré syndrome and CIDP, and notes that doctors rarely use them.

29460636.conclusion_quote: Pooled findings from 25 studies confirmed the main role of a relapsing-remitting disease course and higher education to employment.
29460636.summary: This review of 25 studies found that people with multiple sclerosis who keep jobs more often have a relapsing remitting disease course and higher education.

37554254.conclusion_quote: Although a unique modality, there is not enough evidence to support the employment of SCS over current medical standard of care.
37554254.summary: A review of published studies found too little evidence to show that spinal cord stimulation reliably reduces spasticity in people with MS compared with standard care.

32202173.conclusion_quote: Thus, there is evidence that anxiety, depression, migraine and lower cognitive performance form part of the MS prodrome.
32202173.summary: This review of 29 studies found that anxiety, depression, migraine and poor thinking performance were more common before MS onset than in people without MS.

34320057.conclusion_quote: MBT is a safe and effective approach for clinical rehabilitation of MS patients that leads to positive results regarding both motor and non-motor functions.
34320057.summary: Ten clinical trials found that music therapy, including rhythm, instruments and dance, improved walking, balance, fatigue and mood in people with MS.

28207850.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis shows an association between expression of HERVs, and in particular the HERV-W family, and MS.
28207850.summary: Researchers reviewed many studies and found that ancient viral DNA in the human genome, especially one family, is linked to multiple sclerosis.

38237804.conclusion_quote: The most significant recommendations are that immunomodulatory DMT be started in patients with radiologically isolated syndrome with persistent radiological activity, that patient perspectives be considered, and that the term "lines of therapy" no longer be used in the classification of DMTs (> 90% consensus).
38237804.summary: This Spanish consensus updates how doctors treat multiple sclerosis, recommending early use of strong drugs for some patients and considering patients' own views.

34950154.conclusion_quote: S1PRM use increased the risk of cardiovascular AEs by 1.21 times in patients with MS, and increased risks for bradyarrhythmia and hypertension were at 2.92- and 2.00-fold, respectively.
34950154.summary: Pooling 17 trials, this review found that multiple sclerosis drugs acting on S1P receptors raised the risk of heart side effects, mainly slow heartbeat and high blood pressure.

26189826.conclusion_quote: This review revealed the great economic burden of multiple sclerosis on society.
26189826.summary: This review of studies found that multiple sclerosis causes large indirect costs from lost work and reduced productivity, higher in Europe and for more disabled patients.

28088382.conclusion_quote: FES used for foot drop has a positive initial and ongoing effect on gait speed in short walking tests.
28088382.summary: Electrical stimulation for foot drop modestly improved walking speed over short distances in people with MS, but not over longer walks.

30240593.conclusion_quote: We found some evidence that exercise compared with passive control alleviates pain in this population, but there were limitations in reporting and study quality with high risk of bias of individual studies and heterogeneity between studies.
30240593.summary: Exercise may reduce pain in people with MS compared with no active treatment, but evidence is weak because the included studies had high risk of bias.

32469284.conclusion_quote: The provision of home-based palliative care (either general or specialist) is recommended with weak strength for patients with severe, progressive MS.
32469284.summary: A European expert guideline recommends palliative care at home for people with severe progressive MS, but evidence for many of their needs remains limited.

30025277.conclusion_quote: The available evidence strongly suggests that RLS risk is higher among MS patients than healthy controls.
30025277.summary: Pooled studies found about one in four people with multiple sclerosis have restless legs syndrome, far more often than healthy people.

31765492.conclusion_quote: SD in women with MS is multidimensional, comparable in prevalence with other neurological disorders and increases with advancing disease.
31765492.summary: This review of 61 studies found sexual problems are common in women with MS and worsen as the disease advances, but few good treatment trials exist.

27401492.conclusion_quote: Greater understanding of the factors associated with enrolment and attrition rates would help in planning and developing a more appealing self-management intervention that patients can easily accept and incorporate into their everyday lives.
27401492.summary: Across 48 studies, about half of people asked joined MS self management programmes, and about 15 to 17 percent dropped out, mostly for medical reasons.

35791675.conclusion_quote: Our MR study supported that leukocyte telomere length and MS have a positive causal relationship.
35791675.summary: A genetic analysis found that people with longer leukocyte telomeres, the protective caps on chromosomes in white blood cells, had higher odds of developing multiple sclerosis.

38350062.conclusion_quote: Individuals with comorbidities are included in clinical trials, although they may still be underrepresented compared with the general MS population.
38350062.summary: Almost half of people in MS drug trials had at least one other health condition, such as depression or high blood pressure, though they may be underrepresented.

34084311.conclusion_quote: The result of this systematic review shows that the pooled prevalence of seizure and epilepsy among MS patients is 2% and 3%, respectively.
34084311.summary: Researchers pooled 39 studies and found that about 2 in 100 people with multiple sclerosis have seizures, and about 3 in 100 have epilepsy.

37420270.conclusion_quote: Well-defined national consensus protocols may facilitate dialogue between policymakers and healthcare professionals and thus contribute to better patient care in the long run.
37420270.summary: Hungarian neuroimmunology experts agreed on eight recommendations for treating relapsing MS, covering starting, switching, monitoring, stopping, and special situations like pregnancy.

33504299.conclusion_quote: However, there are no effective treatments for this disease and the immunomodulatory therapies that currently exist have proven limited success since they only delay the progress of the disease.
33504299.summary: This review looks at current MS drugs that calm the immune system and newer drugs being tested to repair damaged myelin, the protective coating on nerves.

32872076.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis will provide a high-quality synthesis from existing evidence for the performance of empathy and ToM in MS.
32872076.summary: This planned review will pool existing studies to measure how well people with multiple sclerosis understand and share others' feelings, compared with healthy people.

30384202.conclusion_quote: There is still not sufficient evidence to state whether gluten plays a role in MS, but limitations of current evidence have been identified and directions of future research have been suggested.
30384202.summary: This review of 50 studies found not enough evidence to show whether gluten affects multiple sclerosis, though some studies suggested that a diet without gluten may help.

33385827.summary: Plasma exchange, a treatment that filters the blood, reduced disability in people with severe NMOSD attacks, with best results when started 8 to 23 days after onset.

27237767.conclusion_quote: We demonstrate a significant lower prevalence of Helicobacter pylori infection in patients with multiple sclerosis.
27237767.summary: A review of six studies found people with multiple sclerosis were less likely to have Helicobacter pylori stomach infection, which may protect against developing the disease.

37258412.conclusion_quote: These international statements will be valuable for informing individualized therapeutic decision-making and could form the basis for standardized practice guidelines.
37258412.summary: An international panel of 24 experts agreed on 25 statements guiding which of three newer antibody treatments to use for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder.

27772557.conclusion_quote: This review found that the use of CBT for the treatment of fatigue in patients with MS has a moderately positive short-term effect.
27772557.summary: Pooling four randomized trials, this review found cognitive behavioral therapy modestly reduced fatigue in people with MS in the short term, but the benefit faded after treatment ended.

35802297.conclusion_quote: Significant cognitive differences are revealed for all categories with the strongest effect observed for overall IQ.
35802297.summary: Children who developed MS before age 18 scored lower than peers on cognitive tests, most strongly on overall IQ, with slower thinking speed and milder language difficulties.

27668357.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis provides evidence that rituximab therapy reduces the frequency of NMOSD relapses and neurological disability in patients with NMOSDs.
27668357.summary: Pooled data from 46 studies suggest rituximab reduces relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica, though side effects such as infections mean caution is needed.

30285675.conclusion_quote: Meta-analyses confirmed that IFN-β and GA reduce ARR and generally delay progression as defined in these trials, though there was no clear 'winner' across outcomes.
30285675.summary: Interferon beta and glatiramer acetate reduce relapses compared with placebo and may slow disability worsening, but no treatment clearly outperforms the others.

31610402.conclusion_quote: Family members of those with MS may be at greater risk of developing psoriasis.
31610402.summary: Relatives of people with MS appear more likely to develop psoriasis, a skin condition, than relatives of people without MS, based on five studies.

32348222.conclusion_quote: The anti-Il-6 agents tocilizumab and satralizumab show promising results in active NMOSD.
32348222.summary: Review of studies on two drugs, tocilizumab and satralizumab, found they may reduce relapses and pain in neuromyelitis optica, with mild side effects.

35742424.conclusion_quote: Based on the network meta-analysis, we suggest that although each type of exercise is useful, yoga, virtual reality training, and aerobic training are more effective in improving the balance function of people with MS; aquatic exercise, virtual reality training, and aerobic training are more effective in improving the functional walking ability of people with MS.
35742424.summary: Researchers combined 31 trials and found that yoga, virtual reality and aerobic exercise help balance, while water exercise, virtual reality and aerobic exercise help walking in people with MS.

31637963.conclusion_quote: We identified several CNADs that are valid to screen for MS-related cognitive impairment, or to supplement full, conventional neuropsychological assessment.
31637963.summary: This review found several computer tests that reliably screen for thinking problems in people with MS, though whether a technician is needed remains unclear.

35998365.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis provides evidence that the TNFA (-308 G/A, - 238 G/A, and - 376 G/A) and TNFB +252A/G polymorphisms were not risk factors for the occurrence of MS.
35998365.summary: Pooled studies found that common variants in the TNF genes do not raise the risk of multiple sclerosis, while one IFNG variant showed only a weak link.

25795002.conclusion_quote: The pleiotropic effects and effects in the murine model of MS could not be converted to a proven effect in relapsing MS and hence statin therapy either as a monotherapy or in combination with IFNβ treatment for RRMS, and statin monotherapy for CIS cannot at present be recommended.
25795002.summary: Statins did not clearly help people with relapsing MS when added to interferon or used alone, though they may slow progression in secondary progressive MS.

32750612.conclusion_quote: This review presents evidence from a small number of studies that suggests disability and cognition are negatively associated with CMI in people with MS, indicating that greater disability and cognitive dysfunction may be associated with lower dual-task performance.
32750612.summary: A review of 13 studies found that greater disability and poorer thinking skills are linked to worse ability to walk or balance while doing a second mental task in MS.

31765999.conclusion_quote: MSCs transplantation proved to be a safe and tolerable therapy.
31765999.summary: Review of 10 small studies suggests stem cell transplants in MS are generally safe and tolerable, but whether they truly help patients remains unproven and needs larger controlled trials.

32865151.conclusion_quote: The prevalence of suicidal ideation in multiple sclerosis patients was estimated as 13% (CI 95% = 0.09-0.17).
32865151.summary: A pooled analysis of eight studies found that about 13% of people with multiple sclerosis have thoughts of suicide, with higher rates in developed countries.

31059848.conclusion_quote: An altered RNA processing of genes mediating immune signaling pathways has been repeatedly implicated in MS.
31059848.summary: This review of 36 studies found that abnormal RNA splicing, which shapes how genes make proteins, has repeatedly been linked to immune genes in MS.

33435410.conclusion_quote: Although the evidence is limited, rehabilitation using MI with the application of musical and verbal guides (compared to non-intervention or other interventions), can produce benefits on gait, fatigue and QOL in pwMS with a low score in the Expanded Disability Status Scale.
33435410.summary: Five studies suggest that imagining movements, with music or spoken guidance, may modestly improve walking, fatigue and quality of life in people with MS, though evidence is limited.

33578206.conclusion_quote: This observation reinforces the recommendation of not stopping current DMTs.
33578206.summary: Reviewing 84 studies, this paper found no clear link between most disease-modifying MS drugs and worse COVID-19 outcomes, though anti-CD20 drugs remain debated.

34814882.conclusion_quote: Interleukin-6-receptor inhibitors therapy showed a promising result with good efficacy and acceptable adverse events profile for treatment of NMOSD.
34814882.summary: Drugs that block an immune signal called IL 6 reduced relapses in neuromyelitis optica patients, and their side effects were judged acceptable across nine studies.

25739555.conclusion_quote: Aerobic training can improve aerobic capacity in PwMS to a degree that is associated with secondary health benefits.
25739555.summary: Researchers pooled 40 studies and found people with MS have lower fitness than healthy people, and aerobic exercise training can measurably raise their fitness.

31752913.conclusion_quote: This systematic review indicated that the probiotics could improve immune and inflammatory parameters, the cytokines and cells in MS disease.
31752913.summary: A review of seven studies suggests probiotics may help calm immune and inflammatory activity in multiple sclerosis, but more research is needed.

25647290.conclusion_quote: The findings confirm that more than one-third of the multiple sclerosis patients are suffering from swallowing difficulties.
25647290.summary: Pooling 15 studies, this review found that about 36 percent of people with MS have swallowing difficulties when screened with simple tests, and higher rates when measured objectively.

28071581.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis indicates that AQP4-Ab serostatus has the positive with poor visual outcome in NMO.
28071581.summary: Neuromyelitis optica patients who test positive for the AQP4 antibody were about three times more likely to have vision problems, according to pooled studies.

28618110.conclusion_quote: Preliminary data suggest that intravesical vanilloids might be effective for treating NLUTD in patients with MS.
28618110.summary: Pooled trials suggest capsaicin placed in the bladder reduces leaks and urination frequency in people with MS, but side effects are common and evidence is low quality.

32719975.conclusion_quote: The prevalence of neurologic, cardiovascular, metabolic, and autoimmune comorbidities was elevated in PwMS in general, and furthermore, this adversely affected a broad range of outcomes.
32719975.summary: This review found that people with MS more often have other health conditions like heart disease, metabolic and autoimmune disorders, which worsen many outcomes.

27756056.conclusion_quote: Therefore, using textured or other types of stimulating insoles for the treatment of balance and gait impairments in patients with multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease seem to have no effect.
27756056.summary: Special insoles with textured or stimulating surfaces did not improve walking or balance in people with multiple sclerosis or Parkinson's disease, based on six studies.

32623436.conclusion_quote: The prevalence of anti-JCV antibody seropositivity is variable among MS patients in different countries, and the pooled estimate showed that this is 60% overall.
32623436.summary: A pooled analysis of eight studies found that about 60 percent of people with multiple sclerosis carry antibodies to the JC virus, though rates differ between countries.

35843141.conclusion_quote: Investigations in our patients did not reveal robust evidence of prior subclinical attacks so far.
35843141.summary: Authors reply to criticism of their vaccine linked neuromyelitis optica report, noting more such cases and finding no clear sign of earlier hidden attacks.

31816449.conclusion_quote: In PwMS, muscle strength of particularly the weakest limb explains 20% to 30% of the variance across a number of lower-limb functional capacity tests.
31816449.summary: Weakness in the weaker leg explains about 20 to 30 percent of differences in walking and other leg function tests in people with MS.

34720761.conclusion_quote: Sexual function, sexual satisfaction, and emotional well-being can all be effectively addressed with various PT interventions.
34720761.summary: Physical therapy improved sexual function, satisfaction and emotional wellbeing in people with MS, with pelvic floor exercises and mindfulness among the most effective approaches.

33328949.conclusion_quote: This paper presents a systematic review of the literature in automated multiple sclerosis lesion segmentation based on deep learning.
33328949.summary: This review summarises deep learning methods that automatically outline multiple sclerosis lesions on brain MRI scans, comparing how accurately they perform and their strengths and weaknesses.

37206644.conclusion_quote: The meta-analysis of observational and MR based on genetic variants does not support the correlation between MS and breast cancer.
37206644.summary: Combining past studies and genetic analyses, this research found no clear link between multiple sclerosis and breast cancer risk.

35512501.conclusion_quote: The agreed statements provide up-to-date guidance on DMT sequencing for optimal patient management.
35512501.summary: Twenty-five experts agreed on 99 of 106 statements giving practical guidance on when and how to switch disease modifying treatments in relapsing multiple sclerosis.

35204361.conclusion_quote: This review and meta-analysis confirmed that lesion counts and volumes could be associated with disability and might offer additional valid guidance in treatment decision making.
35204361.summary: Researchers pooled studies finding that people with more brain lesions on early MRI scans were more likely to develop greater disability in multiple sclerosis over the long term.

29454521.conclusion_quote: No evidence of an association between hepatitis B vaccination and central demyelination was found.
29454521.summary: This review of 13 studies found no link between hepatitis B vaccination and multiple sclerosis or other central nervous system demyelination.

29027112.conclusion_quote: Herein, we have identified several noteworthy biomarkers of multiple sclerosis susceptibility.
29027112.summary: Researchers reviewed 44 earlier studies of gene variants in multiple sclerosis and found about a fifth of links were strong enough to be considered likely true.

31778926.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the scientific impact of MS/ NMOSD in the SEA was considered low in quantity and quality.
31778926.summary: This review of published research found that Southeast Asian studies on MS and NMOSD were few in number and generally low in quality and impact.

27063624.conclusion_quote: Treatment with immunomodulators seems to reduce long-term probability of disability progression.
27063624.summary: Pooling 14 studies of over 13,000 people with relapsing MS, interferon beta or glatiramer acetate were linked to a lower chance of long term disability worsening.

31344607.conclusion_quote: This review illustrates the gap in knowledge of APA alterations in MS patients.
31344607.summary: Researchers reviewed eight studies and found that people with multiple sclerosis start walking differently, with weaker and slower early balance movements and shorter first steps.

35462584.conclusion_quote: From the review of the literature, we can infer that VZV seems to trigger LETM attacks and not the disease itself.
35462584.summary: A review of published cases found that shingles or chickenpox may trigger spinal cord and optic nerve inflammation in neuromyelitis optica, but not the disease itself.

34653376.conclusion_quote: Depending on population and type of exercise, physical activity was associated with improvements in walking, function, balance, depression, sleep, ADL, spasticity, female sexual function, and aerobic capacity.
34653376.summary: Reviewing 168 studies, this paper found that physical activity can improve walking, balance, sleep and daily activities in people with MS, cerebral palsy or spinal cord injury, with few harms reported.

32872066.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis will provide a high-quality synthesis from existing evidence for social cognition performance in MS and its subtypes.
32872066.summary: This is a plan for a future review that will pool studies on how well people with multiple sclerosis recognise emotions and understand others' thoughts, across MS subtypes.

33748960.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, socioeconomic data can serve as robust outcome measures to study various aspects of MS reflecting the broader consequences of the disease.
33748960.summary: A review of 27 studies found people with MS have lower employment and earnings, more sick leave and benefit use, but similar education levels to others.

30246874.conclusion_quote: To date, very low-quality evidence suggests no benefit of vitamin D for patient-important outcomes among people with MS.
30246874.summary: Vitamin D supplements did not reduce relapses, disability, or MRI lesion activity in people with MS, and appeared safe, though evidence quality is very low.

28522663.conclusion_quote: Noncontrast MR imaging techniques, such as DTI-based FA, can assess MS lesion acuity without gadolinium.
28522663.summary: Researchers combined 37 studies and found that a noncontrast MRI measure called fractional anisotropy can tell active MS lesions from inactive ones without gadolinium contrast dye.

32453803.conclusion_quote: Although a number of prediction models for RRMS have been reported, most are at high risk of bias and lack external validation and impact analysis, restricting their application to routine clinical practice.
32453803.summary: Researchers reviewed 30 studies of tools that predict how relapsing MS will progress. Most tools were poorly designed and untested, so they are not yet ready for everyday clinical use.

30231128.conclusion_quote: We herein propose practical recommendations for the treatment of MS, with the main focus on the choice and management of DMTs, as well as present a review of the scientific rationale supporting therapeutic strategies in MS.
30231128.summary: Brazilian MS and neurology experts wrote practical guidance on choosing and managing disease modifying drugs for multiple sclerosis, based on current evidence and practice.

30690007.conclusion_quote: This systematic review identified mostly insufficient conclusions for predicting driving performance in driving simulator studies, and possible conclusions for predicting fitness to drive in on-road studies.
30690007.summary: This review found that current tests give mostly uncertain evidence for predicting safe driving in people with MS, with a few tests like the Stroke Driver Screening Assessment probably useful.

35462868.conclusion_quote: Individuals with MS expend more energy when walking compared with controls.
35462868.summary: People with MS use more energy to walk than people without MS, and higher walking energy use was weakly linked to greater fatigue.

31462182.conclusion_quote: Omega-3 and fish oils supplementations have beneficial effects on reducing the relapsing rate, inflammatory markers, and improving the quality of life for MS patients.
31462182.summary: A review of seven studies found that omega-3 and fish oil supplements may reduce MS relapses and inflammation and improve quality of life.

36335449.conclusion_quote: In short, statins represent an attractive new measure for treating MS.
36335449.summary: Reviewed studies in MS and animal models suggest statins calm immune activity, may protect nerves, reduce relapses and lesions, and appear safe.

31159998.conclusion_quote: Physicians and patients should be aware of the updated recommendations for immunizations of patients with MS.
31159998.summary: French MS experts reviewed the evidence and issued updated advice on vaccinations for people with MS, including which vaccines are safe alongside immunosuppressive treatments.

34188950.conclusion_quote: Massage as a complementary and non-pharmacological therapy might have been associated with alleviating fatigue and pain in M.S. patients.
34188950.summary: A review of ten studies found that massage therapy reduced fatigue and pain in people with multiple sclerosis, though larger trials are needed.

36274283.conclusion_quote: We found consistent relationships to neural correlates across in-person and remote SDMT administration modalities.
36274283.summary: Remote and in-person administration of the Symbol Digit Modalities Test gave similar links to brain volume on MRI in people with MS, supporting remote cognitive testing.

32521483.conclusion_quote: Despite high heterogeneity, we confirm the historic assumption that ARR reduces during pregnancy, and demonstrate an overall reduction in ARR over time.
32521483.summary: Pooled data from many studies show MS relapses become less frequent during pregnancy, with a rebound after birth, and overall relapse rates have fallen over time.

36923578.conclusion_quote: Having a parent with MS has a relevant effect on children.
36923578.summary: Researchers reviewed 28 studies and found that having a parent with MS often brings mood, behaviour and social difficulties for children, though results varied and more research is needed.

28828902.conclusion_quote: The quality of reporting of cognitive rehabilitation for memory, attention and executive function for multiple sclerosis, across a range of study designs, is poor.
28828902.summary: Researchers reviewed 54 studies of brain training for thinking problems in multiple sclerosis and found that many did not describe their treatments clearly enough.

33260401.conclusion_quote: The meta-analysis we have performed shows that the use of the CVS in differentiating MS from other mimicking diseases is encouraged; moreover, the use of dedicated sequences such as 3D-EPI and the high MRI field is beneficial.
33260401.summary: A review of brain scan studies found that a vein running through the centre of MS lesions reliably helps tell MS apart from similar conditions, especially with advanced scanners.

26088327.conclusion_quote: Recent advances in MS registries will allow nation-wide studies and temporal comparisons between countries, provided that age- and sex-standardized estimates are available.
26088327.summary: Studies from the Middle East and North Africa found MS is fairly common there, with prevalence varying widely between countries and onset usually around age 28.

34856949.conclusion_quote: Fatigue is a prevalent symptom in pwMS and is associated with considerable QoL and economic burden.
34856949.summary: Fatigue is common in people with MS, affecting 36.5 to 78 percent, and is linked to poorer quality of life and lost work.

34509464.conclusion_quote: Exercise should be considered an effective fatigue management strategy.
34509464.summary: Exercise, especially combined exercise and resistance training, appears to reduce fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, according to a review of 58 trials.

25662901.conclusion_quote: A biomarker of Epstein-Barr virus (anti-EBNA IgG seropositivity), infectious mononucleosis, and smoking showed the strongest consistent evidence of an association.
25662901.summary: Researchers reviewed 44 meta-analyses of environmental factors and MS. Only EBV antibodies, infectious mononucleosis, and smoking showed strong, reliable links to developing the disease.

35408195.conclusion_quote: For this reason, robot-assisted gait training is considered just as effective as conventional rehabilitation training for improving gait in people with MS.
35408195.summary: A review of 17 trials found robotic walking training works about as well as conventional rehabilitation for gait in MS, though study quality was moderate to low.

31079157.conclusion_quote: The data presented throughout this review provide insight into the emerging evidence base for sodium intake as a risk factor for MS disease progression and potentially onset of disease.
31079157.summary: This review of 12 studies suggests that eating high amounts of salt may increase the risk of MS starting or getting worse, but more research is needed.

31005713.conclusion_quote: Mitoxantrone may be effective in reducing the frequency of relapse and slowing down the progression of disability in patients with NMOSD.
31005713.summary: Eight studies with 117 patients suggest mitoxantrone may reduce relapses and slow disability in NMOSD, but its heart and leukemia risks limit its use.

32032617.conclusion_quote: Thus, it has been hypothesized that TLR4 may be a part of the MS puzzle.
32032617.summary: This review suggests that TLR4, an immune sensor that detects infection and tissue damage, may contribute to how multiple sclerosis develops.

34334057.conclusion_quote: There is little focus on persons with MS in the early disease course in physical activity behavior change interventions.
34334057.summary: Few physical activity programs for people with MS have included people recently diagnosed, and their effects on activity levels were mixed depending on how they were measured.

27973919.conclusion_quote: Technology-based distance physical rehabilitation increased physical activity among persons with MS, but further research on walking in MS is needed.
27973919.summary: Remote rehabilitation delivered by internet, phone, games or pedometers helped people with MS be more active, but its effect on walking remained unclear.

36533191.conclusion_quote: Dropouts across the virtual reality and control comparators were similar without significant differences.
36533191.summary: Researchers pooled 16 trials of virtual reality balance and walking training in MS and found people dropped out at similar rates to standard care.

32507148.conclusion_quote: The majority of the studies analyzed showed positive results after Pilates training intervention and concluded that Pilates intervention is safe and effective for the treatment of dysfunction of balance, strength, quality of life, cognition, physical performance, walking and posture parameters on MS patients.
32507148.summary: A review of 12 studies found that Pilates exercise generally improved balance, strength, quality of life, thinking and walking in people with multiple sclerosis, and appeared safe.

33709027.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis showed a significant negative correlation between 25 (OH) vitamin D level and disability of MS patients so that the disability reduces with increasing the 25 (OH) vitamin D level.
33709027.summary: A pooled analysis of 14 studies found that higher vitamin D levels were linked to less disability in people with multiple sclerosis, especially in women.

36545647.conclusion_quote: Online peer support can help those unable to access in-person support groups and can reduce the risk of social isolation.
36545647.summary: A review of 11 studies found online peer support helps people with MS share information and feel emotionally supported, though symptoms can make technology hard to use.

33847188.conclusion_quote: Overall, the Cw is elevated in pwMS but with a similar energetically most optimal walking speed, compared with healthy subjects.
33847188.summary: People with MS use more energy to walk than healthy people, but their most efficient walking speed is about the same.

28505177.conclusion_quote: Resolving the persistent clinico-radiological paradox will likely require simultaneous evaluation of multiple components of the complex pathology using optimum measurement techniques for both cognitive and MRI feature quantification.
28505177.summary: Researchers pooled 50 studies and found a moderate link between MRI white matter lesions and thinking problems in people with MS, with much variation in how studies were done.

31778221.conclusion_quote: The evidence regarding the effects of interventions for preventing falls in MS is sparse and uncertain.
31778221.summary: Researchers reviewed 13 trials and found the evidence on preventing falls in MS is limited and uncertain, with some hints that exercise improves balance and mobility.

30006858.conclusion_quote: This review concluded that some micro-organisms such as HHV-6, C. pneumoniae and TTV have been considered as cofactors to make MS a progressive type.
30006858.summary: Researchers reviewed 14 studies and found that some infectious agents such as herpesvirus 6, Chlamydia pneumoniae and torque teno virus may help MS become progressive, though evidence is inconsistent.

32731203.conclusion_quote: The present meta-analysis suggested that tocilizumab is a relatively effective and safe treatment for NMOSD.
32731203.summary: A meta-analysis of five trials with 89 patients found tocilizumab substantially reduced relapses in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, with most side effects being mild.

31099113.conclusion_quote: Alpha-blockers may be effective and safe for treating NLUTD in female and male patients with MS but the studies were small and the overall quality of evidence was low.
31099113.summary: Three small studies with 50 patients suggest alpha-blockers help bladder problems in people with MS and cause few side effects, but evidence quality is low.

33588903.conclusion_quote: Dalfampridine exerts positive effects on walking ability, finger dexterity, and cognitive function.
33588903.summary: Dalfampridine improved walking, hand dexterity and thinking speed in people with MS, but caused more side effects than placebo.

30268039.conclusion_quote: Difficulties with employment and/or reduced work hours were associated with cognitive impairment in MS.
30268039.summary: Reviewing 13 studies, this paper found that people with MS who lost or struggled with work performed worse on thinking tests, especially speed, memory and problem solving.

27237747.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that the WBV may improve the knee extension muscle strength.
27237747.summary: Pooled trials found whole body vibration may strengthen knee extensor muscles in people with MS, but it did not clearly improve walking or mobility.

32174181.conclusion_quote: People adjust to SPMS in different ways, with the success of adjustment influenced by a patient's primary coping mechanism.
32174181.summary: People with secondary progressive MS adjust in different ways, and how well they cope depends on their coping approach, support from others, and activity levels.

37290970.conclusion_quote: A higher depression genetic burden was associated with approximately 30%-40% increased odds of depression in European genetic ancestry participants with MS compared with those without depression and was no different compared with those with depression and no comorbid immune disease.
37290970.summary: People with MS and depression carry more inherited depression risk genes than people with MS alone, which could help spot those at risk earlier.

29370683.conclusion_quote: Conclusions The median worldwide prevalence of JCV among adults with MS or NMO was found to be 57.1%.
29370683.summary: A review of 18 studies found that about 57 percent of people with MS or NMO carry the JC virus, which can rarely cause a serious brain infection.

32552343.conclusion_quote: Further research is needed to optimize clinical detection and medical management of this condition.
32552343.summary: Doctors reviewed 79 children with a large, MS-like brain or spinal cord lesion that can look like a tumour, and summarised how to recognise and manage it.

32282702.conclusion_quote: This study suggested that the CD24 Val allele was associated with an increased risk of MS and larger-scale studies of populations are needed to explore the role of CD24 Ala/Val polymorphism during the pathogenesis of MS.
32282702.summary: Seven studies found a gene variant called CD24 Val linked to higher MS risk, mainly in Asian populations but not European ones.

29498324.conclusion_quote: The few papers that did, reported that the measures have good reliability and appear to have good face, concurrent, and ecological validity, but these need to be evaluated further.
29498324.summary: This review found 12 everyday memory measures used in MS studies, but most lacked psychometric testing. The few tested looked reliable and valid but need further checks.

32158427.conclusion_quote: Our study performed a meta-analysis to generate an estimate of the relevance of miRNA change and the occurrence of MS, and revealed circulating miRNAs has the potential to be used for MS diagnosis, especially for RRMS.
32158427.summary: Pooling 11 studies, the review found that blood microRNA levels may help diagnose multiple sclerosis, especially the relapsing remitting form.

33979770.conclusion_quote: In this indirect treatment comparison of patients with RMS, OZM appeared to have an improved benefit-risk profile over TERI.
33979770.summary: Compared with teriflunomide, ozanimod showed fewer relapses, fewer side effects, and fewer people stopping due to side effects in an indirect comparison.

32361940.conclusion_quote: Higher-quality randomized controlled trials are needed to establish the cognitive efficacy of pharmacologic treatments for MS-related cognitive dysfunction, with cognition as the primary endpoint.
32361940.summary: A review of 87 studies found not enough evidence that drugs improve thinking and memory problems in people with MS, and better trials are needed.

31507517.conclusion_quote: This review highlights the presence of CPI among MS patients.
31507517.summary: Review of 14 studies finds that people with multiple sclerosis have trouble balancing while doing a thinking task at the same time, and suggests better ways to test this.

34079453.conclusion_quote: At present, 0.5 mg/d remains to be the optimal dose of fingolimod for RRMS patients but trials of a lower dose are still of great clinical significance and should be paid more attentions.
34079453.summary: A review of 11 trials found the 0.5 mg daily dose of fingolimod reduced relapses, while the 5 mg dose worked less well and caused more side effects.

28283486.conclusion_quote: Comparisons across treatments in HA or RES RRMS will be associated with high levels of uncertainty until new data are collected for these subgroups.
28283486.summary: Fingolimod looked possibly better than dimethyl fumarate in highly active MS and possibly worse than natalizumab in severe MS, but the limited data mean these results are uncertain.

36855929.conclusion_quote: Some synergy exists between treatment recommendations in HTA reports and CGs, although discrepancies were seen in timelines and in recommended treatment lines and subindications.
36855929.summary: Most health technology assessment reports and clinical guidelines for MS medicines gave similar recommendations, but timing, treatment lines and subgroups often differed.

30875858.conclusion_quote: As shown in 3 out of 10 studies, improvement in disease measures may be more apparent in those with lower baseline vitamin D levels.
30875858.summary: A review of ten trials found vitamin D supplements may help some measures of MS, mainly in people with low baseline vitamin D, and were generally safe.

36831789.conclusion_quote: Graph theory is useful in the detection and prediction of MS and can play a significant role in identifying cognitive impairment associated with MS.
36831789.summary: This review of 24 studies found that graph theory, a way of mapping brain networks in scans, can help detect and predict multiple sclerosis and spot thinking problems.

37746391.conclusion_quote: Our results identified specific areas of pregnancy planning in MS patients, where different treatment strategies might be considered to facilitate a safe and successful pregnancy while maintaining clinical and radiological stability.
37746391.summary: Expert neurologists agreed on 47 of 63 statements guiding family planning for people with MS, including which MS medicines may be used before, during or after pregnancy.

30058696.conclusion_quote: S-SNHL can be an early manifestation of MS and should always be considered in the differential diagnosis of this condition, especially in women.
30058696.summary: A review of 47 studies found sudden hearing loss can be an early sign of multiple sclerosis, especially in women, and should be considered when diagnosing it.

29982111.conclusion_quote: Research regarding the effects of exercise training on cytokines and adipokines in MS is in its infancy, but exercise represents an adjuvant therapy in MS, and future studies are essential for clarifying the role of exercise on cytokines and adipokines in MS.
29982111.summary: Twelve studies found that exercise generally did not clearly change inflammatory cytokine or adipokine levels in people with MS, though the evidence was inconsistent and weak.

31146649.conclusion_quote: Statistically significantly lower mean BMI was revealed in the overall MS patients' group during the MS course than in healthy controls.
31146649.summary: People with multiple sclerosis had lower body mass index than healthy people, with the difference seen in relapsing MS, women and men with MS.

31706166.conclusion_quote: Findings suggest FES cycle training may reduce CVD risk alongside trends for a reduction in spasticity post training, however the low quality of the literature precludes any definitive conclusions.
31706166.summary: A review of nine studies found FES cycling is well tolerated by people with MS who have mobility problems, though evidence of benefits is weak and inconclusive.

33703936.conclusion_quote: IVMP should not be routinely used as treatment for SPMS and is not recommended as an alternative treatment for SPMS.
33703936.summary: Pooled results from four randomised trials suggest high-dose intravenous methylprednisolone does not help secondary progressive MS and is not recommended as a treatment.

30365626.conclusion_quote: Higher cortisol levels may be associated with the progression and severity of MS.
30365626.summary: A review of studies found that cortisol, a stress hormone, is altered in MS and may relate to depression, fatigue and disease severity.

29936326.conclusion_quote: HIIT appears to be safe and effective in increasing fitness in people with MS and low levels of disability.
29936326.summary: Seven studies suggest high intensity interval training is safe and improves fitness in people with MS who have mild disability. More research is needed in progressive MS.

32932167.conclusion_quote: AZA is effective in reducing relapse and improving patients' neurological function.
32932167.summary: Azathioprine, a drug that calms the immune system, reduced relapses and improved disability scores in neuromyelitis optica patients, but blood and liver checks are needed.

36735763.conclusion_quote: Consensus was obtained for the determination of the monitorization interval and for most of the clinical variables.
36735763.summary: Portuguese neurologists agreed on how often to monitor MS patients and which clinical signs, such as brain shrinkage and reduced mobility, suggest the disease is becoming progressive.
