36178780.conclusion_quote: Four interventions benefited participation in the domains of activities of daily living or sleep.
36178780.summary: This guideline reviews research on occupational therapy for adults with MS and their caregivers, finding helpful interventions for daily activities, sleep, work, and caregiver relationships.

29210147.conclusion_quote: The suggestion that some drugs may prevent MS is intriguing and warrants further study.
29210147.summary: A review of 13 studies found that some prescription drugs were linked to higher or lower MS risk, with mixed results, so more research is needed.

34964271.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this review provides evidence for the anti-inflammatory and antioxidative effects of LA in both in vitro and in vivo experiments; therefore, patients with MS may benefit from LA administration.
34964271.summary: Lipoic acid, a natural antioxidant, reduced inflammation and immune cell spread in lab and mouse MS studies, and some patients had stable disability, better walking, and few side effects.

31580307.conclusion_quote: In this review, we examine the recent literature on the pathophysiology of blood vessels in patients with multiple sclerosis treated with ozone therapy.
31580307.summary: This review looks at recent research on how blood vessels are affected in people with multiple sclerosis who receive ozone therapy, a treatment that may reduce inflammation and oxidative stress.

29267988.conclusion_quote: This review provides low-quality evidence that resistive inspiratory muscle training with a resistive threshold device is moderately effective postintervention for improving predicted maximal inspiratory pressure in people with mild to moderate MS, whereas expiratory muscle training showed no significant effects.
29267988.summary: Breathing muscle exercises may modestly improve predicted inspiratory strength in people with MS, but the evidence is low quality and other benefits were unclear.

25634170.conclusion_quote: Strength training is useful for increasing muscle strength in Parkinson disease and to a lesser extent multiple sclerosis.
25634170.summary: Pooled studies found that strength training improved muscle strength in people with multiple sclerosis and Parkinson disease, with smaller gains in multiple sclerosis, plus some gains in fatigue and daily function.

30599428.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that VEMPs may detect very small lesions in the vestibular pathways of MS patients; thus, they could have a role in the diagnosis of MS-related vertigo and in the monitoring of vertigo in MS patients as a tool additional to traditional MRI.
30599428.summary: Vertigo is common in MS, and a dizziness test called VEMPs often shows abnormalities, sometimes even when MRI scans look normal.

34088539.conclusion_quote: The research landscape on NMOSD in Africa, though limited, provides significant insight into the epidemiology, etiology, and clinical characteristics of the disease.
34088539.summary: Researchers reviewed 14 studies on neuromyelitis optica in Africa and found limited but useful information on disease causes and patient features, with gaps in treatment knowledge.

34944714.conclusion_quote: Measurement of nitrite/nitrate in the CSF might be a valuable tool facilitating the differentiation of MS and NIOND.
34944714.summary: Pooled past studies found higher nitrite and nitrate levels in spinal fluid of people with MS than in those with other nervous system conditions.

30316992.conclusion_quote: Refinement of objective measures of speech has enhanced our understanding of Multiple Sclerosis-related deficits in cross-sectional analysis while both integrative and longitudinal studies are identified as major gaps.
30316992.summary: This review found that speech problems in MS can be measured by computer analysis of voice, which could track disease, but long studies are lacking.

31441835.conclusion_quote: The results of the systematic review and meta-analysis will provide updated evidence for the use of siponimod for multiple sclerosis.
31441835.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of clinical trials to assess how well siponimod works and how safe it is for multiple sclerosis.

30999768.conclusion_quote: It appears that the ability to seek and maintain social relationships and to participate in social and daily activities is important for persons with MS.
30999768.summary: Review of 34 studies found that people with MS face difficulties building relationships, facing stigma and fatigue, which affects their quality of life and health.

34573172.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed that the NDI is significantly reduced in MS lesions and NAWM than in WM from healthy participants, corresponding to reduced intracellular signal fraction, which may reflect underlying damage or loss of neurites.
34573172.summary: A review of seven studies found that a brain imaging measure of nerve fibre density is lower in MS lesions and in white matter that looks normal, suggesting nerve fibre loss.

31123141.conclusion_quote: CSF NfL correlates with MS activity throughout the course of MS, reflecting the axonal damage in pwMS.
31123141.summary: Cerebrospinal fluid neurofilament light chain, a marker of nerve damage, was higher in people with MS and highest during relapses than in remission.

27026167.conclusion_quote: RMT can be an adjunctive therapy in the rehabilitation of neurodegenerative diseases improving ventilatory function and respiratory strength.
27026167.summary: Respiratory muscle training improved breathing strength and lung function in people with MS or ALS, though it did not change lung capacity or walking distance.

28764994.conclusion_quote: Admitting the prevalence of alexithymia in MS and its potential negative impact on the quality of life and interpersonal communication, screening for it is relevant for a better management.
28764994.summary: A review of 14 studies found that about 10% to 53% of people with MS have alexithymia, a difficulty recognising and describing feelings, linked to anxiety, depression and fatigue.

32977072.conclusion_quote: Further research is needed to convincingly evaluate fibrinogen as a practical biomarker for diagnostic use or for assessing disease severity.
32977072.summary: A review of published studies finds fibrinogen may play a role in multiple sclerosis, but it is not yet proven useful as a test to diagnose or measure disease severity.

29916361.conclusion_quote: We hope that these first Portuguese magnetic resonance imaging guidelines, based in the best available clinical evidence and practices, will serve to optimize multiple sclerosis management and improve multiple sclerosis patient care across Portugal.
29916361.summary: Portuguese MS and neuroradiology experts agreed on practical guidelines to standardise how MRI scans are used to diagnose and monitor multiple sclerosis.

31185780.conclusion_quote: Epidemiologic data aid in understanding the magnitude of multiple sclerosis and its clinical phenotypes, for planning for new disease-modifying therapies in the pediatric population.
31185780.summary: A review of 19 studies found that childhood MS becomes more common with age, affects girls more often as they get older, and is mostly the relapsing form.

32410904.conclusion_quote: This systematic review revealed that LUTSs are highly prevalent in MS.
32410904.summary: Urinary bladder problems are very common in people with MS, affecting about two thirds of them, with needing to urinate often being the most frequent symptom.

36154604.conclusion_quote: Immunosuppressive drug therapy is effective for patients with NMOSD, but its safety is controversial.
36154604.summary: Review of 15 studies found immunosuppressive drugs appear to help people with NMOSD, but their safety is unclear and the evidence is of poor quality.

35066269.conclusion_quote: Therefore, timelier and more effective measures should be conducted among MS patients to decrease the burden of both diseases.
35066269.summary: This genetic study found that people with multiple sclerosis may have a slightly higher risk of heart attack, but not stroke, than others.

37880961.conclusion_quote: This study identified key terms and obtained agreement on definitions for 30 terms.
37880961.summary: Experts agreed on clear definitions for 30 exercise terms used in multiple sclerosis research, so studies can be compared and combined more reliably.

34591875.conclusion_quote: Selection of outcome measures remains heterogenous in RCTs on gait rehabilitation interventions in MS.
34591875.summary: Researchers used many different tests to measure walking in multiple sclerosis rehabilitation trials, and the most common were the 6-minute walk and Timed Up and Go tests.

26198892.conclusion_quote: Behaviour change interventions provided for relatively short duration (eight to 12 weeks) may increase the amount of physical activity people with multiple sclerosis engage in, but appear to have no effect on the physical components of quality of life and fatigue.
26198892.summary: Short behaviour change programmes of eight to 12 weeks may help people with MS become more physically active, but did not improve physical quality of life or fatigue.

35968319.conclusion_quote: Consensus achieved on these topics could guide neurologists to identify earlier disease progression and to plan targeted clinical and therapeutic interventions during the earliest stages of SPMS.
35968319.summary: Experts agreed on 72 of 83 statements about monitoring patients, spotting progression early, and using clinical tests and biomarkers to recognize the shift to secondary progressive MS.

36249930.conclusion_quote: The results of this review suggest that strength training may elicit improvements in functional and physiological upper extremity outcomes for PwMS.
36249930.summary: A review of eight trials found strength training may improve hand and arm function in people with MS, though results were inconsistent across tests.

35529929.conclusion_quote: Therefore, EAT is a promising and effective therapy to improve quality of life, fatigue, balance, spasticity, and gait speed in PwMS.
35529929.summary: Horse therapy appeared to improve quality of life, fatigue, balance, spasticity and walking speed in people with MS, though study quality varied.

31233959.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis shows a significant association between suicide and multiple sclerosis, although ethnic and geographical differences were not considered.
31233959.summary: Pooling 16 studies, people with multiple sclerosis were about 1.7 times more likely to die by suicide than the general population.

29294398.conclusion_quote: There was insufficient evidence to support any 1 medical therapy and so earlier surgery may be preferable.
29294398.summary: A review found weak evidence for drug treatments of facial pain in MS, and about half of surgical patients had their pain return within two years.

30014314.conclusion_quote: High-quality evidence shows that alemtuzumab, natalizumab and ocrelizumab present the highest efficacy among DMTs, and other meta-analyses are required regarding adverse events frequency, to better understand the safety of therapies.
30014314.summary: Comparing many multiple sclerosis drugs, alemtuzumab, natalizumab and ocrelizumab best reduced relapses, while more research on side effects is still needed.

29937752.conclusion_quote: The lack of epidemiological data available in the Asia Pacific region creates a blind spot in the surveillance of MS which obscures the true burden of MS, causing patients to struggle to receive the resources and funding that they need.
29937752.summary: A review of 16 population studies found MS data for only 6 of 32 Asia Pacific countries, so the true disease burden in the region is unclear.

35069584.conclusion_quote: Our study results demonstrates that pregnancy can induce the onset or relapse of attacks in NMOSD patients.
35069584.summary: Pregnancy can trigger new or worse attacks in people with NMOSD, and continuing immunosuppressive medicine during pregnancy appeared to reduce attacks, though it may raise some newborn health risks.

31102028.conclusion_quote: The present review provides a summary of the tests most commonly used in this region and recommendations for future investigation.
31102028.summary: A review of 13 studies found inconsistent use of cognitive tests for multiple sclerosis across Arab countries, and the SDMT was the most common test used.

32628889.conclusion_quote: This review highlights the large variation in fall definitions, faller classifications and outcomes used in this research field.
32628889.summary: Researchers studying falls in people with MS use many different definitions and outcome measures, which makes it hard to compare studies and combine their results.

26590664.conclusion_quote: More studies on the epidemiology of MS in Brazil will be needed for a better assessment of its prevalence and profile.
26590664.summary: This review of 19 studies found that multiple sclerosis rates in Brazil vary widely by region, from about 1.4 to 27 cases per 100,000 people, so more research is needed.

36180289.conclusion_quote: The experts defined precise diagnostic criteria adapted to clinical practice for earlier identification of SPMS, paving the way for better management of this stage of the disease.
36180289.summary: French MS experts agreed that worsening disability scores on the EDSS scale, with matching symptoms, should be the only agreed test for diagnosing secondary progressive MS earlier.

37399673.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of this consensus seek to optimize the care, management and treatment of PwMS in Latin America.
37399673.summary: Latin American MS specialists agreed on practical advice for checking and managing infection risks in people taking disease-modifying drugs, including vaccines and COVID-19.

36565557.conclusion_quote: A set of statements was defined by the experts and seeks to serve as a guide to apply this concept in clinical practice.
36565557.summary: Argentinian neurologists used a Delphi consensus process to create guidance for involving MS patients in treatment decisions.

32329046.conclusion_quote: The neurologist should be aware of current evidence to assess the risk-benefit of starting, maintaining and stopping disease-modifying therapies in multiple sclerosis during the pandemic.
32329046.summary: Spanish neurologists wrote practical advice on whether to start, continue or pause multiple sclerosis medicines during the COVID-19 pandemic, based on a literature review and their clinical experience.

37293849.conclusion_quote: This first European consensus on vaccination in pwMS proposes the best vaccination strategy according to current evidence and expert knowledge, with the goal of homogenizing the immunization practices in pwMS.
37293849.summary: European experts agreed 53 recommendations on vaccines for people with MS taking disease-changing drugs, covering safety, effectiveness and groups like pregnant women and children.

30702305.conclusion_quote: High levels of CR were associated with better cognitive task performance in verbal and spatial memory, attention, processing speed, verbal fluency, and inhibitory control.
30702305.summary: A pooled analysis of 18 studies found that people with multiple sclerosis who have higher cognitive reserve tend to perform better on most thinking tests.

28267811.conclusion_quote: Overall, included studies demonstrated that educational programs and especially CBT-based approaches have a positive effect on reducing fatigue.
28267811.summary: Patient education programs, especially those using cognitive behavioral therapy, reduced fatigue in people with MS across ten trials, but lasting benefits and real-life impact remain unclear.

37846325.conclusion_quote: In MOG-ON, anterior involvement is more common and the involved length is mostly more than 1/2 of the optic nerve length, whereas posterior involvement, intracranial segment, optic chiasm, or optic tract, is more common in NMOSD-ON.
37846325.summary: This review of 55 studies found that optic nerve inflammation from MOG antibodies usually affects the front of the nerve over long stretches, while NMOSD tends to affect rear parts.

35958974.conclusion_quote: In this study, RTX appeared to be superior to AZT and MMF in improving disability and reducing relapse in patients with NMOSD.
35958974.summary: Rituximab appeared to reduce relapses and disability better than azathioprine or mycophenolate in NMOSD, with fewer side effects overall.

26856938.conclusion_quote: Pharmacological and psychological treatments for depression were effective in reducing depressive symptoms in MS.
26856938.summary: Reviewing 13 trials, treatments such as talking therapy and antidepressant medicines reduced depression in people with MS, but evidence for anxiety treatments was too limited.

30544086.conclusion_quote: Overall, the results of all the studies analysed in this review demonstrated that pre-cooling therapy can prevent the symptom worsening due to increased body temperature in multiple sclerosis patients without causing adverse effects.
30544086.summary: Cooling the body before activity using cooled garments or ice packs appears to prevent heat-related symptom worsening in people with MS without notable side effects.

30734989.conclusion_quote: Exercise successfully improves MRI outcomes and peripheral biomarkers (i.e. brain-derived neurotrophic factor) in people with MS.
30734989.summary: Exercise improved brain scan results and a blood marker of brain health in people with MS, though the studies were small and many participants dropped out.

32627277.conclusion_quote: Placebo is an important variable in the design of CIDP trials.
32627277.summary: Many patients with a nerve inflammation condition improved or stayed stable on placebo, so placebo effects must be considered when designing trials.

38011353.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review show that there are discrepancies between the results of studies regarding the relationship between RLT and cognition status in patients with MS.
38011353.summary: This review of 14 studies found mixed results on whether thickness of the retina's layers, measured by eye scan, relates to thinking and memory problems in MS.

35763914.conclusion_quote: The analysis suggests the safety profile of the COVID-19 vaccines.
35763914.summary: Nine studies found that COVID-19 vaccines were generally well tolerated in NMOSD patients, though a few patients developed the disease soon after vaccination.

35736623.conclusion_quote: Specifically, abnormal activation and atrophy of the thalamus and some regions of the sensorimotor network seem linked to fatigue.
35736623.summary: Review of 50 studies found that people with MS and fatigue often show changes in the thalamus and sensorimotor brain areas, suggesting these areas contribute to fatigue.

31869429.conclusion_quote: Fingolimod may offer benefits for RMS patients and presents an acceptable safety profile.
31869429.summary: A meta-analysis of ten studies found fingolimod cut relapses in relapsing multiple sclerosis compared with placebo, with safety similar to comparators.

31217172.conclusion_quote: This new meta-analysis confirms that MS prevalence is still strongly positively associated with increasing latitude and that the gradient is increasing, suggesting that potentially modifiable environmental factors, such as sun exposure, are still strongly associated with MS risk.
31217172.summary: Multiple sclerosis is still more common further from the equator, and this difference has grown, suggesting environmental factors like sun exposure may influence risk.

36753458.conclusion_quote: The percentage of those meeting the guidelines reduced with increasing disability level and during the pandemic.
36753458.summary: A survey of people with MS found fewer met physical activity guidelines as disability rose and during the COVID pandemic.

34218221.conclusion_quote: According to our meta-analysis, the administration of vitamin D in different dosages (ranging from 2,857 to 14,007 IU/day) and treatment period (ranging from 6 to 24 months) did not affect the clinical outcomes (EDSS and relapses during research) in patients with MS.
34218221.summary: Pooled trials found that vitamin D supplements at different doses and durations did not improve disability scores or relapse rates in people with multiple sclerosis.

35042091.conclusion_quote: In this letter, we highlight some points in their meta-analysis regarding high heterogeneity levels that reflect some methodological concerns related to pooling studies with considerable variability.
35042091.summary: This letter critiques a meta-analysis of deep brain stimulation for MS tremor, noting high variability between studies and suggesting better ways to pool their results.

37662038.conclusion_quote: Existing data lend credence to the hypothesis that inflammatory mediators transmitted via fluid exchange across this communication window, thereby represents a key pathobiological mechanism capable of culminating in hearing disturbances associated with neuroimmunological and neuroinflammatory disorders of the nervous system.
37662038.summary: This review found people with migraine, Parkinson's or MS more often have hearing problems than healthy people, possibly from inflammation passing into the inner ear.

27645339.conclusion_quote: Compared with placebo, clear reductions in ARR with disease-modifying therapies were accompanied by more uncertain changes in disability progression.
27645339.summary: Across 28 trials, most MS drugs reduced relapses compared with placebo, with alemtuzumab and natalizumab ranking highest, but effects on disability were less certain.

34455470.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that grey matter atrophy in MS may be resulted from the joint effects of multiple genes that are associated with this disorder, especially genes with downregulated expression in MS.
34455470.summary: Researchers found 623 genes linked to brain grey matter loss in MS, with many of these genes being less active in people with MS, which may help explain cognitive problems.

32474916.conclusion_quote: When comparing the existing literature on neurophysiological motor examinations in PwMS and HC, consistent and substantial impairments of CNS function were seen in PwMS, whereas impairments of the PNS were less pronounced and inconsistent.
32474916.summary: Review of studies found that brain and spinal motor signal pathways are consistently impaired in people with MS, while nerve impairments outside the brain are milder and less consistent.

32153674.conclusion_quote: Prevalence of SD is discrepant among women with MS in different countries and it should be considered as an important concern.
32153674.summary: Roughly half of women with multiple sclerosis reported sexual problems in this review of nine studies, though rates varied widely between studies and countries.

31637431.conclusion_quote: New large case-control instrumental investigations are warranted to establish the real objective entity and impact of sleep comorbidities.
31637431.summary: This review found that sleep problems are common in multiple sclerosis, but few studies have measured them objectively with sleep recordings, so larger studies are needed.

34900327.conclusion_quote: This approach will facilitate transparent creation of high-quality and trustworthy guidelines, and allow the global guidelines to be adopted or adapted into national settings.
34900327.summary: This paper describes how the MS International Federation plans to create guidelines on off-label MS treatments, aiming for transparent, trustworthy recommendations that can be used worldwide.

35699899.conclusion_quote: Therefore, the offer to examine MS patients with atypical symptoms for possible MG identification seems very rational.
35699899.summary: This review describes patients who have both myasthenia gravis and demyelinating brain or spinal diseases such as MS, and suggests screening MS patients with unusual symptoms for myasthenia.

32200337.conclusion_quote: In addition to the safety and good tolerance, its efficacy on multiple sclerosis is comparable to that of conventional walking training and is even superior in improving fatigue and spasticity.
32200337.summary: Robot-assisted walking training worked about as well as conventional walking therapy for people with MS, and was better for fatigue and leg stiffness.

36381897.conclusion_quote: Despite the risk of mild hematological abnormalities in the newborn and the risk of spontaneous abortions at the same rate as that of the general population, NAT use can be considered safe in pregnancy.
36381897.summary: Review of nine studies found natalizumab, an MS drug, appears reasonably safe in pregnancy, though it may cause mild blood changes in newborns and stopping it risks relapse.

31287842.summary: This is a correction notice to a published review of how common multiple sclerosis is in Iran, fixing errors in the original article.

34733228.conclusion_quote: Herbal medicines were determined to improve the symptoms of MS and to reduce the frequency of recurrences.
34733228.summary: A review of 14 mostly small studies found that East Asian herbal medicines may ease MS symptoms and reduce relapses, but the evidence is weak.

38011449.conclusion_quote: GA and IFN beta-1a are associated with several side effects which may be related to the immunomodulatory function of medication or other injection-related reactions.
38011449.summary: Case reports of two MS drugs, glatiramer and interferon, most often describe skin, liver and allergic side effects, mostly in women.

36564664.conclusion_quote: These French expert consensuses provide up-to-date relevant guidance on the use of IRT in clinical practice.
36564664.summary: French multiple sclerosis experts reached agreement on 16 of 19 statements about using immune reconstitution therapy early and for patients wanting family planning or lifestyle flexibility.

35875457.conclusion_quote: This review indicates that self-efficacy and self-management abilities may be effectively promoted, particularly through group training interventions.
35875457.summary: Nurse-led educational and group training programs improved self-efficacy and self-management in people with MS, and participants were generally satisfied with them.

28914229.conclusion_quote: DMTs were clinically effective for RRMS and CIS but cost-effective only for CIS.
28914229.summary: Interferon beta and glatiramer acetate reduced relapses and slowed disability worsening in MS compared with no drug, but were only cost effective for early CIS.

30567012.conclusion_quote: Despite the use of a wide range of non-pharmacological interventions for the treatment of chronic pain in pwMS, the evidence for these interventions is still limited or insufficient, or both.
30567012.summary: Reviewers found that many non-drug treatments for chronic pain in MS, such as nerve stimulation and hypnosis, may help, but the evidence is too weak to be sure.

35572921.conclusion_quote: Cerebellar and/or brainstem lesions indicate a poor overall prognosis in multiple sclerosis, but because of inconsistency, more clinical data are needed.
35572921.summary: A review of studies found that MS lesions in the cerebellum or brainstem are linked to a worse outlook, though more clinical data are needed to confirm this.

29406768.conclusion_quote: The findings of this meta-analysis indicate that yoga is no better or worse than other exercise modalities as a treatment intervention for adults with stroke and MS, and children.
29406768.summary: Yoga was no better or worse than other exercise for adults with stroke or MS and for children, though evidence in children with cerebral palsy is lacking.

29414293.conclusion_quote: Physical activity was associated with measurable benefits on ability outcomes, but continuation is likely required to maintain benefits.
29414293.summary: Exercise studies from 2011 to 2016 found that physical activity improved walking, balance and strength in people with MS, with mostly mild side effects, though benefits may need ongoing activity.

33658933.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis found that, with favorable safety performance, the use of ozanimod as a treatment of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis in adults was associated with a significant reduction of the annualized relapse rate during the treatment period, decreased number of gadolinium-enhancing lesions at the end of the trial, and lowered number of new or enlarging T2 lesions over the treatment period.
33658933.summary: Pooling three large trials, the pill ozanimod reduced relapses and new brain lesions in relapsing MS and caused fewer reported side effects than control treatments.

36527368.conclusion_quote: The panel recommended to include intrathecal κ-FLC synthesis in the next revision of MS diagnostic criteria as an additional tool to measure intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis.
36527368.summary: Experts agreed that measuring kappa free light chains in spinal fluid is an accurate, quick test for MS and should be added to future diagnostic criteria.

27207462.conclusion_quote: The available studies on spasticity treatment offer some insight to guide clinical practice but are of variable methodological quality.
27207462.summary: A review of drug treatments for muscle stiffness in MS found baclofen, tizanidine and gabapentin work best as first choices, with other drugs for harder cases.

35160134.conclusion_quote: Cumulative data suggest that Pilates can be a rehabilitation tool for pwMS.
35160134.summary: Pilates exercise seems to improve balance, walking, strength and thinking in people with MS, with good adherence and few side effects, but not fatigue or quality of life.

31525626.conclusion_quote: Oral DMTs may be associated with a higher incidence and greater nocebo severity than newer injectables.
31525626.summary: In MS drug trials, many people given a placebo still reported side effects, especially in oral drug trials, and some stopped treatment because of them.

35063907.conclusion_quote: The IL-17 signaling pathway influences the relationship between Multiple Sclerosis and Acute Myocardial Infarction and represents a potential target for drug intervention.
35063907.summary: Researchers compared gene activity in MS and heart attack patients and found an inflammatory immune pathway, IL-17, that may link the two diseases and could be a drug target.

28414733.conclusion_quote: We found no association between anti-KIR4.1 antibody positivity and MS.
28414733.summary: Researchers found no antibodies against the KIR4.1 protein in MS patients using three lab tests, and a review of prior studies found mixed, inconsistent results.

27604618.conclusion_quote: The study found no change in risk of developing multiple sclerosis (MS) after vaccination against hepatitis B virus, human papillomavirus, seasonal influenza, measles-mumps-rubella, variola, tetanus, Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG), polio, or diphtheria.
27604618.summary: This review of published studies found that common vaccines do not raise the risk of developing multiple sclerosis, and flu shots do not trigger relapses.

33609923.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that FMF could be associated with MS; and further studies are needed to investigate a potential causal association.
33609923.summary: A review of 24 people with both conditions suggests familial Mediterranean fever may be linked to multiple sclerosis, though causation is not yet proven.

27756020.conclusion_quote: The profile of the MS in Brazilian seems to correspond to that observed in high-MS-prevalence areas.
27756020.summary: Reviewed Brazilian MS studies suggest the disease looks like that seen in areas with high prevalence, and African ancestry raises the risk of earlier disability.

32218697.conclusion_quote: Higher serum levels of Hcy were noted in patients with MS when compared with control groups.
32218697.summary: A pooled analysis of 21 studies found people with MS had higher homocysteine levels than healthy controls, while vitamin B12 and folate levels did not differ.

33090003.conclusion_quote: Ofatumumab offers beneficial outcomes for RMS by reducing relapse and disability progression risk.
33090003.summary: A network comparison of studies found ofatumumab works about as well as other strong antibody treatments at reducing relapses and disability worsening in relapsing MS.

34070705.conclusion_quote: The review proves telerehabilitation to be an effective motivational tool to restore and maintain both physical and cognitive function in patients with MS.
34070705.summary: A review of 17 studies found that remote and virtual rehabilitation helped people with multiple sclerosis keep up physical and thinking abilities, especially during COVID-19.

30536361.conclusion_quote: All papers included in this systematic review showed mobile applications designed specifically for MS, but the low methodological quality of the articles included and the fact that there are no coincidences between the apps found in the scientific literature and in the apps markets mean that their use could not be recommended in a generalized way.
30536361.summary: This review found 46 smartphone apps for MS, but the studies testing them were weak and the apps did not match across research and app stores.

27538416.conclusion_quote: Overall, IFN-β-1a-SC and natalizumab seem to have the most favorable benefit-risk ratios among first- and second-line DMTs, respectively.
27538416.summary: This review compared MS drugs by how many patients must be treated for one to benefit or be harmed. Interferon beta 1a injections and natalizumab showed the most favorable balance of benefits and risks.

29194677.conclusion_quote: In the appropriate clinical and electrophysiological setting, CIDP associated with cancer should be considered.
29194677.summary: A review of published studies found that a nerve disorder called CIDP is linked to cancers, most often blood cancers and melanoma, and it often responds to treatment.

30284038.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that vitamin D supplementation may have a therapeutic role in the treatment of MS.
30284038.summary: Twelve trials with 950 people found no statistically significant benefit from vitamin D for MS, though trends favoured it, and higher doses may bring worse outcomes.

36457862.conclusion_quote: Based on the NMA and SUCRA ranking, we can conclude that symptoms including fatigue, pain, spasticity, and QOL can be improved by following NIBS protocol after treatment.
36457862.summary: Brain stimulation techniques such as magnetic and electrical stimulation may ease fatigue, pain, spasticity and quality of life in people with MS, though evidence quality is low.

30141723.conclusion_quote: Over three decades, PMS trial populations changed and are now older, with a longer disease duration and more disability, with lower on-trial progression rates.
30141723.summary: Clinical trials for progressive multiple sclerosis have, over 30 years, enrolled older people with more disability, and people in the placebo groups progressed less often.

26149978.conclusion_quote: Our recommendations are intended to help radiologists and neurologists standardize and optimize the use of MRI in clinical practice for the diagnosis of MS.
26149978.summary: Expert guidelines from the MAGNIMS network explain when, how and what to report from brain and spinal cord MRI scans when doctors suspect multiple sclerosis.

29501849.conclusion_quote: The study provides information on discriminated epidemiological features of PPMS in the region.
29501849.summary: Few studies exist on primary progressive MS in Latin America. Reported prevalence was low, about 0.13 to 1.1 per 100,000 people, and no incidence or mortality data were found.

26369511.conclusion_quote: We present recommendations on how and when to use MRI for disease monitoring, and discuss some promising MRI approaches that may be introduced into clinical practice in the near future.
26369511.summary: This guideline explains how and when doctors should use MRI scans to track multiple sclerosis progression and predict future disability.

32544164.conclusion_quote: The currently available long-term data for patients with RRMS exhibit serious or critical risks of bias that preclude robust comparisons between long-term studies.
32544164.summary: Long term studies of MS treatments have serious bias problems, so their apparent benefits and safety results cannot yet reliably compare drugs.

26268445.conclusion_quote: Our data show that 2.0-18.9% of patients developed NAbs to Avonex™, 16.5-35.4% of patients developed NAbs to Rebif™ and 27.3-53.3% of patients developed NAbs to Betaferon/Betaseron™.
26268445.summary: Interferon beta MS drugs can trigger neutralising antibodies that blunt their effect, with Avonex causing the fewest cases and Betaferon the most.

35545683.conclusion_quote: No evidence of novel signal of association with MS specific for the Italian continental population has been found; nevertheless, two MS loci seems to play a relevant role, raising the interest to further investigations for TBKBP1 gene.
35545683.summary: Researchers analysed genetic data from Italian people and found three DNA variants linked to the TBKBP1 gene that may influence multiple sclerosis risk.

26856947.conclusion_quote: Under random-effect model meta-analysis the data showed that the frequency of Treg cells was not a risk factor in multiple sclerosis using current laboratory methods.
26856947.summary: Researchers combined eight case control studies and found that the number of regulatory T cells, immune cells that calm inflammation, does not appear to raise the risk of multiple sclerosis.

32442885.conclusion_quote: This systematic review provides one clear finding: multiple sclerosis places a huge economic burden on healthcare models and societies due to productivity losses and caregiver burden.
32442885.summary: This review of cost studies finds that multiple sclerosis causes a large financial burden, mainly from lost work and unpaid care, and costs rise as the disease becomes more severe.

35957787.conclusion_quote: It increases the attention of doctors to follow accurate measurements to diagnose multi sclerosis regarding the initial symptoms.
35957787.summary: Multiple sclerosis can start with a rare symptom of spinning dizziness caused by central nervous system involvement. Doctors should carefully check for it when diagnosing.

28215060.conclusion_quote: Evidence that aquatic treatment improves quality of life in affected patients was very good in two studies, good in four, fair in two and weak in two.
28215060.summary: Ten studies reviewed found that exercise in water may improve quality of life for people with multiple sclerosis, though evidence strength varied widely.

36319902.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of this consensus would provide a useful guide for the proper use of telemedicine for the assessment, follow-up, management, and treatment of people with MS.
36319902.summary: Argentinean neurologists agreed on guidelines for using telemedicine to diagnose, monitor, and treat adults with multiple sclerosis, including relapses and disease modifying medicines.

31650807.conclusion_quote: the results of our review highlighted the scarce use of HADs for the identification of cases affected by neurological diseases in Italy.
31650807.summary: This review found that Italian healthcare databases are rarely used to identify people with Parkinson's, multiple sclerosis, or epilepsy, and existing methods need more validation.

26195057.conclusion_quote: A wide range of telerehabilitation is used in pwMS, however, the quality of evidence on these interventions was low.
26195057.summary: Reviewers found that telerehabilitation, delivered remotely, may help MS symptoms like fatigue and daily function, but evidence is weak and more robust trials are needed.

32504180.conclusion_quote: To date, no neurophysiological or fluid biomarker is sufficiently validated to support the early diagnosis of SPMS.
32504180.summary: This review found that no nerve test or body fluid marker is yet proven to detect secondary progressive MS early, though nerve measures and neurofilament light chain look promising.

30841862.conclusion_quote: RTX has acceptable tolerance, reduces the relapse frequency, and improves disability in most patients with NMO.
30841862.summary: Rituximab, an antibody therapy that depletes B cells, reduced relapses and disability in people with NMO with acceptable side effects.

27919475.conclusion_quote: Given the various cognitive deficits in MS, it is expected that higher language abilities would be affected.
27919475.summary: This review of 30 studies found that people with MS may have language problems, but differing study methods make firm conclusions difficult.

37846392.conclusion_quote: Inclusion of the RNFL and macular GC-IPL is recommended for monitoring disease progression and attention should be paid to changes in the INL.
37846392.summary: Researchers pooled 42 studies and found retinal nerve layers thin more in neuromyelitis optica eyes than in healthy eyes, suggesting these scans can track disease.

28992626.conclusion_quote: Fampridine seems to be beneficial at improving gait speed in PwMS in the long term.
28992626.summary: A review of 18 studies found that fampridine seems to help people with MS walk faster over the long term, though few studies followed patients for over a year.

33227661.conclusion_quote: Plasma exchange, whether used as rescue or as first-line therapy, is an effective therapeutic method in patients during acute attacks of NMOSD.
33227661.summary: Pooled results from 24 studies found plasma exchange reduced disability in acute neuromyelitis optica attacks, with about three in four patients responding, whether used first or as backup.

28283114.conclusion_quote: MS can present with a variety of psychotic symptoms.
28283114.summary: Researchers reviewed published reports of 91 people with MS who had psychosis, and many of them improved with steroid treatment.

35885595.conclusion_quote: The question and the main interest of this review is whether histopathological findings are relevant for the diagnosis and can be useful in disease assessment.
35885595.summary: This review looks at whether nerve biopsy findings help diagnose chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy, a nerve disorder, and track how the disease is doing.

35514529.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis provides evidence that relapse rates are considerably higher with IFNs versus fingolimod or natalizumab.
35514529.summary: Pooled data from 19 studies found children with MS had far fewer relapses on fingolimod or natalizumab than on interferon beta, supporting newer trial designs.

25787186.conclusion_quote: Consensus is needed to define autonomic dysfunction in patients with multiple sclerosis.
25787186.summary: Pooled results from 611 people with MS found about 42 percent had heart nerve control problems when one abnormal test counted, versus 19 percent when two were required.

34341708.conclusion_quote: Despite few studies in this field, there is substantial evidence on the association of TL and MS.
34341708.summary: Researchers reviewed seven studies and found that people with MS often have shorter telomeres, the protective caps on chromosomes, and shorter telomeres link to worse disability.

35908447.conclusion_quote: Interferons and glatiramer acetate are preferred initial choices for DMTs based on observational evidence, with the requirement of a switch to a more effective DMT if breakthrough MS activity occurs.
35908447.summary: Saudi experts recommend diagnosing MS in children with the standard adult criteria after ruling out similar conditions, and starting with interferons or glatiramer acetate.

31588832.conclusion_quote: For better MS prevention and treatment outcomes, efforts should be geared towards treating thyroid problems, sex hormone alterations, VD deficiency, sleep problems and melatonin alterations.
31588832.summary: This review of 362 studies proposes that mitochondrial damage, oxidative stress, vitamin D, sex hormones and thyroid hormones play key roles in multiple sclerosis, and suggests managing them.

29771367.conclusion_quote: Web-based interventions had a short-term positive effect on self-reported physical activity in people who had MS and were ambulant.
29771367.summary: Online programs gave people with MS who could walk a short term boost in self reported physical activity, but long term effects are unknown.

28151053.conclusion_quote: MS progression was consistently associated with low vitamin D levels, and smoking was associated with a more rapid decline in MS disability.
28151053.summary: This review of 59 studies found that low vitamin D levels and smoking are linked to MS getting worse, while epidural pain relief during childbirth was not.

33381517.conclusion_quote: Several promising candidate biomarkers suitable for clinical application in MS have been studied.
33381517.summary: A review of 30 studies found several promising body fluid markers that could help diagnose multiple sclerosis or track how it progresses, though larger studies are needed.

32441265.conclusion_quote: Rehabilitation can provide benefits to the performance of people with multiple sclerosis by reducing their perceived fatigue and disability.
32441265.summary: Rehabilitation programmes in people with multiple sclerosis reduced fatigue and disability and slightly improved quality of life, based on 16 controlled trials.

34614458.conclusion_quote: There is substantial variation in advice given to women with MS around pregnancy, and this is reflected in prescribing practice by UK Neurologists.
34614458.summary: A UK survey of neurologists found wide differences in advice on MS medicines during pregnancy, though most had changed their prescribing after national guidelines.

38011464.conclusion_quote: Plant-based diet is a backbone for dietary recommendations in MS patients although low-fat, low-calorie, and KD diets with the addition of fish oil, vegetable oil, and flavonoids could be helpful.
38011464.summary: Fifteen trials of 669 people with MS suggest that diets, especially plant based, low fat and ketogenic diets, may help fatigue, relapses and disability.

33805095.conclusion_quote: The present work suggests that people with MS have a decrease in speed and stride length, as well as an increase in double-stance intervals during gait.
33805095.summary: People with multiple sclerosis walk more slowly with shorter steps and spend more time with both feet on the ground, according to a review of 12 studies.

32372725.conclusion_quote: Comorbidities such as depression, anxiety, migraines and reproductive, urological and bowel issues are common and negatively impact patients' quality of life.
32372725.summary: Young women with MS often have other health problems like depression, migraines, and bladder or bowel issues, which lower quality of life. The authors suggest a team-based approach to care.

34211673.conclusion_quote: Our findings show that vitamin D supplements (high or low dose) have no significant effect on relapse rate and disability during treatment in MS patients.
34211673.summary: Nine trials found that vitamin D supplements, at high or low doses, did not reduce MS relapses or slow disability worsening compared with placebo or other doses.

27919483.conclusion_quote: Given the overlap between anxiety and depression, a transdiagnostic treatment approach is suggested.
27919483.summary: Researchers reviewed 131 studies and found anxiety in people with MS is linked to disability, poor quality of life, depression, and many other demographic, physical, and psychological factors.

29055445.conclusion_quote: The reviewed studies conclude that there is not a clear relationship between IFNβ and depression.
29055445.summary: This review of ten studies found no clear link between interferon beta treatment and depression in people with MS, though a past history of depression raises risk early on.

30408586.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, kappa index has a great clinical sensitivity and specificity as a support in MS diagnosis.
30408586.summary: The kappa index, a cerebrospinal fluid test, helped diagnose multiple sclerosis and predicted which early patients would develop it, based on a study and pooled analysis of eight studies.

28413944.conclusion_quote: Because there is no head-to-head comparison of the different protocols and only limited information on psychometric properties of outcomes, there is currently no gold standard to assess motor fatigability.
28413944.summary: Researchers reviewed 48 studies on muscle tiredness in people with MS and found many different testing methods, so there is no agreed standard way to measure it yet.

27456884.conclusion_quote: VR represents a motivational and effective alternative to traditional motor rehabilitation for MS patients.
27456884.summary: This review of 10 studies found that virtual reality programs may motivate people with MS and help improve movement and thinking difficulties, though more research is needed.

32607071.conclusion_quote: Based on available RCT data, exercise does not seem to have an effect on anxiety in people with MS.
32607071.summary: Exercise trials in people with MS found no clear reduction in anxiety, though the evidence is limited by small studies and risk of bias.

27091121.conclusion_quote: Treatment with fingolimod compared to placebo in RRMS patients is effective in reducing inflammatory disease activity, but it may lead to little or no difference in preventing disability worsening.
27091121.summary: Fingolimod reduced relapses and MRI disease activity compared with placebo in relapsing MS, but did not clearly slow disability worsening, and more people stopped it because of side effects.

32098162.conclusion_quote: Compared with no intervention, vestibular rehabilitation was more effective for balance development (SMD = 2.12; 95% CI = 0.49, 3.75; p = 0.01; I 2 = 89%) and dizziness symptoms improvement (SMD = -17.43; 95% CI = -29.99, -4.87; p = 0.007; I 2 = 66%).
32098162.summary: Vestibular rehabilitation exercises improved balance and reduced dizziness in people with MS compared with no intervention, though it did not clearly beat other exercise programs.

31636661.conclusion_quote: Although there is insufficient evidence for TMS in clinical assessments of MS, this review serves as a template to inform future research.
31636661.summary: A review of 30 studies found that magnetic brain tests were linked to MS severity, movement problems and fatigue, but the evidence is too weak for clinical use.

28507011.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that circulating vitamin D concentrations can be considered a biomarker of MS and supplemental vitamin D can be used therapeutically.
28507011.summary: This review of 47 studies suggests diet, especially higher vitamin D levels, may help lower MS risk and relapses, though more research is needed on other supplements.

31521916.conclusion_quote: Patients with MS tend to have increased blood Hcy levels compared to controls.
31521916.summary: People with multiple sclerosis tend to have higher homocysteine and lower vitamin B12 levels in their blood, with B12 lowest during relapses.

30956686.conclusion_quote: Results from the present review and meta-analysis can help to profile patients who are at greater risk of post-NTZ disease reactivation.
30956686.summary: Stopping natalizumab can cause MS to flare up again, especially in younger patients and those with more prior relapses or active lesions before treatment.

36530641.conclusion_quote: Both the prevalence of vaccine types for certain CIDEs and the heterogeneity in time of onset suggest that different mechanisms-with distinct dynamic/kinetic-might underly these events.
36530641.summary: Researchers reviewed six new cases and 49 published studies of nervous system inflammation after COVID-19 vaccines, finding rare events that differed by vaccine type and timing.

26484519.conclusion_quote: Due to lack of commonality between measures of cognition, training sequences and intervention period, it remains unclear as to whether exercise training can be effective in improving the cognitive functions of neurological patients.
26484519.summary: Across twelve trials in stroke, Parkinson's and MS, exercise often improved thinking, but overall evidence was too inconsistent to confirm it helps cognition.

32728946.conclusion_quote: This study identified several modifiable risk factors for primary prevention of MS that should inform public health policy.
32728946.summary: This study used genetic data and a review of published research to test many possible causes of MS. Higher body weight and low vitamin D or physical activity were linked to higher MS risk.

31150100.conclusion_quote: This systematic review identified moderate-quality evidence that, compared with sham procedure, venous PTA intervention did not provide benefit on patient-centred outcomes (disability, physical or cognitive functions, relapses, quality of life) in people with MS.
31150100.summary: Three trials found that angioplasty to open veins was safe but did not help people with MS with disability, relapses, or quality of life.

28212923.conclusion_quote: The included studies provide good evidence of the real-world effectiveness of fingolimod and highlight the diversity of methodologies used to assess treatment benefit in clinical practice.
28212923.summary: A review of 34 studies from clinical practice found fingolimod improved MS outcomes over time and worked better than interferons or glatiramer, though results versus natalizumab were inconsistent.

29304511.conclusion_quote: Although a strong level of evidence exists for some measures included in this review, there was an absence of psychometric studies on commonly used measures such as gait kinematics.
29304511.summary: Researchers reviewed walking tests used to judge assistive devices for foot drop in MS. Some tests are well checked for accuracy, but commonly used measures like gait kinematics have not been studied.

37426444.conclusion_quote: This systematic review suggests that there is an association between NMOSD and SARS-CoV-2 infections and COVID-19 vaccinations.
37426444.summary: A review of 41 cases found neuromyelitis optica, a rare immune disorder hitting the spine and optic nerves, may follow COVID-19 infection or vaccination.

31878897.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis suggested a significant association between TaqI polymorphism and MS susceptibility.
31878897.summary: Combining 30 studies, researchers found that one vitamin D receptor gene variant, TaqI, may slightly raise the risk of developing MS.

28428119.conclusion_quote: The literature suggests that treatment with high-efficacy immunotherapies is more potent in suppressing relapse activity when initiated early vs. with a delay after the MS diagnosis.
28428119.summary: Starting strong MS drugs early seemed to control relapses better than waiting, though evidence on disability and brain scan changes was unclear.

29380072.conclusion_quote: Results highlight the need to integrate sleep assessment into routine MS care.
29380072.summary: Reviewing 12 studies, this paper found that poor sleep is linked to thinking problems in MS, especially attention and processing speed, and may predict later decline.

34653837.conclusion_quote: UHF MRI improves cortical lesion detection in MS considerably compared to 3 T MRI, particularly for type II-IV lesions.
34653837.summary: Very strong MRI scanners find far more cortical lesions in MS than standard scanners, though they still miss many lesions seen under the microscope.

28383945.conclusion_quote: The ICF can help guide the selection of clinical measures to assess psychosocial functioning in adults with MS and highlight areas necessitating further research and/or intervention.
28383945.summary: This review of 49 studies found that depression in multiple sclerosis is linked to less social participation, weaker support from family and friends, and personal factors such as low confidence and anxiety.

34920249.conclusion_quote: Based on the overall feedback rate of about 250 people in relation to the number of 6500 board-certified neurologists in Germany, the overall appreciation of the guideline can only be considered as an indicator and not proof of acceptance.
34920249.summary: Most surveyed German neurologists agreed with the new multiple sclerosis guideline, but feedback from group discussions and individuals was more varied and critical.

32062178.conclusion_quote: The current meta-analysis demonstrated that the C allele of IL7R T244I polymorphism might be a risk factor for the MS susceptibility in Europe but not in Middle East.
32062178.summary: Pooling 28 studies, this review found an IL7R gene variant may slightly raise MS risk in Europeans but not in Middle Eastern people.

32675076.conclusion_quote: Serum NfL (sNfL) is a plausible marker of neurodegeneration that can be measured accurately, sensitively, and reproducibly, but standard procedures for sample processing and analysis should be established.
32675076.summary: Experts reviewed evidence and found that blood levels of neurofilament light track nerve damage and disease course in MS, though inflammation also raises levels.

36490227.conclusion_quote: The results suggest a simple, trustworthy, and evidence-based app that focuses on helping persons with MS reach the PAGs.
36490227.summary: Researchers asked people with MS what an exercise app should offer, and they wanted personalised plans, expert feedback, science-backed content and control over their own data.

34484933.conclusion_quote: A workgroup was created to develop a consensus fellowship curriculum to serve as a resource for all current and future training programs.
34484933.summary: Experts created a standard training curriculum for doctors specialising in multiple sclerosis and related immune nerve disorders, to help fellowship programs teach consistently.

31637711.conclusion_quote: Based on the findings of the RCTs included in this review, we are uncertain whether palliative care interventions are beneficial for people with MS.
31637711.summary: Three small trials found palliative care at home did not clearly improve quality of life, adverse events, or hospital admissions for people with MS, and evidence remains uncertain.

30844920.conclusion_quote: This harmonization of exercise guidelines provides a prescriptive basis for healthcare providers, exercise professionals, and people with multiple sclerosis, stroke, and Parkinson disease regarding exercise programming.
30844920.summary: This review combined exercise guidelines for multiple sclerosis, stroke, and Parkinson disease, recommending aerobic and strength training several days a week at moderate effort.

31201680.conclusion_quote: Pain in CIDP is an underexplored field.
31201680.summary: Pooling 38 studies of 991 patients, this review found nearly half of people with CIDP have pain at some point, and pain in CIDP is poorly studied.

26008938.conclusion_quote: TENS is a safe and effective non-pharmacological alternative in the management of central pain in people living with MS.
26008938.summary: A review of four studies found that TENS, a mild electrical nerve stimulation device, reduced central pain in people with MS, with moderate benefit.

28926943.conclusion_quote: The systematic comparison allows for extraction of some "common" design characteristics, which may be helpful to further assess the efficacy of mAbs and role of specific targets in preclinical models of multiple sclerosis.
28926943.summary: This review of 122 animal studies found mixed results for monoclonal antibody treatments, with dose and timing not clearly linked to better outcomes.

27216225.conclusion_quote: Despite the range of rehabilitative treatments available for MS, there is a lack of high-quality evidence for many modalities.
27216225.summary: This review of 39 systematic reviews found strong evidence that physical therapy helps daily activity, but many other rehabilitation approaches lack high-quality evidence.

31042118.conclusion_quote: Telemedicine is a viable platform for delivering specialty MS care.
31042118.summary: This review of 28 studies found telemedicine, such as remote neurological checks and online rehabilitation, is workable and often beneficial, cost effective and liked by patients and clinicians.

31669296.conclusion_quote: There was a large difference in T25FW performance in MS compared with controls without MS (ES=-0.93, mean difference=2.4s, P<.01).
31669296.summary: This pooled analysis found that people with MS walk much slower on a timed walking test than people without MS, and they walk slower still with greater disability or progressive disease.

27645338.conclusion_quote: Patients with MS and NMO showed lower serum UA levels when compared with healthy controls.
27645338.summary: People with MS or NMO had lower uric acid levels in their blood than healthy people, so this blood marker might help doctors diagnose these conditions.

35490449.conclusion_quote: Based on 327 replies in total, the current survey largely reproduced the findings of an earlier, smaller survey on the prefinal consultation version of the guideline and confirmed high acceptance rates.
35490449.summary: A survey of German-speaking neurologists found high acceptance of the 2021 MS guideline, though neurologists at large MS centers felt it put too much weight on safety.

35634012.conclusion_quote: Wheelchair users with MS in this study generally rated the NMSS Guidelines for Physical Activity as appropriate.
35634012.summary: Wheelchair users with MS mostly found the national physical activity guidelines appropriate, though they found upper and lower body exercises hardest to do alone.

29971666.conclusion_quote: The structure of economic models used in CEAs of DMTs for RRMS has converged over time.
29971666.summary: This review examined computer models used to estimate whether disease-modifying drugs for relapsing MS are good value for money. The models have become more similar over time, but important differences remain.

31677540.conclusion_quote: The VDR TaqI polymorphisms showed association with MS risk, especially in Caucasians.
31677540.summary: This pooled analysis of 27 studies found that some vitamin D receptor gene variants are linked to multiple sclerosis risk, with the TaqI variant most consistent, especially in Caucasians.

32672370.conclusion_quote: The results indicate that fingolimod and interferon beta-1b are the most efficacious treatments but also have some of the worst effects on liver safety.
32672370.summary: A new statistical method compared relapsing MS drugs on effectiveness and liver safety, even where data were sparse. Fingolimod and interferon beta were most effective but carried the greatest liver risks.

31462584.conclusion_quote: Clinicians should recommend that patients with MS follow all local vaccine standards, unless there are specific contraindications and weigh local vaccine-preventable disease risks when counseling patients.
31462584.summary: This guideline advises people with MS to keep up with standard vaccines, get a yearly flu shot, and avoid live vaccines when taking drugs that weaken the immune system.

31401379.conclusion_quote: The proportion of Th17 cells and the levels of Th17-related cytokines was increased in NMOSD patients compared with the control group and MS patients.
31401379.summary: This review of 38 studies found that people with NMOSD have higher levels of Th17 immune cells and related inflammatory signals than healthy people and people with MS.

28151074.conclusion_quote: We did not identify any risk factor interventions with significant effects on MS progression, but the overall QoE was limited.
28151074.summary: A review of 37 trials found that exercise, diet, and vitamin D did not significantly slow multiple sclerosis progression, though the evidence was limited.

27488370.conclusion_quote: While both treatments show initial promise for reducing the swallowing impairment, they require further research using well-controlled experimental designs to determine their clinical applicability and long-term treatment effects for dysphagia across different types and severity of MS.
27488370.summary: Five studies tested electrical stimulation and botulinum toxin for swallowing problems in MS. All reported some improvement, but the evidence is limited and needs stronger research.

28994622.conclusion_quote: The findings of this review suggest that considering individual or disease-related factors could help healthcare professionals in identifying those less likely to adapt to multiple sclerosis.
28994622.summary: People with MS often cope by avoiding problems or focusing on emotions rather than taking active steps, and personal and health factors shape how they cope.

28427700.conclusion_quote: The evidence presented in this review suggests that FES has a positive orthotic effect on walking in PwMS.
28427700.summary: Reviewing twelve studies, this paper found functional electrical stimulation improves walking speed while the device is switched on, but lasting benefits after stopping were not shown.

28376639.conclusion_quote: Limited evidence is available to guide gait symptom control for people with MS.
28376639.summary: Fampridine helped walking speed in some people and improved walking endurance, while evidence for cannabis and baclofen was weak or lacking.

29762863.conclusion_quote: Results suggest that pwMS are less physically active than a general population across PA outputs of steps per day and minutes of MVPA per day.
29762863.summary: People with multiple sclerosis take far fewer steps and do less moderate to vigorous activity each day than the general population.

28283101.conclusion_quote: No clear sex-based differences in response to DMTs have been documented to date.
28283101.summary: This review of 14 studies found no clear evidence that men and women respond differently to multiple sclerosis treatments, though more research is needed.

28866778.conclusion_quote: Prescribed CBMs are a potentially cost-effective add-on treatment for MS spasticity; however, this evidence is uncertain.
28866778.summary: A review of ten studies found cannabis medicines may be cost-effective for muscle stiffness in MS, but the evidence is uncertain and only moderate in quality.

30779803.conclusion_quote: The PHQ-9 represents a suitable tool to screen for MDD in pwMS.
30779803.summary: Seven studies found the PHQ-9 questionnaire is a suitable screening tool for depression in people with MS, but not yet reliable for diagnosis or tracking symptoms over time.

35767391.conclusion_quote: Our data-driven approach reveals that paraneoplastic NMOSD does not present a homogeneous phenotype nor peculiar features.
35767391.summary: Researchers reviewed 46 published studies of neuromyelitis optica linked to cancer and found these cases vary widely, so cancer screening may help patients of any age.

35261569.conclusion_quote: The evidence in this study is insufficient to show a dramatic effect of sensory integration therapy in various forms.
35261569.summary: A review of nine studies found that some sensory based exercises, such as vestibular rehabilitation and vibration, may reduce fatigue in MS, but the evidence is still weak.

34876925.conclusion_quote: Results of this systematic review concerning women with relapsing MS show a complex and often conflicting picture regarding DMT exposure and relapses during and after pregnancy.
34876925.summary: Across 28 studies of women with relapsing MS, findings were mixed, though stopping high efficacy drugs before pregnancy may raise relapse risk during pregnancy.

33424483.conclusion_quote: A pressing need for development and adequate evaluation of psychological interventions for sexual dysfunction in MS remains.
33424483.summary: Six studies with 295 people found that psychological treatments improved sexual function or satisfaction in MS, but more high-quality research is still needed.

28716323.conclusion_quote: Treatment should be based on stratifying patients by risk from morbidity from retention and by symptoms caused by retention.
28716323.summary: Review of 12 studies found that many people with MS have bladder problems, including urine retention, and that treatment should depend on risk and symptoms.

31818426.conclusion_quote: The efficacy of autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation (AHCT) has been shown in CIDP patients.
31818426.summary: French expert guidelines explain which chronic inflammatory nerve disease patients may receive stem cell transplants, and how to prepare, treat and follow them afterwards.

29606320.conclusion_quote: Thanks to a collaborative work among NMO-SD experts belonging to the NOMADMUS project, we provide here recommendations for all these topics concerning RTX use in NMO-SD.
29606320.summary: Expert panel gives practical advice on using rituximab, a drug that targets B cells, to prevent relapses in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, covering checks, vaccines, infusions and infections.

29648897.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis suggests that the rs2104286 A allele is associated with increased MS risk in both Caucasians and Asians, whereas the rs12722489 C allele is associated with elevated MS risk in Caucasians but not in Asians.
29648897.summary: Pooled studies found the rs2104286 gene variant raises multiple sclerosis risk in European and Asian people, while rs12722489 raises risk only in Europeans.

27452316.conclusion_quote: Limited evidence suggests that COC or OC use after MS onset does not worsen the clinical course of disease.
27452316.summary: Limited evidence from four studies suggests that birth control pills taken after an MS diagnosis do not make the disease worse. Other contraceptive methods were not studied.

36307225.conclusion_quote: The use of anti-TNFα was associated with an increased risk of MS compared with nonusers, especially among patients with RD.
36307225.summary: Among Canadian patients with rheumatic disease, those taking anti-TNF alpha drugs had about twice the risk of developing multiple sclerosis compared with non-users.

40903858.conclusion_quote: A key recommendation is the need for a national bladder pathway for PwMS.
40903858.summary: UK experts updated guidance on managing bladder problems in people with MS, covering assessment, treatments, self management, and calling for a national bladder care pathway.

32664124.conclusion_quote: The conclusion of this study will provide evidence to determine whether PLEX is an effective and safe intervention for patients with NMO-ON.
32664124.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of randomized trials to check whether plasma exchange helps vision and is safe for optic nerve inflammation in neuromyelitis optica.

29627004.conclusion_quote: Despite the observed trends, no definite conclusions can be drawn on the relationship between brain connectivity and PS decline in MS given the limitations of the current literature.
29627004.summary: A review of 32 studies found that brain connections linked to thinking speed in MS are not yet clearly understood, though some frontal and corpus callosum patterns appear relevant.

31368394.conclusion_quote: These pooled data support an increase in ARR following ART.
31368394.summary: Pooled data from several case series suggest multiple sclerosis relapses become more frequent after assisted reproductive treatment, though one separate cohort found no increase.

29333935.conclusion_quote: This review showed no significant association between HPV vaccination and MS.
29333935.summary: Researchers reviewed existing studies and found no significant link between HPV vaccination and multiple sclerosis, though the studies had limited power to detect one.

35645625.conclusion_quote: Sleep disturbances are a major contributor to NMOSD disease burden and may arise from the disruption of sleep circuitry, in addition to physical and psychological complications.
35645625.summary: People with NMOSD often sleep poorly, about 70 percent by one estimate, and their sleep problems are similar in severity to those seen in multiple sclerosis.

26642051.conclusion_quote: Available DMD are effective in reducing disability progression in patients with RRMS, independently of the route of administration and their classification as "first" or "second" line therapies.
26642051.summary: This meta-analysis found that disease-modifying drugs lower the risk of worsening disability in relapsing multiple sclerosis compared with placebo, whether taken by injection or by mouth.

28434462.conclusion_quote: The results indicate that Tai Chi is likely safe and may provide physical and psychosocial benefits in individuals with Multiple Sclerosis.
28434462.summary: Across eight small studies, Tai Chi appeared safe and seemed to improve balance, walking, fatigue, mood and quality of life in people with MS, though results varied.

30290702.conclusion_quote: A discrepancy seems to exists between the effectiveness of physical activity interventions in people with Multiple Sclerosis depending on whether physical activity was assessed objectively or subjectively, with the latter indicating effects.
30290702.summary: Exercise and behaviour change programmes seemed to increase how active people with mild to moderate MS felt, but measured activity did not change and evidence on sitting time was lacking.

28252608.conclusion_quote: The new oral agent for the treatment of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS), dimethyl fumarate (DMF), helps change the pathogenetic mechanisms of the disease, thus decreasing the rate of exacerbations, slowing down disease progression, and reducing the risk of radiological progression of the disease.
28252608.summary: Clinical guidelines describing how dimethyl fumarate, an oral pill, can reduce relapses, slow progression, and limit new scan changes in relapsing multiple sclerosis.

29313265.conclusion_quote: Attribute-based stated preference is a useful method with which to examine the preferences of people with MS in their choice of DMT.
29313265.summary: Surveys asking people with MS how they weigh treatment features are useful, but studies need larger samples and more patient input in their design.

34422112.conclusion_quote: Our recommendations are based on current scientific evidence and apply to those medications approved in wide parts of Europe, particularly German-speaking countries (Germany, Austria, and Switzerland).
34422112.summary: An expert panel from German-speaking countries updated its 2021 advice on which multiple sclerosis drugs to use, based on current scientific evidence.

33411191.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that enhancing PA might not modify the risk of developing MS independent of established risk factors.
33411191.summary: A genetic study found no clear evidence that higher physical activity lowers the risk of developing multiple sclerosis.

30189226.conclusion_quote: CMI should be assessed in MS with a standardised dual task such as the Verbal Fluency task while walking, with measurements of the double support time and the effect on the cognitive task.
30189226.summary: Patients with multiple sclerosis struggled more when walking while doing a thinking task, and the verbal fluency walking test best detected this problem.

25756363.conclusion_quote: DMD appear to be effective in attenuating brain atrophy in comparison to placebo and their benefit in delaying the rate of brain volume loss increases linearly with longer treatment duration.
25756363.summary: Pooled trials found that MS medicines slowed brain shrinkage compared with placebo, and the benefit grew the longer people took them.

31670208.conclusion_quote: The purpose of these guidelines is to provide practical recommendations and algorithms for the diagnosis and treatment of MS based on current scientific evidence and clinical experience.
31670208.summary: Updated expert guidelines explain how to diagnose multiple sclerosis, avoid unnecessary tests, and choose treatments for each stage of the disease.

34573208.conclusion_quote: mHealth is a promising tool in pwMS but more studies are needed to validate these solutions in the other ICF categories.
34573208.summary: Smartphone and app-based tools showed a small benefit for thinking skills and a moderate benefit for fatigue in people with MS, but more research is needed.

28755682.conclusion_quote: There is limited, but promising evidence for the benefits of exercise training in persons with MS with severe mobility disability.
28755682.summary: Review of 19 studies found limited but promising signs that exercise, including adapted methods, may help people with MS who have severe walking difficulties. More research is needed.

34070298.conclusion_quote: This study provides the first evidence regarding the needs and experiences of CAMS and their caregivers.
34070298.summary: This review of 26 studies found that pediatric MS affects children's school, friendships, mental health and physical function, with fatigue a major barrier and caregivers needing psychological and social support.

28182629.conclusion_quote: The existing evidence supports the effectiveness of Tai chi on improving quality of life (QOL) and functional balance in MS patients.
28182629.summary: Tai chi appears to improve quality of life and balance in people with multiple sclerosis, though fatigue results were inconsistent and evidence is limited by small studies.

28810436.conclusion_quote: These data are consistent with the positive by-products of maintaining work with multiple sclerosis.
28810436.summary: Working adults with multiple sclerosis who were employed reported better quality of life and mood, fewer work difficulties, and more effective coping than those not working.

26747125.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review indicated that different types of upper limb rehabilitation strategies can improve upper limb function in PwMS.
26747125.summary: A review of 30 studies found that several arm and hand rehabilitation approaches, including robot training and multidisciplinary programs, can improve function in people with MS.

31016045.conclusion_quote: Fatigue management programs have moderate evidence; other strategies such as OT strategies and telerehabilitation show low evidence.
31016045.summary: Occupational therapy fatigue programs in MS have moderate supporting evidence, while other approaches like telerehabilitation have only weak evidence so far.

29178444.conclusion_quote: There is low- to moderate-quality evidence that annual intravenous cycles of alemtuzumab at a dose of 12 mg per day or 24 mg per day reduces the proportion of participants with relapses, disease progression, change of EDSS score and developing new T2 lesions on MRI over 24 to 36 months in comparison with subcutaneous IFN beta-1a 44 μg three times per week.
29178444.summary: Alemtuzumab given as yearly infusion cycles reduced relapses and disease progression more than interferon beta 1a injections, with similar overall side effects, though evidence quality was low to moderate.
