30684378.conclusion_quote: Therefore, all healthcare providers involved in the follow-up of multiple sclerosis patients must be prepared to discuss pregnancy and breastfeeding issues, and provide the best possible counselling.
30684378.summary: Portuguese experts give practical advice on managing multiple sclerosis before, during and after pregnancy, including which medicines are safe to use.

37560832.conclusion_quote: We reproduced the association of eight polymorphisms ( C6orf10 rs3129934, INAVA rs7522462, IL7R rs10624573, EOMES rs11129295, GPR65 rs2119704, GPC5 rs9523762, CD6 rs17824933 and CD58 rs2300747 ) with MS, previously identified in GWAS in European populations.
37560832.summary: Researchers tested known MS genetic markers in over 2000 people from Bashkortostan and confirmed eight genetic variants linked to MS risk, also found in European studies.

28320112.conclusion_quote: Many patients' experience of information during the standard healthcare system does not provide satisfactory understanding of the risks and benefits of DMDs.
28320112.summary: Patients often underestimated drug risks and overestimated benefits, and standard information did not give them a satisfactory understanding. Patients preferred treatments offering big benefits even with higher risks.

34950142.conclusion_quote: Evaluation of their diagnostic significance and therapeutic potential could help in the design of novel treatments for MS.
34950142.summary: A review of 53 studies found many RNA molecules that regulate genes are altered in people with MS, suggesting they could help diagnosis and future treatments.

27045883.conclusion_quote: Best evidence, which included one or more prospective studies, suggested that lower exposure to sunlight and/or lower serum vitamin D levels were associated with an increased risk of developing MS onset and subsequent relapses, but a similar quality of evidence was lacking for disease progression.
27045883.summary: Reviewing 184 studies, this paper found that low sunlight and vitamin D, smoking, infections and adolescent obesity may influence MS onset, relapses and progression.

29442178.conclusion_quote: Recent high quality reviews find cannabinoids may have modest effects in MS for pain or spasticity.
29442178.summary: Cannabis-based treatments may modestly ease pain and muscle stiffness in multiple sclerosis, according to a review of 11 systematic reviews covering 32 studies.

29923070.conclusion_quote: BICAMS has been widely applied across cultures and languages to assess cognition in MS.
29923070.summary: This review found the BICAMS cognitive test is validated across many languages and countries, and it detects slowed thinking and memory problems in people with MS compared with healthy adults.

26195055.conclusion_quote: AQP4 detection in serum with immunoassay is a great tool for the diagnosis of patients with NMO, due to the high specificity, allowing the clinician to differentiate this disease from other neurological conditions that resemble NMO.
26195055.summary: Blood tests for antibodies against aquaporin 4 were highly specific for neuromyelitis optica, with the cell based test most sensitive, helping doctors separate it from similar conditions.

30537635.conclusion_quote: Natural products not only alleviate clinical symptoms, but also have the unique advantages of protecting and repairing effects on nervous system.
30537635.summary: This review of published papers finds that natural products may ease multiple sclerosis symptoms and help protect and repair the nervous system.

30195200.conclusion_quote: This network meta-analysis provided a comprehensive summary of efficacy and safety of monoclonal antibodies for RRMS, which might provide a reference for treatment.
30195200.summary: This review combined 14 trials of monoclonal antibody drugs for relapsing MS. Most reduced relapses, and natalizumab plus interferon and alemtuzumab gave the best balance of benefit and safety.

34827444.conclusion_quote: It suggests that the risk of having a second relapse, previously ascribed to OCGBs, may, to a certain extent, be related to the presence of intrathecal IgM.
34827444.summary: Antibodies called IgM found in spinal fluid were more common in relapsing MS than in early MS, and their presence was linked to a higher chance of a second relapse.

36537426.conclusion_quote: The ICDC criteria have enhanced clinician's ability to diagnose NMO spectrum disorder in the early stages.
36537426.summary: A review of 36 Indian patients with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder found the new international criteria identified 33% more cases than the older 2006 criteria.

32153675.conclusion_quote: The results of this systematic review were not satisfactory.
32153675.summary: Pooled results from three small trials could not clearly show whether vitamin D supplements change immune signalling molecules in people with MS. More trials are needed.

35496484.conclusion_quote: The dataset can be used to study the relationship between MS-lesion, EDSS and patient clinical information.
35496484.summary: Researchers released brain scans from 60 people with multiple sclerosis, with expert outlines of lesions and disability scores, for studying the disease.

29973121.conclusion_quote: For objective cognitive functioning, weighted effect-size analysis revealed small effects of cognitive-focused interventions on working memory ( g = 0.31) and visual learning ( g = 0.32).
29973121.summary: Cognitive training programs produced small improvements in working memory, visual learning, anxiety and depression in people with MS, but not in self-reported thinking ability.

25327395.conclusion_quote: Exercise may be a potential treatment to prevent or reduce depressive symptoms in individuals with MS, but existing studies do not allow solid conclusions.
25327395.summary: Researchers combined 15 trials and found that exercise moderately reduced depressive symptoms in people with MS, though the evidence is not yet strong enough to be certain.

31210903.conclusion_quote: This study obtained the prevalence rate of dysphagia in patients affected by MS globally, yet there was infinite statistical society and limited methodological quality.
31210903.summary: Pooling 22 studies, this review estimated that about 43 percent of people with MS have swallowing difficulties, with higher rates found by objective tests than by patient questionnaires.

33757115.conclusion_quote: We highlight unanswered questions and propose future directions, with the aim of focusing research priorities towards better methods, analysis, and interpretation of results.
33757115.summary: Experts reviewed evidence that damage to deep grey matter areas of the brain occurs in MS, linked to disability, and set imaging priorities for future research.

30657008.conclusion_quote: Acute brainstem MS relapses, with demyelinating lesions affecting the medulla, may cause acute cardiac and pulmonary events presumably secondary to sympathetic hyperstimulation.
30657008.summary: Review of published case reports finds that MS relapses in the brainstem can sometimes trigger sudden heart and lung problems, likely through overactive nerve signalling.

28481421.conclusion_quote: Low-quality evidence from randomised trials does not show significant benefit from azathioprine or interferon beta-1a and moderate-quality evidence from one randomised trial does not show significant benefit from a relatively low dose of methotrexate for the treatment of CIDP.
28481421.summary: Four small trials of azathioprine, interferon beta or methotrexate found no clear benefit for CIDP, a nerve disease, so larger trials are needed.

29175676.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis showed that modafinil was an effective pharmacologic therapy for MS fatigue.
29175676.summary: Pooling five trials, modafinil reduced fatigue scores on one fatigue questionnaire compared with placebo, but not on another, and did not affect thinking speed.

37296187.conclusion_quote: Our study provides useful implications for the development of AQP4-positive NMOSD prevention strategies.
37296187.summary: A genetic study found that eating more oily fish and raw vegetables may lower the risk of a severe inflammatory disease of the brain and spinal cord called NMOSD.

34290665.conclusion_quote: These findings provide evidence that MI is a promising rehabilitation tool for reducing fatigue in PwMS and return to work strategies.
34290665.summary: Five studies suggest that imagining movements, especially with rhythmic sound cues, may help reduce fatigue in people with MS and support their return to work.

35371265.conclusion_quote: MSCs have a certain effect on different autoimmune diseases, but more RCTs are needed to further modify or confirm the conclusion.
35371265.summary: Mesenchymal stem cell transplants showed some benefit across several autoimmune diseases in 18 randomized trials, but evidence for multiple sclerosis remains controversial and more trials are needed.

30317542.conclusion_quote: Information provision for people with MS seems to increase disease-related knowledge, with less clear results on decision making and quality of life.
30317542.summary: Reviewing 11 trials, providing information to people with MS appears to improve their knowledge of the disease, while effects on decisions and quality of life were unclear.

28108125.conclusion_quote: Interventions designed to improve understanding of DMD risk and benefit information are moderately successful.
28108125.summary: Review of 15 studies found that extra education helped MS patients understand drug risks and benefits better, though they still overestimated benefits and decisions did not clearly change.

35207216.conclusion_quote: These studies demonstrated that AHSCT is a highly efficacious and relatively safe therapeutic option for the treatment of highly active MS.
35207216.summary: Six patients with aggressive MS treated with stem cell transplant were described, and a review of studies found the treatment is effective and fairly safe for highly active disease.

34161898.conclusion_quote: This expert consensus approach provides physicians with some guidelines on optimizing the benefit/risk ratio when switching DMTs in patients with MS.
34161898.summary: French MS experts developed consensus guidance on when people with MS can switch between disease-modifying drugs, and whether a waiting period is needed, to balance benefits and risks.

34987796.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the HFE polymorphisms C282Y and H63D are not associated with susceptibility to MS in populations of Caucasian origin.
34987796.summary: A review of seven studies found that two common variants in the hemochromatosis gene do not appear to raise the chance of developing multiple sclerosis in people of European descent.

35316355.conclusion_quote: Standardization of brain and spinal cord MRI protocols for diagnosis, assessment of prognosis, and monitoring of therapy, as well as the use of 3D-FLAIR (three-dimensional fluid-attenuated inversion recovery) as the most important sequence in the diagnosis of lesions in the brain have been included, as this allows better interpretation and comparability, e.g., in follow-up assessments.
35316355.summary: An expert panel updated German guidelines on using MRI scans to diagnose and monitor multiple sclerosis, adding spinal cord scans and standard protocols for more consistent results.

31068151.conclusion_quote: Future studies are needed to help clinicians to decide, which intervention should be allocated to the individual patient.
31068151.summary: Robot-assisted gait training did not improve walking more than usual walking practice in people with MS, and baseline walking speed or disability did not change this.

26751247.conclusion_quote: Beside the importance of the general disability level and walking limitations, the results highlight the importance of personal factors (eg, PA-related self-efficacy, self-regulatory constructs, sociodemographic factors).
26751247.summary: Studies of people with MS found that greater disability, walking problems, low confidence in being active, and self regulation issues go with lower physical activity.

31300912.conclusion_quote: We explored the efficacy of several MT programs, taking into account the different aspects of application feasibility in the clinical management of MS patients and the future challenges.
31300912.summary: This review examined 13 studies on music-based therapies for multiple sclerosis, looking at how well they address physical, cognitive and mood problems in patients.

27004596.conclusion_quote: There is some evidence to support the effectiveness of memory rehabilitation on memory function, as well as on quality of life.
27004596.summary: Memory training helped people with MS perform better on objective memory tests and some quality of life measures, but not on mood or reported memory problems.

31017288.conclusion_quote: Virtual reality is as effective as conventional training for improving balance in people with MS.
31017288.summary: Virtual reality helped balance in people with MS about as well as conventional training, but was not shown to speed up walking more than other treatments.

32590313.conclusion_quote: Our MR results indicated that coffee consumption might not be causally associated with risk of MS occurrence.
32590313.summary: Genetic analysis found no evidence that drinking coffee causes a higher or lower chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

29518781.conclusion_quote: Psychosocial interventions have a significant, positive impact across a range of outcomes for PwMS with small, yet consistent, effect sizes.
29518781.summary: Psychological treatments modestly improved mood, anxiety, fatigue and quality of life in people with MS, though they did not help physical quality of life.

30427062.conclusion_quote: Studies of EAE in mice suggest that SCFAs may play a role in the development and progression of EAE, but so far this has not been confirmed in humans.
30427062.summary: This review found that fatty acids made by gut bacteria may slow mouse models of MS, but human evidence is lacking, and MS patients' gut bacteria vary inconsistently.

27829351.conclusion_quote: Further studies with a focus on the molecular mechanisms of the protective natural compounds are needed to decrease possible side effects and to develop new medicines for MS.
27829351.summary: This review found that many natural compounds, like vitamins, fish oils and plant chemicals, showed helpful effects against MS in studies, though some caused side effects.

34139461.conclusion_quote: Although many coincidences, there are still many hollows in the medical attention of MS in Mexico.
34139461.summary: Mexican neurologists agreed on recommendations for diagnosing and treating early MS, including when to start drugs and which drugs to use, to improve real world care.

29055456.conclusion_quote: MS patients tend to have elevated Hcy blood levels compared to healthy controls.
29055456.summary: Pooled studies found people with multiple sclerosis tend to have higher homocysteine in their blood, while vitamin B12 and folate levels looked similar to healthy people.

29565171.conclusion_quote: Vitamin D may influence multiple sclerosis improvement.
29565171.summary: Review of 29 studies found vitamin D levels were the most studied nutrition factor in MS, with vitamin D possibly linked to improvement, alongside sunlight and physical activity.

29020113.conclusion_quote: Although the results are promising more robust evaluation is required in order to determine the effectiveness of self-management interventions on depression, anxiety and quality of life in people with MS.
29020113.summary: Self-management programmes often improved quality of life for people with MS, with some signs of better mood and less anxiety, but stronger studies are still needed.

26233264.conclusion_quote: Cognitive dysfunction can be a significant symptom of multiple sclerosis of early onset, but its impact and management needs to be better assessed.
26233264.summary: Review of 32 studies finds thinking and memory problems are common and disruptive in children with MS, but assessment methods vary and few treatments have been proposed.

24998351.conclusion_quote: The AA ApaI and FF FokI genotypes are significant risk factors for MS.
24998351.summary: A combined analysis of 13 studies found that certain vitamin D receptor gene variants, specifically ApaI AA and FokI FF genotypes, are linked to higher multiple sclerosis risk.

30527815.conclusion_quote: In this article we give the indications of autologous stem cell transplantation in multiple sclerosis as well as recommendations regarding post-transplant follow-up of patients under the hospice of the SFGM-TC and the Francophone Society of Multiple Sclerosis.
30527815.summary: This guideline from French transplant and MS societies explains when stem cell transplant may be used for multiple sclerosis and how patients should be monitored afterward.

33620251.conclusion_quote: Cladribine and ofatumumab have an efficacy comparable with therapies classified in the ABN guidelines as high efficacy.
33620251.summary: Researchers ranked newer MS drugs by how well they cut relapses, finding cladribine and ofatumumab as effective as the strongest existing treatments, with ocrelizumab and ozanimod in a middle-to-high range.

36418179.conclusion_quote: Genetically determined lower 25(OH)D levels were not associated with worse disease outcomes in PwMS and raises questions about the plausibility of a treatment effect of vitamin D in established MS.
36418179.summary: Genetically lower vitamin D levels were not linked to worse MS outcomes, including relapses, disability, walking, hand function, and brain scans, in this study of nearly 2,000 people.

33986958.conclusion_quote: Our systematic review evidences that SCS is effective in MS patients.
33986958.summary: A review of seven studies found that spinal cord stimulation, an implanted device, helped many MS patients, especially with bladder problems and pain.

35778721.conclusion_quote: Given that individual patient data from clinical studies are often not available, the review will allow to analyse the evidence on TEM in MS immunotherapy and thus support clinical decision making in individual cases.
35778721.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of existing trials to see which MS immunotherapies work best for different groups of patients, such as by age, sex, or scan results.

30612100.conclusion_quote: As the complexity and range of available disease-modifying drugs increase, further data gathering via a UK-wide MS pregnancy register is recommended.
30612100.summary: An expert panel created UK guidelines to help doctors and women with MS discuss pregnancy, treatment during pregnancy, and delivery, and recommends a UK pregnancy register.

32989721.conclusion_quote: Meta-analyses confirmed the benefit of all DMTs in terms of relapse rate compared with placebo with a comparable rate of SAEs for the DMTs that could be included in the network.
32989721.summary: Researchers compared multiple sclerosis drugs against placebo across 33 trials and found all of them reduced relapses, with serious side effects being similar to placebo.

38011462.conclusion_quote: Among 47 assessed risk factors, sunlight exposure, cigarette smoking, measles infection, Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection, and stressful events had a significant association with MS.
38011462.summary: This review of 16 studies from the Middle East and North Africa found that sunlight may protect against MS, while smoking, measles, EBV infection and stress may raise risk.

30096568.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of these consensus guidelines attempt to optimize the health care and management of PPMS patients in LATAM.
30096568.summary: Latin American MS experts agreed on guidance for diagnosing and caring for primary progressive MS, recommending the 2017 McDonald criteria and rehabilitation alongside careful use of immunotherapy.

28532673.conclusion_quote: Current clinical evidence does not support the theory that central neuraxial analgesia negatively affects the course of multiple sclerosis.
28532673.summary: This review of 37 reports found that spinal or epidural pain-numbing procedures rarely coincided with MS worsening, and no clear cause and effect was shown.

33918927.conclusion_quote: Based on these 14 papers, we cannot draw strong conclusions on the composition of the gut microbiota in SCI and MS patients.
33918927.summary: Researchers reviewed 14 studies and found that gut bacteria evidence in spinal cord injury and MS is too limited for firm conclusions, though diversity may be lower in some patients.

26609919.conclusion_quote: There is insufficient evidence to support or refute the effectiveness of external memory aids for improving memory function in people with MS.
26609919.summary: A review of nine studies found too little evidence to tell whether memory aids like digital organisers help memory problems in people with MS.

27324894.conclusion_quote: These deficits in social cognition may underpin difficulties in social functioning in MS.
27324894.summary: People with multiple sclerosis performed worse than healthy people at understanding others' thoughts and recognising facial emotions, especially fear and anger, and worse performance was linked to other thinking problems.

32339483.conclusion_quote: Consistent with previous findings, back pain and osteoarthritis are the most prevalent conditions with high aggregate medical costs.
32339483.summary: This review of eight conditions, including MS, found back pain and osteoarthritis are most common and costly, while others cost more per patient.

28780323.conclusion_quote: TaqI polymorphism is a significant protective factor for MS.
28780323.summary: A meta-analysis of 21 studies found that one vitamin D receptor gene variant, TaqI, is linked to lower risk of developing multiple sclerosis.

32940128.conclusion_quote: Patients with MS should be vaccinated with careful consideration of risks and benefits.
32940128.summary: A panel of experts agreed on advice for vaccinating people with multiple sclerosis, including yearly flu shots for everyone and checking infection history at diagnosis.

28120634.conclusion_quote: In summary, our meta-analysis revealed a significantly higher PRL level in MS patients than healthy controls, and it is influenced by region, age and disease duration.
28120634.summary: Eight studies found that people with multiple sclerosis have higher blood levels of the hormone prolactin than healthy people, varying by region, age and disease length.

32583051.conclusion_quote: This first systematic review of CIDP burden of illness demonstrates the high physical and psychosocial burden of this rare disease.
32583051.summary: This review of 64 studies found that CIDP, a rare nerve disease, causes major physical and emotional burden for patients and high costs for healthcare systems.

34948854.conclusion_quote: We seek to encourage neurologists and specialists in multidisciplinary healthcare teams to prescribe and promote exercise at diagnosis and across all stages of the disease trajectory using prescriptive guidelines as part of comprehensive MS care.
34948854.summary: This review explains the history of exercise for MS and finds it is safe and helps symptoms, urging doctors to prescribe it at every stage.

33392439.conclusion_quote: This umbrella review presents a novel and timely approach to synthesise existing falls literature to identify effective non-pharmacological interventions for people with MS, PD and stroke.
33392439.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of existing studies on non-drug ways to prevent falls in people with MS, Parkinson's disease, or stroke.

27082500.conclusion_quote: In patients with relapsing-remitting MS, alemtuzumab 12 mg was better than subcutaneous interferon beta-1a for the following outcomes assessed at 24 months: relapse-free survival, sustained disease progression-free survival, number of participants with at least one adverse event and number of participants with new or enlarging T2-hyperintense lesions on MRI.
27082500.summary: Three trials with 1713 people found alemtuzumab delayed relapses and disability worsening better than interferon beta-1a in relapsing MS, though slightly more people had side effects.

27491674.conclusion_quote: This systematic review provides an evidence base for trade-offs in the selection of an instrument for assessing self-reported symptoms of depression in research or clinical practice involving people with MS.
27491674.summary: A review of 21 studies found that depression questionnaires for people with MS vary widely in how well they have been tested, so choices must be made carefully.

33325640.conclusion_quote: To our knowledge, this case represents the latest onset of IFNβ-related aHUS in MS patients.
33325640.summary: A man with relapsing MS developed a rare, serious kidney and blood condition after years of interferon beta, and eculizumab helped his kidney function recover.

27543046.conclusion_quote: We provide evidence that overall there is a minimal difference in CMI between persons with MS and those without MS.
27543046.summary: Researchers combined 13 studies and found people with MS perform dual tasks, like walking while thinking, about as well as people without MS overall.

29149804.conclusion_quote: In this first NMA to consider cladribine tablets, ocrelizumab and daclizumab for treatment of RRMS, cladribine tablets are a comparatively effective and safe alternative to other DMTs in both active RRMS and HRA + DAT populations.
29149804.summary: Cladribine tablets reduced relapses by 58 percent versus placebo and performed about as well as other treatments, with safety similar to most alternatives.

31232938.conclusion_quote: This systematic review proposal might provide recent, important, and trusted information for better treatment of patients.
31232938.summary: This protocol plans a review of trials testing whether vitamin A supplements improve symptoms and quality of life in people with multiple sclerosis. No results are reported yet.

30653737.conclusion_quote: Preliminary data suggest that desmopressin might be effective for treating nocturia in patients with MS.
30653737.summary: This review of nine small studies suggests desmopressin may reduce nighttime urination in people with MS, but side effects are common and the evidence is weak.

31517556.conclusion_quote: The results showed that IFN-β can reduce the proportion of Th17 cells, the levels of IL-17 and IL-23 in serum of MS.
31517556.summary: Interferon beta treatment was linked to fewer Th17 immune cells and lower levels of the inflammatory signals IL-17 and IL-23 in people with MS.

37846287.conclusion_quote: Monoclonal antibodies are particularly effective treatments in avoiding recurrence for NMOSD patients, according to this meta-analysis.
37846287.summary: Monoclonal antibody drugs reduced relapses in neuromyelitis optica patients across pooled trials, and their side effects were not clearly worse than those of older immune-suppressing treatments.

26901651.conclusion_quote: Advances in MS registries around the globe allow nationwide population-based studies and will allow worldly comparisons between the prevalence and incidence in different regions that are provided to monitor estimation.
26901651.summary: This review of 68 studies found that multiple sclerosis rates across East, South East and South Asia vary widely, from very low to moderate, with Iran reporting the highest prevalence.

37594495.conclusion_quote: The model of interdisciplinary cooperation between radiologists and neurologists with the aim of a regional standardization of MRI could serve as an example for other regions of Germany in order to optimize MRI for MS.
37594495.summary: German neurologists and radiologists agreed on shared standards for MRI scans in multiple sclerosis, aiming to make scan results comparable and improve teamwork between doctors.

33628508.conclusion_quote: Where possible, physicians need to support and encourage women to pursue their dream of a fulfilling family life, supported where necessary by active interventions for RRMS that are increasingly evidence based.
33628508.summary: An expert panel in Saudi Arabia says many women with MS avoid having children due to misconceptions, and newer treatments give more options for pregnancy and breastfeeding.

34723448.conclusion_quote: Physical activity was associated with improvements in walking ability, general function, balance (including fall risk), depression, sleep, activities of daily living, female sexual function, and aerobic capacity, depending on population enrolled and type of exercise utilized.
34723448.summary: Across people with MS, cerebral palsy, or spinal cord injury, physical activity improved walking, balance, mood, sleep, and daily living, though long-term heart and metabolic health was not studied.

30863357.conclusion_quote: At the moment, there is no available clinically actionable pharmacogenomic biomarker that would enable more personalized treatment of MS.
30863357.summary: Review of 48 studies found no reliable genetic test yet to predict which multiple sclerosis medicines will work best for a patient.

34520000.conclusion_quote: This systematic review reveals that exercise training principles were not respected in the majority of included RCTs.
34520000.summary: Most exercise trials in people with MS did not follow key exercise training principles, and few reported adherence, making their results hard to interpret or repeat.

27160862.conclusion_quote: Smoking habits are significantly associated with MS, although the association is not very strong.
27160862.summary: Smokers, including former and current smokers, had higher odds of developing multiple sclerosis, with risk rising with the amount smoked.

28761631.conclusion_quote: Our study showed that the familial prevalence of MS among Iranian people is relatively high.
28761631.summary: A pooled analysis of 15 Iranian studies estimated that about 11 percent of people with MS have a family member with the disease.

33295123.conclusion_quote: The overall prevalence of primary headaches among patients with MS was considerably high.
33295123.summary: Pooling 16 studies, about 56 percent of people with multiple sclerosis had primary headaches, mostly migraine, suggesting headache screening may help patient care.

33549545.conclusion_quote: This review provides a comprehensive overview of BCTs as the active ingredients in behavior change interventions targeting physical activity in MS.
33549545.summary: This review identified the behavior change methods used in programs that encourage people with multiple sclerosis to be more physically active, to guide future program design.

34505112.conclusion_quote: Ocrelizumab ranked best among all other treatments in terms of reducing ARR and SAEs.
34505112.summary: A pooled analysis of seven trials found that ocrelizumab reduced relapses and serious side effects more than interferon in relapsing MS.

27880972.conclusion_quote: The effects of IFNs-beta and GA in the treatment of people with RRMS, including clinical (e.g. people with relapse, risk to progression) and MRI (Gd-enhancing lesions) measures, seem to be similar or to show only small differences.
27880972.summary: Comparing two early MS drugs, interferon beta and glatiramer acetate, found similar results for relapses and disease progression, though interferon better limited brain lesion growth.

35327341.conclusion_quote: Modest short-term benefits were realized in MS responders to adjunctive therapy with CBD/THC mixtures.
35327341.summary: A review of 28 studies found that cannabinoid mixtures modestly eased spasticity, pain, sleep and bladder problems in MS, and may help repair myelin in lab and animal studies.

34616564.conclusion_quote: Many online recourses regarding physical activity and exercise training for MS were either inconsistent with the established PAGs or did not address the guidelines.
34616564.summary: Most online physical activity information for people with MS did not match expert guidelines, with webpages accurately addressing only about 5 of 18 recommendations.

28963666.conclusion_quote: Despite a considerable heterogeneity of findings, there is evidence that SSR is a useful tool in MS.
28963666.summary: Across 13 studies, about one in three people with MS lacked a skin nerve reflex in at least one limb, and their reflexes were slower than those of healthy people.

34139157.conclusion_quote: We recommend changes in MRI acquisition protocols, such as emphasising the value of three dimensional-fluid-attenuated inversion recovery as the core brain pulse sequence to improve diagnostic accuracy and ability to identify new lesions to monitor treatment effectiveness, and we provide recommendations for the judicious use of gadolinium-based contrast agents for specific clinical purposes.
34139157.summary: Experts updated guidance on using MRI scans in multiple sclerosis, recommending a specific brain scan sequence and careful use of contrast dye for diagnosis and monitoring.

27107751.conclusion_quote: The summarized results of 48 studies demonstrate that sleepiness, as indicated by elevated ESS scores, is less prevalent and less severe than fatigue but is present in a significant proportion of patients with MS.
27107751.summary: Sleepiness is less common and less severe than fatigue in multiple sclerosis, but still affects many patients, so doctors should check both when assessing symptoms.

32129684.conclusion_quote: Available evidence of off-label rituximab use for the treatment of patients with RRMS suggests generally favorable efficacy versus placebo and interferons/glatiramer acetate; however, the poor quality of the included studies limits any robust conclusions.
32129684.summary: A review of studies found rituximab may help relapsing MS compared with placebo and older drugs, but poor study quality means firm conclusions are not possible.

27130689.conclusion_quote: Data limitations were not highlighted in the results, failing to present the uncertainty in the results to users clearly.
27130689.summary: This review found that UK cost estimates for multiple sclerosis drugs rely on uncertain assumptions and rarely test how reliable they are.

26070975.conclusion_quote: This review suggests that balance may improve through exercise interventions, but that the magnitude of the improvements achieved in existing programs may not be sufficient to impact falls outcomes.
26070975.summary: Exercise and balance training may modestly improve balance in people with MS, but the review found no clear reduction in falls.

27941528.conclusion_quote: Active treatments produced statistically significant improvements compared with placebo.
27941528.summary: Pooled trials found that MS treatments reduce relapses and new lesions compared with placebo, and about five patients must be treated for one to benefit.

33847901.conclusion_quote: After adjustment of baseline patient characteristics, the MAIC demonstrated that the efficacy and safety of ozanimod 1.0 mg OD was superior to that of DMF 240 mg BID.
33847901.summary: Using statistical matching of past trial data, ozanimod appeared to work better than dimethyl fumarate for relapses, disability worsening and side effects in relapsing MS.

31389262.conclusion_quote: Despite the limitations illustrated in this article, fingolimod still constitutes a paradigm shift in MS treatment.
31389262.summary: This review covers fingolimod, an early MS pill, discussing its long term benefits, safety concerns, and why newer drugs are being developed.

33552235.conclusion_quote: DMTs for RRMS show efficacy in treating disease activity independent of age as demonstrated by group-level data from DMT clinical trials.
33552235.summary: Pooled data from 26 trials found that multiple sclerosis drugs reduce relapses and brain lesions regardless of patient age, though trials mostly enrol people with active disease.

29141810.conclusion_quote: Under random effect model of meta-analysis, the data showed that the proportion of Th17 cells in PB and levels of serum IL-17 and IL-23 increased among MS patients compared to control subjects.
29141810.summary: Pooling 12 studies, this review found higher levels of a type of immune cell called Th17 and related signalling proteins in people with MS than in healthy people.

32466101.conclusion_quote: Based on the recent literature, PE and IA may be considered as equal treatment possibilities in patients suffering from acute, glucocorticosteroid-unresponsive MS relapses.
32466101.summary: A pooled review found plasma exchange and immunoadsorption each helped roughly 77 to 81 percent of people with MS relapses that did not respond to steroids.

34441245.conclusion_quote: Although the MS community is getting closer to a standardization of MRI protocols, there is still a relatively wide heterogeneity among NR, with particular reference to contrast administration, which must be overcome to guarantee an adequate quality of patients' care in MS.
34441245.summary: Neuroradiologists surveyed about MS MRI scans found good adherence to guidelines for T2 sequences, but wide variation in gadolinium contrast use.

34264791.conclusion_quote: Several therapeutic formulations, including VSL#3, Lactobacillus paracasei, Bifidobacterium animalis, E. coli Nissle 1917, and Prevotella histicola , emerged as the most promising.
34264791.summary: A review of 37 studies found that several probiotic and gut bacteria treatments, such as VSL#3 and Prevotella histicola, look most promising for MS, though evidence is limited.

26598432.conclusion_quote: This systematic review highlights the paucity of well-designed studies, which are needed to evaluate the available MS rehabilitative therapies.
26598432.summary: Reviewed studies found some exercise, balance and breathing programs may help walking, balance and daily function, but high quality evidence is still scarce.

33844056.conclusion_quote: The availability of vaccines has raised some concerns among neurologists regarding the safety and efficacy of vaccination in patients with multiple sclerosis (MS) taking immunomodulatory or immunosuppressive therapies.
33844056.summary: Experts wrote consensus advice on whether people with multiple sclerosis taking immune medicines can safely and effectively receive COVID-19 vaccines.

28385181.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results demonstrated that rs1800896, rs1800871 and rs1800872 polymorphisms may not be the risk factor for the development of MS in both the populations.
28385181.summary: A pooled analysis of nine studies found that three variants of the IL10 gene were not clearly linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

27033666.conclusion_quote: Our data show that H. pylori infection and MS is negatively correlated, especially in Western countries.
27033666.summary: Pooling nine studies, this analysis found multiple sclerosis patients were less often infected with H. pylori bacteria than healthy controls, especially in Western countries.

34509134.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of these consensus guidelines attempt to optimize the health care and management of MS patients by setting how MSCU should work in our region.
34509134.summary: Latin American neurology experts agreed on recommendations for how specialist multiple sclerosis care units should be set up and run in the region.

28844164.conclusion_quote: There is an extensive long-term experience on fingolimod use in clinical practice demonstrating the favorable benefit-risk of this drug.
28844164.summary: Review of extended experience with fingolimod, an oral MS drug, finding its benefits outweigh its risks when experienced doctors choose patients carefully and manage side effects.

29128525.conclusion_quote: Although respiratory muscle training can improve maximal respiratory pressure in MS and lung volume recruitment can slow the decline in vital capacity, evidence is lacking to recommend specific respiratory rehabilitation programs adapted to the level of disability induced by the disease.
29128525.summary: A review of 11 studies found breathing exercises may improve breathing muscle strength in MS, but there is not yet enough evidence to recommend specific respiratory rehabilitation programs.

29176905.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis reveals strong evidence that oMP is not inferior to ivMP in increasing the proportion of patients experiencing clinical improvement at day 28.
29176905.summary: Oral methylprednisolone worked about as well as IV steroids for MS relapses and caused similar side effects, though oral users reported more insomnia.

31405369.conclusion_quote: Fatal adverse events related to treatment with alemtuzumab occur more frequently than previously published in the literature.
31405369.summary: Researchers reviewed a European drug safety database and found more deaths linked to alemtuzumab in MS than previously reported, often within the first month after treatment.

26513633.conclusion_quote: Our results highlight the improvement of clinical and radiological findings in treated patients (p < 0.005), confirming NTZ efficacy.
26513633.summary: Natalizumab appeared to improve clinical and scan findings in people with MS, but its safety needs further study.

25839039.conclusion_quote: The finding that there is a lack of evidence pertaining to changes in the cognitive domain as well as to the specific consequences of CMI in MS was noted.
25839039.summary: This review found that people with MS struggle more when doing two tasks at once, like walking while talking, but research on thinking effects and outcomes is limited.

25998261.conclusion_quote: This review identified conflicting findings in the published literature about the effectiveness of various forms of cognitive rehabilitation techniques used in patients with MS.
25998261.summary: This review of 33 studies found that cognitive rehabilitation in MS often showed some improvement, but the evidence is conflicting and too weak to draw firm conclusions.

28658410.conclusion_quote: The current criteria overestimated the frequency of BMS and, for that reason, this highlights the importance of validating the diagnostic methods practiced.
28658410.summary: Reviewing 31 studies, researchers found benign MS estimates vary widely, many people have thinking problems and brain changes, and current diagnostic rules likely overcount cases.

34354581.conclusion_quote: Compared to the control arm, monoclonal antibody therapy showed a significantly better outcome in restraining the HR for relapse among patients with NMOSD but insignificant effects in NMOSD patients with seronegative APQ4-IgG.
34354581.summary: Antibody drugs reduced relapses in people with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, especially those with the AQP4 antibody, and did not increase side effects overall.

26000455.conclusion_quote: The IL23R polymorphisms rs10889677, rs7517847, and the IL12B polymorphism rs3212227 are not associated with MS risk.
26000455.summary: Pooling seven studies, this analysis found that three immune system gene variants were not clearly linked to MS risk, though one showed a weak association overall.

27568030.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis indicates that the ACE I/D polymorphism is not associated with susceptibility to MS in Europeans of Slavic origin.
27568030.summary: A pooled analysis of four studies found that a common ACE gene variant does not appear to increase the risk of developing multiple sclerosis in people of Slavic European origin.

26896750.conclusion_quote: The cumulative evidence supports that exercise training is associated with changes in muscular (small in magnitude) and cardiorespiratory (moderate in magnitude) fitness outcomes in persons with MS.
26896750.summary: Pooling 20 controlled trials, this review found that exercise training modestly improves muscle strength and more noticeably improves heart and lung fitness in people with MS.

32442883.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of these consensus guidelines are intended to optimize the management and treatment of MS patients during their reproductive age in Argentina.
32442883.summary: Argentine neurologists developed consensus recommendations on planning pregnancy, pregnancy itself, and the postpartum period for women with multiple sclerosis.

27188999.conclusion_quote: This study suggested that the IL7R C allele was associated with an increased risk of MS and larger-scale studies of populations are needed to explore the roles played by the IL7R T244I polymorphism during the pathogenesis of MS.
27188999.summary: This review of 17 studies found that a genetic variant in the IL7R gene, called the C allele, is linked to a higher chance of developing MS, especially in Europeans.

31924590.conclusion_quote: Understanding the needs and preferences of CIS/RRMS patients regarding DMT attributes and non-treatment related attributes are important to improve treatment decision-making and reduce non-adherence.
31924590.summary: Review of 24 studies found patients with early or relapsing MS value treatment effectiveness, dosing method and few side effects, while forgetfulness and side effects often cause missed doses.

32249718.conclusion_quote: In the present narrative review, we updated our published umbrella review, showing that body mass index in childhood and adolescence and anti-viral capsid antigen (anti-VCA) IgG seropositivity are additional credible risk factors of MS.
32249718.summary: This review of earlier studies suggests smoking, past mono infection, Epstein Barr virus exposure, and childhood weight may raise MS risk, while genetic studies hint at vitamin D.

27424509.conclusion_quote: Smoking is associated with MS risk.
27424509.summary: This pooled analysis of 33 studies found that people who smoke are more likely to develop multiple sclerosis than people who do not smoke.

27456877.conclusion_quote: It was demonstrated that the IL7R T244I polymorphism was associated with susceptibility to MS.
27456877.summary: A variant in the IL7R gene, rs6897932, appears linked to multiple sclerosis risk, according to a pooled analysis of 11 studies.

29764226.conclusion_quote: Four oral DMTs: fingolimod, teriflunomide, dimethyl fumarate, and cladribine have been approved by the regulatory agencies.
29764226.summary: This review explains four approved pill treatments for relapsing multiple sclerosis, their benefits and safety, and how they fit into treatment across the Middle East and North Africa.

27723651.conclusion_quote: Excess body weight during childhood and adolescence was associated with an increased risk of MS; severe obesity demonstrated a stronger risk.
27723651.summary: Pooling five studies, this paper found that being overweight or obese as a child or teenager is linked to higher later risk of MS, especially in women.

27175669.conclusion_quote: In summary, we found that the genetic variant rs703842 in CYP27B1 is associated with MS risk in Caucasians.
27175669.summary: Analysis of seven studies found that carrying the C version of gene variant rs703842 in CYP27B1 is linked to a lower chance of developing MS in Caucasians.

31816524.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of these consensus guidelines attempt to optimize the health care and management of patients with MS in Argentina.
31816524.summary: Argentine MS specialists agreed on practical recommendations covering diagnosis, prognosis, personalised treatment, spotting treatment failure, and drug safety monitoring.

26358158.conclusion_quote: Exercise therapy, and particularly endurance, mixed, or 'other' training, may reduce self reported fatigue.
26358158.summary: Exercise reduced tiredness in people with MS compared with no exercise and did not appear to cause harm, though study quality was only moderate.

31949442.conclusion_quote: Cell transplantation with aMSCs in MS patients is safe, with the largest benefit profile obtained in patients with aMSCs intrathecal injection.
31949442.summary: A review of nine small studies found that transplanting a patient's own stem cells into MS patients was safe, with better results when given intrathecally, into the spinal fluid.

29032493.conclusion_quote: Internationally, a large number of health economic assessments of DMTs in RRMS were available, yielding difficult to compare, and at times conflicting, results.
29032493.summary: This review of 37 studies found that cost effectiveness analyses of disease modifying drugs for relapsing MS were numerous but hard to compare, with sometimes conflicting results.

26238166.conclusion_quote: In this study, the average multiple sclerosis patient receiving first-generation disease-modifying treatment or no disease-modifying treatment lost approximately 0.7% of brain volume/year, well above rates associated with normal aging (0.1%-0.3% of brain volume/year).
26238166.summary: Across studies, MS patients lost about 0.7% of brain volume per year, much faster than normal aging, whether or not they were treated with standard MS medicines.

25802867.conclusion_quote: This review exposes a gap in our understanding of the risk factors associated with the onset of PPMS, our current knowledge being predominated by relapsing-onset MS.
25802867.summary: A review of twenty studies found Epstein Barr virus exposure may raise the risk of relapsing MS, but research on risk factors for progressive MS onset is scarce.

25620137.conclusion_quote: Disease specific instruments are available for incorporation into the clinical setting for MS and SCI patients with neurogenic bladder.
25620137.summary: This review found 18 validated questionnaires for bladder problems in people with MS or spinal cord injury, though many are only available in English and few cover prolapse symptoms.

34139567.conclusion_quote: In this consensus statement, we provide updated recommendations on multiple sclerosis (MS) management during the COVID-19 crisis and the post-pandemic period applicable to neurology services around the world.
34139567.summary: Thirteen multiple sclerosis experts used an online consensus process to issue updated advice on managing multiple sclerosis during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

33237365.conclusion_quote: This letter is written to inform an important error in the methodology section of a systematic review article entitled "Treatment Effects for Dysphagia in Adults with Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review" by Dalal Alali et al., which consequently resulted in a precise paradox probably and inadvertently affecting the search strategy, results, discussion, and/or conclusion of this systematic review.
33237365.summary: This letter flags a methodology error in a review of swallowing treatments for people with MS, which may have affected its search, results and conclusions.

30621765.conclusion_quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis would bring insight into the potential of this outcome as a marker of disease evolution.
30621765.summary: This protocol plans a review of whether wearable motion sensors measuring walking can show how severe multiple sclerosis is over time.

26281954.conclusion_quote: This review suggests that physiotherapy may be effective for the rehabilitation of people with progressive multiple sclerosis.
26281954.summary: A review of 13 trials found that physiotherapy, such as exercise and stretching, may help people with progressive MS, though larger studies are needed.

35280300.conclusion_quote: Through weighted co-expression network analysis and ssGSEA analysis, CD56 bright natural killer cell was identified as the key immune infiltration factor in MS, whether in GM or WM.
35280300.summary: Researchers compared gene activity in grey and white matter lesions of people with MS and found similar networks, with CD56 bright natural killer cells appearing central in both.

26486929.conclusion_quote: There is a lack of evidence to address the review question on the efficacy of sodium channel blockers for people with MS.
26486929.summary: Only one small trial of lamotrigine was found, so there is not enough evidence to show whether sodium channel blockers protect nerves or slow disability in MS.

25900414.conclusion_quote: There is moderate-quality evidence to support that dimethyl fumarate at a dose of 240 mg orally three times daily or twice daily reduces both the number of patients with a relapse and the annualised relapse rate over two years of treatment in comparison with placebo.
25900414.summary: Two trials found dimethyl fumarate reduced relapses in relapsing MS over two years compared with placebo, with common mild side effects and some uncommon low white blood cell counts.

25935887.conclusion_quote: The excess mortality in MS relative to the general population has not changed over the past 50 years.
25935887.summary: People with multiple sclerosis die at about 2.8 times the rate of the general population, and this excess has not shrunk over the past 50 years.

34626224.conclusion_quote: Although not every patient should be treated with HE DMTs at the initial stages of the disease, early and unrestricted access to HE DMTs with a positive benefit-risk profile and a reasonable value proposition will provide the freedom of choice for an appropriate treatment based on a shared decision between expert physicians and patients.
34626224.summary: Experts agree that people with MS should get strong, early treatments when suitable, decided together with their doctor, rather than being held back by reimbursement limits.

25710014.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis demonstrated that MS was significantly associated with fracture risk.
25710014.summary: Combining earlier studies, this analysis found that people with multiple sclerosis have a higher risk of broken bones, especially in women and in those taking certain medicines.

30192317.conclusion_quote: People with MS respond to resistance training with consistent strength gains.
30192317.summary: Pooled results from 11 trials show that strength training increases muscle strength and walking speed in people with multiple sclerosis, though study quality varied.

26021323.conclusion_quote: The new synthetic small molecule agents such as laquinimod, masitinib and siponimod with different mechanism of actions can be administered orally rather than by injection.
26021323.summary: This review summarises three newer tablet-based MS drugs, laquinimod, masitinib and siponimod, covering how they work and their clinical trial results so far.

38011404.conclusion_quote: There is evidence for the effectiveness of fingolimod in reducing annualized relapse rates (ARRs) and improving magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings, but the evidence does not support the effectiveness of teriflunomide and further studies are required to determine its efficacy.
38011404.summary: Three studies found fingolimod reduced relapses more than injectable interferon but caused more side effects, while teriflunomide showed weaker evidence of benefit.

37127916.conclusion_quote: By investigating the shared genetics of psoriasis and MS, along with their modifiable risk factors, our findings will advance innovations in treatment for patients suffering from comorbidities.
37127916.summary: People with psoriasis have a higher risk of developing MS, and the two diseases share genetic factors involving inflammation pathways that may point to new treatments.

29423611.conclusion_quote: On the other hand, overwhelming pieces of evidence confirm that the reactivations often drive the demyelinating plaques by initiating microglial inflammation.
29423611.summary: This review of 70 studies finds that reactivation of human endogenous retroviruses appears to trigger inflammation and nerve damage in multiple sclerosis, rather than directly causing the disease.

27491475.conclusion_quote: This is considerably higher than in the general population; thus, more research on this topic is needed to further understand the relationship between MS and uveitis.
27491475.summary: Reviewed studies on MS and uveitis, finding both conditions occur together far more often than in the general population, though the link needs further research.

25973275.conclusion_quote: This review reveals the gaps that still exist in the epidemiological knowledge of NMO in the world.
25973275.summary: Neuromyelitis optica is rare, and the few studies on how often it occurs worldwide were low quality and inconsistent, so reliable global figures are still lacking.

28027680.conclusion_quote: In this comprehensive meta-analysis of real-world studies in RRMS, IFN-beta-1a IM, IFN-beta-1a SC and IFN-beta-1b SC had similar clinical profiles.
28027680.summary: Pooled studies of everyday patients found three interferon beta drugs gave similar relapse and disability results, though one caused far fewer antibody reactions that can weaken treatment.

32197022.conclusion_quote: Understanding how multiple sclerosis patients experience fatigue, the cause of their fatigue, as well as how they self-manage their fatigue will better inform healthcare providers and patients.
32197022.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of studies on how people with multiple sclerosis experience fatigue and manage it themselves.

30315481.conclusion_quote: The two guidelines offer a similar view and similar recommendations for the most relevant and common questions of clinical practice.
30315481.summary: This editorial compares new European and American guidelines on MS treatment, finding they largely agree, with differences on pregnancy, mitoxantrone, and secondary progressive MS.

25623244.conclusion_quote: This review highlights substantial gaps in the epidemiological knowledge of comorbidity in MS worldwide.
25623244.summary: A review of 249 studies found that comorbidities in MS are reported inconsistently, with major gaps in knowledge, especially in Central and South America, Asia and Africa.

33245423.conclusion_quote: despite a minor error in wording, our systematic review provided an accurate reflection of the literature at that point in time.
33245423.summary: The authors reply to a letter criticising their review of swallowing treatments in people with MS, saying one wording error did not change its overall accuracy.

25583845.conclusion_quote: This review confirms that psychiatric comorbidity, particularly depression and anxiety, is common in MS.
25583845.summary: A review of 118 studies found that depression and anxiety are common in people with MS, while other psychiatric conditions are less studied.

30786783.conclusion_quote: This analysis has demonstrated that cladribine tablets have comparable relative efficacy to other highly efficacious DMTs in active RRMS across all subpopulations, thus validating the comparative effectiveness results from previous network meta-analysis.
30786783.summary: Researchers compared cladribine tablets with four other MS drugs and found it works about as well as those drugs in people with active relapsing MS.

35284088.conclusion_quote: Expert recommendations based on their clinical experience will be more helpful to clinicians in clinical settings regarding the usage of teriflunomide and provide valuable insights applicable in day-to-day practice.
35284088.summary: Gulf region MS experts reviewed teriflunomide and recommended it for adults with early or relapsing MS, weighing cost, adherence, safety monitoring and coronavirus status.

33143012.conclusion_quote: These results suggest consistency in MRI-detectible regional GM loss across multiple MS studies, and the estimated effect sizes and symmetries can help design prospective studies to test specific hypotheses.
33143012.summary: Pooling many brain scan studies, researchers found consistent grey matter loss in specific brain regions of people with MS or early symptoms, linked partly to disease duration and age.

29917273.conclusion_quote: Preliminary data suggests beneficial effects of catheterization on the urological outcome in patients with MS.
29917273.summary: Review of four small studies found catheter use improved quality of life, bladder emptying, and leakage in people with MS, but evidence is limited.

32442886.conclusion_quote: Monoclonal antibody therapy was effective and safe in NMOSD treatment.
32442886.summary: Pooled trials found monoclonal antibody drugs reduced relapses and disability in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, with fewer serious side effects than placebo.

31151870.conclusion_quote: Cooccurrence of a seizure in a patient with MS may complicate the management process.
31151870.summary: This expert consensus from Iran gives practical advice on managing seizures in people with multiple sclerosis, based on recent research and expert opinion.

30819213.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that MDS and MS are immunopathologically distinct entities in the majority of cases.
30819213.summary: Researchers reviewed spinal fluid test results from people with Schilder's disease and found they usually differ from multiple sclerosis, suggesting it is a separate condition.

26566789.conclusion_quote: A sufficient explanatory model of fatigue in caMS is lacking as studies in this area are few and diverse.
26566789.summary: Fatigue in children with MS is poorly understood, a review of 12 studies found it linked mainly to low mood, not to clinical factors.

26822746.conclusion_quote: In patients presenting with a clinically isolated syndrome, MRI can support and substitute clinical information in the diagnosis of multiple sclerosis by showing disease dissemination in space and time and by helping to exclude disorders that can mimic multiple sclerosis.
26822746.summary: Expert consensus guidelines explain how MRI scans can help confirm multiple sclerosis in people with a first suspicious episode by showing damage spread across time and different brain areas.

27003123.conclusion_quote: There was low-quality evidence to support that teriflunomide at a dose of 7 mg/day or 14 mg/day as monotherapy reduces both the number of participants with at least one relapse and the annualized relapse rate over one year or two years of treatment in comparison with placebo.
27003123.summary: Teriflunomide, a pill for relapsing MS, reduced relapses compared with placebo, though the evidence quality was low and comparisons with other drugs were unclear.

31590282.conclusion_quote: Data on IA are still sparse, but several studies indicate comparable efficacy between both apheresis procedures.
31590282.summary: This review found that plasma exchange and immunoadsorption can help treat MS relapses that do not respond to steroids, but most evidence is from small or unblinded studies.

31530036.conclusion_quote: The authors present an update to our guidance, focussing on the management of relapsing-remitting RRMS.
31530036.summary: An expert panel in Qatar updates advice on choosing disease modifying drugs for relapsing MS, depending on how active each patient's disease is.

26150166.conclusion_quote: GSTT1 null genotype is associated with MS in Caucasian populations; however, no association was found between MS and polymorphisms of MTHFR, GSTM1, and GSTP1.
26150166.summary: Some gene variants, specifically a GSTT1 deletion, were linked to higher MS risk in people of European descent, but other tested gene variants showed no link to MS.

27759810.conclusion_quote: African ancestry is a condition inherent in the patient and should be considered as an initial clinical characteristic affecting prognosis, and influencing which therapeutic decision to make in initial phases.
27759810.summary: A review of 14 studies found that people of African descent with MS often have more disability and faster progression than people of European descent.

39470772.conclusion_quote: The ICF linkage reveals a broad spectrum of functioning covered by the guideline-recommended instruments and facilitates the selection of appropriate instruments for the affected persons.
39470772.summary: A review of MS guideline outcome tools found they measure many aspects of daily functioning, but rarely cover environmental factors such as home or workplace conditions.

32430188.conclusion_quote: Physiotherapists are able to support the management by: (a) having a greater understanding of MSRF and (b) being able to help patients manage the factors that influence it.
32430188.summary: Review of nine studies found MS fatigue affects body, thinking and social life, and coping strategies shape its impact on patients.

25969865.conclusion_quote: Based on the available data, we conclude that CPET is feasible provided that the CPET modality is tailored to the physical abilities of the patient.
25969865.summary: Review of 46 studies found that exercise heart and lung testing is feasible and safe for people with MS when tailored to their abilities.

28958607.conclusion_quote: Substantial progress has been made since our previous review regarding the identification of effective treatments for cognitive impairments in persons with MS.
28958607.summary: A review of 40 studies found that cognitive rehabilitation has some effective options for attention and memory problems in MS, but stronger trials are still needed.

30900096.conclusion_quote: The correct affiliation is presented here.
30900096.summary: This correction notice fixes a missing author affiliation for Maria Pia Amato in an Italian consensus paper on cognitive assessment in multiple sclerosis.

30825477.conclusion_quote: Thus, there is little generalizability or transportability research supporting either behavioral approach for managing cognitive dysfunction in this population under real-world conditions (i.e., as a standard-of-care).
30825477.summary: This review examines exercise and cognitive rehabilitation for thinking problems in MS, finds little real-world evidence, and proposes a roadmap for future trials.

32220214.conclusion_quote: Siponimod offers a significant therapeutic advance that may slow disease progression compared to other DMTs in an EXPAND-like population with secondary progressive disease.
32220214.summary: This study compared siponimod with other MS drugs in secondary progressive MS using adjusted trial data. Siponimod slowed disability worsening more than some drugs, and it numerically reduced relapses versus most, though not always significantly.

26286700.conclusion_quote: OTC anti-oxidants EGCG and ALA show the most consistent benefit, however only in preclinical studies.
26286700.summary: Review of antioxidant supplements sold without prescription found benefits in animal studies but no proof they help MS patients.

27448520.conclusion_quote: Some studies found improvements in muscle strength, functional capacity, coordination, resistance, balance, and some areas of MSSS-88.
27448520.summary: A review of nine randomised trials found some gains in strength, balance and daily function from vibration training in people with MS, but the evidence is limited.

25533302.conclusion_quote: The complexity of understanding cancer risk in MS is augmented by inconsistencies in study design, and the relative paucity of age, sex and ethnicity-specific risk estimates from which the strong impact of age on the incidence of cancers can be assessed.
25533302.summary: This review of 38 studies found cancer rates in people with MS varied widely, with some cancers more common and others less common than expected.

26488634.conclusion_quote: Intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) may have some potential roles in this regard.
26488634.summary: This review examines whether immunoglobulin infusions could slow brain shrinkage in multiple sclerosis, and suggests they may have a potential role.

33378076.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of this consensus guidelines attempt to optimize the care of SPMS patients in Argentina.
33378076.summary: Argentinian neurologists agreed on recommendations for defining and following people with secondary progressive MS, aiming to make care more consistent across the country.

32940121.conclusion_quote: Recommended risk reduction and management strategies for infections include screening at diagnosis and before starting a new DMD, prophylaxis where appropriate, monitoring and early diagnosis.
32940121.summary: Expert doctors agreed on advice for spotting and preventing infections such as herpes, tuberculosis and urinary infections in people with MS taking disease-modifying drugs.

27492048.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, teriflunomide significantly reduces annualized relapse rates and disability progression with a similar safety and tolerability profile to placebo.
27492048.summary: Teriflunomide reduced relapses and slowed disability worsening in relapsing MS, with side effects like diarrhea and hair thinning, but serious adverse events were similar to placebo.

29119763.conclusion_quote: Conclusions there is incomplete evidence of the efficacy and safety of medical use of cannabis in the clinical contexts considered in this review.
29119763.summary: Cannabis showed fairly reliable relief of multiple sclerosis spasticity and pain, but evidence for chronic neuropathic pain and chemotherapy nausea was weak, and the safety evidence is incomplete.

33721957.conclusion_quote: Sixteen recommendations for the diagnosis and treatment of DON were formulated, including classification and diagnosis, therapies in acute and chronic phases, and the follow-up management, which has important guiding significance for the improvement of clinical treatment and reduction of the recurrence rate.
33721957.summary: A new Chinese guideline gives sixteen recommendations for diagnosing and treating demyelinating optic neuritis, aiming to lower recurrence and improve vision outcomes.

26305459.conclusion_quote: Moderate- to high-quality evidence from two small trials shows that plasma exchange provides significant short-term improvement in disability, clinical impairment, and motor nerve conduction velocity in CIDP but rapid deterioration may occur afterwards.
26305459.summary: Plasma exchange, which filters the blood, gave brief gains in disability and nerve function in CIDP, but some patients worsened later and side effects occurred.

33582965.conclusion_quote: Alterations in the cortico-striatal-thalamic networks, sensorimotor network, and insula may be involved in the common pathogenesis of RRMS and PPMS.
33582965.summary: Brain scans of people with relapsing and primary progressive MS show shrinkage in networks linked to movement and thinking, with some differences between the two types.

25533299.conclusion_quote: Population-based studies that report age, sex and ethnicity-specific estimates of incidence and prevalence are needed in jurisdictions worldwide.
25533299.summary: Researchers reviewed 61 studies and found psoriasis and thyroid disease were the most common autoimmune conditions in people with MS, with possible links to bowel disease and uveitis.

25786797.conclusion_quote: This study formally shows that in RRMS higher treatment effects are associated with characteristics of earlier (lower age and Expanded Disability Status Scale) and more active (higher gadolinium activity) disease.
25786797.summary: Pooling six drug trials, the researchers found that MS drugs worked better in younger people, people with more active inflammation on scans, and those with milder disability.

25370720.conclusion_quote: The evidence for an association between high SES and increased MS risk is inconsistent but with some indication of a stronger effect in countries and time periods with higher inequality.
25370720.summary: Researchers reviewed 21 studies and found that links between high social status and multiple sclerosis risk were inconsistent, possibly stronger where income inequality is higher.

33727274.conclusion_quote: We have followed an inclusive, systematic and transparent process to develop the LEAP-MS intervention that enables detailed description of components, context and guiding principles to inform ongoing evaluation.
33727274.summary: Researchers developed an online physical activity program for people with progressive MS, combining online tools with physiotherapy coaching, based on interviews with patients, carers and therapists.

27553873.conclusion_quote: Effects of IFN-β1α therapy are associated with a statistically significant impact on baseline median T2 lesion volume.
27553873.summary: Pooling 10 trials, interferon beta 1a modestly reduced relapses in relapsing MS, a benefit linked to baseline MRI lesion size, but it caused more side effects.

26983008.conclusion_quote: SLDMDs were associated with reduced PBVC slope over time in RRMS, regardless of the period considered.
26983008.summary: This review of trials found that second line multiple sclerosis drugs slowed brain shrinkage over time more than placebo or first line drugs did.

29721338.conclusion_quote: In MS patients, qualitative and quantitative modifications may be present in any kind of decision-making task and can appear independently of other cognitive measures.
29721338.summary: Researchers reviewed 12 studies and found people with MS often make poorer decisions than healthy people, and these problems can occur separately from other thinking difficulties.

30852304.conclusion_quote: The present findings limit the protective role of CR against the impact of the brain damage to selected aspects of cognition (those related to lexical access and cognitive flexibility) in MS.
30852304.summary: This review found that cognitive reserve, such as education, only partly protects thinking skills from brain damage in MS, mainly word fluency.

26092914.conclusion_quote: The core clinical characteristics required for patients with NMOSD with AQP4-IgG include clinical syndromes or MRI findings related to optic nerve, spinal cord, area postrema, other brainstem, diencephalic, or cerebral presentations.
26092914.summary: Experts from around the world agreed on new rules for diagnosing neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorders, a condition separate from MS, using antibody testing and brain and spinal scans.

25712347.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis suggests that exercise improves walking speed and endurance in pwMS.
25712347.summary: Across 13 trials, exercise helped people with MS walk faster and farther, but not on a timed 25 foot walk or up and go test.

29085589.conclusion_quote: Research to date generally supports the role of riboflavin in MS outcomes.
29085589.summary: This review found that riboflavin, a vitamin, may help people with MS, with supplements linked to better motor function, but more human studies are needed.

30179270.conclusion_quote: At a time when disease progression represents the target for future interventions in MS, establishment of more quantitative and objective outcomes remains a key priority of MS research.
30179270.summary: Pooled placebo data from three MS trials found that disability worsened less in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe or North America, while simple walking tests showed no such difference.

35274837.conclusion_quote: This study has revealed that NMOSD experts in Korea principally follow the available treatment guidelines.
35274837.summary: Korean NMOSD specialists mostly follow official guidelines for diagnosis and treatment, but differ on monitoring, steroid tapering, pregnancy care, and follow up scans.

26039238.conclusion_quote: We conclude that the CD24 226 C>T polymorphism increases the risk of MS, while the 1527-1528 TG>del polymorphism seems to have a protective role against MS, suggesting that these two polymorphisms can be used as predictive biomarkers for MS development.
26039238.summary: A CD24 gene variant (226 C>T) was linked to higher MS risk, while another variant (TG deletion) appeared to lower risk.

29766386.conclusion_quote: While there are no formal guidelines published regarding the assessment of cognitive function in MS, on the basis of an expert opinion meeting, held in Milan (Italy) on July 4, 2016, we report the recommendations of a panel of Italian experts including MS neurologists and neuropsychologists for the assessment and follow-up of cognitive function in adult MS subjects.
29766386.summary: Italian MS experts met in 2016 and agreed on recommendations for how doctors should test and monitor thinking and memory problems in adults with multiple sclerosis.

34773597.conclusion_quote: The NMA results suggest that complement component 5 (C5) inhibition prevents NMOSD relapses more effectively than broader mechanisms of action.
34773597.summary: Comparing approved NMOSD drugs, eculizumab, which blocks complement, reduced relapses more than satralizumab or inebilizumab in adults with AQP4 positive disease.

31928606.conclusion_quote: We hope that these first Portuguese magnetic resonance imaging guidelines will contribute to optimize multiple sclerosis management and improve patient care in Portugal.
31928606.summary: Portuguese experts created standard MRI scanning protocols and reporting guidelines to help doctors diagnose and monitor multiple sclerosis more consistently across hospitals.

34297142.conclusion_quote: Our recommendations are based on current scientific evidence and apply to those medications approved in wide parts of Europe, particularly German-speaking countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland).
34297142.summary: Experts from German-speaking countries updated their 2021 advice on choosing drugs that slow multiple sclerosis, based on current scientific evidence.

25387069.conclusion_quote: RRMS patients treated with glatiramer have the lowest odds of experiencing AEs, while patients taking DMF or teriflunomide have similar, higher odds of developing AEs, suggesting that patients treated with glatiramer may have higher QoL than patients under DMF or teriflunomide.
25387069.summary: Combining three trials of 3737 relapsing MS patients, glatiramer caused fewer side effects than dimethyl fumarate or teriflunomide, which had similar, higher rates.

32844631.conclusion_quote: Our results provide an evidence of an association between multiple sclerosis and the PVT1 rs759648 allele in the populations of Russian and Tatars from the Republic of Bashkortostan.
32844631.summary: A genetic variant called PVT1 rs759648 was linked to higher MS risk in Russian and Tatar people from Bashkortostan, while three other variants showed no link.

32162578.conclusion_quote: The generation of this thematic framework with multi-expert perspectives can bolster the quality and scope of exercise studies in MS that may ultimately improve the daily lives of people with MS.
32162578.summary: An international group of MS exercise experts met and identified five priority themes to improve exercise research, with expert groups now developing recommendations for each.

26437396.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, for the first time we provide evidence of a consistent dysregulation of splicing-related genes in MS and we discuss its possible implications in modulating specific AS events in MS susceptibility genes.
26437396.summary: Researchers combined existing gene studies and found that genes controlling how RNA is processed are consistently altered in people with multiple sclerosis.

26393519.conclusion_quote: Optimal PPMS study methods involve appropriate patient selection, especially regarding the PPMS phenotype and progression rate.
