26393519.summary: Previous trials in primary progressive MS may have failed partly because of how patients were chosen and how progression was measured. Combined measures of function may detect progression better.

31517571.conclusion_quote: Rates of diagnostic and therapeutic care, and survival after AMI were lower in the MS population than in a matched population.
31517571.summary: People with multiple sclerosis who had a heart attack were less likely to receive heart procedures and recommended medicines and more likely to die afterward than matched people without MS.

31746485.conclusion_quote: UDS represents an important diagnostic tool for MS patients and is particularly useful to evaluate the pattern of LUT dysfunction in high-risk patients.
31746485.summary: An expert panel agreed that urodynamic testing is a useful tool for assessing bladder problems in people with multiple sclerosis, especially those at high risk.

31289819.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, early complement pathway gene variants were consistently associated with structural and functional measures of multiple sclerosis severity.
31289819.summary: Genetic variants in early complement pathway genes, such as C3, C1QA and CR1, were linked to eye nerve damage and vision loss in people with multiple sclerosis.

29103823.conclusion_quote: Results outlined the importance of confirmed genes to understand signaling pathways in MS disease and shed light on their utility to develop new drugs targets.
29103823.summary: A review of earlier pooled studies found that 15 candidate genes are linked to multiple sclerosis risk, while 14 others showed no clear link.

25854331.conclusion_quote: There is currently limited evidence on the efficacy of telerehabilitation in improving functional activities, fatigue and quality of life in adults with MS.
25854331.summary: Review of nine trials found weak evidence that remote rehabilitation programmes may reduce fatigue and improve daily functioning and quality of life in people with MS, with no side effects reported.

31209474.conclusion_quote: In this review, we provide the clinicians and researchers with a practical guide to enhance the proper recognition of multiple sclerosis lesions, including a thorough definition and illustration of typical MRI features, as well as a discussion of red flags suggestive of alternative diagnoses.
31209474.summary: This review gives doctors and researchers a practical guide to recognising MS lesions on brain and spinal scans, and to spotting signs that point to other conditions instead.

30301382.conclusion_quote: Sensor-based balance and mobility assessment are valid in comparison with reference standard techniques and are reliable to measure performance in the MS population.
30301382.summary: Researchers reviewed 33 studies showing that wearable sensors can reliably and accurately track walking and balance in people with MS, helping detect problems in everyday life.

31943361.conclusion_quote: Multidisciplinary management for patients with NLUTD due to MS is advised, including urologists, neurologists, rehabilitation, and nurses.
31943361.summary: Experts agreed that bladder problems in people with MS should be found early and managed by a team including urologists, neurologists, rehabilitation specialists and nurses.

27000232.conclusion_quote: The meta-analysis indicates that the T allele, CT and TT genotype of polymorphism of IL4 rs2243250 (C/T) may reduce the risk of MS in Caucasian populations, while polymorphisms of IL4 I3(709)*VNTR and IL4R rs1801275 may not associated with risk of MS in Caucasian populations.
27000232.summary: A pooled analysis of ten studies found one IL4 gene variant linked to lower MS risk in people of European descent, while two other variants showed no link.

25533301.conclusion_quote: This review suggests that seizure disorders and sleep disorders are common in MS, but highlights gaps in the epidemiological knowledge of these conditions in MS worldwide.
25533301.summary: This review of studies found that seizures and sleep disorders are common in people with multiple sclerosis, though research from many regions of the world is limited.

26564433.conclusion_quote: A brain MR imaging with gadolinium is recommended for the diagnosis of MS.
26564433.summary: International experts updated MRI guidelines for diagnosing and monitoring multiple sclerosis, recommending brain scans with contrast dye and spinal cord scans when brain results are unclear.

32564333.conclusion_quote: Where possible, a patient planning pregnancy can be switched to a DMD considered safe in this setting.
32564333.summary: Gulf region experts give recommendations for managing MS medicines around pregnancy and breastfeeding, including switching to safer drugs when planning pregnancy and using interferon beta during pregnancy when needed.

26160450.conclusion_quote: Meta-analysis showed that there is no evidence that alcohol consumption is associated with an increased risk of multiple sclerosis.
26160450.summary: Pooling ten studies, researchers found no clear link between drinking alcohol and developing multiple sclerosis, though a possible protective effect remains unproven.

30214214.conclusion_quote: NFL chain has significantly increased in MS patients, which substantially strengthens the clinical evidence of the NFL in MS.
30214214.summary: Pooled studies found higher levels of a nerve damage marker, neurofilament light, in spinal fluid and blood of people with MS, suggesting it could aid diagnosis.

30692710.conclusion_quote: Rule-based, fuzzy-logic and artificial neural network methods have had more applications in intelligent systems for the diagnosis of MS, respectively.
30692710.summary: A review of computer systems for diagnosing multiple sclerosis found that rules, fuzzy logic and neural networks were the most common methods, with neural networks most accurate.

25533300.conclusion_quote: Despite the relatively high prevalence of some vascular comorbidities in the MS population, important gaps exist in our understanding of their epidemiology.
25533300.summary: Review found high blood pressure and cholesterol are common in people with MS, and heart and stroke problems occur more often than in the general population.

25538150.conclusion_quote: Although they have been the subject of less study than other comorbidities, irritable bowel syndrome, arthritis, and chronic lung disease are common in the MS population and occur more often than expected when compared to the general population.
25538150.summary: Researchers reviewed published studies and found that bowel irritability, arthritis, and chronic lung disease are common in people with MS, more often than in the general population.

29176956.conclusion_quote: Higher efficacy treatments exert their benefit over lower efficacy treatments only during early stages of MS, and, after age 53, the model suggests that there is no predicted benefit to receiving immunomodulatory DMTs for the average MS patient.
29176956.summary: Pooling 38 trials, the authors found that MS drugs slow disability mainly in younger patients, with little predicted benefit after about age 53.

27447980.conclusion_quote: Collectively, there is insufficient well-designed research to definitively conclude that exercise, physical activity, and physical fitness are effective for improving cognition in MS.
27447980.summary: This review of 26 studies found conflicting evidence that exercise helps thinking and memory in people with MS, so more strong research is needed.

32014494.conclusion_quote: Other follow-up MRIs do not require contrast enhancement, provided current and previous MRI acquisitions follow the same standardized protocol including 3D FLAIR sequences.
32014494.summary: French experts recommend fewer gadolinium contrast scans when monitoring MS patients, using contrast only at diagnosis, treatment starts, and key checkpoints.

30473535.conclusion_quote: Thus, we conclude that ICAM1 rs5498 may not be related to the risk of multiple sclerosis in Caucasian or Asian populations, which still merits further research.
30473535.summary: A pooled analysis of 11 studies found a gene variant in ICAM1 weakly linked to lower multiple sclerosis risk, with no clear effect in Caucasian or Asian groups.

32763842.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of these consensus guidelines seek to optimize management and specific treatment of NMOSD patients in LATAM.
32763842.summary: Latin American neuromyelitis optica experts agreed on recommendations for diagnosing, treating and managing NMOSD patients in the region, to improve long-term outcomes.

27999521.conclusion_quote: Based on this small sample, the HADS-A shows promise as an applicable measure for people with MS.
27999521.summary: A review of four studies found that the Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale anxiety subscale may be the most accurate screening tool for MS, though evidence is limited.

26274821.conclusion_quote: Overall, this meta-analysis involved 3200 MS patients and 3069 matched healthy controls and it did not evidence significant association of the LILRA3 deletion [carriers of LILRA3 deletion: p = 0.25, OR (95% CI) = 1.07 (0.95-1.19)], even after stratification by gender and the HLA-DRB1*15:01 risk allele.
26274821.summary: This combined study of about 3200 people with MS and 3069 healthy controls found no link between the LILRA3 gene deletion and MS risk.

26421830.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis suggests that WBV training has potential in improving walking endurance in MS patients with low disability status.
26421830.summary: Seven small trials suggest whole body vibration training might improve walking endurance in people with mild MS, but the evidence is weak and more research is needed.

34138444.conclusion_quote: Existing DMT therapy should be continued at this time.
34138444.summary: Expert neurologists from the Arabian Gulf advise that most MS treatments are safe during COVID-19, so patients should keep their medicines and get vaccinated.

26409621.conclusion_quote: Despite convergence over time to a similar Markov structure, there are still significant discrepancies between health economic models of RRMS in the United Kingdom.
26409621.summary: Researchers reviewed UK economic models for relapsing MS drugs and found they are becoming more similar over time but still differ in assumptions and methods, limiting comparisons.

30833871.conclusion_quote: Evidence from this review is inconclusive regarding the effectiveness of nonpharmacologic interventions in reducing the severity and impact of fatigue in progressive MS populations.
30833871.summary: A review of 13 studies found that exercise, behavioural and rehabilitation programmes for fatigue in progressive MS had mixed results, so their benefit remains unclear.

29353550.conclusion_quote: The present guideline will enable homogeneity of treatment decisions across Europe.
29353550.summary: European experts produced 21 recommendations on drug treatment for multiple sclerosis, covering efficacy, safety, response criteria, poor response, and use during pregnancy, to guide doctors' treatment decisions.

33837163.conclusion_quote: Physical activity research in MS should include both analyzing the effects of exercise and the unique challenges faced by persons with MS in putting the PAGs into practice.
33837163.summary: Interviews with 40 people with MS found they saw the Canadian exercise guidelines as a good starting point but wanted clearer instructions on how to meet them.

30669146.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that psoriasis is significantly associated with an increased risk of developing MS.
30669146.summary: People with psoriasis appear to have a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, according to a pooled analysis of nine observational studies.

28457198.conclusion_quote: This synthesis of qualitative studies indicates that people with multiple sclerosis who experience cognitive deficits benefit from cognitive rehabilitation programmes.
28457198.summary: Reviewing seven qualitative studies, this paper found that people with MS with thinking problems felt cognitive rehabilitation helped their awareness, strategies, mood and quality of life.

31008714.conclusion_quote: To our knowledge, this will be the first comprehensive systematic review aiming to assess the effect of vitamin D supplements on clinical and para-clinical outcomes in patients with multiple sclerosis.
31008714.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of trials testing whether vitamin D supplements reduce MS relapses, MRI lesions, and inflammatory markers. No results are reported yet.

30381987.conclusion_quote: These quality standards for core, achievable and aspirational care provide MS teams with a three-level framework for service evaluation, benchmarking and improvement.
30381987.summary: Neurologists from 19 countries agreed on three levels of timely care standards for multiple sclerosis, covering diagnosis, treatment decisions, lifestyle and monitoring, to help teams improve care.

32123524.conclusion_quote: Following the PAGs for at least 12 of 16 weeks results in improvements in fitness, mobility, fatigue symptoms, and QOL, confirming their effectiveness for improving health in people with MS.
32123524.summary: People with MS who followed Canadian exercise guidelines for at least 12 of 16 weeks improved fitness, mobility, fatigue, and quality of life compared with those who did not.

27064875.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis demonstrates that the MCP-1 -2518 A/G polymorphism is not associated with susceptibility to vasculitis, RA, or MS.
27064875.summary: Researchers combined earlier studies and found that a variant in the MCP1 immune gene does not raise the risk of vasculitis, rheumatoid arthritis, or multiple sclerosis.

29774055.conclusion_quote: Immunotherapy of stroke might be effective and could become a promising treatment strategy, but larger clinical trials with standardized interventions and outcome measures are needed.
29774055.summary: Review of stroke studies testing MS drugs found most showed smaller brain damage and better recovery, but evidence is inconsistent and larger human trials are needed.

35913055.conclusion_quote: The goal is to facilitate efficient and comprehensive evaluation of patients with MS in the primary diagnostic workup and follow-up imaging.
35913055.summary: Researchers created standard report templates for brain and spinal cord MRI scans of people with multiple sclerosis, to make reports complete, consistent, and easier for doctors to use.

32089038.conclusion_quote: We, an expert group of physicians practising in Arabian Gulf countries, present pragmatic consensus recommendations for the use of disease-modifying therapy, according to the level of MS disease activity, according to objective criteria, and prior treatment (if any) received by a given patient.
32089038.summary: Doctors from Arabian Gulf countries wrote practical advice on choosing MS drugs that slow the disease, based on how active a patient's disease is and what treatments they have had before.

28602542.conclusion_quote: Exercise significantly improves depressive symptoms among people with multiple sclerosis.
28602542.summary: Pooling 14 studies, exercise reduced depressive symptoms in people with MS, and larger mood benefits occurred when exercise also improved fatigue.

25942344.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis indicates that CD24 P266-C/T polymorphism is more associated with the risk of MS than healthy controls.
25942344.summary: Pooling seven studies, this analysis found that a variant of the CD24 gene is linked to higher risk of multiple sclerosis, though more large studies are needed.

25561247.conclusion_quote: Very low quality evidence from one small, randomised trial did not show a statistically significant benefit from oral prednisone compared with no treatment.
25561247.summary: Weak evidence from two small trials did not clearly show whether steroid tablets help people with CIDP, a nerve disorder that is not multiple sclerosis.

27747156.conclusion_quote: Among the 14 genes of KIR in the human genome, lack of KIR2DS1 is accompanied by MS.
27747156.summary: A meta analysis of 568 MS patients and 280 controls found that lacking the KIR2DS1 gene is linked to MS, while no other KIR gene was a risk factor.

26656273.conclusion_quote: This meta-analysis provides strong evidence that EBV alone, HLA-DRB1*1501 alone or their interaction is associated with an elevated risks of MS.
26656273.summary: Pooling five studies, this analysis found that Epstein Barr virus infection and a specific gene variant each raise MS risk, and together they add extra risk on one measure.

26865523.conclusion_quote: Our recommendations will help address knowledge gaps regarding the incidence, prevalence, and effect of comorbidity on outcomes in MS.
26865523.summary: Experts agreed on which other health conditions to study in people with MS, how to measure how common they are, and how they affect MS outcomes.

26888986.conclusion_quote: Our recommendations will help address knowledge gaps regarding comorbidity that interfere with the ability to interpret safety in monitored trials and will enhance the generalizability of findings from clinical trials to "real world" settings where the MS population commonly has comorbid conditions.
26888986.summary: This consensus paper recommends that MS clinical trials account for other health conditions patients have, so results better reflect everyday patients and drug safety can be judged accurately.

31474810.conclusion_quote: This review provides preliminary evidence that FES has a positive effect on aspects of HRQOL in people with MS; however, the variety of HRQOL outcomes used makes it difficult to determine definitive conclusions.
31474810.summary: Reviewing eight studies, researchers found that functional electrical stimulation for foot drop likely improves quality of life for people with MS, though evidence is preliminary.

26314587.conclusion_quote: Results will inform future research on the perceived determinants and consequences of physical activity and exercise in those with MS and can be adopted for developing professional education and interventions for physical activity and exercise in MS.
26314587.summary: A review of 19 qualitative studies found that fatigue, fear, and lack of accessible facilities hinder exercise in MS, while exercise helps function, social life, and feelings of control.

25426773.conclusion_quote: WM damage is widespread in MS with differential and only minimally overlapping distributions of low FA that relates to physical disability and cognitive impairment.
25426773.summary: A brain imaging study combining 12 studies found widespread white matter damage in MS, linked to physical disability and especially to thinking problems.

29372069.conclusion_quote: Latent tuberculosis should be considered in patients with multiple sclerosis who are going to be treated with immunomodulatory and immunosuppressant medications.
29372069.summary: Experts agreed that people with multiple sclerosis should be screened for latent tuberculosis before starting certain immune system drugs, and their liver enzymes should be checked regularly.

27603119.conclusion_quote: MSFC is more sensitive than EDSS in detecting the progression of MS disease.
27603119.summary: This review of nine studies compared two disability scales used in MS trials and suggests the MSFC may detect disease progression better than the EDSS.

25405534.conclusion_quote: Our meta-analysis suggests that MS patients have reduced overall BMD compared with healthy controls.
25405534.summary: This review of 11 studies found adults with multiple sclerosis have weaker bones than healthy people, with longer disease, higher steroid use, and greater disability increasing the risk.

34086513.conclusion_quote: Our study provides support for the promotion of PA in persons with MS and the development of community-based programs adapted for people with MS.
34086513.summary: Participants in an exercise trial for people with MS reported better mood, knowledge, physical function and daily activity, especially when programs were supportive and included peers with MS.

30103172.conclusion_quote: Overall, this critical review shows that the methodological quality of CGs were moderate to good but physical activity-related content quality was heterogeneous and low.
30103172.summary: This review found that MS clinical guidelines are generally well written, but their advice on physical activity is inconsistent and often weak.

29536270.conclusion_quote: In this paper, we report the consensus protocol of this working party on autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in multiple sclerosis.
29536270.summary: Belgian experts agreed a standard protocol for stem cell transplantation in people with multiple sclerosis whose disease does not respond to standard treatments, to guide care and data collection.

25830931.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this meta-analysis suggests that the CD24 Ala57Val polymorphism is associated with an increased risk of MS in Caucasians.
25830931.summary: A pooled analysis of studies found that carrying two copies of the CD24 Val variant is linked to higher multiple sclerosis risk in people of European descent.

31423899.conclusion_quote: Content and construct validity are established for Rasch-based MAL-18 for chronic stages of stroke and MS.
31423899.summary: Researchers created a shorter version with 18 items of a questionnaire that rates arm and hand movement quality after stroke or MS, and found it reliable and valid.

30035845.conclusion_quote: It was the key for the formulation of the 10 guideline questions and for the identification of patient-important outcomes.
30035845.summary: Patients and carers helped shape questions for a European palliative care guideline for severe MS. Their input took time but was valuable, and it identified outcomes patients care about.

32419748.conclusion_quote: The aim of the present consensus expert opinion document is to appraise the potential concerns when managing our patients with underlying CNS autoimmune demyelinating disorders during the current COVID-19 pandemic.
32419748.summary: Indian neurology experts give advice on managing patients with MS and similar brain conditions who take immune suppressing medicines during the COVID pandemic.

29380254.conclusion_quote: Complete blood counts with differential should be obtained prior to initiation of treatment and at monthly intervals thereafter for 48 months after the last infusion.
29380254.summary: Alemtuzumab raises the risk of a blood platelet disorder called immune thrombocytopenia, so Belgian experts recommend regular blood tests for four years after treatment.

33362684.conclusion_quote: These expert consensus guidelines aim to address this unmet need by summarizing the evidence-base for AHSCT in MS and providing recommendations for current rehabilitation practice along with identifying areas for future research and development.
33362684.summary: Experts created guidance on how patients should be rehabilitated before and after stem cell transplant for MS, to help them regain function and quality of life.

28306712.conclusion_quote: We concluded cannabinoids in multiple sclerosis do not reduce spasticity or pain, and are probably associated to frequent adverse effects.
28306712.summary: Cannabinoids did not reduce spasticity or pain in multiple sclerosis and probably cause frequent side effects, according to a review of 35 studies.

26064692.conclusion_quote: When explored, relevant correlation between improved function and MRI-detected brain changes was often found, supporting the hypothesis that training-induced brain plasticity is specifically linked to the trained domain.
26064692.summary: This review of studies found that motor and cognitive training, often using video games, was linked to changes in brain structure and activity in people with MS.

30886530.conclusion_quote: The data evaluated in this systematic review provide evidence for the efficacy and safety of THC:CBD in clinical practice and confirm results obtained in RCTs.
30886530.summary: Real-world studies of a cannabis-based spray, THC:CBD, found it reduced muscle stiffness in people with MS and was generally well tolerated, matching trial results.

31162319.conclusion_quote: Ultimately, cost-effective care in MS relates to using appropriate medicines in patients with active MS, ensuring adherence, and careful monitoring.
31162319.summary: A hypothetical patient case explains how following MS treatment guidelines, correct diagnosis, and quality measures can make care both effective and affordable.

29500681.conclusion_quote: The article Management of immune thrombocytopenia in multiple sclerosis patients treated with alemtuzumab: a Belgian consensus, written by Lambert et al., was originally published electronically on the publisher's internet portal on 27 January 2018 without open access.
29500681.summary: This is a correction notice for a Belgian consensus on managing low platelet counts in people with MS treated with alemtuzumab, which was first published without open access.

30447859.conclusion_quote: The recommended protocol aims to improve the imaging procedure and, most importantly, to standardize conducting MRI scans in all MRI departments.
30447859.summary: Polish radiology experts publish updated guidelines on how to perform brain MRI scans in multiple sclerosis, so that scans are consistent across hospitals and monitoring is reliable.

29372482.conclusion_quote: However, practical clinical guidance in case of abnormal thyroid-related findings prior to or after alemtuzumab treatment is currently lacking.
29372482.summary: Belgian experts created a practical plan for managing thyroid problems in people with MS treated with alemtuzumab, since such guidance was previously lacking.

26971321.conclusion_quote: HL displays considerable genetic overlap with MS and other autoimmune diseases.
26971321.summary: Genetic analysis found that Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple sclerosis share inherited risk factors, mainly in the immune gene region.

29263835.conclusion_quote: A meta-analysis of publicly available summary statistics on multiple sclerosis combined with three Nordic multiple sclerosis cohorts (21,079 cases, 371,198 controls) revealed seven sequence variants associating with multiple sclerosis, not reported previously.
29263835.summary: Researchers combined large genetic datasets and found seven new gene variants linked to multiple sclerosis risk, many near immune-related genes.

29189966.conclusion_quote: This article presents the consensus of Belgian MS specialists and nephrologists on the practicalities of diagnosis, management, and treatment of alemtuzumab-associated renal adverse events based on good clinical practice.
29189966.summary: Belgian MS and kidney specialists agreed on practical steps to detect, manage and treat kidney problems caused by alemtuzumab, a drug for relapsing multiple sclerosis.

31110181.conclusion_quote: Our analysis identifies pan immune cell as well as cell-specific susceptibility genes in T cells, B cells and monocytes.
31110181.summary: Researchers combined genetic data from multiple sclerosis studies to find which immune cells, such as T cells, B cells and monocytes, carry genes linked to disease risk.

27207450.conclusion_quote: We report shared genetic pathways in different MS-GWAS datasets and highlight some new MS risk pathways.
27207450.summary: Researchers combined genetic and gene activity data from several MS studies and found shared biological pathways linked to MS risk, many confirmed across datasets.

28757204.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we describe a low-frequency CYP2R1 coding variant that exerts the largest effect upon 25OHD levels identified to date in the general European population and implicates vitamin D in the etiology of multiple sclerosis.
28757204.summary: A rare genetic variant in the CYP2R1 gene strongly lowers vitamin D levels and is linked to higher multiple sclerosis risk, supporting a role for vitamin D.

26856944.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the data indicate that cholesterol and markers of cholesterol turnover have potential to be used clinically as biomarkers of disease activity and may even be implicated in the pathogenesis of MS.
26856944.summary: A review found that higher blood cholesterol and related markers linked to worse MS disease activity and MRI findings, suggesting they could serve as biomarkers.

26896783.conclusion_quote: Consensus recommendations have been developed to guide local neurologists on the diagnosis and treatment of patients with MS.
26896783.summary: Neurologists in Kuwait agreed on guidance for diagnosing MS using the 2010 McDonald criteria and choosing treatments based on individual risk and benefit.

25583848.conclusion_quote: Our results support the continuing efforts to identify unknown genetic factors that fill the gap of 'missing heritability'; moreover, a 'missing environmentality' deserves future investigations into the role of non-heritable components that act as both shared and individual-specific exposures.
25583848.summary: Combining eight twin studies, researchers estimated that genes explain about half of MS risk, while shared and personal environments explain the rest, pointing to unknown environmental factors.

28587380.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the present meta-analysis suggested that anti-B-cell mAbs are a relatively effective and safe treatment for MS.
28587380.summary: This pooled analysis of four trials found that treatments targeting B cells reduced brain scan inflammation and relapses without increasing side effects.

27881095.conclusion_quote: BVL was considered to be a useful measurement to longitudinally assess disease progression and cognitive function in patients with MS.
27881095.summary: This expert panel agreed that measuring brain shrinkage over time is useful for tracking MS progression and thinking skills, and should be added to NEDA.

27209163.conclusion_quote: Although the results of high power studies are not available, correcting vitamin D status seems plausible in all MS and CIS patients.
27209163.summary: Iranian neurologists recommend checking vitamin D levels in MS patients and supplementing those with low levels, aiming to keep levels between 40 and 100 ng/ml.

29109506.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that epigenetic modifications may reveal the link between a modifiable risk factor and the pathogenetic mechanisms.
29109506.summary: Smoking changed blood DNA methylation in people with MS, with larger changes tied to smoking amount and genetic risk, hinting at how smoking may affect the disease.

32893778.conclusion_quote: This article aims to present the state-of-the-art and provide guidance based on the best level of available evidence and expert opinion regarding the management of multiple sclerosis patients at different stages: pregnancy planning, pregnancy, partum, and the postpartum period.
32893778.summary: This Portuguese expert consensus gives practical advice for women with multiple sclerosis on planning pregnancy, managing disease-modifying medicines, and care after birth and breastfeeding.

26537743.conclusion_quote: Escalation of attack therapy improves outcome.
26537743.summary: Retrospective study of 185 neuromyelitis optica patients found that stronger, escalating attack treatments improved recovery, while myelitis and bilateral optic neuritis recovered poorly.

30554040.conclusion_quote: While age at onset is a factor that cannot be controlled in NMOSD, we can reduce the delay in diagnosis/preventive treatment and reduce future relapses in the brain/brainstem and spinal cord.
30554040.summary: In 182 NMOSD patients with spinal cord inflammation, greater disability was linked to older age at onset, delayed diagnosis or preventive treatment, longer spinal lesions, and symptomatic brain lesions.

30931029.conclusion_quote: Aquatic exercises may be effective at improving balance impairment in patients with hemiplegia and multiple sclerosis.
30931029.summary: Water-based exercise appeared to improve balance and, for some people with MS, walking. Evidence for Parkinson's disease was too limited to draw conclusions.

29181199.conclusion_quote: Aerobic exercise improves walking ability in PwMS.
29181199.summary: Aerobic exercise appears to improve walking in people with MS, though benefits were not consistently kept after follow up and effects on nerve growth proteins remain unclear.

27684943.conclusion_quote: Indirect analyses of RCT data and head-to-head comparisons of observational findings indicate that NTZ may be more effective than FGD in terms of disease activity reduction in patients with RRMS.
27684943.summary: Pooling existing studies, natalizumab appeared to reduce relapses and disease activity more than fingolimod in relapsing MS, though direct trials are still needed to confirm this.

28230962.conclusion_quote: Progression of MS may vary with modifiable risk factors.
28230962.summary: This review examined changeable risk factors linked to faster MS progression and whether targeting them could slow the disease down.

28084646.conclusion_quote: Plasma exchange produces short-term improvement in impairment as determined by neurological examination, and probably produces short-term improvement in disability.
28084646.summary: A review of treatments for the nerve disease CIDP found that plasma exchange and immunoglobulin infusions help in the short term, while evidence for steroids and other drugs is weak.

27834394.conclusion_quote: On the basis of a thorough review of the existing literature on the CVS and the consensus opinion of the members of the North American Imaging in Multiple Sclerosis (NAIMS) Cooperative, this article provides statements and recommendations aimed at helping radiologists and neurologists to better understand, refine, standardize and evaluate the CVS in the diagnosis of MS.
27834394.summary: Experts reviewed the research and agreed on recommendations to help doctors use an MRI check for veins inside brain lesions to diagnose multiple sclerosis more consistently.

28116160.conclusion_quote: Nephelometric assays for KFLC in CSF reliably detect intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis and discriminate MS patients.
28116160.summary: A test measuring free light chains in spinal fluid reliably detected immune activity in the brain and distinguished people with multiple sclerosis from others.

29103086.conclusion_quote: The obtained reference segmentations may represent a more precise target to evaluate, compare against and also train, the automatic segmentations.
29103086.summary: Researchers created a public brain MRI dataset of 30 MS patients, with lesion outlines agreed by three experts, to help test automated lesion detection methods.

27456872.conclusion_quote: While recognizing that policy is not static in any country, we believe that patients' interests would be better served if a European treatment guideline was developed.
27456872.summary: This review compares how European countries start and switch MS treatments and argues that a shared European treatment guideline would benefit patients.

26819262.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that apart from the confirmed HLA region, the association of anti-EBNA-1 IgG titer with MS risk is also mediated through non-HLA genes, and that studies aimed at identifying genetic loci influencing EBNA immune response provides a novel opportunity to identify new and characterize existing genetic risk factors for MS.
26819262.summary: Genetic variants that influence antibody levels against EBV also affect multiple sclerosis risk, both inside and outside the immune HLA region.

27916699.conclusion_quote: The results support the feasibility and acceptability of a home-based exercise intervention based on physical activity guidelines and supplemented with behavioural strategies for adults with mild-to-moderate MS.
27916699.summary: A small trial found that a home exercise program with coaching was practical and acceptable for people with mild to moderate MS, and participants reported exercising more.

26537494.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrated that BVL is associated with declines in cognition in MS patients across several cognition measures.
26537494.summary: Researchers reviewed 18 studies and found that greater loss of brain volume in people with MS is linked to worse thinking and memory test scores.

27599780.conclusion_quote: This project provides a consensus checklist gathering necessary information when considering multiple sclerosis treatment in newly diagnosed patients.
27599780.summary: Spanish experts agreed on a 48-item checklist of information to gather from newly diagnosed multiple sclerosis patients before starting treatment.

29744874.conclusion_quote: Applying the IPMSSG criteria to all children with a diagnosis of ADEM leaves 65 per cent of the cases without a diagnosis and lowers the incidence rate of paediatric ADEM.
29744874.summary: Researchers in Denmark studied 52 children with a brain inflammation condition called ADEM. Only a third met strict diagnostic criteria, and none later developed MS.

27390706.conclusion_quote: IVIG can be considered as an alternative therapeutic option, second-line therapy or adjuvant therapy, considering its beneficial effects (high tolerance, need to be injected with longer intervals, etc.) for treating relapsing-remitting MS patients.
27390706.summary: Intravenous immunoglobulin reduced relapses and improved outcomes in relapsing MS compared with placebo, with no clear change in disability scores.

27558404.conclusion_quote: The aim of this consensus statement is to provide practical advice for the use of MRI in this setting.
27558404.summary: A Swedish expert panel created practical recommendations on when and how doctors should use MRI scans to diagnose and monitor multiple sclerosis.

27572866.conclusion_quote: In addition, proposals are made for definitions of no evidence of disease activity and inadequate treatment response that are important because of new therapeutic options and trials.
27572866.summary: Experts reviewed the 2012 pediatric MS definitions and the 2010 McDonald criteria, and proposed new ways to define when children's disease is inactive or treatment is not working.

26039748.conclusion_quote: With similar efficacy compared to other RRMS treatments in terms of annualized relapse rate and 3- and 6-month CDP, a promising safety profile, and up to 93% reduction in number of injections (which may improve adherence), PEG-IFN every 2 weeks offers a valuable alternative treatment option for patients with RRMS.
26039748.summary: Pooled analysis of past trials suggests a biweekly injection of peginterferon works about as well as other MS injections, needing far fewer doses.

27331013.conclusion_quote: The mutant alleles of EVI5 rs11808092 polymorphism may increase the susceptibility to MS while those of CD58 rs2300747 polymorphism may decrease MS risk.
27331013.summary: Gene variants in EVI5 appear to raise multiple sclerosis risk, while a CD58 variant may lower it, and a CIITA variant showed no link.

28360957.conclusion_quote: In most cases of "safe" bladder, behavioural treatment is considered first-line defense.
28360957.summary: Most people with MS develop bladder problems over time, and treatment is tailored to each person, starting with behaviour changes and medicines, then options like injections or nerve stimulation.

29958016.conclusion_quote: People with MS should be provided with information on how to manage their fatigue alongside any exercise prescription.
29958016.summary: People with MS who do not exercise named tiredness, lack of support, and physical symptoms as main barriers, and suggested exercising with others and having support as solutions.

32561334.conclusion_quote: Vaccination in patients who are candidates for immunosuppressive therapy should be considered before starting immunosuppressive treatment providing the patient's clinical situation allows.
32561334.summary: Spanish experts recommend vaccinating adults with multiple sclerosis before starting immunosuppressive drugs, and avoiding live vaccines once those drugs have begun.

25946578.conclusion_quote: The purpose of these guidelines is to provide practical recommendations and algorithms for the diagnosis and treatment of MS based on current scientific evidence and clinical experience.
25946578.summary: Expert consensus recommendations update how multiple sclerosis is diagnosed and treated, covering relapses, early stages, and the different progressive forms, using current evidence and clinical experience.

28446795.conclusion_quote: In all, IL7RA locus polymorphisms could play an important role in the predisposition to MS, which could contribute to a better understanding the pathogenesis of multiple sclerosis.
28446795.summary: Combining 27 studies found that three variants in the IL7RA gene are linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, while another variant showed no link.

28443147.conclusion_quote: Each patient should be evaluated uniquely, after taking into account his/her symptoms, disease course and length, comorbidities, physical status, and medications.
28443147.summary: Nearly 90% of people with MS have bladder problems, which usually appear years after diagnosis. Each patient needs individual assessment, with urodynamic testing as the key advanced investigation.

27974107.conclusion_quote: These become more operable in clinical diagnosis and treatment of multiple sclerosis and other immune-mediated demyelinating diseases of the central nervous system in children.
27974107.summary: This article explains the 2012 international consensus criteria for diagnosing multiple sclerosis and related inflammatory nerve diseases in children, making them easier to use in clinics.

24990077.conclusion_quote: This study provides the first review of the UK evidence base of experiences of health care for MS.
24990077.summary: A review of five qualitative studies found that UK multiple sclerosis patients' care experiences centred on emotions, continuity of care, access, and professional support, though the studies were weak.

28937037.summary: This is a correction notice for a Chinese guideline on diagnosing and treating tumefactive demyelinating lesions, a rare brain lesion type that is not specific to multiple sclerosis.

30326184.conclusion_quote: Efforts are needed to improve long-term tailored treatment and home treatment to reduce economic costs.
30326184.summary: French neurologists mostly followed guidelines when giving intravenous immunoglobulin to patients with two rare nerve diseases, but long-term and home treatment need improvement.

28352806.conclusion_quote: With current evidence, CTLA-4 gene rs221775A>G single nucleotide polymorphism had no association with the susceptibility of multiple sclerosis.
28352806.summary: Pooling 20 studies, a common variant of the CTLA4 gene was not linked to a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis.

27941510.summary: This protocol describes a planned review of whether internet-based programmes can help people with multiple sclerosis become more physically active and how they experience them.

28070374.conclusion_quote: Future studies should consider the use of prospective design with self-reported evaluations and the study of moderators and mediators related to amount of stress and autonomic nervous system reactivity to determine the effects of stress on multiple sclerosis.
28070374.summary: Reviewing 23 studies, researchers found stress links to MS onset and progression, with diaries and interviews giving the most consistent results.

26655434.conclusion_quote: This trial serves to inform development of Phase II and III RCTs which can determine the actual efficacy and effectiveness of home-based exercise based on the MS-specific physical activity guidelines for improving symptoms and HRQOL.
26655434.summary: This study describes the design of a trial testing whether an exercise program done at home is practical and helpful for people with multiple sclerosis.

27014514.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated that exposure to smoking is an important risk factor for MS.
27014514.summary: Combining many studies, this analysis found that smokers, especially men and current smokers, have a higher chance of developing multiple sclerosis, and passive smoking also raises risk.

25660217.conclusion_quote: The new OFSEP protocol will provide a unique opportunity to study a population-based collection of data from people with MS.
25660217.summary: French researchers created a standard brain and spinal cord MRI scan protocol for a national registry of about 41,000 people with MS, so scans can be compared across centres.

28659856.conclusion_quote: We can conclude that RAGT can bring more benefits on improving 6MWT among MS patients, but it is not enough to make a clinically significance conclusion.
28659856.summary: Robot-assisted gait training improved endurance on a six minute walk test in people with MS more than usual walking therapy, but balance and other walking measures showed no clear difference.

27787630.conclusion_quote: MS specialists should consider BT therapy for symptomatic treatment of spasticity.
27787630.summary: A task force review of 55 publications found that botulinum toxin injections appear effective and safe for muscle stiffness in MS, so specialists should consider them.

25139943.conclusion_quote: In MS, cervical cord atrophy already occurs in CIS.
25139943.summary: Early MS patients already showed a thinner upper neck spinal cord than healthy people, and uneven cord structure may be a better warning sign.

28607695.conclusion_quote: The Canadian recommendations update the 2006 Consortium of MS Centers Consensus revised guidelines to assist physicians in their management of MS patients and to aid in treatment decision making.
28607695.summary: Canadian experts recommend how to use brain and spinal cord MRI scans to track how well relapsing MS patients respond to treatment, including when to schedule follow up scans.

28699154.conclusion_quote: The recommendations of this consensus guidelines attempts to optimize the health care and management of patients with MS in Venezuela.
28699154.summary: Experts in Venezuela agreed on seventeen recommendations for using MRI scans when diagnosing and monitoring multiple sclerosis patients in their country.

29525396.conclusion_quote: The effectiveness of commercial video game therapy for improving postural balance in patients with MS is limited.
29525396.summary: Commercial video games gave people with MS only limited balance benefits, with no clear gains in walking or stepping tests.

27445888.conclusion_quote: The results indicate that mindfulness-based interventions may relieve fatigue in neurological conditions such as stroke, TBI, and MS.
27445888.summary: Researchers pooled four trials of mindfulness training in people with stroke, brain injury or MS and found it moderately reduced fatigue.

26526385.conclusion_quote: DMF is an effective and well tolerated therapy for RRMS.
26526385.summary: Pooled data from two large drug trials found that delayed-release dimethyl fumarate reduced relapses needing steroid drips and reduced hospital stays for people with relapsing MS.

28103520.conclusion_quote: Results show that health promotion programs for persons with MS can improve physical activity and related constructs.
28103520.summary: Thirteen people with MS took part in an eight-week health education program to encourage exercise. Most attended regularly, and participants reported more confidence and physical activity afterward.

27694484.conclusion_quote: A 46-item instrument developed in accordance with international PROM development guidelines through literature review, developed by subject matter experts and refined through pretesting examining content validity provides a preliminary measure for assessing patient-report of health status in NMO.
27694484.summary: Researchers created a questionnaire of 46 questions for people with neuromyelitis optica to report their own health, refined through patient interviews.

27349050.conclusion_quote: The recent studies from the literature clearly have proven the efficacy and safety of interferon beta treatment in children.
27349050.summary: This review says interferon beta is the first choice drug for treating multiple sclerosis in children, and recent studies show it works and is safe for them.

27579581.conclusion_quote: In most cases, a single therapy is not sufficient to treat pain, and a multidisciplinary approach, which include pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatments is needed.
27579581.summary: Experts reviewed evidence on pain in stroke, MS, cerebral palsy, spinal cord injury and spasticity, finding that pain treatment usually needs several combined approaches.

27157522.conclusion_quote: This consensus statement includes treatment recommendations for a wide range of demyelinating diseases, from isolated demyelinating syndromes to the different forms of multiple sclerosis, as well as recommendations for initial therapy and changes in drug medication, and additional comments on induction and combined therapy and practical aspects of the use of these drugs.
27157522.summary: Spanish neurologists issued updated guidance on treating multiple sclerosis, covering approved drugs, when to start them, follow-up, switching medications, and special situations.

25912471.conclusion_quote: Despite the limitations of the study, we think it is advisable that when a group becomes involved in the development of CPGs that they follow with the development of assessment criteria in order to evaluate the validity as well as their character as intermediate indicators of the quality of practices.
25912471.summary: Audits of 17 MS neurology departments found compliance with new care guidelines varied widely between sites, with poor record keeping and lack of time or resources as common causes.

24852923.conclusion_quote: There is a need for patient and cohort specific monitoring procedures.
24852923.summary: Researchers tested two updated MRI rules for flagging risky lesion increases in MS trials. Both predicted relapses about as well as the original rule, suggesting monitoring should be tailored.

26204085.conclusion_quote: In accordance with SEN 2010 guidelines, the majority of patients from the study had an adequate clinical response.
26204085.summary: A review of 218 Spanish patients found most had a good response to their MS drugs, and many with a poor response stayed on the same treatment.

42963036.conclusion_quote: Limited but convergent preclinical evidence suggests ES may enhance remyelination by modulating neuronal and inflammatory pathways.
42963036.summary: A review of animal studies found that electrical stimulation of the brain, vagus nerve, or peripheral nerves improved myelin repair in models of multiple sclerosis.

42610722.conclusion_quote: Family planning counselling should become part of routine MS care.
42610722.summary: Polish neurology and obstetric societies advise that women with MS can plan pregnancy and breastfeed, with individualized treatment decisions and joint care between specialists.
